title: Blackstone Credit & Insurance - Infrastructure Credit, Senior Associate
description:
Blackstone is the world’s largest alternative asset manager. Blackstone seeks to deliver compelling returns for institutional and individual investors by strengthening the companies in which the firm invests. Blackstone’s over $1.3 trillion in assets under management include global investment strategies focused on real estate, private equity, credit, infrastructure, life sciences, growth equity, secondaries and hedge funds. Further information is available at . Follow @blackstone on LinkedIn, X (Twitter), and Instagram.

Blackstone Credit & Insurance

Blackstone Credit & Insurance (“BXCI”) is one of the world’s leading credit investors. Our investments span the credit markets, including private investment grade, asset based lending, public investment grade and high yield, infrastructure debt, collateralized loan obligations, direct lending and opportunistic credit. We seek to generate attractive risk-adjusted returns for institutional and individual investors by offering companies capital needed to strengthen and grow their businesses. BXCI is also a leading provider of investment management services for insurers, helping those companies better deliver for policyholders through our world-class capabilities in investment grade private credit.

Job Description/Responsibilities:

Associates and Senior Associates within the Infrastructure & Asset Based Credit team will have the opportunity to participate in all aspects of the investment process from origination through execution, with responsibilities including financial analysis and modeling, transaction structuring, industry research and competitive analysis, and drafting memoranda for internal and external use. The volume of transactions and structure of deal teams require significant sharing of responsibility and ownership of work products. The role can be based in New York City or Houston.

Qualifications:
Blackstone seeks to hire individuals who are highly motivated, intelligent, and have demonstrated excellence in prior endeavors. In addition to strong analytical and quantitative skills, the successful candidate should have:

  • 2+ years of relevant work experience in investment banking, private equity or private credit

  • Experience analyzing financial statements and conducting due diligence

  • Exceptional financial modeling and analytical skills

  • Strong organizational and process management skills

  • Proven track record of collaborating effectively in fast-paced investment environments, with excellent communication, teamwork, and problem-solving skills


The duties and responsibilities described here are not exhaustive and additional assignments, duties, or responsibilities may be required of this position. Assignments, duties, and responsibilities may be changed at any time, with or without notice, by Blackstone in its sole discretion.

Expected annual base salary range:

$150,000 - $200,000

Actual base salary within that range will be determined by several components including but not limited to the individual's experience, skills, qualifications and job location. For roles located outside of the US, please disregard the posted salary bands as these roles will follow a separate compensation process based on local market comparables.

Additional compensation and benefits offered in connection with the role consist of comprehensive health benefits, including but not limited to medical, dental, vision, and FSA benefits; paid time off; life insurance; 401(k) plan; and discretionary bonuses. Certain employees may also be eligible for equity and other incentive compensation at Blackstone’s sole discretion.

Blackstone is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, sex, pregnancy, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, marital or partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, genetic predisposition, veteran or military status, status as a victim of domestic violence, a sex offense or stalking, or any other class or status in accordance with applicable federal, state and local laws. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including but not limited to hiring, placement, promotion, termination, transfer, leave of absence, compensation, and training. All Blackstone employees, including but not limited to recruiting personnel and hiring managers, are required to abide by this policy.

If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application, please contact Human Resources at 212-583-5000 (US), +44 (0)20 7451 4000 (EMEA) or +852 3656 8600 (APAC).

title: Solution Architect, New Zealand Enterprise
description:
- Do you love tackling new business challenges using leading edge technology?
- Do you want to help NZ Enterprises realize the potential of Agentic AI?
- Are you curious by nature and enjoy experimentation to create innovative solutions?
- Do you want to work somewhere in which you can collaborate and share ideas to enable technology adoption at pace and at scale?

AWS Enterprise Solutions Architects are trusted advisors to our customers, helping them solve some of their largest business challenges by designing and advising on some of the most scalable, flexible and resilient solutions in the world.
Working closely with internal teams at AWS, you’ll identify how our customers push the boundaries and how we can improve our services to obsess over our customers.

Being a thought leader who creates and presents content you’ll help all of our customers scale and grow in non-linear ways, using AWS as their building blocks.

In this role, you will push technology boundaries and help scale some of the largest companies in New Zealand. You will have the opportunity to partner with customers in their AI and cloud journey to have visible and measurable impact in their growth ambitions.

You will test traditional thinking by pushing the boundaries for your customers and AWS to dream and deliver beyond what they think is possible.

Our customers’ needs are moving fast, so you will too. Be part of the team helping our largest customers find innovative and transformative ways to reinvent their business!

Key job responsibilities
- Work directly with customers to accelerate their business outcomes and recommend best-practice cloud and AI architectures in line with their long-term business needs.
- Drive technical solutions discussions with your customers, diving deep into the details to solve complex technical problems and use your knowledge to craft scalable, flexible, and resilient cloud architectures.
- Scope and own customer engagements, with attention towards clear and well-defined objectives and success criteria.
- Define and execute on the strategy by engaging highly technical teams (Solutions Architects, Technical Account Managers, AWS professional services consultants and consulting/managed services partners).
- Act as a thought leader in the wider community, playing a key role in educating, sharing best practices, presenting at events, writing white papers, blogs, and running workshops.
- Share the voice of the customer to influence the roadmap of new features and services for the AWS platform. Proactively work within the organization to influence the evolution of the platform.


A day in the life
Our solutions architects are experienced technologists with technical breadth and depth coupled with strong interpersonal skills. The variety of customers is huge as we work across all industries within our Enterprise segment, like retail, telecommunications, media and entertainment to name a few. On a daily basis you will work alongside people who are leading the way in designing cloud bases architecture. We are the trusted advisor to our customers, so challenge our customers to think differently, learn more build elegant, transformative solutions!

About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

title: Staff Cyber Security Engineer
description:
Job Description Summary

We are seeking an experienced Senior Security Engineer to lead and execute security architecture, design, vulnerability management, and risk analysis across both cloud and on‑premises environments. This role is responsible for ensuring secure‑by‑design implementations, proactive risk identification, and continuous improvement of the enterprise security posture across platforms, infrastructure, and applications.
Key Responsibilities
Security Architecture & Design

Design, review, and govern security architectures for cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP) and on‑prem infrastructure.
Ensure alignment with enterprise security standards, threat models, and regulatory requirements.
Provide security design guidance for new platforms, applications, and services.
Participate in architecture and design reviews to identify risks early and recommend mitigations.

Cloud & Infrastructure Security

Implement and manage cloud security controls including IAM, network security, data protection, logging, and monitoring.
Secure on‑prem environments including servers, networks, virtualization platforms, and hybrid integrations.
Support secure configuration baselines and hardening standards for cloud and on‑prem systems.

Vulnerability Management

Own and drive the vulnerability management lifecycle, including discovery, triage, risk scoring, remediation guidance, and verification.
Analyze scan results and penetration test findings to determine true risk and business impact.
Partner with engineering and infrastructure teams to prioritize remediation efforts.

Risk Analysis & Threat Modeling

Perform security risk assessments, threat modeling, and impact analysis for systems and services.
Translate technical findings into clear risk statements and actionable recommendations.
Support ongoing risk tracking and reporting for leadership and audit readiness.

Security Operations & Governance

Contribute to incident response investigations from a technical analysis perspective.
Support compliance initiatives (e.g., ISO, SOC, HIPAA, IEC 62304, NIST) by providing technical evidence and assessments.
Develop and maintain security standards, patterns, and reference architectures.

Required Qualifications

8–12 years of experience in cyber security engineering, with hands‑on expertise in both cloud and on‑prem environments.
Strong experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and associated security services.
Proven background in security architecture, design reviews, and infrastructure security.
Hands‑on experience with vulnerability scanning tools, risk assessment methodologies, and remediation processes.
Solid understanding of network security, operating system security, and identity and access management.
Strong analytical and communication skills, with the ability to explain security risks to both technical and non‑technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working in regulated environments (healthcare, medical devices, finance, or similar).
Familiarity with security frameworks and standards such as NIST, ISO 27001, CIS, OWASP.
Experience with container and Kubernetes security.
Security certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, CISM, or equivalent.
Experience supporting hybrid or large‑scale enterprise environments.

Receives, collects, preserves, stores, and maintains chain-of-custody of property and evidence collected or received from officers, investigators or technicians. Work may be required on weekends and holidays. This classification is an entry-level evidence technician in the Sheriff’s Department.

Essential Functions:


As defined under the Americans with Disabilities Act, this classification may include any of the following tasks, knowledge, skills, and other characteristics. This list is ILLUSTRATIVE ONLY and is not a comprehensive listing of all functions and tasks performed by incumbents of this class. Work assignments may vary depending on the department’s need and will be communicated to the applicant or incumbent by the supervisor.

  • Takes custody of property and evidence from officers, investigators or technicians under a variety of environmental and physical conditions which may include unpleasant sights and smells or adverse weather conditions:

  • Documents receipt, authorized transfers and disposition of all items in custody;

  • Catalogs, labels, tags, packages, stores and retrieves evidence and property;

  • Travels to departmental substations, crime scenes and laboratories to take custody and transport items of evidence;

  • Safely and correctly handles potentially hazardous materials encountered in performance of assigned duties;

  • Maintains chain of custody of all property and evidence received and provides access only to authorized personnel;

  • Grants temporary custody of property and evidence to authorized persons for laboratory testing, court appearances or other authorized purposes;

  • Advises law enforcement personnel, attorneys and others on procedures of evidence and authorization for release of property;

  • Disposes of property and evidence by release, sale or destruction after adjudication and maintains records of disposal;

  • Checks items received against information available on multi-agency computer information system for registered owner information;

  • Takes custody of and secures seized vehicles;

  • Testifies in court as to chain of custody for property and evidence;

  • Packages and prepares evidence for shipment to owners or out-of-state laboratories;

  • Photographs property prior to release or destruction and completes associated paperwork.

Two years of experience as an inventory control clerk in a law enforcement setting.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Data Engineering
description:

Job Description:

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

Job Summary

We are looking for a highly motivated and experienced Data Engineer to join our data engineering team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in building scalable data pipelines using the AWS cloud stack and extensive hands-on experience with Snowflake. Proficiency in Python and SQL, along with graph and vector database technologies, is essential. This role requires strong problem-solving abilities and a proactive mindset to deliver efficient, scalable, and reliable data solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines on AWS using services such as S3, Glue, Lambda, Redshift, and EMR.
  • Build and optimize data warehousing solutions using Snowflake, including performance tuning and data modeling.
  • Write efficient and reusable code in Python and SQL for data transformation and processing.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including data scientists, analysts, and business stakeholders, to understand data requirements.
  • Integrate vector databases with LLM-based applications and AI workflows.
  • Monitor, troubleshoot, and improve pipeline performance and reliability.
  • Ensure data quality, integrity, and security across all stages of the pipeline.
  • Participate in code reviews, architecture discussions, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in data engineering or related roles.
  • Strong hands-on experience with AWS cloud services, including data and AI workloads.
  • Deep understanding of Snowflake architecture, performance tuning, and best practices.
  • Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL for data pipelines, transformations, and services.
  • Hands-on experience with graph databases (e.g., Neo4j, Neptune) and vector databases (e.g., Milvus, Amazon OpenSearch).
  • Experience with version control systems (e.g., Git) and Git workflows.
  • Experience working with Azure DevOps (AzDO) boards for backlog management in Agile environments.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong communication and collaboration abilities.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

Nice to Have skills

  • Knowledge of the NVIDIA ecosystem and its applications in data and AI.
  • Exposure to RAPIDS libraries (cuDF, cuML, cuGraph) or CUDA-based tooling for GPU-accelerated data processing, enabling faster transformation and optimization during large-scale ingestion workflows.
  • Hands-on expertise with vector databases, specifically Milvus, covering schema design, indexing, and optimizing write performance for large-scale embedding ingestion pipelines.
  • Proficiency in building Knowledge Graph (Neo4J) ingestion pipelines using Graph Databases — including entity extraction, relationship modelling, and populating nodes and attributes.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with orchestration tools such as AWS Step Functions.
  • Familiarity with data governance and compliance practices.
  • Exposure to real-time data processing frameworks (e.g., Kafka, Spark Streaming).

This position requires working onsite five days a week.

Relocation is available for this position.

title: Partner - Commercial
description:

Here at BNZ, it's about more than just banking. We work together in an agile, energising environment to create innovative solutions through our promise "If you can imagine a better future, let's find a way."

We support wellbeing, flexible working and have a generous leave offering. There is the opportunity for growth, learning and career development. No two days are the same.

Mō te Tūranga | About the Role

We have an excellent opportunity for an experienced Commercial banking professional to progress their career in an equally challenging yet exciting role, based in Christchurch. This role will give you the opportunity to support some of our largest customers to achieve their goals!

We spoke with our Senior Partner who let us know the following about the role:

What does a day in the life of a Commercial Partner look like?

No day is the same and it's this variety is what makes the role so exciting. A typical day might entail;

  • In the morning you're out on-site with one of your customers reviewing their annual business plan and understand their funding needs for the year ahead.
  • Over lunch you have your Business Development hat on attending an industry event or meeting a new potential customer
  • During the afternoon you're back in the office analysing financials and the information you have gathered to structure lending assessments.

Any way you have it, you'll learn and grow, and get to work with a range of industry leading BNZ specialists to ensure the delivery of appropriate products and services to meet our customers' requirements.

What is the team culture and environment like?

You will be joining a collaborative and supportive team, allowing you to share knowledge, learn from others and continually grow and develop.

Most importantly, we're looking for someone who's motivated to help put their stamp on our culture and challenge us to lift the bar.

This role is a great mix of working independently and coming together as a team to deliver for our clients.

What is the most exciting thing about this opportunity?

It is a sought after, diverse role with plenty of scope for professional development!

What is the most challenging thing about this opportunity?

We need to find someone who is motivated by connecting with new opportunities - not afraid to put themselves out there, pick up the phone or jump in the car to see how we can help. Our clients and prospective clients expect us to add value to them and what they do - we must make every interaction count.

The successful candidate also needs to be able to be seen as a "trusted advisor" and build confidence by demonstrating their ability to work effectively through funding requirements for customers.

What attributes will this person have in order to be successful?

We are looking for a self-motivated, ambitious team player who has a growth mindset and desire to contribute to the performance of our region.

Ideally, you will also have a high level of commercial acumen and either an already established professional network in the region or proven ability to grow a network to help serve our customers brilliantly!

This is an exciting opportunity to join us! We're bold thinkers who are taking brave steps to create a company that people want to work for, and customers want to bank with. Ehara taku toa i te toa takitahi, engari he toa takitini" - Success is not the work of an individual, but the work of many.”

title: Personlig assistent i Luleå
description:
Vi söker dig som vill arbeta som assistent åt en liten flicka på cirka 10 månader. Barnet bor tillsammans med sina föräldrar i ett lugnt och välkomnande hem. Familjen är samarbetsvillig och mån om ett bra arbetsklimat för dem som arbetar där. Arbetsplatsen ligger i Sjulsmark, cirka 30 minuters bilresa från centrala Luleå.

Om uppdraget

Uppdraget är medicinskt avancerat och flickan kräver tillsyn dygnet runt. Med anledning av flickans trakeostomi arbetar ni alltid två assistenter tillsammans — du är aldrig ensam med ansvaret. Arbetet sker i flickans hem och med ut när familjen är iväg.

Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter är att övervaka flickans andning, hantera trakealkanyl, sköta slemsugning, ge inhalationer och tillföra näring via sond. Det är specialiserade moment som kräver fokus, noggrannhet och uthållig uppmärksamhet under hela arbetspasset.

Du får full introduktion i alla medicinska moment och fortlöpande utbildning under uppdragets gång. Tidigare medicinsk erfarenhet är inget krav — vi lär upp rätt person.

Vem är du?

Personkemin mellan dig, barnet och familjen är avgörande, och vi lägger därför stor vikt vid hur du är som person. Vi söker dig som ser personlig assistans som ett yrke och tar dig an uppdraget med empati och professionell omsorg.

Du är lugn, observant och trygg i din yrkesroll. Du är van vid att arbeta i någon annans hem och förstår vikten av att respektera familjens rutiner, integritet och roll i barnets liv. Du tar initiativ i din yrkesroll och samarbetar nära både kollega och familj.

Vi ser gärna att du är:

  • Ansvarsfull, empatisk och lyhörd

  • Lugn och uppmärksam även under långa pass

  • Punktlig och flexibel, och kan hoppa in när det behövs

  • Noggrann med dokumentation och rapportering

  • En god lagspelare

Krav

  • Familjen önskar att assistenten är kvinna

  • Du röker inte (rester av rök i kläder och hår kan påverka barnets andning)

  • Du har god svenska i tal och skrift

Eftersom arbetsplatsen ligger cirka 30 minuters bilresa från centrala Luleå, i ett område med begränsade bussförbindelse behöver du som sökande körkort och tillgång till bil för att kunna ta dig till och från arbetet på ett bra sätt.

Om anställningen

Arbetstiderna varierar mellan dag, kväll och natt enligt schema. Tillträde enligt överenskommelse.

Om Novum Assistans

Novum är en rikstäckande assistansanordnare som vill göra skillnad för individen, branschen och samhället. Hos oss är du delaktig genom regelbundna arbetsplatsträffar där uppdraget utvecklas tillsammans, och du får möjlighet att utvecklas både som person och i din yrkesroll. Läs mer om Novum här.

Ansökan

Urval sker löpande, så vänta inte med din ansökan. Vi tillämpar ett strukturerat urval där personlighet och bemötande väger tungt. För anställning hos Novum krävs BankID, som du även använder i tjänsten.

Välkommen med din ansökan.

title: DevOps Infrastructure Engineer - RDT China Enterprise Technologies
description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Job Description

As a DevOps Infrastructure Engineer at the SE7 level, you will be responsible for solving unusually complex business problems with innovative DevOps and cloud infrastructure solutions across the entire platform landscape . Operating with considerable independence, you will establish the technical direction for the entire lifecycle of our platforms—from inception and design through deployment, operations, security, and retirement.

In this role, you will build a secure, self-service Internal Developer Platform (IDP) that abstracts away infrastructure complexity while enforcing rigorous compliance, cloud security AIOps, and proactive threat mitigation across both cloud-native environments and AI agent platforms.

Key Responsibilities

1. Cloud Security Operations & AIOps

  • Vulnerability & Patch Automation: Drive continuous monitoring of cloud server OS vulnerabilities and design fully automated OS patching pipelines/toolsets to rapidly mitigate risks across the infrastructure landscape.
  • Hardened Image Lifecycle: Author and maintain gold-standard cloud server AMIs (OS) utilizing an Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) approach (e.g., Terraform, Ansible, Packer) .
  • Continuous Security Monitoring: Manage and optimize Cloud Security Hub and Security Center platforms. Take responsibility for landing zone security alert handling, triaging, and remediation.
  • Endpoint & Key Security: Oversee the deployment and continuous maintenance of endpoint security agents (including Cortex XDR and Nessus agents), and optimize Cloud Key Management Services (KMS) for robust data encryption.
  • AIOps & Security Assessments: Pioneer cloud security AIOps to predict, detect, and automatically remediate security anomalies. Lead comprehensive cloud platform security assessments and continuous refinement strategies.

2. DevOps Engineering & Adoption

  • Secure Software Supply Chain: Lead the adoption, support, and integration of the DevOps toolchain across all automated CI/CD pipelines , spanning threat modeling, SAST (Static Application Security Testing), DAST (Dynamic Application Security Testing), SCA (Software Composition Analysis), and runtime security monitoring.
  • Container & Orchestration Security: Lead Kubernetes cluster hardening, establishing fine-grained network policies, container runtime security, and secure configuration baselines.
  • Centralized Secret Vaulting: Establish and enforce unified secret management protocols across all application environments using centralized secret and credential vaulting solutions.

3. AI Agent Security & Safeguards

  • Agent IAM & Identity Management: Design and implement robust Identity and Access Management (IAM) frameworks specifically tailored for autonomous AI agents, including identity and secret management for agent plugins and external tools.
  • Continuous Guardrails & Monitoring: Architect and maintain continuous agent guardrails and runtime monitoring systems to trace, evaluate, and restrict agent reasoning and actions within safe boundaries.
  • Model & Database Safeguards: Ensure model artifact security and establish strict integration safeguards for databases, ADP, and Vector/Graph Databases (VectorDB) to prevent data exfiltration and unauthorized access.
  • Active Defense & Hardening: Implement automated prompt red-teaming pipelines to proactively discover LLM vulnerabilities, and lead code execution sandbox hardening to run agent-generated code safely.

4. Platform Engineering & Excellence

  • Platform Engineering: Lead automation tools design and implementation to optimize the Cloud security operation. You will turn security requirements into technical design and lead the development team to deliver it.
  • Audit,Compliance : Ensure all cloud and AI environments strictly adhere to enterprise Quality/Regulatory standards . Lead complex audit exercises, provide audit evidence, author remediation plans, and design end-to-end disaster recovery (DR) strategies

Qualifications & Technical Skills

  • Experience: 5+ years of experience as an Infrastructure, DevOps, or Security Engineer , with at least 2+ years of hands-on experience designing secure AI architectures or Agentic platforms. Experience in the pharmaceutical, life sciences, or top-tier tech industries is highly preferred.
  • AI Agent Security Mastery: Proven experience with agent runtimes, prompt security, sandbox design, VectorDB integrations, and managing credentials/identities for plugins and external MCPs/APIs.
  • DevOps & Kubernetes Hardening: In-depth technical knowledge of security toolchains (SAST/DAST/SCA), Kubernetes cluster hardening, container runtime security, and credential vaulting solutions.
  • Cloud Operations & IaC: Mastery of Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, CloudFormation) for managing cloud environments . Proven track record of OS hardening, AMI baking, endpoint agent maintenance (Cortex XDR, Nessus), and Cloud Security Hub automation.
  • Hands-on Engineering: Highly proficient in at least one backend development or scripting language (e.g., Python, Go) with deep expertise building automated, secure CI/CD pipelines (GitLab/GitHub, JFrog) .
  • Compliance & Audit Leadership: Strong ability to translate complex corporate policies and regulatory standards into technical controls, lead audit exercises, and manage incident responses .
  • Language: Fluent bilingual capabilities in both English and Mandarin, enabling seamless collaboration across global and local cross-functional teams.

The Care Navigator functions as a core member of an Integrated Care team that includes the Primary Care Provider (PCP), Behavioral Health Clinician (BHC), and psychiatric provider. Job Description:

AI Architect – Modern AI Applications
3M Health Care is now Solventum

At Solventum, we enable better, smarter, safer healthcare to improve lives. As a new company with a long legacy of creating breakthrough solutions for our customers’ toughest challenges, we pioneer game-changing innovations at the intersection of health, material and data science that change patients' lives for the better while enabling healthcare professionals to perform at their best. Because people, and their wellbeing, are at the heart of every scientific advancement we pursue.

We partner closely with the brightest minds in healthcare to ensure that every solution we create melds the latest technology with compassion and empathy. Because at Solventum, we never stop solving for you.

The Impact You’ll Make in this Role

As a AI Architect with deep expertise in Machine learning, Agentic AI, Generative AI, and Natural Language Understanding (NLU), you will lead high-impact AI Platform development for HIS applications. In this role, you will be a hands-on research and development leader - driving technical breakthroughs, designing novel AI architectures, and directly influencing the integration of advanced AI into mission-critical healthcare products. You will collaborate closely with other scientists, engineers, and domain experts to create platform/solutions that are explainable, reliable, and transformative for healthcare operations.

This role is focused on building scalable AI platforms and frameworks from scratch and is not a data science or model experimentation role.

Key Responsibilities
Healthcare-Focused AI Development

  • Architect, design and develop AI platform to support large language models to handle healthcare-specific language, regulatory requirements, and ethical considerations.

  • Frameworks which can support AI pipelines that can process structured and unstructured healthcare data (FHIR, HL7, clinical notes, claims data).

  • Contribute to domain-specific model architectures that improve clinical decision-making, revenue cycle management, and patient engagement.

Technical Leadership

  • Serve as the primary technical authority on any AI Platform related development within product teams.

  • Mentor junior AI designers and engineers through code reviews, research guidance, and technical workshops.

  • Drive internal knowledge-sharing on emerging AI trends, frameworks, and best practices.

Operational & Compliance Excellence

  • Implement rigorous model evaluation frameworks for accuracy, robustness, and fairness.

  • Ensure compliance with healthcare privacy and data security regulations (HIPAA, HITRUST).

  • Partner with engineering to move research prototypes into production environments.

Required Qualifications

  • Master’s in Computer Science, AI, Machine Learning, or related field AND 10+ years of experience in developing AI/ML platform on Cloud & on-Prem.

Or

  • 15+ software engineering background in AI, Machine Learning, or related field with 10+ years of experience in building AI/ML platforms.

  • Proficiency in Python, and modern ML libraries.

  • Experience with GenAI, LLMs, transformer architectures, and advanced Model Routing (dynamically selecting and orchestrating open-source vs. proprietary models based on latency, cost, and capability tiers).

  • Skilled with AI development tools and frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Hugging Face, LangChain, LlamaIndex).

  • Deep expertise in building enterprise-grade RAG systems, including advanced chunking, hybrid search, vector database management, and retrieval optimization.

  • Hands-on experience with autonomous AI agents and reasoning systems, specifically mastering Agent-to-Agent (A2A) communication protocols and the Model Context Protocol (MCP) for multi-agent orchestration.

  • Advanced skills in Agent Context Management, including context window optimization, stateful memory injection, caching strategies, and managing long-running agent contexts.

  • Proven ability in Observability, Logging, and Scalable systems, including specialized LLM/Agent tracing to monitor reasoning steps, token usage, and system latency.

  • Strong track record applying AI architectures to scalable, generic enterprise platforms and complex use cases.

  • Strong background with cloud platforms, On-Prem deployments, and MLOps/LLMOps practices.

  • Strong background in containerization and infrastructure as code (Kubernetes, Terraform, etc.).


Preferred Skills

  • Experience with Knowledge Graph DBs (e.g., Neo4j), NoSQL/SQL databases, and native Vector databases, particularly in designing advanced GraphRAG and hybrid-retrieval architectures.

  • Familiarity with advanced multi-agent orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, AutoGen, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel) for complex, stateful workflow execution.

  • Proven ability to take complex AI Architecture/Design—especially non-deterministic LLM and multi-agent systems—from concept to highly available, production-grade deployments.

  • Experience with LLM Evaluation frameworks (e.g., Ragas, TruLens, LLM-as-a-Judge) to continuously monitor and score agent reasoning and RAG retrieval quality.

  • Knowledge of model fine-tuning techniques (LoRA, PEFT) and model distillation to create smaller, task-specific models that optimize cost and latency within the model routing layer.

  • Familiarity with implementing platform-wide AI guardrails, prompt injection defenses, and output validation mechanisms.

description:
Asiakkaamme TOPyhä Oy etsii tulityövahteja ja luukkuvahteja teollisuuden revisiotöihin Oulun alueen tehdasympäristöihin.

Työtehtävät keskittyvät pääasiassa luukkuvahdin ja tulityövahdin rooleihin, joissa korostuu tekninen osaaminen ja turvallisuus. Työ vaatii jatkuvaa tarkkaavaisuutta. Tämän kertainen revisio starttaa alustavasti maanantaina 9.11. ja kestää arviolta noin viikon.

Työntekijätarpeet vaihtelevat tehtaan olosuhteista riippuen. Asiakkaamme vastaa vuorosuunnittelusta ja kaikille valituille tulee tasavertaisesti tunteja siinä määrin missä se on mahdollista.

Työntekijöiltä toivomme aiempaa kokemusta luukkuvahdin töistä, teollisuuden aputöistä tai tulityövahdin tehtävistä.

Työntekijöillä on ehdottomasti oltava tulityökortti ja työturvallisuuskortti. Myös mahdollisuus vuorotöihin, pitkiin päiviin ja viikonloppuvuoroihin on edellytyksenä työn menestyksekkääseen suorittamiseen.

Tarjoamme sinulle mahdollisuuden kehittyä ja erikoistua teollisuuden alalla, sekä työskennellä osana ammattitaitoista tiimiä. Tämä on ainutlaatuinen tilaisuus saada arvokasta kokemusta ja oppia uutta teollisuuden monipuolisista tehtävistä. Jos olet valmis tarttumaan haasteeseen ja kehittämään osaamistasi, tämä työpaikka on sinua varten!

Yhtä kaikki, tärkeintä on, että nimemme jää mieleen ja yhdistetään hyvään laatuun, korkeaan turvallisuuskulttuuriin, vastuullisuuteen ja hymyileviin kasvoihin.

title: Laboratory Technician / Operator BTA/CTA – Protein Analytics (all genders)
description:
Role Overview

Help us ensure the quality and reliability behind every protein we bring to life.

As our Laboratory Technician - Protein Analytics, you'll be the hands-on backbone of our analytical lab, running the routine testing that tells us exactly what's happening inside our fermentation-derived proteins. From HPLC-UV runs to sample prep for proteomics and protein assays, your careful, well-documented work gives our scientists the data they need to keep pushing our precision fermentation platform forward.


Location: Frankfurt am Main

.

About Formo

At Formo, we’re rebuilding dairy to help create a just and resilient food system.

Using precision fermentation, we produce real, bio-identical milk proteins, starting with casein, without the need for animals.

As a B2B ingredient company, we partner with leading food manufacturers to bring next-generation dairy products to market. We focus on developing and scaling high-performance dairy proteins that enable our partners to create exceptional products.

Our work sits at the intersection of molecular biology, food science, and industrial biotechnology. By combining cutting-edge science with deep application expertise, we empower the dairy industry to deliver products that are indulgent, functional, and more sustainable - without compromise.

Formo is a venture-backed, fast-growing company with an international team of entrepreneurs, scientists, and operators united by the ambition to transform dairy from within the industry. Together with our partners, we are shaping a future where animal-free dairy proteins unlock new possibilities for innovation at global scale.


Key Responsibilities

Analytical Testing

  • Perform routine HPLC-UV analyses according to established SOPs

  • Conduct protein assays (e.g. Bradford) and support physicochemical analyses (e.g. particle size determination)

Sample Preparation

  • Prepare samples for proteomics analyses (e.g. protein extraction, digestion, purification)

Documentation & Quality

  • Thoroughly evaluate and document results in accordance with internal guidelines

Instrument Management

  • Operate, clean, calibrate and maintain analytical instruments

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with scientists to support ongoing projects


About You

Education & Experience

  • Completed training as a BTA, CTA or comparable qualification

  • Initial practical laboratory experience (e.g. through training, internships or entry-level work)

Technical & Functional Skills

  • Basic knowledge of HPLC or chromatographic methods is a plus

  • Good documentation skills

  • English proficiency at least B1 level (spoken and written); German is a plus

Mindset & Collaboration

  • Careful, structured and reliable working style, with high motivation and scientific curiosity to learn new techniques

  • Genuine interest in protein analytics and biochemical methods

  • Team-oriented mindset with a strong sense of responsibility


Why you’ll love it here

Ready to shake things up?

At Formo, you don’t just trade your labor for compensation - you join a mission. One powered by frontier science, real-world impact, and a team of brilliant, driven people who care deeply about what they’re building.

You’ll work side by side with interdisciplinary experts across highly skilled entrepreneurs, scientists, and operators. We believe the best ideas emerge when diverse perspectives collide, and when people are trusted with responsibility, autonomy, and meaningful challenges.

We’re building something ambitious, and we take the work seriously - but not ourselves. Expect close collaboration, fast learning and innovation, and a culture that celebrates progress (often with tastings 🧀).


What we offer:

  • Help reinvent one of the world’s most iconic food categories

  • Participate in employee equity and build long-term ownership in what we’re creating

  • Benefit from regular team off-sites, monthly perks like discounted public transport passes and fitness memberships

  • Invest in your growth with a dedicated annual development budget for learning, training, and conferences

  • Enjoy 28 days of paid vacation, and an additional day after 3 and 4 years tenure

  • Make an impact on the environment and society with 1 (fully paid) Team Impact Day

  • Work in an innovative office and lab environment with access to cutting-edge food and biotech infrastructure

  • Connect over regular team lunches, healthy and not so healthy snacks and drinks and shared moments that bring the team together

Do you want to shape the future of Enterprise Asset & Portfolio Management? What if you could architect a ServiceNow domain used across a global industrial technology leader—and have the mandate to influence not only today's solutions, but the platform strategy for years ahead?

Why Sandvik?

At Sandvik, we're building the next generation of enterprise workflows. As a Solution Architect for Asset & Portfolio, you'll be at the centre of that journey, helping us create scalable, sustainable and intelligent solutions that support thousands of users worldwide.

This is more than an implementation role. You'll shape architectural direction, challenge assumptions, influence investment decisions and drive standards that keep our platform resilient, scalable and future-ready.

You’ll join a focused, expert team working at the core of our digital landscape.

About the job

You act as the technical design authority for the Asset & Portfolio domain within our ServiceNow platform. You operate within the Platform Architecture & Governance team, translating validated business needs into scalable, secure, and sustainable technical solutions while safeguarding platform integrity. The Asset & Portfolio domain contains capabilities such as Application Portfolio Management (APM), Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM), Software Asset Management (SAM) and more.

Job responsibilities

  • Define target architectures and architectural roadmap for your domain
  • Make strategic technology decisions that balance capability, maintainability and cost
  • Champion an OOTB-first mindset and challenge unnecessary customisation
  • Review designs, code and implementation approaches to safeguard platform quality
  • Lead platform health, upgrade readiness and technical debt initiatives
  • Guide engineers and implementation partners with architectural leadership and mentorship
  • Play a key role in preparing the platform for future innovations, including AI-driven capabilities and automation

Location

This role is based in Sandviken or World Trade Center in Stockholm.

Your profile

You see architecture as more than solution design and you combine deep ServiceNow expertise with curiosity, business understanding and a passion for building platforms that last.

A structured mindset and the confidence to challenge non-standard solutions help you thrive in complex environments.

You also bring:

  • Extensive experience designing enterprise-scale solutions within ServiceNow or similar platforms
  • Strong knowledge within HAM, SAM, SPM, APM or related domains
  • A proven track record of driving platform transformation and reducing technical debt
  • Strong understanding of platform governance, quality controls and lifecycle management
  • Ability to contribute to cost estimations and articulate technical and commercial impacts
  • Relevant academic background or equivalent experience in IT operations or service management
  • ServiceNow certifications such as CSA and CIS (CTA or clear path to CTA is a plus)

You’re comfortable engaging with stakeholders across the organization and translating complex needs into clear technical direction.

You bring a collaborative mindset and communicate confidently with both technical and non-technical audiences. Balancing detail with a strategic view comes naturally, and you’re driven to improve quality while ensuring long-term sustainability.

Our culture

At Sandvik, we’re tech driven, innovative and entrepreneurial. We believe that success is a team effort so we value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive culture where people can be themselves and reach their full potential. So, we invest in supporting each other, learning together and celebrating our differences. Visit our stories hub, LinkedIn or Facebook to get to know us further.

title: Director of Delivery Assurance
description:
Overview

We are looking for Director of Delivery Assurance (DDA) with a passion for delivering desired customer outcomes, who can take responsibility for driving the successful initiation, governance oversight, recovery, and acceleration of large-scale, complex cloud programs. This role focuses on the governance infrastructure, tools, and processes needed to quickly and successfully launch or recover a multimillion-dollar program, setting up program governance, setting up operational cadence, and managing stakeholder relationships. DDA will serve as a trusted advisor to both internal teams and clients, ensuring that every program starts proficiently, is positioned for long-term success, and can be rapidly brought back on track when challenges arise. Creative use of artificial intelligence (AI) is expected to drive program delivery, lead program recovery, and achieve breakthrough 2x efficiency throughout the program lifecycle. This opportunity will allow you to accelerate your career growth, honing your industry and cloud expertise as well as deepening your contractual and commercial acumen.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

In alignment with our Microsoft values, we are committed to cultivating an inclusive work environment for all employees to positively affect our culture every day.



Responsibilities

  • Champion AI-enabled Delivery Excellence: Incubate Agentic AI capabilities across the delivery lifecycle - from deal review through mobilization, delivery oversight, and through lessons learned. Explore how intelligent automation and AI-augmented workflows can enhance execution on complex engagements, partnering across the organization to identify scalable patterns and shape ISD’s AI-enabled delivery roadmap.

  • Program Governance Setup: Establish and implement robust governance framework, tools, and processes tailored to the needs of each program, leveraging AI-driven solutions to ensure alignment with organizational goals and compliance with industry standards and leading practices.

  • Operational Cadence Establishment: Develop and maintain a consistent rhythm of business for the program, including setting up key processes, meetings, and reporting structures to drive program progress. Utilize AI-powered tools to automate routine tasks, streamline workflows, and enhance overall program efficiency.

  • Stakeholder Management: Function as the primary point of contact for stakeholders, facilitating clear communication, expectation management, and conflict resolution. Ensure that all stakeholders are aligned with program objectives and timelines. Maintains effective relationships and influence with leadership team members in the business (e.g. Sales, Delivery, etc)

  • Program Planning and Execution: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop detailed program plans, including timelines, milestones, and deliverables. Ensure that all program activities are executed on time and within scope.

  • Risk Management: Identify potential risks and develop mitigation strategies to minimize their impact on the program. Use AI-powered predictive analytics to proactively detect and address risk factors throughout the program lifecycle, adjusting plans as needed.

  • Continuous Improvement: Continuously assess and refine program activation processes, incorporating lessons learned, best practices, and AI-driven process optimization to enhance efficiency and effectiveness in future programs, aiming for 2x improvement in delivery outcomes.

  • Reporting and Documentation: Provide regular status updates to leadership and stakeholders, including detailed reports on program progress, risks, and issues. Leverage AI automation and generative AI to accelerate reporting, maintain comprehensive documentation, and ensure timely stakeholder communication.

  • Program Recovery: Lead program recovery where needed, starting from a rapid assessment of challenges, leveraging AI for diagnosing root cause, partnering with technical leaders and architects, and implementing targeted turnaround strategies. Drive efficient restoration of program health and performance, aiming for achieving target outcome for the customer and sustainable success.

  • Leadership and Mentorship: Lead and mentor program directors, managers and other key personnel involved in the program activation process, fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, and excellence.



Qualifications

Required/Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in related fields AND 7+ years of experience in program management of complex technology implementation programs
    • OR equivalent experience.

Additional or Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in related field AND 15+ years' experience in project management of complex technology implementation programs
    • OR equivalent experience.
  • Project Management Professional (PMP) and Program Management Professional (PgMP) certification.
  • Microsoft AZ-900 (Azure Fundamentals) and AI-901 (Azure AI Fundamentals) certifications
  • 8+ years financial management experience.
  • Agile certification, Scrum Master, Agile Certified Practitioner (PMI-ACP), or Professional Scrum Master One (PSM1) certification.
  • Certification in relevant industry.
  • Experience in creating and managing intellectual property (IP).
  • Experience in creating publications.

title: Personlig assistent i Piteå
description:
Vi söker dig som vill arbeta som personlig assistent till ett liten flicka på cirka 10 månader. Barnet bor tillsammans med sina föräldrar i ett lugnt och välkomnande hem. Familjen är öppen, samarbetsvillig och mån om ett bra arbetsklimat för dem som arbetar där. Arbetsplatsen ligger i Sjulsmark, cirka 25 minuters bilresa från Piteå.

Om uppdraget

Uppdraget är medicinskt avancerat och flickan kräver tillsyn dygnet runt. Med anledning av flickans trakeostomi arbetar ni alltid två assistenter tillsammans — du är aldrig ensam med ansvaret. Arbetet sker i flickans hem och med ut när familjen är iväg.

Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter är att övervaka flickans andning, hantera trakealkanyl, sköta slemsugning, ge inhalationer och tillföra näring via sond. Det är specialiserade moment som kräver fokus, noggrannhet och uthållig uppmärksamhet under hela arbetspasset.

Du får full introduktion i alla medicinska moment och fortlöpande utbildning under uppdragets gång. Tidigare medicinsk erfarenhet är inget krav — vi lär upp rätt person.

Vem är du?

Personkemin mellan dig, barnet och familjen är avgörande, och vi lägger därför stor vikt vid hur du är som person. Vi söker dig som ser personlig assistans som ett yrke och tar dig an uppdraget med empati och professionell omsorg.

Du är lugn, observant och trygg i din yrkesroll. Du är van vid att arbeta i någon annans hem och förstår vikten av att respektera familjens rutiner, integritet och roll i barnets liv. Du tar initiativ i din yrkesroll och samarbetar nära både kollega och familj.

Vi ser gärna att du är:

  • Ansvarsfull, empatisk och lyhörd

  • Lugn och uppmärksam även under långa pass

  • Punktlig och flexibel, och kan hoppa in när det behövs

  • Noggrann med dokumentation och rapportering

  • En god lagspelare

Krav

  • Familjen önskar att assistenten är kvinna

  • Du röker inte (rester av rök i kläder och hår kan påverka barnets andning)

  • Du har god svenska i tal och skrift

Eftersom arbetsplatsen ligger cirka 30 minuters bilresa från centrala Luleå, i ett område med begränsade bussförbindelse behöver du som sökande körkort och tillgång till bil för att kunna ta dig till och från arbetet på ett bra sätt.

Om anställningen

Arbetstiderna fokuserar främst på nattetid. Tillträde enligt överenskommelse.

Om Novum Assistans

Novum är en rikstäckande assistansanordnare som vill göra skillnad för individen, branschen och samhället. Hos oss är du delaktig genom regelbundna arbetsplatsträffar där uppdraget utvecklas tillsammans, och du får möjlighet att utvecklas både som person och i din yrkesroll. Läs mer om Novum här.

Ansökan

Urval sker löpande, så vänta inte med din ansökan. Vi tillämpar ett strukturerat urval där personlighet och bemötande väger tungt. För anställning hos Novum krävs BankID, som du även använder i tjänsten.

Välkommen med din ansökan.

title: Porgera | Supervisor, Senior - Construction Projects
description:
Supervisor, Senior - Construction Projects (241628)


About Us

New Porgera Limited (NPL) is a leading mining company dedicated to sustainable practices and community engagement in Papua New Guinea. As the operator of the Porgera Gold Mine, we focus on extracting high-quality mineral resources while prioritizing the well-being of our employees, the environment, and the local communities. Our commitment to safety, innovation, and responsible mining ensures that we not only contribute to the economy but also support the development and prosperity of the regions we operate in. At NPL, we strive to create a positive impact, fostering strong relationships with stakeholders and promoting sustainable growth for future generations.

NPL now has a vacancy for a qualified and experienced individual to join our Capital and Projects as Supervisor, Senior – Construction Projects (241628)

About the role

Reporting to the Superintendent – Construction Projects, the Supervisor, Senior - Construction Projects is responsible for overseeing the planning, coordination, execution, and successful delivery of construction and community infrastructure projects within the New Porgera Limited (NPL) operational area. The position provides leadership and technical supervision for construction activities, contractors, and project resources to ensure all works are completed safely, on schedule, within budget, and in compliance with engineering standards, statutory regulations, and NPL operational requirements.

The incumbent plays a key role in driving continuous improvement in project execution, safety performance, contractor management, and stakeholder engagement while supporting NPL's commitment to sustainable development and community investment.

In this role, you will:


 Supervise day-to-day construction activities across multiple project sites within the mine
 Development of project execution plan
 Development and compliance with engineering SOW and specification
 Health, Safety, Security and Environmental management, including rigorous use of JSA and SWP
 Development / implementation of project change management procedure
 Compile and manage work schedules and budgets for all aspects of the project
 Management of earthmoving, civil, structural and other specialized contractors
 Report writing and cost variance reporting
 Conduct regular site inspections, safety briefings, and toolbox talks
 Demobilization of construction resources and equipment
 Implement and manage a project stock reduction plan
 Coordinate and monitor contractors, subcontractors, and in-house teams
 Ensure construction works meet engineering specifications, timelines, and site safety standards
 Liaise with project engineers, planners, and procurement teams to ensure timely availability of materials and resources
 Actively promote, monitor and enforce compliance of personnel with safe work practices
 Maintain accurate records of progress, safety incidents, and project documentation
 Ensure all incidents are reported and investigated according to Company policy and statutory requirements, and all recommended corrective actions are completed
 Maintain a high level of health, safety and environmental awareness and comply with the NPL Occupational Health & Safety and Environment Policy and all related rules and procedures


About You

 Recognized tertiary Degree qualifications in Engineer, Building Construction, or equivalent are desirable, in addition to the key skills and experience
 Minimum five (5) years' experience in construction supervision.
 Previous experience in a large-scale mining operation.
 Experience managing medium-scale construction projects.
 Experience delivering community infrastructure projects.
 Proven experience supervising contractors and construction workforces.
 Demonstrated experience within mining, infrastructure, civil construction, or heavy industry environments.
 Strong planning and scheduling experience.
 Current PNG Driver's License Class 6.
 Project Management certification.
 Contractor Management training.
 Occupational Health and Safety qualifications.
 Strong understanding of construction methodologies, safety standards, and regulatory compliance
 Excellent communication (both oral and written), negotiation and interpersonal skills
 Advanced level skills utilizing Microsoft Office programs, in particular Word and Excel, PowerPoint and MS Projects
 Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills, with the ability to anticipate and address project-related challenges

Mobilization Requirement

This is a PNG National position, a site-based role on a FIFO arrangement with a rotation of 21 days on and 14 days off. Candidates must successfully pass a pre-employment medical, including drug and alcohol screening (to be arranged only for successful candidates after the interview stage), and provide an up-to-date Police Clearance Certificate (acquired within the last 6 months). title: Työhönvalmentaja, Business Oulu -liikelaitos, Byströmin tiimi
description:
Haluatko tehdä merkityksellistä työtä ja nähdä oman työsi vaikutukset ihmisten arjessa?

Haemme TYÖHÖNVALMENTAJAA vakinaiseen virkaan BusinessOulun Työllisyyspalveluihin. Tehtävä alkaa 1.1.2027 tai sopimuksen mukaan.

BusinessOulu on Oulun kaupungin liikelaitos, jonka tehtävä on edistää kaupungin elinvoimaa luomalla menestymisen mahdollisuuksia alueelle, asukkaille ja yrityksille. Rakennamme vahvaa pohjoista kasvukeskusta, joka houkuttelee nuorekkaana yritys-, asuin- ja opiskelupaikkakuntana. Luomme uusia työpaikkoja kestävästi yritysten kasvun kautta. Palvelemme alkavia, kasvavia ja kansainvälistyviä yrityksiä niiden toiminnan ja toimintaympäristön kehittämisessä sekä verkostoitumisessa ja osaavan työvoiman rekrytoimisessa. Autamme työnhakijoita työllistymään ja kehittämään osaamistaan. Luomme suoria yhteyksiä yritysmaailmaan, jotta saamme työnhakijat ja avoimet työpaikat kohtaamaan. BusinessOulussa toimii eri tehtävissä yhteensä 400 työntekijää. Nämä useiden alojen osaajat muodostavat toimivan työyhteisön. Osana tätä joukkoa pääset hyödyntämään omia vahvuuksiasi ja kehittymään asiantuntijana.

Töihin työllisyyspalveluihin?

Työhönvalmentajana työskentelet virkasuhteessa Business Oulu -liikelaitoksen työllisyyspalveluissa. Työllisyyspalveluiden tavoitteena on edistää työllisyyttä: työnvälityksellä, tukemalla työnhakijoiden osaamisen kehittymistä työmarkkinoiden tarpeisiin perustuen, tunnistamalla, edistämällä ja todentamalla työnhakijoiden työkykyä sekä vaikuttavalla palveluohjauksella.
Työllisyyspalveluissa palvellaan sekä työnhakija- että työnantaja-asiakkaita, ja tehdään yhteistyötä muiden Oulun seudun työllisyystoimijoiden kanssa. Oulun kaupunki vastaa vastuukuntana Oulun seudun työllisyysalueen toiminnasta. Merkittävä osa työllisyyspalveluiden tehtävistä on lakisääteisiä. Olemassa olevien työnhakija- ja työnantajapalveluiden lisäksi kehitetään uusia vaikuttavia keinoja työllisyyden edistämiseksi yhdessä kumppaniverkoston kanssa.

Henkilöasiakaspalvelut on jaettu organisaatiossamme toimiala- ja nuorten palvelutiimeihin sekä työllistymisen edistämisen monialaisen palvelun tiimiin. Työhönvalmentaja sijoittuu Byströmin tiimiin, osaksi Ohjaamon työyhteisöä. Työnhakija-asiakkaat ovat nuoria, alle 30-vuotiaita aikuisia ja työtä tehdään monialaisesti valtakunnallisten Ohjaamon perusteiden mukaan.

Mitä työ sisältää?

Työhönvalmentajan tehtävänä on työnhakija-asiakkaiden työhönvalmennus sekä soveltuvan työvoiman hankkiminen työnantaja-asiakkaille. Työssä yhdistyy ihmisten kohtaaminen, ratkaisujen etsiminen ja yhteistyö eri toimijoiden kanssa.

Työhönvalmentaja toimii työnhakija-asiakkaiden tukena työmarkkinoille ohjautumisessa yksilökohtaisen ja ryhmämuotoisen työnhakuvalmennuksen avulla ja vastaa asiakkaan valmennusprosessista sekä sen etenemisestä. Työhönvalmentaja arvioi yhdessä omavalmentajan kanssa työnhakija-asiakkaan soveltuvuutta työhönvalmennukseen, hyödyntää työssään tuetun työhönvalmennuksen menetelmiä (IPS - sijoita ja valmenna -työhönvalmennus) sekä tekee yhteistyötä työnantajien ja työllisyyden toimijaverkoston kanssa. Työhönvalmentaja osallistuu BusinessOulun yritysyhteistyöhön ja Pohjois-Pohjanmaan työhönvalmennuksen verkostoon.

Työhönvalmentaja tuntee keskeiset työllistymistä edistävät palvelut ja tukimuodot sekä osaa soveltaa niiden käyttöä omassa työssään. Työtehtäviin kuuluu aktiivinen neuvonta työnantajille käytettävissä olevista tukimahdollisuuksista; mm. taloudelliset tuet, työolosuhteiden järjestelytuki, työhönvalmentajan tuki työpaikalla. Työhönvalmentaja hyödyntää työhön paluun, työssä jatkamisen ja työhön pääsyn keinoja suhteessa asiakkaan osaamiseen ja työkykyyn.

Työhönvalmentajan työ on asiakkaan omissa toimintaympäristöissä liikkuvaa. Työtehtäviin kuuluu myös erilaisten työvoiman kohtaantoa edistävien ja rekrytointikynnystä madaltavien tilaisuuksien, tapahtumien, viestinnällisten toimenpiteiden suunnittelemista sekä toteuttamista. Työhönvalmentaja osallistuu työllisyyspalveluiden kehittämistyöhön omasta roolistaan käsin. Työ on pääsääntöisesti lähityötä ja asiakaspalvelu tapahtuu useimmiten kasvokkain. Osittainen etätyöskentely on mahdollista.

Mitä toivomme sinulta?

Sovellut työhönvalmentajan tehtävään, jos sinulla on kipinää ja osaamista asiakaslähtöiseen ohjaustyöhön ja viet eteenpäin haastavatkin tilanteet lempeällä ratkaisukeskeisyydellä. Toimintaympäristömme on joskus kiireinen, joten tarvitset arkityön priorisointitaitoa sekä kykyä johtaa ja organisoida omaa työtäsi. Tarvitset myös osaamista ratkaista ongelmia tilanteissa, joissa ei aina ole valmista toimintamallia. Toivomme sinun innostuvan myös toiminnan kehittämisestä. Luontevat yhteydet yritysten ja yhteistyökumppaneiden suuntaan helpottavat työtäsi.

Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää sinulta:
kokemusta työnantajayhteistyöstä
työmarkkinoiden, koulutusmahdollisuuksien ja palvelujärjestelmän tuntemusta
verkosto- ja työnantajayhteistyön osaamista
erinomaisia vuorovaikutus-, yhteistyö- ja neuvottelutaitoja

Eduksi luetaan aiempi kokemus nuorten kanssa toimimisesta sekä monialaisesta yhteistyöstä. Eduksi luetaan myös työkykyä tukevien ja osaamisen kehittämiseen liittyvien palveluiden tuntemus.

Kelpoisuusehtona tehtävään on korkeakoulututkinto tai muu soveltuva tutkinto sekä työkokemuksen kautta hankittu ammattitaito ja osaaminen.

Virkaan valitun tulee esittää hyväksyttävä lääkärintodistus terveydentilastaan ennen tehtävän vastaanottamista. Tehtävään valitun on ennen työn alkamista esitettävä lain 504/2002 mukainen rikosrekisteriote.

Oulun kaupunki käyttää vakinaisissa viroissa kuuden (6) kuukauden koeaikaa.

Tehtävää haetaan ensisijaisesti sähköisellä hakulomakkeella. Mikäli hakemusta ei ole mahdollista jättää sähköisesti, toimita hakemus osoitteeseen Oulun kaupungin kirjaamo, PL 71, 90015 Oulun kaupunki, käyntiosoite Kansankatu 55A. Hakemuksessa on mainittava tehtäväkohtainen diaarinumero OUKA/10618/2026. Hakemukset on toimitettava 21.8.2026 klo 15.00 mennessä.

Job Description: Lead Software Engineer (AWS, Snowflake & ML Backend)
Position Overview
Job Title: Lead Software Engineer
Department: Data Analytics

The Lead Software Engineer drives the technical vision, execution, and quality of core software products. This role balances hands-on coding and technical leadership with deep architecture collaboration, partnering with enterprise architects, product managers, data scientists, and engineering teams to design secure, scalable, and high-performance distributed systems. Operating heavily within AWS and Snowflake, this leader will architect the backend services, robust data infrastructure, and automated MLOps workflows that power the productionization of machine learning models and analytical workflows to generate real-time predictions and actionable business insights.

Key Responsibilities
ML & Analytics Workflows Productionization
Model Deployment: Architect and maintain reliable backend microservices to deploy, scale, and monitor machine learning models in production environments.
Pipeline Orchestration: Design robust batch and real-time analytical pipelines that ingest raw enterprise data, perform feature engineering, and output high-accuracy predictions.
MLOps Governance: Establish continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) practices customized for ML infrastructure, including model versioning, registry, and drift tracking.


Cloud & Data Architecture Collaboration
AWS Framework Integration: Co-design cloud-native, distributed backend systems utilizing AWS managed services (such as SageMaker, Lambda, ECS/EKS, and Step Functions).
Snowflake Optimization: Partner with Data Architects to build optimized storage, data views, and high-performance analytical queries within Snowflake to guarantee low latency for downstream insights.
Data Security & Lineage: Ensure strict data governance, access controls, and reproducible data validation protocols across both training pipelines and live execution layers.


Technical Leadership & Mentorship
Hands-On Development: Write clean, efficient, and secure code, actively contributing to critical components and complex backend feature development.
Code Quality & Standards: Champion engineering excellence by setting and enforcing coding standards, conducting thorough code reviews, and establishing robust testing strategies.
Team Guidance: Provide hands-on mentorship, technical coaching, and constructive feedback to junior and mid-level software engineers on the team.


Qualifications & Skills
Experience: 8+ years of professional software development experience, with a solid focus on building data-intensive applications or ML backend infrastructure.

  • AWS Mastery: Hands-on expertise building architectures across the AWS ecosystem, specifically managing compute, storage, and serverless workflow orchestration.
  • Snowflake Competency: Deep proficiency in advanced SQL, Snowflake warehousing, data modeling, and performance tuning for massive, complex analytic datasets.
  • Programming Skills: Strong programming background (e.g., Python) specialized in deploying scalable backend systems, REST/gRPC endpoints, and handling data pipelines.
  • Soft Skills: Exceptional communication, stakeholder management, and the ability to build consensus across multi-disciplinary technical teams.

This position requires working onsite five days a week.

Relocation is available for this position.

August 7, 2026 - August 20, 2026

title: Badpersonal
description:
Östra Göinge kommun med drygt 13 800 invånare är centralt belägen i södra Sverige. Här möter det öppna jordbrukslandskapet den gröna skogsbygden. I Östra Göinge finns det goda livet med tryggt boende, bra skolor, storslagen natur, brett kulturutbud, livskraftigt föreningsliv och goda kommunikationer. Östra Göinge är en av landets modigaste och mest innovativa kommuner. Här har motgång vänts till framgång och här växer stolta göingar!

Vi utgår ifrån Göingemodellen som står för öppenhet, engagemang och ansvar. Du ska våga tänka nytt, ha en vilja att lära och mod att förnya. Allt ska ha målsättningen ”värde för kunden”. 

Vill du göra skillnad? Var då med i utvecklingen av vår bad och simverksamhet.

Hos oss får du mer än bara ett jobb. Här får du stort eget ansvar och utrymme att påverka både din vardag och hela verksamhetens utveckling i tätt samarbete med dina kollegor.

Vi tror på idéer, nytänkande och modet att prova nytt – allt med fokus på värde för kunden.

1 plats(er).

Vi jobbar i tät dialog med skolor, fritidshem och även övriga delar inom Kultur och fritid för att på bästa sätt kunna hjälpa varandra. Det är en viktig del i att förverkliga kommunens vision om välkomnande, trygga mötesplatser.

Ditt intresse för mötet med människor i olika åldrar samt engagemang och flexibilitet i det dagliga arbetet är särskilt viktigt.

title: Claims Examiner (Project Hire)
description:
Job Posting Title:

Claims Examiner (Project Hire)

Req ID:

10156773

Job Description:

About the Role:

The Claims Examiner is an early-career professional who supports Disney’s Corporate Risk Management organization by administering workers’ compensation claims in a way that protects the brand while enabling world-class storytelling and guest experiences. In this role, you will independently manage a portfolio of occupational injury and illness claims, applying sound judgment and problem-solving skills to deliver fair, timely, and compliant outcomes for Cast Members and the company.

Project Hire Assignment: This position is a temporary Project Hire assignment expected to last approximately six (6) months. Employment is intended to support a specific business need for a limited duration and there is no guarantee of extension, conversion, or placement into a regular full-time position at the conclusion of the assignment.

Responsibilities:

As a Claims Examiner, you will handle workers’ compensation claims from initial investigation through resolution, ensuring benefits are administered in accordance with California Labor Code and internal guidelines while supporting Disney’s commitment to a safe, innovative, and collaborative workplace. This intermediate-level role requires you to analyze information, recommend solutions with moderate guidance, and work independently while partnering across teams—helping safeguard the company’s interests and supporting injured Cast Members in their recovery.

  • Administer workers’ compensation benefits for injured Cast Members, including investigation, review and analysis of medical reports, arranging medical examinations, and rating permanent disability.
  • Communicate effectively with Cast Members, physicians, attorneys, and other providers to gather information, explain claim decisions, and facilitate appropriate care and benefits.
  • Establish and maintain case reserves in accordance with California Self-Insurance Plans and department guidelines, using strong analytical skills to evaluate liability and exposure.
  • Oversee vocational rehabilitation benefits with a focus on returning Cast Members to gainful employment whenever possible.
  • Utilize automated claims management systems, paperless document management tools, and web-based portals to document, track, and manage claims in a timely and accurate manner.
  • Maintain frequent contact with multiple stakeholders, including injured Cast Members, area and department management, medical providers, and other professionals, while demonstrating a professional, courteous, and positive demeanor.
  • Work within established levels of authority, seeking supervision as needed or required by internal procedures and guidelines, and provide informal guidance to new team members on claims processes.

​

Required Qualifications:

  • 2+ years administering occupational or workers’ compensation claims in California.
  • Designation as a Workers’ Compensation Claims Examiner in the State of California, per California Department of Insurance guidelines.
  • Required: California Self-Insurance Plans Administrator Certification.
  • Proficient understanding of key elements of the California Labor Code related to workers’ compensation benefits and claim administration.
  • Strong analytical skills in evaluating liability, setting appropriate reserves, and developing action plans for claim resolution.
  • Ability to perform detailed evaluation of claims and permanent disability ratings.
  • Proficient use of automated claims management systems, paperless document management systems, and multiple web access portals.
  • Excellent time management skills with the ability to prioritize multiple issues and meet department expectations and objectives.
  • Effective listening, verbal, and written communication skills, including the ability to deliver concise and informative summaries.
  • Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively within multifaceted teams and build strong relationships with stakeholders.
  • Ability to handle confidential information with discretion and professionalism.
  • Early-career, independent worker with strong problem-solving skills and the ability to analyze a range of issues and recommend solutions with moderate guidance.

​

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Preferred certifications such as IEA, WCCP, or CPDM.
  • Bilingual – English/Spanish.
  • Bachelor's Degree in Business, Risk Management, or a related field.

description:

This role has been designed as ‘’Onsite’ with an expectation that you will primarily work from an HPE office.

Who We Are:

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. HPE Operations is our innovative IT services organization. It provides the expertise to advise, integrate, and accelerate our customers’ outcomes from their digital transformation. Our teams collaborate to transform insight into innovation. In today’s fast paced, hybrid IT world, being at business speed means overcoming IT complexity to match the speed of actions to the speed of opportunities. Deploy the right technology to respond quickly to market possibilities. Join us and redefine what’s next for you

What you’ll do:

  • Translate AI use cases and business requirements into product concepts, delivery plans, pilot scopes, and scalable solution backlogs.

  • Experience coordinating cross-functional teams, vendors, technology teams, and business stakeholders.
  • Familiarity with analytics and reporting tools such as Power BI or Tableau; SQL or Python knowledge preferred.
  • Strong delivery discipline, backlog management, prioritization, and benefits tracking skills.
