title: Supervisor - Airport Operations, Safety
description:
Achieving our goals starts with supporting yours. Grow your career, access top-tier health and wellness benefits, build lasting connections with your team and our customers, and travel the world using our extensive route network.

Come join us to create what’s next. Let’s define tomorrow, together.

Description

At United, we fly into airports around the entire world. And we need a whole team of people to keep things running in tip-top shape! From the exceptional service at the check-in counter to the departure gate, and even behind the scenes making sure your checked bags arrive with you, our Airport Operations team keeps operations at our airports running smoothly every single day.


Job Overview and Responsibilities

The Safety Supervisor - Airport Operations has primary responsibility to develop, implement and administer the station Airport Operations Safety program. The overall objective is reduction of occupational injuries, minimize aircraft and equipment damage, and to ensure regulatory compliance. In addition, provide oversight and guidance to front line leaders and coworkers in order to maximize and leverage support partnerships with cross divisional operational/hub/station leadership towards accomplishment of safety goals, implementation and maintenance of safety initiatives and to ensure compliance with internal and regulatory agency procedures and standards.


  • Safety Administrative Activities:
    • Complete all mandatory regulatory and Company required documentation of activities
    • Attend, support and lead division/unit/group safety meetings, Participate on collateral safety projects
    • Ensure front line co-workers are delivering on service, performance and safety objectives set by the company and station
    • Safety performance (OSHA, LTI, aircraft damages), Safety Excellence program implementation; Safety Fairs, Annual Audiometric Examinations; Develop strategy and policy to comply with safety mandates locally
  • Team Leadership Activities:
    • Oversee the station safety advocates and Line Operation Safety Audit (LOSA) team
    • Act as facilitator to the station led Safety Action Teams
    • Act as liaison with Flight Ops, In Flight and Tech Ops safety teams
    • Engage front-line co-workers to foster a safety culture; participate in briefings, and develop team communications
    • Set expectations with front-line co-workers and gain their commitment to act in accordance with Company guidelines and labor agreements
    • Lead performance dialogues with front-line employees to review metrics, safety communication boards, and work area hazard logs to ensure safe behaviors
    • Identify issues and engage in structured problem solving to assist front-line employees in accomplishing work
    • Conduct trend analyses, review key metrics and take actions to address items not on track - lead performance dialogues with front-line employees to review metrics, safety boards and safety communications
    • Communicate effectively to ensure priorities are understood and acted upon, with clear turnover for continuity across shifts
  • Performance Management Activities:
    • Support and promote Ground Safety Action Program (GSAP) and any action plans requested by GSAP Event Review Committee
    • Provide technical guidance and interpret company guidelines and procedures and/or union agreements to assist employees in performing functional tasks and to ensure that safety, security and service are delivered consistent
    • Ensure and support Safety Management System (SMS) Risk Assessments are accomplished for policy and procedure changes at the station
    • Identify, address and issue appropriate and timely corrective action in accordance with guidelines
    • Conduct routine investigations, as appropriate, into performance, safety (damages and injuries), complaints and other work issues
    • Recognize and document performance
    • Partner with Business Partner safety leaders to define and address performance impacting shared goals and service delivery to
    • United's customers, Participate in peer, safety and accident review boards
    • Confront and address inappropriate behavior and performance issues with specific coaching and feedback

Qualifications

What’s needed to succeed (Minimum Qualifications):

  • High School Diploma, GED or education equivalent required
  • Two years’ experience working in an airline operational capacity or similar experience
  • Demonstrated skill in preparing written and verbal communications, working knowledge of Federal Aviation and/or OSHA regulations
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States for any employer without sponsorship
  • Successful completion of interview required to meet job qualification
  • Reliable, punctual attendance is an essential function of the position

What will help you propel from the pack (Preferred Qualifications):

  • Bachelor’s Degree or 5+ years’ experience in safety preferred
  • Industrial and/or Occupational Safety
  • OSHA 10/30
  • Experience in conflict resolution and decision making and supervising others
  • Formal cause analysis or investigation training; strong written and oral communication skills


The base pay range for this role is $70,304.00 to $86,616.00.
The base salary range/hourly rate listed is dependent on job-related, factors such as experience, education, and skills. This position is also eligible for bonus and/or long-term incentive compensation awards.

You may be eligible for the following competitive benefits: medical, dental, vision, life, accident & disability, parental leave, employee assistance program, commuter, paid holidays, paid time off, 401(k) and flight privileges.

description:

Job Description:

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Caterpillar’s BCP division is hiring for Supplier Development Engineer in Clayton, NC!

Role Summary: In this role you will provide technical expertise and leadership to the Worktools supply base in the execution of Advanced Product Quality Planning (APQP), the implementation of process controls, the development of continuous quality improvement processes and procurement projects, and to develop new and existing suppliers worldwide to ensure all products are free from defects and are in compliance with manufacturing specifications and legal standards and meet our supplier performance requirements.

Job Duties:

  • Work with suppliers to ensure robust process controls are in place to prevent nonconformities/defects.
  • Monitor supplier’s key manufacturing processes, capacity, and quality management systems.
  • Lead or support APQP activities for new product devolvement programs.
  • Ensure supplier’s quality by conducting audits and assessments on incoming parts to identify any quality issues; develop supplier inspection plans, testing, and evaluation mechanisms.
  • Research potential suppliers, assess their manufacturing environment, practices, and procedures; Conduct supplier quality control audits to ensure compliance with organizational and federal policies and standards.
  • Supporting suppliers in improving their performance through process enhancements, implementing process controls and developing quality assurance plans.
  • Generating reports on supplier quality, by monitoring their defect rates and areas that can lead to potential flaws; Guide suppliers to reduce defect rates.

Core Skills

  • Relationships: Maintains close working relationships with suppliers and Caterpillar Supplier Quality Engineers, Logistics and Material Planning Groups, Purchasing Groups, Technical Process Stewards, APQP Leader and Design Engineers.
  • Effective Communications: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors.
  • Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations.
  • Process Improvement: Understanding and insight into evaluating current product quality and production methods and ability to maintain focus on the continuous improvement of processes, products and services.
  • Quality Orientation: Knowledge of quality management methods, tools, and techniques; ability to create and support an environment that meets the quality goals of the organization.
  • Supplier Management - MFG: Knowledge of processes and methods to effectively manage business relationships and transactions with suppliers of raw materials or product components; ability to apply related knowledge, experience and skills into real practice.

Required:

  • A bachelor’s degree, preferably in engineering.
  • Understanding of Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing. Understanding of QCLDM/TCO.

title: Cement Mason - Urban Forestry (BUF) - Public Works (7311)
description:
Under general supervision, performs skilled work in the placing and finishing of concrete on public or private property.

IMPORTANT AND ESSENTIAL DUTIES
Your duties as a Cement Mason may include, but are not limited to the following:

  • Laying out work for new construction or repair.
  • Breaking out damaged concrete and loading it into a dump truck.
  • Preparing job sites by setting up safety tripods and scaffolding.
  • Using various tools and equipment to perform concrete work.
  • Setting screeds and forms for concrete work.
  • Operating a transit/laser level.
  • Pouring and finishing concrete.
  • Mixing and applying toppings, colors, grits, epoxy overlays and waterproofing compounds.
  • Ensuring that completed work is covered and barricaded with A-frame and toe boards.
  • Ensuring tools and jobsites are clean.
  • Writing reports and keeping records.
  • Using a two-way radio, cell phone, and pager.
  • Operating a motor vehicle to travel and transport materials to job sites.

WORKING CONDITIONS:
- The nature of the work may require exposure to inclement weather conditions and may require exposure to hazardous materials and/or conditions.
- This position requires the physical strength and agility to climb ladders; crawl on hands and knees; lift objects that weigh up to ninety (90) pounds and carry them for distances up to fifty (50) feet; lift, drag and/or move with assistance large and/or heavy equipment to truck bed level; bend the knees, waist and back; stoop or squat; ability to kneel, bend and squat for considerable periods of time; remain in uncomfortable positions for extended periods of time.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

Education:

Certificate of completion of Apprenticeship under the authority of the California Division of Apprenticeship Standards including; completion of the City’s apprenticeship program in class 7398 Apprentice Cement Mason I or in class 7399 Apprentice Cement Mason II OR

Completion of a Division of Apprenticeship Standards or Department of Labor recognized apprenticeship program, as evidenced by issuance of a Certificate of Completion of Apprenticeship under the appropriate authority; AND

Experience:

4,160 hours of verifiable work experience as a journey level cement mason; OR

At least 10,400 hours of verifiable journey-level cement masonry work experience.

License and Certification:

Possession of a valid Class C California driver’s license.

Substitution:

Completion of the CA Division of Apprenticeship Standards recognized apprenticeship program with the City and County of San Francisco as evidenced by issuance of a Certificate of Completion of the City’s apprenticeship program under the appropriate authority will substitute for the 4,160 hours journey level cement mason experience.

description:

Job Title

SVP, Enterprise Architecture

About your role:

Lead the enterprise architecture function for Fiserv and define the technology direction that supports business strategy, operational scale, resilience, and security. You will work with executive leaders, product, engineering, infrastructure, data, and security teams to establish architecture standards and guide investment decisions. This role matters because it aligns enterprise platforms and delivery practices to enable consistent, measurable outcomes across the company.

What you'll do:

  • Guide evaluation and adoption of platforms, tools, and patterns for cloud, data, integration, application development, and enterprise security capabilities.

  • Drive current-state and target-state architecture assessments, identify capability gaps, and recommend sequenced plans to reduce technical debt and improve technology efficiency.

  • 10+ years of experience managing and developing teams, including senior architects and architecture leaders.

  • 15+ years of experience evaluating and governing application, data, integration, cloud, and security architecture decisions in regulated or highly controlled environments.

title: IT-strateg till Hägersten-Älvsjö stadsdelsförvaltning

description:
Stockholm – vår huvudstad med miljoner drömmar, förväntningar och ambitioner. Vi jobbar för alla som lever här idag och i framtiden. Nu söker vi dig som vill tänka stort, nytt och annorlunda med oss – för stockholmarna.

Hägersten-Älvsjö är en av 11 stadsdelsförvaltningar i Stockholms stad med cirka 3000 medarbetare. I dag är vi ett av stadens största stadsdelsområden med ca 130 000 invånare. I Hägersten-Älvsjö har du nära till staden, kommunikationer och naturen. Vi erbjuder en dynamisk arbetsplats med möjligheter för dig att utvecklas i din roll.

Välkommen till oss

Hos oss får du möjlighet att vara med och forma en helt ny roll i en växande IT-funktion. Enheten för service och lokaler utvecklar nu sitt arbete inom digitalisering och informationsförvaltning, där vi vill skapa ännu bättre stöd till verksamheterna. Vi är en organisation där det är högt i tak, nära till beslut och där samarbete mellan verksamhet och IT är avgörande för att lyckas. Rollen som IT-strateg är ny och du får därför en viktig möjlighet att påverka både uppdragets innehåll och hur vi arbetar framåt.

Du blir en del av en mindre IT-grupp som idag består av tre IT-samordnare, där du kompletterar och stärker helheten i vårt digitaliseringsarbete.

Vi erbjuder dig

Vi erbjuder en utvecklande roll i en verksamhet som befinner sig i en förändrings- och digitaliseringsresa. Här får du möjlighet att arbeta verksamhetsnära med stor påverkan på hur digitala lösningar utformas och används.

Du får:

  • En nyckelroll i att bygga upp och utveckla IT- och digitaliseringsfunktionen
  • Möjlighet att arbeta nära verksamheten och bidra till samhällsnytta
  • En flexibel och samarbetsinriktad arbetsmiljö med engagerade kollegor
  • Goda möjligheter till kompetensutveckling
  • Förmåner såsom flextid och friskvårdsbidrag. Läs mer om våra förmåner här.

Hälsning från din framtida chef

”Hej! Mitt namn är Robin och jag är chef för enheten för service och lokaler.

Jag har ett lugnt och lyhört ledarskap och tror på att vi lyckas bäst tillsammans. Hos oss är det högt i tak, vi samarbetar nära och stöttar varandra i vardagen.

Jag söker dig som är serviceinriktad, prestigelös och gillar att lösa problem. Här får du en varierad roll med många kontaktytor och möjlighet att göra skillnad.”

Din roll

Som IT-strateg arbetar du i gränslandet mellan verksamhet och IT och är en central länk i förvaltningens digitaliseringsarbete. Du har en strategisk och rådgivande roll där du driver och samordnar utvecklingen av digitala arbetssätt och lösningar.

Rollen är nyinrättad och du får möjlighet att vara med och forma arbetssätt, strukturer och processer för framtidens digitaliseringsarbete. Du arbetar både strategiskt och långsiktigt, samtidigt som du är nära verksamheten i det dagliga arbetet.

Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter:

  • Leda och stödja implementering av pm3-förvaltningsmodell utifrån våra behov och förutsättningar
  • Fungera som objektägare IT för utvalda system
  • Driva och samordna digitaliseringsinitiativ inom förvaltningen
  • Säkerställa att stadens digitaliseringsprocesser efterlevs och utvecklas
  • Vara en brygga mellan verksamheter och IT-funktioner
  • Identifiera och bidra till digitalisering av processer inom exempelvis äldreomsorg och socialtjänst
  • Bidra till informationssäkerhetsarbete och efterlevnad av relevanta regelverk, exempelvis cybersäkerhetslagstiftning
  • Samverka med interna IT-samordnare och externa aktörer

Rollen innebär inget personalansvar men ett tydligt ansvar för samordning, utveckling och förändringsledning inom digitaliseringsområdet.

Du tillhör enheten för service och lokaler och arbetar nära våra tre IT-samordnare.

Din kompetens och erfarenhet

Vi söker dig som har ett starkt intresse för hur digitalisering kan bidra till verksamhetsutveckling och som trivs i en roll där du får kombinera strategi, samordning och förändringsarbete.

För att lyckas i rollen har du:

  • akademisk utbildning inom IT, systemvetenskap eller motsvarande erfarenhet som arbetsgivaren bedömer likvärdig
  • erfarenhet av att driva digitaliserings- eller verksamhetsutvecklingsarbete
  • kunskap om informationssäkerhet och cybersäkerhetsområdet
  • mycket god förmåga att uttrycka dig på svenska i tal och skrift.

Det är meriterande om du har:

  • certifiering inom ISO 27001 Lead
  • erfarenhet av digitaliseringsarbete inom offentlig verksamhet
  • kunskap om PM3
  • erfarenhet från arbete inom Stockholms stad

Vi värdesätter följande personliga förmågor:

Du är initiativtagande och trivs i en roll där du själv driver arbetet framåt och tar ansvar för att saker händer. Du är utvecklingsinriktad och har ett naturligt intresse för att förbättra arbetssätt, processer och digitala lösningar. Samtidigt arbetar du strukturerat och har förmåga att skapa ordning och tydlighet även i komplexa sammanhang. Du har ett strategiskt perspektiv och kan se långsiktiga konsekvenser och möjligheter i digitaliseringsarbetet. Rollen kräver att du är självgående och trygg i att fatta beslut och driva frågor utan att alltid ha färdiga ramar. Vi ser också att du har en god helhetssyn, där du förstår hur olika delar i verksamhet och IT hänger ihop och bidrar till organisationens gemensamma mål.

Övrigt

På grund av sommarledighet kommer möjligheten att besvara frågor om tjänsten att vara begränsad under delar av rekryteringsperioden. Urval påbörjas under vecka 35 och de första intervjuerna planeras att genomföras under vecka 36.

Vi rekryterar utan det personliga brevet i denna rekrytering för att stärka fokus på de kompetenser och erfarenheter som efterfrågas för denna roll.

Vi ser mångfald som berikande och välkomnar alla sökande.

Stockholms stad arbetar med kompetensbaserad rekrytering som syftar till att se till varje persons kompetens och därmed motverka diskriminering.

Dit ga je doen

Schrijven, redigeren en actualiseren van uiteenlopende communicatie-uitingen, zoals bewonersbrieven, flyers, informatiedocumenten, nieuwsbrieven en webteksten. · Beheren en actualiseren van de website en andere digitale communicatiekanalen, waaronder het intranet (Workvivo). · Continu verbeteren van de online informatievoorziening op basis van vragen, signalen en gebruikersinzichten. · Een actieve bijdrage leveren aan de ontwikkeling en het beheer van het nieuwe huurdersportaal en de bijbehorende interne en externe kennisbank. Hierbij zorgdragen voor actuele, begrijpelijke en gebruiksvriendelijke informatie. · Vertalen van complexe informatie naar heldere en toegankelijke communicatie die aansluit bij de informatiebehoefte van huurders en collega's. · Ondersteunen bij communicatieprojecten, waaronder communicatie rondom nieuwbouwprojecten, bewonerscommunicatie en incidentele campagnes. · Ondersteunen bij het opstellen en versturen van e-mailcommunicatie en nieuwsbrieven. · Bijdragen aan de consistente toepassing van de huisstijl, tone of voice en corporate branding van Heimstaden. · Signaleren van kansen om communicatieprocessen, content en digitale communicatiemiddelen verder te verbeteren. · Waar passend gebruikmaken van AI en andere digitale hulpmiddelen om content te ontwikkelen en communicatieprocessen efficiënter in te richten.

Wie ben jij?

Je bent creatief, leergierig en krijgt energie van het schrijven en creëren van content. Je hebt hbo werk- en denkniveau en hebt onlangs een opleiding in communicatie, marketing of een vergelijkbare richting afgerond, of rondt deze binnenkort af.

Je hebt een uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal. Je weet informatie helder, toegankelijk en aantrekkelijk over te brengen en hebt affiniteit met digitale communicatie. Je vindt het leuk om content te ontwikkelen voor verschillende kanalen. Ervaring met een CMS, Adobe Express of e-mailmarketingsoftware, zoals Apsis, is een pré, maar geen vereiste.

Natuurlijk zijn we naast jouw kennis en vaardigheden ook benieuwd naar jou als persoon. Je werkt nauwkeurig, toont initiatief en werkt graag samen om onze communicatie iedere dag een beetje beter te maken.

Wat bieden wij?

Werken bij Heimstaden betekent werken in een dynamische internationale organisatie. Hier is volop ruimte voor ontwikkeling en persoonlijke groei, sterker nog, je past goed bij Heimstaden als je verder wilt komen en een stapje extra wilt zetten. We vragen redelijk wat van onze nieuwe collega, maar…daar staat natuurlijk ook wat tegenover:

  • Salaris tussen EUR 2.900 en 3.800 bruto per maand (afhankelijk van ervaring);
  • Een functie voor 24 tot 32 uur
  • Goede pensioenregeling en diverse personeelsverzekeringen;
  • Reiskostenvergoeding van 0,25 cent per km of volledige OV-vergoeding;
  • 28 vakantiedagen + 3 roostervrije dagen en mogelijkheid tot bijkoop van 5 vakantiedagen;
  • Laptop en telefoon
  • Een maandelijkse internetvergoeding;
  • Eenmalige vergoeding van maximaal 400,- euro netto voor inrichting van de thuiswerkplek.

We hechten veel waarde aan een goede samenwerking en van elkaar leren. Het is mogelijk om af en toe thuis te werken, maar jouw aanwezigheid op kantoor wordt zeer gewaardeerd. Ons kantoor is goed gefaciliteerd en beschikt over een dakterras waar collega’s samen lunchen en borrelen.

Een assessment maakt onderdeel uit van het sollicitatieproces, net zoals het nagaan van referenties en het aanvragen van een Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag. Bij vragen hierover horen we het graag van je!

Bij Heimstaden geloven we dat diversiteit ons sterker maakt. Onze collega’s zijn net zo divers als de buurten waarin we actief zijn. Met toewijding, vernieuwende ideeën en een gedeelde passie creëren we een veilige en fijne plek om te wonen met aandacht voor vandaag en de wereld van morgen.

title: [쌤157] 서비스 기획자
description:
About

# “모두가 최저세금으로”

널리소프트는 사업에 관한 어려운 문제를 소프트웨어로 해결한다는 미션 아래 모두가 최저세금으로 편리하게 세금 문제를 해결할 수 있는 ‘AI 세금신고 쌤157’을 서비스 하고 있는 테크 스타트업 입니다. 널리소프트는 스마일게이트 인베스트먼트, 우리 벤처투자, 미래에셋 벤처투자, 카카오뱅크, KB증권, D3쥬빌리 등의 투자자로부터 투자를 받았으며 누적 투자금은 127억원입니다. 쌤157은 출시 시점부터 지금까지 계속해서 사용자의 높은 지지를 받으며 (스토어 평점 4.8 이상), 개인사업자 세무 시장을 소프트웨어 기술력으로 혁신하고 있습니다. 우리는 세금 뿐 아니라 사업을 하면서 겪는 모든 어려운 문제를 소프트웨어로 해결해 나갈 것 입니다.

--
# 쌤157의 일하는 방식

우리는 탁월한 책임감을 가진 사람들을 존중하고, 그런 사람들이 성장할 수 있는 문화를 추구합니다. 어려운 도전 과제를 즐기는 사람들, 최고의 서비스를 내 손으로 만들어 내면서 시장을 혁신하는 과정을 즐기는 사람들, 완벽한 자율과 권한이 주어지는 환경에서 스스로 성과를 이루는 사람들을 우리는 인재라고 정의합니다. 이들은 회사를 위해서 자신의 무엇을 책임져야 하는지 정확하게 이해하고, 이를 통해 회사와 함께 엄청난 성장을 이룰 수 있는 사람들입니다. 만약 나에게 하달된 업무만 단순 반복하며 일 하기를 원하는 사람이라면 우리의 조직 문화와 맞지 않을 것입니다.

--
[홈페이지]
https://ssem.kr/

[채용페이지]
https://ssem157.careers.team

[플레이스토어]
https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.nullee.ssem

Responsibilities

# **이런 일을 함께 해요**

• 쌤157의 핵심 기능인 "SSEM 서비스를 기획, 설계하고 개발까지의 전 과정을 리딩"해요.
• 사용자 니즈를 파악하고, 이를 바탕으로 기능 아이디어를 구체화해요.
• 기능 출시 전후의 데이터를 기반으로 문제를 분석하고, 개선 방향을 도출해요.
• 개발자, 디자이너와 긴밀히 협업하며 "서비스의 완성도를 높이는 과정"을 함께해요.
• 개인사업자 시장에 대한 이해를 바탕으로, **기존의 복잡함을 단순하게 바꾸는 일**을 해요.

---
# **쌤157에서 '서비스 기획자'로 함께하면요**

• "사용자 중심의 사고로, 실질적인 변화를 만들어낼 기회"를 얻게 돼요.
• 작은 팀 안에서 직접 방향을 설정하고, 빠르게 실행해볼 수 있어요.
• 세금과 관련한 정의되지 않은 문제를 찾아내고, "스스로 기획의 기준을 세울 수 있는 환경"이에요.
• 다양한 직군과 자유롭게 의견을 나누고, 함께 문제를 해결하는 협업의 재미를 느낄 수 있어요.
• 제품이 커지는 과정을 처음부터 끝까지 함께하며 "성장의 실감"을 경험할 수 있어요.

Requirements

# **이런 경험이 필요해요**

• B2C 앱 서비스의 기획, 개발, 성장을 직접 주도해본 경험이 필요해요.
• 사용자 관점에서 문제를 정의하고, 실행 가능한 솔루션으로 연결해본 경험이 필요해요.
• 세금 및 개인사업자 시장에 관심이 많고, 이 시장의 문제를 바꾸고 싶은 열정을 가진 분이면 좋겠어요.
• 문제 해결을 위한 커뮤니케이션과 문서화, 일정 관리에 익숙한 분이면 잘 맞을 거예요.

Preferred

# **이런 경험이 있다면 더욱 좋아요**

• IT 또는 관련 업계에서 "3년 이하 경력을 가진 주니어 (신입 포함)" 라면 특히 환영해요.
• 전략적인 사고를 바탕으로 기획부터 실행까지 "직접 해본 경험"이 있으신 분이면 좋아요.
• 완전히 새로운 서비스를 0부터 만들어본 경험(0 to 1)이 있으시다면 더욱 반가워요.
• 작은 팀에서 여러 역할을 유연하게 넘나들며 일한 경험이 있다면 잘 어울릴 거예요.

Benefits

• 오직 일에만 집중하는 환경
• 수평적이고 편한 사무실 분위기
• 회사와 같이 나의 커리어 성장도 가능한 곳
• 연차 휴가의 자유로움
• 눈치 보지 않는 출퇴근
• 개인별 법인카드 제공

title: 00T10N - Manufacturing Technician 3
description:
00T10N - Manufacturing Technician 3

Description -

Job Summary
• This role is responsible for dismantling, adjusting, repairing, and assembling equipment according to relevant blueprints and schematics as well as collecting and assessing data related to the manufacturing process. The role actively tests new products, provides technical assistance to process development and engineering teams, and addresses technical quality issues. The role identifies areas for manufacturing line improvement and ensures updates are integrated into the systems. The role also aligns its work with the company's strategy while demonstrating problem-solving skills and forward planning.

Responsibilities
• Gathers and assesses data concerning both the manufacturing process and associated equipment, and interprets blueprints and schematics relevant to the manufacturing process.
• Tests new products and provides technical assistance to process development and engineering personnel.
• Dismantles, adjusts, repairs, and assembles equipment according to schematics, repair manuals, or specifications.
• Provides hands-on assistance to resolve technical quality issues related to customer complaints, manufacturing, engineering, test methods, and equipment.
• Identifies potential areas for improvement in the manufacturing line, optimizing tool availability, cycle time, and utilization.

title: Lead Software Engineer (Oracle/BI/.Net–Financial Reporting)
description:
About Us:


insightsoftware is a global provider of reporting, analytics, and performance management solutions that unlock the potential of business data and transform the way finance and data teams operate. We empower leaders from over 32,000 organizations to make timely and intelligent decisions. Our comprehensive solutions span Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A), Controllership, and Data and Analytics. We deliver finance teams the insights required to navigate any economic climate and drive greater financial intelligence, while increasing productivity, visibility, accuracy, and compliance. Learn more at insightsoftware.com.

Job Description:

Job Description

insightsoftware is looking for a technically sharp, people-first Engineering Lead to lead our Financial Reporting team — a squad at the center of our most complex and high-stakes enterprise workloads. This is not a process-management role. We want a hands-on technical leader who codes when it counts, drives architecture decisions with conviction, and knows how to get the best out of engineers in an AI-accelerated development environment.

You'll lead a team building and maintaining mission-critical reports and dashboards that serve Fortune 500 financial enterprises. You think in systems, not just features. You hold the bar high on code quality, design integrity, and delivery discipline — and you coach your team to do the same.

If you've led high-performing backend engineering teams, are fluent in modern AI developer tooling, and thrive at the intersection of technical depth and people leadership — this role is built for you.

The differentiator we're hiring for: This is not a role for someone who has moved away from the database. We need an architect-level Oracle SQL/PL-SQL practitioner who leads by example — writing and reviewing the hardest queries on the team, not just approving other people's designs.

Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end delivery of Reporting and BI features: from technical design through sprint execution to production — with full accountability for quality and timelines
  • Drive architectural decisions for scalable, high-performance dashboards using Oracle, BI Tools, Azure and .NET/C#— creating PoCs, reviewing PRs, and actively contributing code where it matters
  • Champion AI-first development practices across the team — mandating and coaching effective use of GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or equivalent AI coding tools as a standard part of the engineering workflow, not an optional extra
  • Shape the technical roadmap in partnership with Product — ensuring long-term architectural health is never traded away for short-term velocity
  • Run high-quality 1:1s, performance reviews, and growth conversations that move the needle on individual development and team retention
  • Enforce engineering standards: code quality gates, branch policies, code freeze discipline, and release management protocols — with zero ambiguity
  • Lead code reviews and architecture discussions as a teacher and a critic — raising the technical floor of every engineer on the team
  • Translate complex data reporting requirements into clean, maintainable, production-ready software
  • Partner with cross-functional teams — Product, QA, DevOps, and Customer Success — to deliver releases that enterprise clients can depend on

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science or equivalent demonstrated engineering depth
  • 10+ years of hands-on experience in designing and developing enterprise SaaS applications on the backend with deep understanding of Databases
  • 2+ years of engineering team management with a proven record of growing senior engineers and retaining high performers
  • Architect/Principal engineer level deep expertise in relational databases - Oracle PL/SQL — complex query optimization, stored procedures, performance tuning, and large-scale data handling
  • Very strong command of SQL and data modelling
  • Experience in Reporting/BI on Development side (Power BI, Tableau, Qlik etc.)
  • Demonstrated, day-to-day use of AI developer tools (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor) with the ability to coach teams on maximizing their impact
  • Experience in building and consuming RESTful APIs using .Net/C# in distributed, enterprise-scale systems
  • Solid grounding in Agile/Scrum delivery — sprint discipline, backlog ownership, and release management rigor
  • Strong proficiency with Git, branching strategies, and CI/CD practices
  • Experience in financial domain applications — FinTech or equity management — is a significant plus
  • Experience with Azure Cloud will be a plus
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication — you can explain a complex database design to a product manager and a deployment risk to an engineering Director with equal clarity

title: Senior Consultant - Project Delivery
description:
WSP India is seeking an experienced and adaptable Project Management Expert to join the Earth & Environment (E&E) business line supporting the US GCC region. This opportunity is ideal for a project professional with strong expertise in project controls, project execution, scheduling, document management, procurement, and project governance, complemented by a sound understanding of E&E engineering projects. The successful candidate will play a key role in supporting a growing portfolio of multidisciplinary projects by ensuring efficient project delivery, operational excellence, and adherence to established project management standards.

Project Delivery

  • Facilitate successful project execution by working closely with project managers, engineering teams, procurement functions, and key stakeholders to align scope, schedule, budget, and delivery objectives.
  • Implement and maintain project controls processes to track project performance, identify risks, and provide actionable insights for effective decision-making.
  • Partner with technical teams to understand project requirements and support the timely delivery of quality project outputs.
  • Oversee document management processes, procurement tracking activities, and compliance with project governance, quality, and operational standards.

Project Operations

Programme Management, Reporting & Controls

  • Support portfolio and regional leadership in monitoring key financial metrics, including revenue, costs, accounts receivable (AR), work-in-progress (WIP), and Days Sales Outstanding (DSO).
  • Monitor project performance indicators through WSP systems, ensuring compliance with reporting requirements and governance frameworks.
  • Prepare and coordinate progress reports, dashboards, meeting records, and project documentation to support project teams and client stakeholders.
  • Develop, maintain, and continuously enhance project schedules, risk registers, issue logs, and action trackers to support effective project governance.

Coordination & Stakeholder Engagement

  • Coordinate across multidisciplinary teams, including technical, commercial, planning, and construction functions, to promote integrated project delivery.
  • Foster strong collaboration between US and India teams by ensuring alignment on project priorities, deliverables, schedules, and responsibilities.
  • Plan and facilitate project meetings, workshops, and review sessions to support informed decision-making and project progress.
  • Risk, Change & Quality Management
  • Lead the identification, assessment, and escalation of project risks and issues that may affect scope, schedule, cost, or overall delivery.
  • Administer change management processes, including impact assessments, tracking of change requests, and coordination of approvals.
  • Promote quality excellence by ensuring compliance with established procedures, project delivery frameworks, and WSP quality standards.

Project Management

  • Support the full project lifecycle, including project initiation, planning, budgeting, work breakdown structures (WBS), resource coordination, risk and change management, compliance monitoring, and project closeout activities within ERP systems.
  • Work closely with Project Managers and cross-functional teams to coordinate project execution, monitor schedules and resources, manage timesheets and billing requirements, and facilitate stakeholder communications across global teams.
  • Strengthen project governance through portfolio reporting, document management, data quality reviews, lessons learned, forecasting, risk analysis, and monitoring of project health metrics to enable informed business decisions.

  • Monitor contract performance, coordinate renewals and amendments, and maintain comprehensive contract records and repositories.
  • Support the creation, modification, and renewal of Work Orders (WOs) while ensuring timely vendor invoice processing within Oracle Horizon ERP.
  • Collaborate with Project Managers and Finance teams to track project expenditures, resolve procurement and contract-related matters, and ensure compliance with internal policies and regulatory requirements.
  • Coordinate procurement activities, provide operational support to project teams, and contribute to procurement audits and capability-building initiatives.
  • Leverage analytics, forecasting tools, and Oracle systems to support procurement planning, maintain accurate procurement data, and drive continuous process improvements.

Essential

  • Bachelor’s / Master’s degree from a reputed academic institution in Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, or a related discipline.

  • Relevant Project Management experience in the AEC (Architecture, Engineering, Construction) industry, typically 9–14 years

  • Good communication skills with clear command over spoken and written English.

  • Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities.

  • Comfortable supporting US and international project teams and working across time zones.

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications as well as Power BI.

  • Able to work to tight deadlines while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.

  • Self-motivated, collaborative, and willing to take ownership of assigned tasks.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead and motivate teams, driving timely and high‑quality delivery of project outcomes.

Preferred

  • Industry-recognised Project Management Qualification like ChPP or progressing towards professional accreditation.

  • Experience supporting projects delivered for US or international clients from an India-based location.

  • Exposure to digital project controls, dashboards, or structured reporting toolsProficient in MS

  • CAPM-PMI / PMP certifications would be an added advantage.

이 두 서비스는 데이터와 고객의 목소리를 하나로 융합하여 놀라운 마케팅 효과를 만들어내고 있어요. 보통 1,000% 이상의 ROAS(광고비 대비 매출)를 기록할 정도로요! 덕분에 국내 대기업을 포함해 약 13만 개의 기업들이 저희를 믿고 함께하고 있습니다.

지금 우리는 여기서 멈추지 않고, “이커머스 올인원 플랫폼”으로 한 단계 더 도약하고 있어요.

title: Keittiötyöntekijä-siivooja
description:
Lapuan tuomiokirkkoseurakunnassa on haettavana keittiötyöntekijä-siivoojan toimi

Lapuan tuomiokirkkoseurakunta on aktiivinen noin 11 000 jäsenen seurakunta Etelä-Pohjanmaalla. Toimintamme ulottuu Lapuan keskustassa sijaitsevan seurakuntatalon lisäksi kiinteistöihimme ympäröivissä kylissä. Seurakunnan palveluksessa työskentelee vakituisesti noin 50 henkeä.

Haemme nyt joukkoomme vakituista keittiötyöntekijä-siivoojaa työskentelemään seurakunnan eri toimipisteissä 1.10.2026 alkaen tai sopimuksen mukaan. Työntekijän tehtäviin kuuluu erilaisten tilaisuuksien ruoka- ja kahvitarjoilujen valmistelua, pidempien leirien tai vastaavien tilaisuuksien ruokahuollon suunnittelua ja toteuttamista, tilojen ylläpitosiivoamista sekä välineistön huoltoa.

Keittiötyöntekijä-siivoojan työ on asiakaspalvelutehtävä, joka vaatii tekijältään hyvää tilanteenlukutaitoa ja tunneälyä. Työ edellyttää kykyä itsenäiseen työhön, mutta myös yhteistyöhön kollegoiden kanssa.

Työaika tehtävässä on 38 tuntia 15 minuuttia viikossa, ja työhön kuuluu myös ilta- ja viikonlopputöitä.

Uudelta keittiötyöntekijältä odotamme:
-Soveltuvaa ammattitutkintoa tai vastaavaa osaamista
-Hygieniapassia
-Kokemusta keittiötyöskentelystä
-Valmiutta oman auton käyttöön
-Halua ja valmiutta asiakaspalveluun

Uudelle työntekijälle luetaan eduksi
-Kokemus tilausten tekemisestä ja suunnittelusta
-Kokemus vastaavista tehtävistä
-Yhteistyötaidot
-Positiivinen asenne

Tarjoamme uudelle keittiötyöntekijä-siivoojalle mielekkään tehtävän nelihenkisessä keittiötiimissämme, meillä viihdytään töissä! Tehtävän palkkaus määräytyy Kirkon virka- ja työehtosopimuksen vaativuusryhmän 401 mukaisesti*. Palkan päälle tarjoamme lounasedun sekä kattavan liikunta- ja kulttuuriedun.

Hakemukset tehtävään pyydetään toimittamaan 21.8. klo 15 mennessä ensisijaisesti Kirkkorekryn kautta tai toissijaisesti paperisena osoitteeseen Koulukatu 2, 62100 Lapua. Haastattelut järjestetään ensisijaisesti tiistaina 25.8. ja toissijaisesti keskiviikkona 26.8. klo 12-16 välisenä aikana. Haastatteluun kutsuttaville ilmoitetaan erikseen 24.8. mennessä, voimme käydä hakemuksia myös läpi jo ennen hakuajan päättymistä. Kirkkoneuvosto päättää valittavasta henkilöstä kokouksessaan tiistai-iltana 1.9.

Lapuan tuomiokirkkoseurakunta on moninainen työyhteisö, jossa arvostamme jokaista sellaisena kuin hän on. Meille on tärkeää kohdata toinen ihminen kunnioittavasti ja ymmärtäen. Toivomme hakijoiksi eri taustoista ja elämäntilanteista tulevia henkilöitä. Tarjoamme tarvittaessa erityisjärjestelyjä, jotta jokaisella olisi mahdollisuus osallistua ja tulla osaksi yhteisöämme.

*Vaativuusryhmän 401 vähimmäispalkka on 2 345,83 € kuukaudessa. Palkan päälle maksetaan kokemuslisää 3, 5, 10 tai 15 vuoden hyväksi lasketun työkokemuksen mukaan vaativuusryhmän 401 mukaisesti. Henkilöllä, jolla on 3 vuotta hyväksi luettua työkokemusta, kuukausipalkka voisi olla 2 429,83 €. Palkkataulukot löytyvät sovellettavan työehtosopimuksen lopusta. Hallinto- ja talousjohtaja antaa mielellään lisätietoja palkkauksesta.

title: Principal Engineer Architect
description:
Overview

Windows is the best OS experience on the planet. Windows helps more than a billion people around the world to Do Great Things, and we are looking for Principal Engineer Architect to drive critical growth bets across multiple Windows customers and segments.

The Windows Experiences team is responsible for delivering seamless and integrated AI experiences in Windows for consumers, information workers, frontline workers, gamers, and others. In this role. You’ll partner closely with other teams in Windows, as well as across Microsoft.

Windows is a complex and mature product, and one of the largest codebases on the planet. We have ambitious business goals, and the architecture we have built over decades can make some changes more difficult to achieve. One of our key high-level goals is to ensure that our technologies, architecture, and decisions accelerate our ability to achieve our business goals, rather than stand in the way.

Ensuring we make quality decisions requires establishing, maintaining, and building strength in our engineering organization. You will be responsible for identifying long-term architectural investments, solving cross-organizational technical challenges, driving engineering excellence, and ensuring that our platform evolves to meet the demands of an AI-first future. This role requires exceptional strategic thinking, deep technical expertise, and the ability to influence senior leaders across organizations.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.



Responsibilities

Technical Leadership for the WXP IDC org

  • You will be seen as and will be playing the technical leadership role at the WXP IDC GM level where you will be setting up, reviewing, signing off and contributing to the technical and architectural decisions made by various GEM teams across the org. You will act as driver, consultant, bouncing board and champion for such technical choices and directions. You will be expected to represent the GEM and their projects at Director level communities to be able to align and bring back the cohesiveness in the technical and architectural stream.

Contributing to the Architecture Community

  • Great ideas come from everywhere. Our goal is for every group to have architecture representation, ensuring that everyone gets their feedback heard and the design help they need. You will also be responsible to be deeply connected with the other Principal IC community within W+D and being deeply involved with the top issues they are helping with and bring new issues to that group for W+D India that will most benefit from their expertise.

Writing it Down & building infrastructure

  • The cumulative decisions we all make on an individual level, in combination, form our overall system architecture. You will drive and contribute to producing documents that support easy offline sharing, commenting and review of the important points of any significant choice. To reduce process overhead, we will look to you to drive and contribute to defining templates that enable quick specifications for large-scale, multi-organizational architectures while ensuring consistent detail and review flow.

Review Forums

  • You will be here to help, supporting from one-pager reviews to get early design insights and coaching, all the way through any needed reviews. This individual will set up forums for review of their team’s work.

Planning and Strategy

  • While we encourage teams to dream the future of Windows unrestricted by technical realities, we also understand that technical realities exist that make some efforts more costly or difficult to achieve than others. Identifying these “big rocks,” up-levelling the visibility of our hardest problems and building a multi-release approach for addressing them will be a key role facilitated by the individual in this position.

Leadership Team Participation

  • This role reports to the WXP IDC GM and as such you are a key member of the GM’s Leadership Team. You will participate in a wide variety of decision-making discussions and will need to bring your unique viewpoint to the table, share, and help us make the best decisions. Similarly, you work on a wide variety of group-impacting activities whether it is D&I initiatives, training, communications, etc.

IC Mentor and Confidant

  • As an approachable member of the leadership community with a role most similar to the ICs in the org, you will need to devote some of your focus to mentoring and growing others and having your pulse on the IC community. You will need to bring that back to the leadership and ensure we make changes to make the IC employee experience as great as possible. Many people will see you as a path to the Architect and Principal Engineer, so you will need to represent the Group Manager and their LT in the way they would.


Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 8+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python.
    • OR equivalent experience.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical field, or equivalent industry experience.
  • 12 + years of experience shipping commercial software.
  • 5+ years of experience with C++ and Windows is a huge plus.
  • Deep technical experience including leading others.
  • Researching (and perhaps building prototypes and beyond) some new ways of doing something.
  • Demonstrates good communication and data presentation and storytelling skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence technical direction across multiple organizations without direct authority.
  • Exhibits a growth mindset and humility, while working through high-stakes scenarios.
  • Proven experiences as an ally who can further a more open, diverse, and inclusive workplace with a goal of everyone feeling like they belong.
  • Proven experience leading architecture for enterprise-scale platforms, operating systems, cloud services, or highly distributed systems.
  • Demonstrated hypothesis-driven, problem-solving orientation.
  • Solid design, coding, debugging, teamwork, and communication skills.
  • Planning and Execution: Ability to think holistically and strategically. Leverage understanding of execution rhythm so that the team operates at a high level, knowledge is shared appropriately, and decision making happens at the right levels on the team. Proven ability to plan, organize, and manage complex technical products.
  • Communication: Able to conduct insightful, multi-faceted conversations with senior product and technical decision makers inside and outside Microsoft. Conceptualize complex ideas quickly and convey those thoughts to others in a clear, effective and motivating manner.
  • Collaboration: Experienced collaborator able to work effectively across broad teams and influence stakeholders of all levels and of all disciplines across Microsoft.
  • Cultural Leadership: Proven ability to lead cultural initiatives, having positive impact on team morale and fostering an environment of inclusion.
  • Microsoft Values: As a senior member of the Windows Engineering Team, candidates must be excellent representatives of the Microsoft cultural attributes and leadership principles.
  • Judgement: Excellent technical judgment. Consistently demonstrating maturity and intellectual curiosity, helping the team pursue the best ideas.
  • Windows and/or Experience in Artificial Intelligence is an added advantage.

description:

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

About Cat Financial

Cat Financial is a subsidiary of Caterpillar Inc., the world’s leading manufacturer of construction and mining equipment, off-highway diesel and natural gas engines, industrial gas turbines and diesel-electric locomotives. For more than 40 years, Cat Financial has provided a wide range of financing solutions to customers and Cat® dealers for machines, engines, Solar® gas turbines, genuine Cat parts and services. Headquartered in Nashville, Tennessee, Cat Financial serves customers globally with offices and subsidiaries located throughout North and South America, Asia, Australia, Europe and Africa. Visit cat.com to learn more about Cat Financial.

Role Definition

  • Provide leadership to formulate, propose and implement interest rate risk, debt placement strategies, foreign exchange, and funding strategies for Caterpillar Financial Services Corporation (CFSC), manage CFSC pricing functions, manage global factoring programs for CFSC and support key processes in support of the corporate business plan.

Responsibilities

  • Oversees regional funding in either North America or Latin America, including the management and issuance of short and long-term debt securities, including commercial paper, medium-term notes, bank bilateral financing, and other capital solutions.
  • Oversees cash management team for North America, supports regional line units with banking and account management needs, and structures and administers intercompany funding.
  • Oversees the administration of the global interest rate and FX risk management systems and processes and provides asset liability management leadership and recommendations for regional line units.
  • Oversees global pricing function with responsibilities including the establishment of cost of funds, annual spread target setting, monthly reporting, and ROE evaluation of all transactions reviewed by Credit Committee.

Degree Requirement

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

Core Skills Required:

  • Relationship Management: Knowledge of relationship management techniques; ability to establish and maintain healthy working relationships with clients, vendors, and peers.
  • Staff and Career Development: Knowledge of available internal and external learning resources and ability to address learning, training, and career development needs of individuals, teams or organization.
  • Asset and Liability Management (ALM): Knowledge of asset and liability tools, techniques and business practices; ability to manage, measure, and monitor risks associated with assets and liabilities.
  • Financial Instruments: Knowledge of the concepts, types and applications of financial instruments; ability to perform analyses, management and other related tasks associated with financial service business.
  • Financial Markets: Knowledge of the products, types, competitors, customer base, major issues and regulatory considerations in the financial markets; ability to apply financial market knowledge to various business environments.
  • Financial Risk Management: Knowledge of tools, techniques, and strategies applied in financial risk management; ability to quantify, qualify, and manage financial risk.
  • Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP): Knowledge of the generally accepted accounting principles (GAAP); ability to apply GAAP appropriately within the organization.
  • Treasury Management: Knowledge of the principles and methods of managing treasury; ability to use tools, techniques and processes to maximize the value of an organization's financial assets and revenue while minimizing risk.

Top Candidates Will Bring:

  • Treasury & Capital Markets Leadership: Demonstrated expertise developing and executing funding strategies, including debt issuance, capital markets activities, commercial paper programs, bank financing, and long-term funding solutions that support business growth and profitability.
  • Asset Liability Management (ALM) Expertise: Deep understanding of balance sheet management, liquidity planning, and asset liability management principles, with the ability to optimize risk-adjusted returns and support strategic financial decision-making.
  • Interest Rate & Foreign Exchange Risk Management: Proven ability to identify, assess, and manage interest rate and foreign exchange exposures through effective risk management frameworks, hedging strategies, and derivative instruments.
  • Strategic Financial Leadership: Experience translating complex market dynamics into actionable business strategies, providing executive-level recommendations that align funding, pricing, and risk management decisions with organizational objectives.
  • Pricing & Profitability Management: Strong commercial acumen with experience establishing cost of funds methodologies, evaluating transaction profitability, managing spread performance, and supporting return on equity (ROE) objectives.
  • Global Funding & Liquidity Management: Track record of overseeing regional or global funding operations, cash management activities, banking relationships, and intercompany funding structures across multiple markets and currencies.
  • Executive Influence & Stakeholder Management: Exceptional ability to build trusted partnerships with senior leaders, banking partners, credit committees, and cross-functional teams to drive results and influence strategic outcomes.
  • People Leadership & Team Development: Proven success leading high-performing teams, developing talent, fostering collaboration, and creating an environment that supports continuous learning, accountability, and career growth.
  • Financial Markets Expertise: Comprehensive knowledge of economic trends, capital markets, funding environments, and emerging financial developments, with the ability to anticipate market impacts and proactively adjust strategy.
  • Analytical & Decision-Making Excellence: Strong quantitative and problem-solving skills with the ability to evaluate complex financial scenarios, assess risk, and make sound business decisions in a dynamic global environment.
  • Multilingual Communication: Fluent in English, Spanish, and Portuguese, with the ability to build strong relationships and communicate effectively across diverse international markets.

Additional information:

  • This position requires the successful candidate to work full time, 5 days per week in the Nashville main office.

$185,808.00 - $297,300.00

Olet nimikesuojattu lähihoitaja, laillistettu sairaanhoitaja tai sosionomi.
Kokemusta mielenterveys- ja päihdeasiakkaiden kanssa työskentelystä.
Halu oppia uutta, omatoimisuus, asiakaslähtöisyys sekä hyvät ihmissuhdetaidot ovat hyvä pohja työskentelylle ohjaajana.

Hygieniapassia.

Asiakaslähtöistä ajattelutapaa, hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja sekä kehittämismyönteisyyttä.

tsimme lämminhenkisiä ja reippaalla palveluasenteella varustettuja lähihoitajia työskentelemään Rovaniemelle kotiin tuotettavissa ammatillisissa lapsiperhepalveluissa.

Arvomme ystävällisyys, joustavuus ja luotettavuus näkyvät päivittäisessä työssämme.

Tiimiesihenkilön alaisen tiimin vuoden 2025 henkilöstötyytyväisyys kyselyn tulokset olivat kauttaaltaan hyviä/kiitettäviä ja asiakastyytyväisyyskyselyn tulokset kiitettäviä/erinomaisia!

Job Summary:

Caterpillar is seeking a Senior IT Analyst - Order Management Systems to support and improve enterprise applications that power order management, digital commerce, customer-facing platforms, and connected business processes. This role will provide technical leadership, operational oversight, and application delivery support for systems that help business teams, dealers, customers, and internal users work more effectively.

In this position, you will collaborate with business stakeholders, architects, software development teams, vendors, and support organizations to deliver enhancements, improve system reliability, troubleshoot complex issues, plan releases, support testing, and contribute to modernization initiatives. You will help connect business needs with scalable, secure, and reliable technology solutions.

This is a strong opportunity for an experienced IT applications professional who enjoys working across business and technology, solving complex problems, improving enterprise systems, and contributing to future technical leadership or solution architecture opportunities.

What you will do:

  • Lead application delivery and operational support activities for enterprise order management, digital commerce, and customer-facing applications.

  • Partner with business teams to understand needs, analyze requirements, evaluate solution options, and support strategic technology initiatives.

  • Coordinate application enhancements, releases, testing, deployment readiness, and production implementation.

  • Identify and manage risks, issues, dependencies, and impacts across interconnected business applications and technology platforms.

  • Work with developers, architects, vendors, cybersecurity, compliance, infrastructure, and support teams to maintain reliable and secure applications.

  • Troubleshoot complex system, integration, data flow, and production support issues.

  • Support application governance, compliance, audit, security, and operational standards.

  • Contribute to technology roadmaps, modernization planning, application lifecycle management, and continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Communicate status, decisions, risks, and recommendations to business partners, technical teams, and leadership.

  • Identify opportunities to improve support, delivery, automation, monitoring, and AI-enabled processes.

What you will have:

  • System Testing: Knowledge of system and software testing; ability to design, plan and execute system testing strategies and tactics to ensure the quality of software at all stages of the system life cycle.

  • Requirements Analysis: Knowledge of tools, methods, and techniques of requirement analysis; ability to elicit, analyze and record required business functionality and non-functionality requirements to ensure the success of a system or software development project.

  • Application Design, Architecture: Knowledge of application design and architecture principles and practices; ability to utilize application design methodologies, tools, and techniques to convert business requirements and logical models into a technical application design.

  • Core Application Systems: Knowledge of major production application systems used for delivery of services to internal and external clients; ability to leverage major production application systems in diverse situations.

  • Technology Advising: Ability to evaluate technology solutions, provide guidance to stakeholders, and promote best practices.

  • Decision Making and Critical Thinking: Ability to analyze technical and business requirements, identify risks, and develop effective strategies.

Basic requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Information Systems, or a related area.

  • Pre-advanced English.

  • Experience supporting, delivering, testing, enhancing, or implementing enterprise business applications.

  • Strong understanding of application systems, business process support, system integration, issue resolution, and production stability.

  • Experience gathering, analyzing, documenting, and validating business and technical requirements.

  • Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

  • Ability to work across business and technical teams in complex environments with multiple applications, integrations, vendors, and global partners.

Top candidates will also have:

  • 6+ years of experience in application delivery, application support, systems analysis, software development, or related technology roles.

  • Experience with order management, digital commerce, customer experience, supply chain, ERP, dealer/customer platforms, EDI, B2B integrations, or similar enterprise platforms.

  • Experience with Microsoft Azure, DevOps, AWS, Snowflake, Microsoft Power BI, Microsoft Dynamics 365, or other enterprise cloud and data platforms.

  • Experience with APIs, data flows, middleware, systems integration, and enterprise application architecture concepts.

  • Familiarity with Agile delivery, SDLC, release management, testing strategy, user acceptance testing, and production deployment.

  • Experience supporting cybersecurity, compliance, audit, governance, application lifecycle, or technology risk requirements.

  • Ability to influence across teams, simplify complex technical topics, and build trusted relationships with business and technical stakeholders.

General Job Responsibilities

  • Machine Monitoring: Operate and oversee medical equipment, ensuring functionality and safety. Respond promptly to alarms and auditory signals in a high-noise environment.
  • Communication: Answer incoming calls professionally and efficiently, providing accurate information and directing inquiries appropriately.
  • Discharge Preparation: Assist in preparing discharge documentation and coordinating logistics, ensuring timely and accurate processing without direct patient care responsibilities.

Job Summary:

Ensures continuous monitoring of cardiac rhythms by observing cardiac monitors; maintains all records and reports of rhythm strips in accordance with the established nursing standards and procedures.

Job Responsibilities and Requirements:

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Runs strip at time of admission, every 4 hours, and with any rhythm change.
  • Measures PR, QRS, and QT and interprets rhythm accurately when a strip is run.
  • Each strip is signed with first initial, full last name and position.
  • Tubes completed rhythm verification form to appropriate unit in a timely manner. Posts strips on telemetry log for all units.
  • Notifies appropriate unit and staff for any changes in baseline rhythm, including heart rate, or potentially lethal rhythms in adults or children according to protocol.
  • Ensures that alarms are on at all times and set at appropriate limits for adults and children according to protocol.
  • Notifies appropriate staff when electrodes or batteries need to be checked, replaced or changed.
  • Demonstrates awareness of the effect certain procedures or medications have on a patient’s rhythm.
  • Runs continuous strip for sustained VT, V-fib, asystole and bradycardia less than 40 per minute until code team arrives or otherwise notified.
  • Maintains telemetry logs, current patient information, does transmitter/SPO2 inventory per shift, and telemetry charges.
  • Works in a constant state of alertness and safe manner.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

EDUCATION

  • High School diploma/GED or 10 years of work experience

EXPERIENCE

  • No experience required

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Frequent lifting/carrying and pushing/pulling objects weighing 0-25 lbs.
  • Frequent sitting, standing, walking, reaching and repetitive foot/leg and hand/arm movements.

  • Frequent keyboard use/data entry.
  • Occasional bending, stooping, kneeling, squatting, twisting and gripping.
  • Occasional lifting/carrying and pushing/pulling objects weighing 25-50 lbs.
  • Rare climbing.

title: Care Partner
location: MO-SSM Health Saint Louis University Hospital 1201 Grand
description:
It's more than a career, it's a calling.

MO-SSM Health Saint Louis University Hospital 1201 Grand

Worker Type:

Regular

Job Summary:

Care Partners are responsible for meeting the basic needs of patients by providing skilled levels of bedside patient care under the direction of the Registered Nurse. Care Partners also perform clerical duties necessary to the functioning of the nursing unit.

Job Responsibilities and Requirements:

POSITION ACCOUNTABILITIES AND PERFORMANCE CRITERIA (% of Time)

Essential Functions: The following are essential job accountabilities and performance criteria:

1) General Patient Care:

Criteria

A) Carries out the patient’s plan of care as it relates to the patient’s physical needs under the direction of the Registered Nurse.

B) Delivers care requiring broad knowledge of aseptic technique, medical terminology and equipment.

C) Assists nurses and physicians with procedures.

D) Maintains knowledge of and operates equipment used in patient care safely.

E) Retrieves patient care items that are not routinely available on the unit.

F) Retrieves, recovers or follows up on patient care needs.

G) Completed unit clerical duties including the coordination of designated unit activities, transcription of orders, medical record maintenance and serving as a unit receptionist.

H) Prepares rooms prior to admissions and following discharges. Completes patient’s belongings list on admission and transfer.

I) Directs prompt and courteous attention to the needs of patients, families, and visitors.

J) Rounds with purpose.

K) Engages in service recovery activities referring unusual problems to Nurse Manager/ Designate.

L) Rounds after dietary trays are passed to ensure all meals are appropriate or as required for patient satisfaction /care needs.

M) Takes appropriate action when necessary including the resolution of issues related to late or wrong trays.

N) Feeds and sets up trays as needed.

O) Recognizes needs and initiates appropriate action in regard to maintaining supplies and equipment

P) Notifies appropriate department in order to maintain a clean safe environment (housekeeping, maintenance, dietary, etc.)

Q) Functions as a resource person to co-workers, patients/families, medical staff, and ancillary personnel.

2) Safety and Comfort

Criteria

A) Correctly places restraints; observes for constriction of circulation, changes to skin integrity, adequate breathing; knows when and how to change position; provides range of motion (ROM) and skin care, toileting, and opportunities for socialization.

B) Operates Cardiac Monitor i.e.

1. On/off switch

2. Alarms/stand-by

3. Obtaining strip

4. Lead placement

3) Vital Signs/Measurement

Criteria

A) Completes Point of Care Testing as approved by hospital and competency

B) Obtains vital signs including temperature

C) Measures abdominal girth

D) Weighs patients

E) Measures intake and output

4) Mobility and Exercise:

Criteria

A) Applies Pneumatic Air Stockings / Ted Hose

B) Ambulates, turns and positions patients.

5) Respiratory Care

Criteria

A) Assists with incentive spirometry and cough / deep breath.

B) Sets up oxygen therapy such as, nasal cannula or mask as directed by Registered Nurse.

C) Monitors pulse oximetry

D) Completes tracheostomy care

E) Performs suctioning

1. Oral

2. Tracheal: When the patient is assessed by the Registered Nurse to be stable.

6) Wound Care

Criteria

A) Places patient on specialty bed

B) Performs dressing changes (sterile and clean)

C) Cares for pin care site after assessment has been completed by the Registered Nurse. Assists in monitoring that traction weights are hanging freely and in good alignment.

7) Bowel and Bladder Elimination

Criteria

A) Administers enemas

B) Performs straight catheterization. Provides catheter care.

8) Hygiene

Criteria

A) Provides:

1. Hygiene and grooming daily

2. Mouth care (including dentures) at least twice/day.

3. Fresh water at 0800, 1600, 2400 and as needed

4. Perineal care

5. Toileting

9) Specimen Collection

Criteria

A) Obtains:

1. Midstream (clean-voided) urine specimen.

2. Timed urine specimen

3. Sterile urine specimen from an indwelling catheter

4. Urine specific gravity (5 South and 5 ICU only)

5. Urine pH

6. Expectorated sputum specimens

7. Blood specimens by venipuncture

8. Stool specimens

10) Clerical

Criteria

A) Answers phone within 3 rings identifying self, title and nursing unit. Does not keep person on hold for extended periods.

B) Provides directions to physicians, hospital personnel, and visitors to patient’s room.

C) Notifies the physician and nursing staff of new patient’s arrival to unit.

D) Assists in the receiving of articles brought to the nursing unit.

E) Answers pneumatic tube promptly and returns carriers to the appropriate area.

F) Prepares a daily worksheet and confirms all appointments concerning daily work (including blood work) and updates worksheet on each shift.

G) Verifies census sheet, maintains and updates as necessary.

H) Informs Admitting Department of all transfers, discharges, admissions, room changes, and deaths through the computer. Includes disposition of appropriate paperwork.

I) Informs staff/charge nurses / nurse manager of nursing unit activities: return of patients to the floor, physician stat orders, new admissions, etc.

J) Assist nursing staff and ancillary personnel to ensure appropriate and complete specimen labels/requisition orders.

K) Reports critical lab values to appropriate personnel.

L) Initiates and completes secretarial portion of the pre-op checklist.

M) Completes the administrative data screen for all new admissions and updates daily.

N) Assists the nursing staff with paperwork involved in the patient transfer and discharge procedure to include movement of medications.

O) Gives a full report to the oncoming person. (Leaves a written report if unable to give verbal). Informs the Charge Nurse if additional orders are left for the night shift.

P) Checks patient chart periodically throughout the shift for “stat”, flagged and un-flagged orders.

Q) Checks physician orders daily for unsigned verbal/telephone orders and places appropriate flag.

R) Enters orders into the computer accurately.

S) Calls departments to order tests, procedures, and consults which cannot be ordered through the computer.

T) Transcribes orders for tests/procedures/consults onto the TESTS/PROCEDURES section of the profile.

U) Ensures labels are correctly placed on all forms

V) Transcribes medication orders to the medication administration record accurately.

W) Places all physician orders in pharmacy bin. Faxes all physician orders to pharmacy during night shift.

X) Signs orders to indicate orders were taken off with date, time, signature and title

Y) Utilizes appropriate backup systems in the event of computer downtime.

Z) Ensures that stat and timed orders are transcribed promptly.

AA) Initiates and assembles charts

BB) Keeps chart in order; thins chart as needed and places in appropriate file.

CC) Obtains old charges from Medical Records through the computer.

DD) Ensures that Medical Records picks up old charts by placing them in assigned pick up area on day of discharge.

EE) Completes medical record checklist and ensures that the complete chart is sent to Medical Records within 24 hours of discharge and immediately upon patient death.

FF) Sends complete chart including thinned chart and old chart on transfer to patient.

GG) Ensures allergy, and isolation cards are posted in charts when indicated.

HH) Completes and signs secretarial portion of death summary.

11) Safety/Infection Control: Performs job in accordance with safety and infection control policies. (5,8) 5%

Criteria

A) Practices standard precautions and disposes of hazardous wastes per established guidelines.

B) Maintains a safe, clean, comfortable, and therapeutic environment for patients / families / employees in accordance to hospital standards.

1. Maintains clutter free environment.

2. Keeps personal conversations/background noise to a minimum.

3. Adheres to dress code.

C) Reports risk management concerns.

D) Assumes responsibility for completing all annual mandatory requirements:

1. Yearly TB Screening

2. Annual Ethics Training (Initial Ethics, if new employee)

3. Annual Safety Training

6. Annual Blood Borne Pathogens training (if required)

7. Coursework as assigned for .edu

8. Annual competency

9. Age/Population specific competency (if applicable)

11. Unit Specific

E) Obtains report from Registered Nurse and informs nurse of changes in patient’s condition.

F) Communicates concerns or patient complaints to Registered Nurse and other team members as appropriate.

G) Documents all procedures and care concisely and legibly on chart forms according to chart form guidelines.

H) Identifies problems, gathers pertinent data, suggests solutions, communicates using appropriate lines of authority, and works toward problem resolution.

I) Empties soiled linen containers.

J) Works in a constant state of alertness and safe manner.

A) Demonstrates care and courtesy

1. Provides prompt, respectful, courteous service.

2.Meets physical, spiritual, psychological and emotional needs of patients and families as directed by Registered Nurse.

3. Responds to call lights promptly.

4. Apologizes for mix-up and delay.

B) Communicates effectively and maintains confidentiality

1. Listens to staff/patient / family concerns and addresses needs within scope of responsibility.

2. Explains procedures and all education in a manner that staff / patient/ family understands.

3. Allows time for questions.

C) Demonstrates competence and collaboration

1. Provides accurate change of shift report.

2. Provides quality care in accordance to standards.

3. Shares knowledge with other departments to facilitate work flow and continuity.

D) Provides cost effect services

1. Uses resources wisely.

2. Recommends changes in practice that increases efficiency and minimizes waste.

13) Personal Accountability: Demonstrates accountability for own job performance. (6) 5%

Criteria

A) Adheres to and incorporates all customer service standards in patient care and work practices.

B) Participates in additional learning experiences to increase competence including:

1. Staff meetings

2. Mandatory in-services and educational programs

3. Evaluation of self-performance by identifying strengths and areas for improvement.

C) Assists in identifying and implementing nursing unit goals.

14) Performance Improvement (PI): Incorporates Performance Improvement into one's job performance. (6) 5%

Criteria

A) Identifies problems, participation in data collection when requested, suggests solutions, communicates using appropriate lines of authority and works toward problem resolution.

B) Participates in the performance / process improvement process.

1. Assists in developing unit based PI plan.

2. Participates in discussion of PI outcomes.

E) Participates in discussion of PI C2Q data outcomes.

G) Participates in research activities on the nursing unit as appropriate.

15) Age Appropriate Care: Provides age-appropriate care to:

____Infant ___Child ____Adolescent _____Adult _____Geriatric

Criteria

A) Demonstrates knowledge and skills of normal growth & development necessary to provide services to the age of the patient served by the department.

B) Demonstrates ability to assess and interpret age specific data to identify patient needs.

C) Utilizes communication skills necessary to interpret age specific responses to service and interaction.

D) Involves family or significant other in decision making related to services provided.

E) Demonstrates ability to provide service needed for the age groups routinely served by the department assigned.

F) Position specific: Need to enter those responsibilities specific for position

16) Specialized Care: Provides specialized care to patients at high risk for injury.

(1, 2, 4, 5, 8) <1%

Criteria

A) Restraint Care

1. Initiates/evaluates alternatives to restraint prior to application.

2. Applies restraints consistent with the approved procedure.

3. Monitors and assesses patient’s response throughout the restraint period at the appropriate intervals.

4. Provides specified patient care (toileting, skin care, hydration, feeding, etc.) on a timely basis.

Practice Agreement

For Nursing Staff

Please read the below standards and expectations.

Standard (I understand that…)

Our patients deserve care that sets the standard for excellence and meets the needs of each and every patient whose care is our primary purpose and mission. (Quality)

Expectations (So I will…)

  • Consistently adhering to proper infection control practices and I will educate patients and visitors of the same.

Standard (I understand that…)

Treating my colleagues, our patients, visitors, and business partners with respect and dignity is necessary to create an environment where excellence in caring and nursing practice can thrive. (People)

Expectations (So I will…)

  • Show empathy to every patient and communicate my commitment to assist in their comfort, safety, and restoration to health.

  • Come to work with a positive attitude.
  • Offer constructive criticism to co-workers when addressing concerns, praising in public and criticizing in private when necessary.
  • Be part of the solution – not part of the problem.
  • Not complain to or complain in front of my patients/families and staff (i.e. too busy or short staffed, no lunch).

  • Respond promptly to patient requests.

Standard (I understand that…)

Patients and their families are scared and vulnerable. It is my responsibility to communicate through verbal and non-vernal means that I am here to help. (Service)

  • Be compassionate and empathetic to their concerns at all times.

title: Laboratory Technician (Occupational Hygiene)
description:
Full-Time Opportunity

Monday to Friday | 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM

About the Role

We are seeking a Laboratory Technician (Occupational Hygiene) to join our Occupational Hygiene Team. This is primarily a laboratory-based role with occasional field work, supporting the preparation and analysis of occupational hygiene samples to deliver accurate, high-quality results for our clients.

POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES & OBJECTIVES:

Laboratory technician (Occupational Hygiene) will perform the following duties:

  • Receive, sort and prepare laboratory samples in accordance with Standard Operating Procedures.
  • Prepare samples for analysis in accordance with sample and analytical requirements.
  • Perform routine laboratory analysis, quality control checks, validations and project work.
  • Conduct analysis including:
    - Gravimetric analysis of respirable and inhalable dust
    - Respirable crystalline silica analysis
    - Diesel particulate matter analysis
    - Acid digestion for metals analysis
