title: Sr. Process Engineer, Amazon Devices Reverse Logistics
description:
Amazon Lab126 is an inventive research and development company that designs and engineers high-profile consumer electronics. Lab126 began in 2004 as a subsidiary of Amazon.com, Inc., originally creating the best-selling Kindle family of products. Since then, we have produced innovative devices like Fire tablets, Fire TV and Amazon Echo. What will you help us create?

The Role:
The Reverse Logistics Process Engineer is responsible for owning and driving the roadmap for operational excellence across the Amazon Devices reverse logistics network. This role spans multiple organizations and geographies in support of broader business objectives within the Amazon Devices Reverse Logistics ecosystem. You will define the overall Process engineering strategy for the org, build a roadmap to support that strategy, set objectives, analyze data, and drive improvements quantified with metrics.

Travel Required up to 25% (Domestic and International)

Key job responsibilities
In this role, you will:
1. Engineer and optimize reverse logistics processes to reduce cost and improve quality
2. Lead stakeholder reviews to identify process improvement opportunities in cycle time, manufacturing efficiency, capacity planning, UPH standardization, and productivity
3. Lead technical site and line setup (line layout simulation, capacity modeling, equipment specs, system integration) and participate in run-offs to ensure designs are followed and discrepancies resolved
4. Define process engineering metrics and leverage Lean Six Sigma principles to eliminate excess process
5. Develop best practices, SOPs, reports, dashboards, and data visualizations of process engineering metrics
6. Identify and deploy best known standards locally and globally
7. Use statistical analysis and data modeling to optimize performance metrics
8. Bridge operations, engineering, and business teams to drive mindful discussions to translate operational needs into technical requirements
9. Design and coordinate cross-functional engineering projects develop business processes, define technical requirements, and ensure deliverables are completed within required time frames
10. Own the technical roadmap for operations process engineering; contribute to operational planning cycle narratives and define organizational goals for process engineering with clear, measurable success criteria


A day in the life
As a Process Engineer, you will drive operational excellence through a dynamic mix of strategic thinking and hands-on problem-solving. Your days will be diverse, involving performance analysis, cross-functional collaboration, and leadership of improvement initiatives. You'll bridge Operations and Support teams, conducting deep-dives into metrics, developing data-driven solutions, identifying cost reduction opportunities and standardizing workflows. The role demands a balance between tactical operations and strategic projects, requiring strong relationship-building skills across the organization.

About the team
Amazon Devices Reverse Logistics owns global warranty and services for all Amazon Device products. The team's vision is to power the circular economy by giving consumer electronic products another chance to be loved.

Key responsibilities include administering the virtual Health Emergency Operations Center (HEOC), managing standardized Microsoft Teams and SharePoint incident libraries, and co-administering the on-call schedule within the department's personnel and training platform.

During emergency activations, the Emergency Preparedness Communications Coordinator serves as the Communications Lead by coordinating response calls and virtual meetings, documenting command decisions, and distributing approved Situation Reports (SITREPs), Incident Action Plans (IAPs), and operational updates to internal staff and public health, healthcare, and community partners through the County's emergency notification platform.

This position collaborates closely with Training and Exercise, Planning, Logistics, Volunteer, and Program teams, as well as the Office of Emergency Management and local, state, federal, and community partners to support effective emergency preparedness and response efforts.

  • Assists in developing data collection tools, surveys, and assessment instruments;

  • Supports community outreach efforts and participates in public health education and awareness activities;

(Relevant professional level experience and/or education from an accredited college or university may be substituted.)

Four years of experience with Pima County in Public Health Policy Analyst I, Public Health Educator I or II, Public Health Navigator, Public Health Program Specialist or related professional administrative or public health program classifications as determined by the department head at the time of recruitment.

Department

Job Summary

Under the direction of a radiologist, performs general radiographic examinations at a technical level not requiring constant supervision. Performs a variety of technical imaging procedures that entail application of ionizing radiation; therefore, prudent judgment, strong technical skills, and commitment to patient safety are considered requisite professional characteristics for individuals assuming the position as a general radiologic technologist.

Essential Functions:
  • Performs high quality general radiographic/fluoroscopic imaging studies by selecting specific software parameters that will produce a quality image for use by radiologists in their determination of a diagnosis. To provide the necessary data for radiologists to interpret images, the technologist scans all relevant clinical information into the PACS, assigns prioritization box for the radiologists’ worklist, and then transmits current to the PACS. These activities must be completed immediately following examination completion, not to exceed 1 hour. Prepares and assists in administering contrast agents and determines any potential allergies to ensure compliance with departmental practices. (50%)
  • Uses Epic to input patient examination data and to place patient orders, when appropriate. Notates within the appropriate electronic/hardcopy document, as necessary, all pertinent patient information to comply with patient screening, ordering, charting, and medical record requirements (15%)
  • Ensures patient safety, comfort, and personal dignity by following appropriate patient care guidelines to include use of 2 patient identifiers. Transports patients to and from the Department of Radiology, as needed, to prevent patient flow delays. (15%)
  • Assists in the maintenance of department inventory by ordering, stocking, and performing inventory checks on those medical supplies utilized when performing general radiographic examinations. (10%)
  • Attends and participates in departmental huddles, general intradepartmental meetings, and Radiology’s inservices. (5%)
  • Maintains imaging and processing equipment by performing scheduled cleanings and tests; results of all cleanings and tests are documented, as appropriate. Contacts service personnel and notifies supervisory staff of equipment malfunctions. Maintains a clean and orderly working environment through wiping down examination tables, changing linens, stocking supplies, and washing/disinfecting general radiographic equipment. (5%)

title: Varastotyöntekijä Vaasa, Vaasa
description:
Etsimme nyt motivoitunutta ja osaavaa varastotyöntekijää liittymään tiimiimme Vaasassa! Tämä on erinomainen tilaisuus sinulle, joka haluat työskennellä monipuolisessa ja vastuullisessa roolissa, jossa yhdistyvät varastotyöt, huolto- ja asennustehtävät. Työ on toistaiseksi voimassa oleva, ja se tarjoaa mahdollisuuden pitkäaikaiseen työsuhteeseen vakaassa ja kehittyvässä organisaatiossa.

**Mitä työtehtäviisi kuuluu?**
Päivittäisiin tehtäviisi sisältyy varastotyöt, kuten tavaroiden vastaanotto, keräily ja lähetys, sekä huolto- ja asennustehtävät. Työssäsi pääset hyödyntämään teknistä osaamistasi ja varmistamaan, että kaikki sujuu turvallisesti ja tehokkaasti. Työympäristömme on dynaaminen ja nopeatempoinen, joten odotamme sinulta joustavuutta ja kykyä sopeutua muuttuviin tilanteisiin.

**Mitä odotamme sinulta?**
- Erinomaista suomen kielen taitoa, sillä työssäsi tarvitset sujuvaa kommunikointia.
- Voimassa olevia tulityö- ja työturvallisuuskortteja sekä C-ajokorttia.
- Hyviä perustaitoja vastapainotrukin, työntömastotrukin ja hitsauksen käytössä. Näiden osaaminen katsotaan eduksi, mutta ei ole ehdoton vaatimus.
- Tarkkuutta, vastuullisuutta ja turvallisuusajattelua kaikissa työtehtävissä.

**Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?**
Tarjoamme sinulle vakituisen työpaikan, jossa pääset kehittämään osaamistasi ja erikoistumaan alasi ammattilaiseksi. Meillä on modernit työvälineet ja turvallinen työympäristö, jossa työntekijöiden hyvinvointi on etusijalla. Lisäksi tarjoamme kattavan perehdytyksen tehtäviisi ja mahdollisuuden osallistua lisäkoulutuksiin, jotka tukevat ammatillista kehittymistäsi.

**Miksi valita meidät?**
Tässä tehtävässä sinulla on mahdollisuus kasvaa ja kehittyä osana ammattitaitoista tiimiä. Työskentelet alalla, jossa on jatkuvasti uusia haasteita ja mahdollisuuksia erikoistua. Meillä arvostetaan työntekijöiden panosta ja tuetaan heidän urakehitystään. Lisäksi työpaikkamme sijaitsee hyvien kulkuyhteyksien varrella Vaasassa, mikä tekee työmatkoista sujuvia.

Jos olet vastuuntuntoinen, teknisesti taitava ja haluat työskennellä monipuolisessa roolissa, tämä työpaikka voi olla juuri sinua varten. Tule mukaan rakentamaan menestystarinaa kanssamme!

title: Research Officer
description:

The Climate Change in Southeast Asia Programme (CCSEAP) at the ISEAS-Yusof Ishak Institute was established in 2020 to examine the phenomenon of climate change, its impact, and policy responses across the region. title: Head of HR Sweden
description:
Får du energi av transformation, affärsnytta och att leda förändring i en snabbrörlig global miljö?

Ta nästa steg i din karriär som vår nya Head of HR. Hos Svea Solar får du vara med och forma vår people-agenda som stärker affären, bygger framtidens kompetenser och driver transformation genom hela organisationen.

Om Svea Solar

Svea Solar är en av Europas ledande leverantörer av energilösningar för hem och företag. Vår ambition är att göra det möjligt för konsumenter och fastighetsägare att navigera i ett allt mer komplext energisystem och att accelerera omställningen till förnybar energi. Vi vill göra energi enkelt.

Svea Solar grundes 2013 i Sverige och har vuxit till en av EU:s ledande installatörer av solceller för villamarknaden. Vi är verksamma i Sverige, Tyskland, Belgien och Italien. Kärnerbjudandet är installation av solceller, men har därefter breddats till batterier, värmepumpar, elbilsladdare och energioptimering – ett fullt integrerat energiekosystem för hemmet. Vi är främst inriktade på privatmarknaden, med jobbar även inom kommersiella och industriella fastigheter.

Om rollen

Som Head of HR Sweden leder du people agendan för vår svenska verksamhet och påverkar aktivt affärens inriktning, organisatorisk effektivitet och ledarskapsprestation. Du leder ett högpresterande team och samarbetar nära med seniora ledare för att bygga den kompetens, kultur och förmåga som krävs för framtida framgång.

I ett landskap som förändras snabbt genom digitalisering, AI och nya arbetssätt, är du drivande i förändringsarbetet och positionerar People som en strategisk drivkraft för affärsvärde.

Du ingår i den globala HR-ledningsgruppen (People Management Team), deltar i de svenska Business Reviews och leder det svenska HR-teamet. Du rapporterar till den globala CHRO.

I rollen kommer du bland annat att:

  • Äga och driva den svenska HR-strategin i linje med affärsmålen och [koncernens globala people-agenda]

  • Leda och utveckla ett team på fem personer inom (HR Business Partnering, Talent Acquisition, People Operations)

  • Coacha chefer i ledarskap, organisationsutveckling, förändringsarbete och svåra personalärenden

  • Ansvara för kompetensförsörjning, successionsplanering och ledarutveckling

  • Driva arbetet med kultur, engagemang och employer branding

  • Säkerställa efterlevnad av svensk arbetsrätt, kollektivavtal och arbetsmiljölagstiftning

  • Företräda bolaget i förhandlingar och samverkan med fackliga parter

  • Ansvara för lön, förmåner och HR-budget i Sverige

  • Använda data och nyckeltal för att följa upp och prioritera rätt insatser

Är vi en match?

Vi tror att du har..

  • Flerårig erfarenhet av en ledande HR-roll, gärna som HR-chef eller Head of HR

  • Gedigen kunskap i svensk arbetsrätt och praktisk erfarenhet av fackliga förhandlingar och kollektivavtal

  • Dokumenterad erfarenhet av att leda och utveckla team

  • Erfarenhet av förändringsledning i en organisation i tillväxt eller omställning

  • Relevant akademisk examen, exempelvis personalvetarprogrammet eller motsvarande

  • Van att använda såväl svenska som engelska som arbetsspråk

Det är meriterande om du

Har erfarenhet från att jobba in en matrisorganisation eller internationell koncernstruktur.

Varför Svea Solar?

På Svea Solar får du en enastående möjlighet. Chansen att använda din kompetens och din fantasi till att flytta gränserna för vad som är möjligt. Att bygga nya lösningar i en snabbt växande och utvecklande verksamhet. Du kommer att utmanas, men du kommer inte att vara ensam. Du blir en del av ett team av innovatörer med olika bakgrunder, alla drivna av att gå bortom status quo för att skapa det som kommer härnäst.

Om vår rekryteringsprocess

  • Alla kandidater bedöms på lika villkor, med strukturerade frågor och tester via Alva Labs för att säkerställa en rättvis och inkluderande process.

  • Läs mer om vår rekryteringsprocess här.

The Large Power Systems Division (LPSD) is part of Caterpillar’s Power & Energy segment. Through this global organization, Caterpillar designs and manufactures large (greater than 18 liters) diesel and natural gas engines, powertrains and key engine systems. LPSD products and solutions support customers across power generation, industrial, marine, oil & gas, rail, services and Cat® machine applications worldwide.

LPSD teams work across regions and functions to deliver safe, reliable and compliant solutions that help solve our customers’ toughest challenges.

​As an Electrical System Integration Engineer in the LPSD Electrical Systems Integration team you will integrate electrical/mechanical systems for diesel, natural gas, and alternative fuel engines. You will collaborate with global engineering teams, suppliers, customers, and production facilities to take projects from initial conception through commissioning.

Analytical Thinking: Knowledge of techniques and tools that promote effective analysis; ability to determine the root cause of organizational problems and create alternative solutions that resolve these problems.

Effective Communications: Understanding of effective communication concepts, tools and techniques; ability to effectively transmit, receive, and accurately interpret ideas, information, and needs through the application of appropriate communication behaviors.

title: Johdon assistentti
description:
Pidätkö langat käsissäsi myös silloin, kun niitä on paljon? Haluatko työskennellä lähellä liiketoiminnan johtoa ja olla mukana mahdollistamassa sujuvaa arkea kansainvälisessä teollisuusympäristössä?

Boliden Harjavalta hakee vakituiseen työsuhteeseen

Johdon assistenttia

Johdon assistenttina toimit keskeisessä roolissa toimitusjohtajan ja johtoryhmän tukena. Vastaat monipuolisista koordinointi-, viestintä- ja järjestelytehtävistä, jotka varmistavat sujuvan arjen sekä tehokkaan päätöksenteon unohtamatta pitkän tähtäimen suunnittelua.

Tehtävässä yhdistyvät organisointikyky, oma-aloitteisuus sekä kyky hallita useita samanaikaisia kokonaisuuksia. Tehtäviisi kuuluu muun muassa johtoryhmän kokousten järjestäminen ja niihin liittyvien dokumenttien laatiminen, intranetin ylläpito yhteistyössä viestintätiimin kanssa, matka-, vierailu- ja juhlajärjestelyitä sekä yhteistyö tehtävään kuuluvien palveluntuottajien kanssa. Toimit myös henkilöstöassistentin esihenkilönä.

Kenen kanssa tulet työskentelemään?

Työskentelet tiiviisti toimitusjohtajan, johtoryhmän sekä viestintä- ja henkilöstötoimintojen kanssa. Teet yhteistyötä myös muiden Bolidenin johdon assistenttien kanssa.

Raportoit tehtävässä toimitusjohtajalle. Työpisteesi sijaitsee Harjavallassa. Tehtävä edellyttää pääsääntöisesti läsnäoloa toimipaikalla, mutta etätyöskentely on mahdollista yhtiön voimassa olevan etätyöpolitiikan mukaan tehtävien niin salliessa.

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

  • Soveltuvaa koulutusta (esim. HSO-tradenomi tai muu vastaava koulutus)
  • Vähintään muutaman vuoden kokemusta vastaavista tehtävistä
  • Erinomaisia Microsoft Office -taitoja
  • Sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa
  • Kykyä hallita useita samanaikaisia tehtäviä ja muuttuvia aikatauluja
  • Suunnitelmallisuutta ja ennakointikykyä
  • Erinomaisia vuorovaikutus- ja yhteistyötaitoja sekä palveluhenkistä työotetta
  • Kykyä ymmärtää roolisi johdon tukena ja käsitellä asioita luottamuksellisesti

Arvostamme

  • Kokemusta sisäisestä viestinnästä ja intranet-sisältöjen tuottamisesta
  • SAP-järjestelmän tuntemusta

Miksi hakisit meille töihin?

Tässä tehtävässä saat vastuullisen ja monipuolisen roolin, jossa yksikään päivä ei ole samanlainen. Saat mahdollisuuden tehdä yhteistyötä ja verkostoitua eri toimintojen ja sidosryhmien kanssa.

Kannustamme työntekijöitämme jatkuvaan oppimiseen ja itsensä kehittämiseen. Tarjoamme mahdollisuuksia kouluttautua esimerkiksi alakohtaisen osaamisen ja kielitaidon osalta. Henkilöstöllämme on erittäin kattavat henkilöstöedut, kuten kattava työterveyshuolto, henkilöstörahasto, tulospalkkio ja monipuoliset edut vapaa-aikaan.

Lisätietoja

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa toimitusjohtaja Antti Kontiainen, puh. 040 637 4222. Soittoaika 24.8. klo 10.00 - 11.30.

Hakuprosessiin ja rekrytointijärjestelmään liittyviin kysymyksiin vastaa Talent Acquisition Partner Maarit Uusipaikka, maarit.uusipaikka@boliden.com.

Lähetä vapaamuotoinen hakemuksesi ansioluetteloineen 30.8.2026 mennessä.

____________________________________________________________________________

Tule meille töihin! Boliden Harjavalta jalostaa kuparia ja nikkeliä uusiutuvan energiantuotannon, vihreän siirtymän ja modernin yhteiskunnan tarpeisiin. Yhtiö työllistää yhteensä 590 eri alojen ammattilaista Harjavallassa ja Porissa. Yhtiön vuoden 2025 tuotannon arvo oli 3,6 miljardia euroa. Kuparisulattomme ja kuparielektrolyysimme ovat ainoat Suomessa ja nikkelisulattomme ainoa koko Länsi-Euroopassa. Olemme osa kansainvälistä Boliden-konsernia, jonka tavoitteena on olla maailman ilmastoystävällisin ja arvostetuin metallien tuottaja.

  • Process customer invoices in accordance with company policies and pricing guidelines.

  • Coordinate warranty billing, manufacturer reimbursements, insurance claims, and other applicable billing processes.

  • Verify customer billing information and resolve discrepancies prior to invoicing.

  • Ensure service cases are financially closed in a timely and accurate manner.

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for customer billing questions related to completed service work.

  • Explain invoices, warranty coverage, service charges, and payment options in a professional and customer-focused manner.

  • Resolve billing concerns while partnering with Case Managers, Field Service, and Accounting when additional information is required.

  • Maintain positive customer relationships throughout the billing and payment process.

Collections & Payment Processing

  • Process customer payments and maintain accurate payment records.

  • Monitor outstanding balances and perform timely collections follow-up.

  • Coordinate payment plans or other approved payment arrangements when applicable.

  • Escalate unresolved collection issues in accordance with company procedures.

  • =

  • Coordinate Return Material Authorization (RMA) requests.

  • Track warranty claim status through completion.

  • Maintain documentation supporting warranty eligibility and reimbursements.

  • Partner with Purchasing and Field Service to ensure replacement materials are properly tracked.

Case Closure

  • Review service documentation to ensure all required information has been received before closing cases.

  • Confirm billing handoff requirements have been satisfied, including:

  • Completed work orders

  • Technician documentation

  • Customer communications

  • Service dates

  • Billing requirements

  • Supporting documentation

  • Close completed service cases within established service level expectations.

Customer Care Support

During periods of increased call volume or staffing shortages, the Billing Specialist will:

  • Provide inbound phone coverage.

  • Assist with customer inquiries.

  • Route customer requests to the appropriate Case Manager.

  • Support overall Service Center performance by maintaining established service levels.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Partner closely with:

  • Case Managers

  • Field Service Manager

  • Service Technicians

  • Accounting

  • Purchasing

  • Tier II Technical Support

  • Warranty Administrators

  • Manufacturers

to ensure efficient case completion and financial accuracy.

Documentation & Compliance

  • Maintain accurate billing records within company systems.

  • Ensure all customer interactions and billing activities are documented.

  • Protect confidential customer financial information.

  • Follow company policies regarding invoicing, collections, and financial controls.

Continuous Improvement

  • Identify opportunities to improve billing workflows and reduce service closeout time.

  • Recommend process improvements that reduce billing errors and improve customer satisfaction.

  • Participate in Service Center meetings, training, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Employees at all levels are expected to:

  • Understand our Operating Principles; make them the guidelines for how you do your job.
  • Own the customer experience think and act in ways that put our customers first, give them seamless digital options at every touchpoint, and make them promoters of our products and services.
  • Know your stuff be enthusiastic learners, users and advocates of our game-changing technology, products and services, especially our digital tools and experiences.

  • Be an active part of the Net Promoter System a way of working that brings more employee and customer feedback into the company by joining huddles, making call backs and helping us elevate opportunities to do better for our customers.
  • Drive results and growth.
  • Support a culture of inclusion in how you work and lead.

title: SME - Psychiatry Addiction Medicine
description:
Position Overview

  • The Subject Matter Expert – Psychiatry (Addiction Medicine) will provide specialist clinical leadership and assurance for the Substance Use Disorder Audit Programme. The position will ensure that the audit methodology, evidence review, interviews, observations, findings and recommendations accurately reflect contemporary addiction psychiatry, substance misuse treatment, medication-assisted treatment, clinical governance and recovery-oriented models of care.
  • Working alongside the Lead Inspector, the SME will assess whether clinical services are safe, evidence-informed, multidisciplinary, person-centred and appropriately designed for the populations served. The position will provide expert interpretation of clinical evidence and advise on treatment pathways, withdrawal management, prescribing governance, risk assessment, rehabilitation, relapse prevention and continuity of care.

Primary Duties and Responsibilities

  • Act as the principal clinical adviser to the audit team on addiction psychiatry, substance misuse treatment and related clinical governance matters.
  • Review and clinically validate the SUD audit framework, assessment questions, evidence requirements, scoring criteria and risk indicators.
  • Participate in pre-audit document review and identify areas requiring focused clinical enquiry during each facility visit.
  • Assess the facility’s clinical model, including:
    • screening and early identification;
    • triage and comprehensive assessment;
    • diagnosis and formulation;
    • level-of-care determination;
    • individualised treatment planning;
    • withdrawal management;
    • medication-assisted treatment;
    • psychosocial interventions;
    • management of co-occurring mental and physical health conditions;
    • rehabilitation and recovery support;
    • relapse prevention;
    • discharge planning; and
    • follow-up and community reintegration.
  • Evaluate the clinical appropriateness, consistency and governance of treatment pathways for alcohol, opioids, amphetamines, prescription medicine dependence and other relevant substance-use presentations.
  • Review clinical policies and protocols relating to prescribing, medication monitoring, controlled medicines, diversion prevention and escalation of prescribing risk.
  • Assess governance arrangements for opioid substitution or medication-assisted treatment, including induction, titration, monitoring, review and continuity of prescribing.
  • Evaluate whether clinical services operate through an appropriately constituted multidisciplinary team and whether professional roles, responsibilities, competencies and supervision arrangements are clearly defined.
  • Assess the availability and integration of psychiatry, psychology, nursing, social work, occupational therapy, pharmacy, primary care and other relevant disciplines.
  • Conduct structured interviews with psychiatrists, physicians, nurses, psychologists, pharmacists, social workers, therapists and clinical leaders.
  • Evaluate clinical supervision, continuing professional development, competency assurance and access to specialist advice.
  • Assess whether services effectively recognise and manage:
    • intoxication and withdrawal;
    • overdose risk;
    • suicide and self-harm risk;
    • safeguarding concerns;
    • dual diagnosis;
    • physical health complications;
    • medication interactions;
    • relapse risk; and
    • service-user deaths or serious incidents.
  • Determine whether clinical policies are consistent with evidence-based practice and whether they are implemented in routine service delivery.
  • Identify immediate clinical safety concerns and advise the Lead Inspector on their severity, urgency and required escalation.
  • Provide specialist interpretation where clinical practice differs from written policy or where local models require assessment against international best practice.
  • Contribute clinically robust findings, recommendations and corrective actions for each facility report.
  • Identify system-wide clinical capability gaps, including workforce shortages, pathway fragmentation, prescribing risks, limited rehabilitation capacity or inadequate continuity between healthcare and social care.
  • Support the preparation and presentation of the consolidated audit findings and strategic recommendations to the Department of Health.
Qualifications
  • Primary medical qualification recognised by an appropriate national medical regulatory authority.
  • Membership or fellowship of a recognised professional college of psychiatry.
  • Specialist accreditation, board certification or equivalent consultant-level qualification in psychiatry.
  • Specialist training or formal accreditation in addiction psychiatry, substance misuse psychiatry or addiction medicine.
  • Postgraduate qualification in addiction medicine, addictive behaviour, substance misuse or a closely related discipline is highly desirable.
  • Qualification or demonstrated experience in medical education, clinical supervision or professional training is desirable.
Experience
  • At least 10 years of post-specialist clinical experience, including substantial consultant-level practice.
  • Extensive experience in the assessment and treatment of complex substance-use presentations involving alcohol, opioids, stimulants and prescription medicines.
  • Demonstrated experience across more than one SUD service setting, including inpatient, outpatient, detoxification, community and rehabilitation services.
  • Senior clinical leadership experience within a regional, national or multi-site substance misuse treatment service.
  • Experience providing clinical governance, policy development, pathway development and quality assurance across SUD services.
  • Practical experience with medication-assisted treatment, opioid substitution treatment, induction and titration arrangements, depot treatment and controlled medication governance.
  • Experience supervising consultants, doctors, non-medical prescribers and other members of multidisciplinary clinical teams.
  • Demonstrated experience undertaking or supporting clinical audits, quality-improvement programmes and reviews following serious incidents or service-user deaths.
  • Experience developing clinical partnerships and referral pathways between addiction services, mental health services, primary care and other relevant agencies.
  • International experience, particularly within culturally diverse healthcare settings or the Middle East and Asia, is highly desirable.
Knowledge and capabilities
  • Expert knowledge of addiction psychiatry, substance misuse treatment and recovery-oriented care.
  • Strong knowledge of pharmacological and psychosocial interventions for substance use disorders.
  • Detailed understanding of withdrawal management, medication-assisted treatment, controlled medicine governance, safe prescribing and diversion prevention.
  • Strong understanding of co-occurring psychiatric disorders, physical health complications and clinical risk in SUD populations.
  • Ability to assess the clinical quality and safety of services without relying exclusively on individual patient-record review.
  • Ability to evaluate multidisciplinary workforce models, clinical competencies, supervision systems and professional accountabilities.

About the Role

Join a nationally significant NHMRC-funded research program focused on advancing Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander kidney health outcomes. As a Research Associate, you will contribute to impactful research that supports communities to design and implement evidence-based health interventions aimed at reducing the burden of chronic kidney disease. Working within Flinders University's Rural and Remote Health team in Darwin, you will collaborate with researchers, communities, and industry partners across regional, remote and national settings to deliver meaningful health outcomes.

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander communities, industry partners and stakeholders across regional, rural and remote locations.

  • Produce high-quality research outputs, including publications, presentations and contributions to future research funding opportunities.

This position makes a significant contribution to the University’s strategic plan to change 10 million lives, Every One Matters, by 2035 through directly contributing to the strategic driver of Research that Matters. By advancing Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander kidney health through impactful, community-informed research, the role supports the generation of evidence, partnerships and knowledge that drive meaningful health improvements across regional, rural and remote communities.

About You

You are an emerging researcher with a passion for improving Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander health outcomes through impactful, community-centred research. With a background in public health, Indigenous health or a related discipline, you bring strong research skills, experience working across diverse stakeholder groups, and a commitment to delivering high-quality outcomes that contribute to meaningful change in regional, rural and remote communities.

Our postgraduate education pathways (Remote Health Practice program), provides workforce development through Indigenous health and clinical skills training, and we have a community driven research program led by researchers committed to improving health outcomes. SUMMARY

The Care Navigator functions as a core member of an Integrated Care team that includes the Primary Care Provider (PCP), Behavioral Health Clinician (BHC), and psychiatric provider. The Care Navigator is responsible for coordinating and supporting Mental Health care within the clinic and for coordinating referrals to clinically indicated services within and outside of the clinic. The Care Navigator may provide evidence-based treatments to patients or collaborate with other Mental Health providers when such treatment is indicated. This role will report to the Manager, Behavioral Health/Primary Care Integration or designee.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Support and coordinate behavioral health care with the patient, patient’s Primary Care Provider (PCP), BHC, psychiatric provider and other Integrated Care team members.

  • Screen and assess patients for common mental health and substance abuse disorders. This may involve completing or assisting with completion of identified screening tools utilized in practice.

  • Provide patient education about common mental health and substance abuse disorders and available treatment options.

  • Monitor patients (in person or by telephone) for changes in clinical symptoms and treatment side effects or complications.

  • Support psychotropic medication management prescribed by PCPs and/or psychiatric provider, focusing on treatment adherence, side effects and other complications, and effectiveness of treatment.

  • Provide brief interventions using evidence-based techniques such as Behavioral Activation, Problem-Solving Treatment, Motivational Interviewing, or other treatments appropriate for primary care settings.

  • Provide or facilitate referrals to mental health clinic/substance use disorder treatment programs as clinically indicated.

  • Participate in regularly scheduled Integrated Care team meetings and communicate treatment recommendations to team members and outside collaborators as indicated.

  • Facilitate patient engagement and follow-up in care.

  • Maintain a registry of patients in the Integrated Care track that includes engagement, measurement- based care outcomes (PHQ-9) results and other items being used by the team to track and manage care.

  • Facilitate the Integrated Care team’s review of care of patients not responding optimally to treatment that may lead to management changes in medications or psychosocial treatments, or appropriate referrals for additional services.

  • Handle confidential information with discernment and sensitivity.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in Human Services related field, medical related field, customer service, client/patient interfacing experience required; OR

description:

- toimii kaupungin sisäisenä asiantuntijana, joka seuraa henkilötietojen käsittelyä ja auttaa tietosuojasäännösten noudattamisessa
- koordinoi kaupungin tietosuojatyötä ja raportoi johdolle tietosuojan tilasta ja kehittämiskohteista
- neuvoo ja on mukana tietosuojaan liittyvän vaikutuksenarvioinnin tekemisessä ja valvoo sen toteutumista
- valvoo tietosuoja-asetuksen ja muun tietosuojaan liittyvän lainsäädännön ja ohjeistuksen noudattamista

- toteuttaa henkilökunnan tietosuojakoulutuksia
- vastaa muista hallintojohtajan määräämistä tehtävistä

Virkaan valittavalta edellytetään korkeakoulututkintoa soveltuvalta alalta. Tehtävän hoitaminen edellyttää tietosuojalainsäädännön ja muun henkilötietojen käsittelyyn liittyvän lainsäädännön osaamista ja kykyä soveltaa lakia. Tietosuojavastaavan koulutus, kokemus kunta-alalta sekä riskien hallinnasta ja tietojärjestelmien toiminnasta katsotaan hakijan eduksi. Tietosuojavastaavan työ edellyttää kykyä itsenäiseen työskentelyyn, tiimityöskentelytaitoja, paineensietokykyä sekä hyviä vuorovaikutus-, yhteistyö- ja viestintätaitoja.

Valinta suoritetaan hakemusasiakirjojen ja haastattelun pohjalta tehdyn kokonaisarvion perusteella. Virkasuhteen ehdot määräytyvät KVTES:n mukaan. Virkaa täytettäessä noudatetaan kuuden kuukauden koeaikaa. Työ vaatii säännöllistä läsnäoloa Lappeenrannan kaupungintalolla.

Hakemukset tehdään sähköisesti Kuntarekry.fi -palvelun kautta. Hakuaika päättyy 28.8.2026 klo 12.

Haastatteluun valitun hakijan on esitettävä kelpoisuuden osoittavat tutkintotodistukset haastattelutilaisuudessa. Virkaan valitun tulee esittää hyväksyttävä lausunto terveydentilastaan ennen viran vastaanottamista.

location: Spring, Texas, United States of America
description:
Senior Director, Lead-to-Order Software Engineering

Description -

Job Description

HP is seeking an exceptional Senior Director of Lead-to-Order Software Engineering to lead one of the company’s most business-critical digital engineering organizations. This leader will own the strategy, execution, modernization, and operational excellence of HP’s Lead-to-Order software portfolio, spanning CPQ, eCommerce, partner enablement, sales compensation, subscription services, payment and invoicing, digital content, CRM, and commerce platforms.

This role leads a large, global engineering organization across the U.S., India, Brazil, China, Colombia, Europe, and other regions, with responsibility for managers, full-time software developers, contractors, architects, Scrum Masters, and TPMs. The current organization has operated at 350+ software professionals and includes multiple globally distributed engineering managers and delivery teams.

The ideal candidate is a deeply technical, business-oriented engineering executive who can modernize enterprise platforms, accelerate software delivery, improve quality and resiliency, optimize global delivery models, and partner with senior business leaders to enable HP’s Lead-to-Order transformation.

Why This Role Matters

Lead-to-Order sits at the center of HP’s ability to convert customer, partner, and commercial demand into revenue. This leader will drive platforms and capabilities that directly influence quote velocity, order accuracy, partner experience, commerce enablement, subscription growth, sales compensation, and operational efficiency.

Continued portfolio improvements include modernization of CPQ, eCommerce, and subscription platforms; faster quote cycle times; improved order accuracy; large-scale vendor consolidation; AI-enabled SDLC acceleration; and measurable cost savings across software delivery and operations. The organization also delivers business-impacting capabilities across HP2B, B2C commerce, Stellar Direct, Gekko/subscription services, marketing digital asset transformation, HP All-In Plan, and EMEA partner automation.


Responsibilities

Engineering Strategy and Platform Modernization

Lead the vision, architecture, modernization, and execution roadmap for HP’s Lead-to-Order platforms, including CPQ, CRM, B2B/B2C eCommerce, partner portal, partner enablement, partner contra, sales compensation, subscriptions, payment and invoicing, and related digital commerce capabilities.

Drive modernization of strategic platforms to improve scalability, resiliency, security, developer productivity, customer experience, and partner experience.

Establish clear engineering priorities tied to business KPIs, including quote cycle time, order accuracy, revenue enablement, platform availability, cost efficiency, security posture, and delivery predictability.

Global Engineering Leadership

Lead a large, globally distributed engineering organization across multiple geographies, time zones, cultures, and delivery models. Build a high-performance leadership team of engineering managers, architects, technical leads, program leaders, and senior engineers.

Develop talent, strengthen succession plans, improve organizational design, and create clear accountability across multiple software domains and value streams.

Build strong relationships with L3/L4 value stream leaders, business stakeholders, finance, HR, enterprise architecture, security, operations, procurement, and supplier partners.

AI-Enabled Software Delivery and SDLC Transformation

Lead the next generation of software engineering productivity by operationalizing AI-assisted and agentic SDLC accelerators, developer productivity tooling, engineering standards, automation, and measurable delivery improvements.

Define and scale a standard SDLC framework across the organization, including story point baselining, quality gates, DevSecOps practices, release discipline, observability, and continuous improvement. The current role includes leading the development of a standard SDLC framework and operationalizing supplier strategy outcomes.

Operational Excellence, Cost, and Supplier Strategy

Own major software delivery budgets, supplier performance, workforce mix, and cost optimization strategies. Lead vendor consolidation, sourcing strategy, master SOW governance, technical assessments, and delivery model optimization.

Drive significant savings through supplier consolidation, AI-driven development acceleration, infrastructure optimization, contractor-to-FTE conversions, and cloud cost reduction.

Security, Quality, Reliability, and Governance

Ensure all Lead-to-Order platforms meet enterprise standards for security, privacy, compliance, availability, and operational resiliency.

Drive vulnerability remediation, DevSecOps maturity, cloud infrastructure stability, incident reduction, automation, testing strategy, observability, and production excellence. Continue the reduction of high-severity exposure across Azure Pipelines agents and improve stability, job success, and production ticket performance.

Scope of Leadership

This leader will oversee a broad Lead-to-Order portfolio that includes, but is not limited to:

  • Sales Experience, CRM, and CPQ solutions
  • B2B and B2C eCommerce
  • Partner Portal and Partner Enablement
  • Partner Contra
  • Sales Compensation
  • Gekko / Subscription Services
  • Payment and Invoicing
  • Digital Content
  • All-In Commerce / HP All-In Plan capabilities

title: Personlig assistent i Sjulsmark
description:
Vi söker dig som vill arbeta som personlig assistent till ett liten flicka på cirka 10 månader. Barnet bor tillsammans med sina föräldrar i ett lugnt och välkomnande hem. Familjen är öppen, samarbetsvillig och mån om ett bra arbetsklimat för dem som arbetar där. Arbetsplatsen ligger i Sjulsmark.

Om uppdraget

Uppdraget är medicinskt avancerat och kräver tillsyn dygnet runt. Med anledning av flickans trakeostomi arbetar ni alltid två assistenter tillsammans — du är aldrig ensam med ansvaret. Arbetet sker i flickans hem och med ut när familjen är iväg.

Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter är att övervaka flickans andning, hantera trakealkanyl, sköta slemsugning, ge inhalationer och tillföra näring via sond. Det är specialiserade moment som kräver fokus, noggrannhet och uthållig uppmärksamhet under hela arbetspasset.

Du får full introduktion i alla medicinska moment och fortlöpande utbildning under uppdragets gång. Tidigare medicinsk erfarenhet är inget krav — vi lär upp rätt person.

Vem är du?

Personkemin mellan dig, barnet och familjen är avgörande, och vi lägger därför stor vikt vid hur du är som person. Vi söker dig som ser personlig assistans som ett yrke och tar dig an uppdraget med empati och professionell omsorg.

Du är lugn, observant och trygg i din yrkesroll. Du är van vid att arbeta i någon annans hem och förstår vikten av att respektera familjens rutiner, integritet och roll i barnets liv. Du tar initiativ i din yrkesroll och samarbetar nära både kollega och familj.

Vi ser gärna att du är:

  • Ansvarsfull, empatisk och lyhörd

  • Lugn och uppmärksam även under långa pass

  • Punktlig och flexibel, och kan hoppa in när det behövs

  • Noggrann med dokumentation och rapportering

  • En god lagspelare

Krav

  • Familjen önskar att assistenten är kvinna

  • Du röker inte (rester av rök i kläder och hår kan påverka barnets andning)

  • Du har god svenska i tal och skrift

Eftersom arbetsplatsen ligger cirka 30 minuters bilresa från centrala Luleå, i ett område med begränsade bussförbindelse behöver du som sökande körkort och tillgång till bil för att kunna ta dig till och från arbetet på ett bra sätt.

Om anställningen

Arbetstiderna varierar mellan dag, kväll och natt enligt schema. Tillträde enligt överenskommelse.

Om Novum Assistans

Novum är en rikstäckande assistansanordnare som vill göra skillnad för individen, branschen och samhället. Hos oss är du delaktig genom regelbundna arbetsplatsträffar där uppdraget utvecklas tillsammans, och du får möjlighet att utvecklas både som person och i din yrkesroll. Läs mer om Novum här.

Ansökan

Urval sker löpande, så vänta inte med din ansökan. Vi tillämpar ett strukturerat urval där personlighet och bemötande väger tungt. För anställning hos Novum krävs BankID, som du även använder i tjänsten.

Välkommen med din ansökan.

title: Senior Manager, Data Engineering
description:
Job Posting Title:

Senior Manager, Data Engineering

10155926

Job Description:

About the Role & Team

“We Power the Magic!” That’s our motto at Disney Experiences (DX). Our team creates world-class immersive digital experiences for the Company’s premier vacation brands including Disney’s Parks & Resorts worldwide, Disney Cruise Line, Aulani, A Disney Resort & Spa, and Disney Vacation Club. We are responsible for the end-to-end digital and physical Guest experience for all technology & digital-led initiatives across the Attractions & Entertainment, Food & Beverage, Resorts & Transportation, and Merchandise lines of business, as well as other initiatives, including MyDisneyExperience and Hey, Disney!

As the Senior Manager, Data Engineering, you will lead a team of engineers and product managers responsible for operating and advancing the platforms and products that power data and guest experiences across Disney Experiences. This role requires an exceptional leader who pairs deep technical expertise with strong people and communication skills to support partners across Disney Experiences’ diverse portfolio of theme parks, resorts, cruise ships, and other vacation experiences.

You will own the reliability, performance, security, and evolution of our virtual and serverless infrastructure and CI/CD processes and pipelines, as well as internal customer-facing applications, including the segment’s BI and visualization tools, the Snowflake data warehouse, and the current-state identity resolution platform. You will set technical direction, translate platform and business strategy into actionable plans, and build a high-performing team that consistently delivers secure, resilient, and cost-effective outcomes.

If selected for this Full-Time position, you will report to the Director Data Engineering.

What You Will Do

As a Senior Manager of Data Engineering in Data Products and Platforms, you will be accountable for the operation, reliability, and continuous improvement of the platforms and applications your team supports, and for building and developing a high-performing team.

  • Orchestrate the design, development, and oversight of the technology architecture, solutions, and infrastructure that support the segment’s BI and visualization tools, Snowflake data warehouse, and current-state identity resolution platform
  • Lead the operation and continuous improvement of the platform’s virtual and serverless AWS infrastructure and CI/CD pipelines, ensuring availability, performance, security, and resiliency across environments
  • Establish robust processes and frameworks for data flow, API delivery, and storage across service-based and analytics-based offerings, aligning closely with business and technical requirements
  • Set design standards and quality assurance protocols for software and systems development, ensuring data compatibility, operability, and integrity across all connections, transmissions, and storage platforms
  • Translate high-level platform and business strategy into clear, actionable directives, and adjust priorities decisively as business needs change
  • Proactively identify and address operational, performance, and security issues before they affect customers, and lead escalation and resolution when they do
  • Evaluate and adopt emerging technologies, including AI, to advance platform capabilities and accelerate how the team delivers them
  • Balance cost, security, efficiency, and resiliency across architecture and operational decisions
  • Partner with key business and technology stakeholders to capture demand, establish business value, and represent strategies clearly and professionally in executive and high-pressure settings
  • Provide leadership, coaching, and performance management for a multi-disciplinary team of experienced engineers and product managers
  • Develop self and others, supporting career aspirations by recognizing different working styles and leveraging individual strengths
  • Create an open, collaborative environment where ideas are debated on merit, every voice is heard, and the team is empowered to do its best work

Required Qualifications & Skills

  • Minimum 10 years of related work experience, including demonstrated experience leading and developing technical teams
  • Mastery of cross-platform coding languages (e.g., SQL, Python) for data solution development, advanced data manipulation, and analysis
  • Extensive experience in data engineering, including modern database technologies (e.g. Snowflake) and formats, data architecture principles, and data modeling practices
  • Deep, hands-on experience with AWS virtual computing technologies such as EC2 and RDS, and with AWS serverless and managed infrastructure (e.g., KMS, CloudWatch, CodeBuild, ECS, MWAA, VPC, ElastiCache, ECR)
  • Familiarity with BI and visualization tools such as SAP Business Objects and Crystal Reports, Tableau, and MicroStrategy, or comparable platforms
  • Experience working in large-scale code repositories to design, operate, and improve complex CI/CD processes and pipelines
  • Proven ability to think strategically and innovate, translating high-level strategy into actionable directives, adjusting priorities as business needs change, and synthesizing ideas to act decisively with limited context and minimal direction
  • Track record of establishing best practices and standards for scalable, reliable, secure, and high-performance solutions that balance cost, security, efficiency, and resiliency, with a strong bias toward user experience and creating business value
  • A collaborative, open-minded, and passionate leader who builds on the ideas of others, develops and empowers the team, and gets the best from each individual
  • Strong written and oral communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, including the ability to represent ideas clearly and professionally with top executives and in high-pressure situations.
  • Practical experience using agile methodologies (e.g., Scrum, Lean) for iterative delivery

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting identity resolution platforms
  • Containers and orchestration (e.g., Docker, ECS, ECR).
  • Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation, CDK).
  • CI/CD tooling (e.g., CodeBuild, GitLab Runners, Jenkins).
  • Security practices including IAM roles, wire encryption, and KMS.
  • Experience working with remote repositories like GitHub and GitLab.
  • Experience planning and delivering large-scale data or platform initiatives with multi-disciplinary teams.

Education

Integrated Marketing Program Manager

Description -

The Consumer & Small Business Print Global Marketing organization is looking for an Integrated Marketing Program Manager to shape and orchestrate integrated marketing strategy across the print portfolio, spanning hardware, supplies, subscriptions, services, and emerging innovation areas, to drive business growth.

This role translates business priorities, customer and market insights and product roadmaps into cohesive marketing strategies, narratives, toolkits and activation plans. The ideal candidate is strategic, highly organized and comfortable operating in gray spaces – able to identify growth opportunities, align cross-functional teams and drive progress on high-priority initiatives with BU partners, PR & Communications, Product Marketing, Creative & Campaign teams. This person will help shift marketing approach from NPI/product-led to customer use case and solution-led – strengthening HP’s category leadership and ensuring Print shows up with clarity, relevance and impact across launches, events, partnerships, retail moments and market activations.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Global Marketing Strategy & Business Growth

  • Help develop annual and 3-year marketing plan, by translating customer insights, market data, business priorities and product roadmaps into actionable marketing plans.

  • Identify opportunities to position current portfolio to be more relevant through customer-centric storytelling, use cases and commercially meaningful marketing initiatives.

Category Leadership & Marketing Drumbeat

  • Define and manage the global marketing drumbeat calendar, aligning product and solution introductions, retail buying windows, seasonal print moments, events, partnerships, HP innovation stories and customer use cases to drive consistent category relevance and demand creation.

  • Strengthen category leadership by creating more frequent, relevant and commercially meaningful marketing moments beyond traditional product launches.

  • Help HP Print show up as One Print and One HP at key moments such as Amplify and CES by curating the product and solution, shaping the demo narrative and supporting assets that bring the story to life.

Audience and Segment Activation Strategy

  • Develop audience- and segment-specific strategies by mapping customer journeys, defining key touchpoints, and identifying opportunities to improve relevance, engagement, conversion and loyalty.

  • Develop global toolkits, playbooks, and activation frameworks that help markets bring integrated stories to life across channels and customer touchpoints.

  • Partner with creative, retail, digital, and market teams to define the assets, use cases, shopper tools, and content needed for priority initiatives.

Cross-Functional Leadership and Strategic Influence

  • Organize and lead cross-functional workstreams to drive progress on marketing priorities, ensuring clear ownership, milestones, and decision-making.

  • Establish planning cadences and governance mechanisms that improve visibility, prioritization and execution rigor.

  • Stay informed on industry trends, customer behavior, competitive shifts, and marketing innovation, and synthesize as implications for HP’s strategy

  • Present strategies, insights, and recommendations to senior leadership, ensuring clarity, alignment, and support for marketing initiatives and investments.

QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE

- 12+ years in a marketing function, product management, program management, or strategy and planning

- Proven ability leading complex, cross-functional global initiatives with multiple stakeholders

- Strong strategic thinking and business acumen, with ability to connect customer insights, product roadmaps, market dynamics, portfolio priorities, and execution plans

- Experience developing integrated narratives, marketing playbooks and toolkits, activation frameworks, launch plans

- Strong understanding of customer-led storytelling, with the ability to shift narratives from product features to use cases, benefits and customer outcomes

- Excellent communication and executive storytelling skills, with ability to synthesize complex inputs into clear recommendations and executive presentations

- Experience partnering with Comms, Events, Product Management, Product Marketing, Creative Strategy teams

- Highly collaborative, proactive and ability to drive outcomes without having formal authority

The Biomedical Technician will respond to service calls within a hospital or healthcare system in Denver, CO. You will evaluate, diagnose, and perform repair and planned maintenance on biomedical equipment, providing service excellence to drive customer satisfaction.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

  • Evaluate customer biomedical equipment issues, implement appropriate repairs, and perform planned maintenance and safety/environmental inspections to support our customers’ ability to deliver healthcare.

  • Adhere to company policies, procedures, and hospital protocols, to ensure regulatory and compliance requirements are met; ensure documentation of all work performed is captured.

  • Maintain strong relationships and frequent communications with customers to ensure resolution and proper follow-up, to ensure ongoing customer satisfaction.

  • Maintain proper care of tools and test equipment to ensure calibration and ability to deliver timely and accurate repairs/maintenance to our customers.

  • Identify and report all customer quality or compliance concerns immediately to the Quality Organization to ensure services are provided with the highest ethical standards.

Required Qualifications

  • Associate degree, Bachelor’s degree, military education, participant in the formal GEHC Biomed/FE Services Internship or Military Externship program; OR High School Diploma/GED with 2+ years of experience servicing electrical, electronics, IT or mechanical equipment.

  • Experience with electronic digital circuitry and electronic or electro-mechanical devices.

  • Experience interpreting schematic diagrams.

  • Willingness to be available ""after hours"", or work a rotating On-Call schedule, including weekends, for critical issues and coverage, as necessary

Special Physical Requirements:

  • Candidate must be able to lift, carry, push, and pull up to 35 lbs. unassisted and frequently bend, stoop, twist, climb, crouch/squat, kneel/crawl, sit and stand for long periods of time.

  • Candidate must also be able to reach at, above and below shoulder level, flex/extend neck and have good hand and finger dexterity.

  • Specific vision abilities required by this job may include color, close vision, distance vision, peripheral vision and depth perception.

title: Altra: Field Service Representative (Columbus)
description:
At Altra, we are on a never-ending journey to seek out opportunities to unlock potential in ourselves and others and to create a more diverse and inclusive running community. When we’re all working together as the best versions of ourselves, we can feel empowered both individually and as a community.

So, before we get to the job details, take a minute to learn a little more about us – our values and our culture. If you can see yourself working side-by-side with a team of people driven to discover more about ourselves and the world around us, Altra just may be the place for you.

To learn more about our values and our culture, visit Altra Careers or .

What will you do?

A day in the life of a Field Service Representative at Altra looks a little like this.

The Altra Field Service Representative (FSR) is a motivated self-starter responsible for executing seasonal go-to-market and service strategies across the Ohio and West Virgina area. This role drives brand growth, awareness, and sell-through by delivering impactful retail support, community engagement, and field activations.

The FSR partners closely with Sales Representatives, specialty retail accounts, and cross-functional teams to execute activation plans and strengthen Altra’s presence in the market. This position reports to the Regional Field Service Manager.

While this position is fully remote, the ideal candidate for this role will reside in the great Columbus area to better support their client base. This role requires frequent travel within the assigned territory, including attendance at consumer events, races, and expos, and may require evening and weekend work

Let’s break down that day-in-the-life a bit more.

  • Support retail partners through store visits, product demos, and sales floor training to drive product knowledge and sales.

  • Execute merchandising, promotional activations, and seasonal brand initiatives across the territory.

  • Represent Altra at community events, races, expos, and consumer engagement activities.

  • Build strong relationships with retail and community partners to increase brand awareness and advocacy.

  • Partner with Sales Representatives and Field Service teams to deliver effective territory plans, training, and activations.

  • Gather and share insights on consumer feedback, product performance, competitor activity, and market trends.

  • Maintain accurate reporting, manage field resources responsibly, and ensure operational excellence.

  • Achieve territory goals through consistent execution, strong organization, and proactive problem-solving.

What do you need to succeed?

We all have unique skills that we bring to work and celebrate every day. For this role, there are foundation skills you’ll need to succeed and excel. Additionally, while formal education is great to have, we are most interested in your 1-3 years of experience and professional achievements.

The foundation skills you will need in this position are:

  • Familiarity with the Altra product line

  • Experience fitting and selling technical footwear

  • Strong time management, planning, and organizational skills

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills

  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with a team

  • Proficiency in Microsoft applications (including Outlook)

  • Self-motivated, proactive, and driven to take initiative

  • Reliable transportation

  • Location requirement: While this position is fully remote, the ideal candidate will reside within the Columbus OH area to better service their client base.

There are also a few skills that are not required but preferred.

  • 1+ year of specialty retail experience (run or outdoor specialty preferred)

  • 2+ years of marketing, sales, or field service experience

description:

Senior Demand Planner (AMER PACKS)

What will you do?

The Senior Demand Planner will lead all Demand Planning activities including analyzing historical data and identifying current trends to develop unconstrained demand forecasts for both the seasonal and monthly processes. This person will also facilitate the Global consolidation of seasonal forecasts and share these forecasts with cross functional teams including finance, sales, and merchandising to ensure alignment with Brand strategy. Forecasts will impact seasonal purchasing and in-season inventory management. This is a hybrid role, working out of our Jersey City, NJ office.

Let’s break down that day-in-the-life a bit more.

  • Own and manage End-to-End Demand Forecasting: For assigned portions of the business – Lead demand forecasts across categories assigned throughout the GTM process, ensuring alignment with financial plans and marketplace needs. Be the Point of consolidation with Global planning, Supply planning, & other planning team for what concerns demand planning.
  • Seasonal Planning & Forecasting: Develop and present seasonal carry-over plans for the marketplace (~40% of Seasonal Revenue), aligning with marketplace trends, brand direction, and pre-season forecasts in collaboration with Merchandising.
  • Lead for Seasonal MFP & Regional OTB Support: Lead the creation and execution of the seasonal Merchandise Financial Plan (MFP) and support the Regions Open-to-Buy (OTB), ensuring alignment with financial targets and marketplace needs.
  • Drive Forecasting & Marketplace Insights: Partner with Regional Merchandising to deliver GTM forecast inputs, conduct marketplace capacity analysis, and lead demand shaping activities with clear insights on trends and inconsistencies.
  • Optimize Planning Systems & Strategic Programs: Own and maintain demand planning, oversee forecast accuracy, and lead key initiatives like Quick Turn, Vendor Managed Inventory, and Sales Replenishment programs.
  • Enable Business Growth Through Analysis & Governance: Identify opportunities, risks, and growth drivers by category, ensure segmentation diligence, and drive cross functional alignment to enhance demand accuracy and marketplace execution.
  • Reforecasting & Inventory Optimization: Manage style/color ladder plans for key SKUs, adjusting forecasts to meet turn targets and in-stock levels, while collaborating across teams to optimize marketplace inventory.
  • Replenishment Planning & Seasonal Investment Management: Execute the marketplace never-out and seasonal investment program to optimize inventory flow and meet consumer demand. Place and manage the safety stock signals to ensure consistent availability.
  • Optimize Long-Range Planning: Own and manage demand/forecast updates into Logility, ensuring precision in demand planning, and lead the analytical rollup of LRP and MFP for strategic decision-making.
  • Lead the Monthly Demand Reviews and consolidation of global demand to inform supply chain of future needs related to materials, vendor capacity, and buy timing.
  • Responsible for maintaining forecast in system at style / color and monthly level.
  • Measure forecast accuracy utilizing agreed upon KPI’s (such as MAPE & BIAS).
  • Partner closely with supply planning counterparts to determine monthly buy guidelines, understand open to buy and align inventory risks.
  • Proactively develop ad hoc analyses and recommendations to support business objectives.
  • Demonstrate product expertise for assigned categories.

What do you need to succeed?

We all have unique skills that we bring to work and celebrate every day. For this role, there are foundation skills you’ll need to succeed and excel. Additionally, while formal education in a related field is great to have, we are most interested in your 5+ years of experience and bachelor’s degree with preferred concentration in Planning, Supply Chain or Business Management.

The foundation skills you will need in this position are:

  • APICS or IBF Certifications are a plus
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Proven ability to influence cross-functional partners; using data to tell a story
  • Ability to understand, assess, & solve problems by leveraging technical and analytical skills
  • Proven ability to multi-task effectively
  • Advanced Excel Skills (pivot tables, Power BI). Experience in other analytical tools a plus.
  • Understanding of reporting tools (Cognos/Brio/SAP)
  • Self-starter with excellent follow through
  • Excellent attention to detail
  • Forecasting System experience, a plus

Our FDA-licensed, state-of-the-art CGMP manufacturing facility for Gene Therapies is located on the Harmans/BWI campus. title: Lärare åk F-3, Aspebodaskolan
description:
1 plats(er).

Vi söker en engagerad och trygg lärare som vill vara med och göra verklig skillnad för våra elever i årskurs 2. Är du lyhörd, pedagogiskt skicklig och trivs i rollen som klasslärare? Då kan detta vara tjänsten för dig.

Aspebodaskolan är en skola med ca 140 elever som är fördelade på sju klasser från förskoleklass till årskurs 6. Elevantalet varierar mellan 15-24 elever per klass. Skolan ligger i en lantlig idyll mellan Falun och Borlänge - endast 1,5 mil från respektive stad. Vi har en varierad skolgård och en fin inomhusmiljö. På skolan arbetar lärare, lärare i fritidshem och elevassistenter i ett nära samarbete i en positiv anda.

Vår uppgift som personal på skolan är att möta varje elev utifrån deras individuella förutsättningar. Det innebär att möta alla elever, både de som behöver mer stöd i sin utveckling och de som behöver större utmaningar för att nå sin fulla potential.

Du har nu chansen att få arbeta på en skola som präglas av trivsel bland såväl elever, föräldrar och personal. Vi ser fram emot din ansökan.

Arbetsuppgifter

I rollen som vikarierande lärare förväntas du planera lektioner och följa upp elevernas utveckling, samarbeta med övriga pedagoger och personal samt sköta kontakten med vårdnadshavare.

Kvalifikationer

För rollen krävs:

  • Du är legitimerad lärare med behörighet för aktuella årskurser.
  • Du har en stark förmåga att planera och genomföra lektioner.
  • Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska, både i tal och skrift.

Personliga egenskaper

Som person har du lätt att fatta självständiga beslut med elevernas bästa som tydlig utgångspunkt. Du är trygg i din profession och kan leda en elevgrupp med både struktur och värme.

Du samarbetar gärna och väl med dina kollegor och har ett öppet och respektfullt bemötande gentemot vårdnadshavare. Vidare ser vi att du är prestigelös, lyhörd och har ett stort tålamod – egenskaper som hjälper dig att skapa en trygg och inkluderande lärmiljö.

Vi söker dig som trivs i lärarrollen och som aktivt bidrar till ett positivt arbetsklimat. Du har en genuin vilja att stödja elever i deras utveckling och att vara en stabil och engagerad vuxen i deras vardag.

Meriterande kvalifikationer

  • Körkort och tillgång till egen bil, då lokaltrafiken har begränsat med turer till skolan.
  • Erfarenheter av arbete med elever med särskilda behov.

Anställningsvillkor

Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på heltid, med tillträde snarast enligt överenskommelse.

Bifoga gärna utbildningsintyg i din ansökan då detta kommer att efterfrågas om du blir aktuell förtjänsten. Alternativt lämnas intyg i samband med intervju.

För att få anställning måste du uppvisa utdrag ur belastningsregistret vilket kommer att efterfrågas om anställning blir aktuell. Beställ gärna detta i samband med ansökan så att det finns tillgängligt ifall du blir aktuell för tjänsten. Du beställer utdraget direkt från polisens hemsida.

Övrigt

När du skickar in din ansökan kommer du att få besvara urvalsfrågor som är ställda utifrån de krav som gäller för tjänsten. Dina svar är en viktig del av det första urvalet, så se till att svara utförligt och tydligt. I din ansökan ska du bifoga ditt CV, men du ska inte skicka in ett personligt brev – urvalsfrågorna ersätter detta.

Inför denna rekrytering har vi tagit ställning till rekryteringskanaler och därför undanber vi oss ytterligare erbjudanden om kompetensförmedling, annonserings- och rekryteringshjälp. Vi tar endast emot ansökningar via vårt rekryteringssystem i enlighet med GDPR. Vid problem med att genomföra din ansökan är du välkommen att kontakta rekryteringscenter@falun.se

차세대 플랫폼으로 편리함 을 넘어 무한한 가능성을 찾아 진화하고 있는, "커넥트웨이브"입니다.

• CS 처리 건수·리드타임·유형별 통계를 관리해요

2. 서비스 QA를 실행해요 (40%)

• 오픈 후 안정화 기간 이슈를 모니터링하고 에스컬레이션해요

Requirements

(또는 동등한 인턴·계약직 경험)

Preferred

title: Senior Relationship Strategist - PNC Private BankAMG
description:
Position Overview

At PNC, our people are our greatest differentiator and competitive advantage in the markets we serve. We are all united in delivering the best experience for our customers. We work together each day to foster an inclusive workplace culture where all of our employees feel respected, valued and have an opportunity to contribute to the company’s success.

As a Senior Relationship Strategist within PNC's Private Bank organization, you will be based in San Diego, CA.PNC is an in-office company that fosters a supportive culture where employees can thrive and achieve balance. We encourage candidates to connect with their recruiter and hiring manager to understand workplace expectations and ensure the role aligns with their goals.PNC will not provide sponsorship for employment visas or participate in STEM OPT for this position.

Job Description

  • Leads client management activities with clients and prospective clients. Responsible for the development and execution of a relationship management plan to acquire and retain clients. Is accountable for ongoing exceptional client experience. Responsible for managing a book of business. May assist in developing team members.
  • Coordinates with team to determine action plan through thorough discovery of client needs to deliver an exceptional client experience. Consistently reviews needs assessment with clients to determine changes. Has well developed knowledge of all business segment capabilities and offerings. Ensures a strong client commitment and advocacy by delivering proactive and responsive service to meet client goals. Holds team accountable for deliverables.
  • Held accountable for the growth of their book of business through client expansion and new client acquisition. Develops and executes strategies for proactively sourcing new relationships for the bank. Owns communication and contact with existing clients to ensure expansion opportunities are captured. Consistently seeks ways to expand his/her external network for business development.
  • Manages risk through appropriate client selection and ensures that our service delivery is consistent with the fees being charged. Works with risk partners to escalate client concerns to bring about quick resolution. Has well developed knowledge of partner offerings to make business-appropriate introductions. Is accountable to partners for follow up and client communication after initial introduction.
  • Maintains timely, accurate and complete sales/client relationship management administration tasks as determined by the business. Ensures the execution of team processes, such as pre-call planning, post-call debriefs and relationship reviews. May train, coach and/or mentor other team members. May participate in special projects to strengthen the overall business.

PNC Employees take pride in our reputation and to continue building upon that we expect our employees to be:

  • Customer Focused - Knowledgeable of the values and practices that align customer needs and satisfaction as primary considerations in all business decisions and able to leverage that information in creating customized customer solutions.
  • Managing Risk - Assessing and effectively managing all of the risks associated with their business objectives and activities to ensure they adhere to and support PNC's Enterprise Risk Management Framework.

Qualifications

Successful candidates must demonstrate appropriate knowledge, skills, and abilities for a role. Listed below are skills, competencies, work experience, education, and required certifications/licensures needed to be successful in this position.

Preferred Skills

Book Of Business, Client Relationship Building, Customer Engagement, Decision Making, Financial Analysis, Identifying Sales Opportunities

Competencies

Client Relationship Management, Communicating for Impact, Decision Making and Critical Thinking, Influencing, Managing Multiple Priorities, Products and Services, Understanding Customer Needs, Value Selling

Work Experience

Roles at this level typically require a university / college degree. Higher level education such as a Masters degree, PhD, or certifications is desirable. Industry relevant experience is typically 8+ years. Specific certifications are often required. In lieu of a degree, a comparable combination of education, job specific certification(s), and experience (including military service) may be considered.

Education

Bachelors

Certifications

No Required Certification(s)

No Required License(s)

Pay Transparency

Base Salary: $159,600.00 – $296,400.00Salaries may vary based on geographic location, market data and on individual skills, experience, and education. This role is incentive eligible with the payment based upon company, business and/or individual performance.

Application Window
