title: Assistant Director (Biostats & Modelling)
location: CDA - Novena Office Tower A, Level 23
description:
[What the role is]

As Assistant Director (Biostatistics and Modelling) in the Advanced Methods and Analytics Division, you will provide scientific and operational leadership to a multidisciplinary team of biostatisticians, modellers, and data scientists. You will set the technical direction and scientific standards for the division's analytical work across outbreak analytics, infectious disease modelling, and disease forecasting. Your team's outputs will directly inform Singapore's communicable disease policy, outbreak response decisions, and long-term public health strategy making scientific credibility, policy fluency, and leadership capability equally essential to this role.

[What you will be working on]

You will lead the team in conceptualising, designing, and executing advanced analytical and modelling work, drawing on a sophisticated repertoire of epidemiological and statistical methods, mathematical modelling, AI and machine learning approaches, and health economic frameworks. You will set the strategic direction for the team's methodological development, critically interrogate existing approaches, and drive the adoption of state-of-the-art methods where standard approaches are insufficient.

An important part of your role is to ensure the team can deliver timely, credible analytical support during public health emergencies, including the rapid delivery of analytical outputs that can be stood up at pace during a crisis.

You will also be responsible for the day-to-day leadership and operations of the team, including workforce planning and professional development, and will represent the division in senior inter-agency engagements and international technical forums.

[What we are looking for]

Key job responsibilities:

  • Provide scientific and operational leadership to the Biostatistics and Modelling team, setting technical direction and fostering a culture of rigour, innovation, and collaborative problem solving
  • Lead the development and application of advanced analytical methods for communicable disease surveillance and outbreak investigation, including cluster detection, transmission dynamics, risk factor analyses, and real-time estimation of epidemiological parameters such as reproduction numbers and growth rates
  • Oversee the development, validation, and application of mathematical and computational models including dynamic transmission models and agent-based models to assess disease trajectories, evaluate intervention impact, and generate scenario-based projections for operational and strategic decision making
  • Direct the development of disease forecasting models integrating epidemiological and other relevant data streams to generate short- and medium-term predictions of disease activity, supporting early warning, resource planning, and pre-emptive public health action, with rigorous frameworks for forecast evaluation and uncertainty quantification
  • Drive the continuous advancement of the division's methodological capabilities, identifying opportunities to adopt or develop state-of-the-art approaches while maintaining the scientific rigour and reproducibility that high-stakes policy work demands
  • Engage with academic and scientific communities, including through contributions to peer-reviewed publications and/or participation in technical working groups
  • Prepare and present technically sophisticated outputs to senior stakeholders and expert audiences, translating complex findings into clear policy implication.

Job requirements:

  • Postgraduate qualification, preferably at doctoral level, in epidemiology, biostatistics, infectious disease modelling, health economics, public health, data science or a closely related quantitative discipline; candidates with a master's degree and an exceptional track record of applied technical leadership will be considered.
  • Minimum 8 years of relevant experience in public health, biostatistics, epidemiology, infectious disease modelling, or a related field, with at least 2 years in a leadership or supervisory capacity.
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex, high-stakes analytical work in a policy-relevant or operational public health setting, including during outbreak or emergency response contexts.
  • Technical expertise across multiple methodological domains, including infectious disease modelling, biostatistics, health economic evaluation, and/or AI or machine learning methods applied to public health data.
  • Proven ability to translate complex technical findings into clear, credible, and actionable recommendations for senior policy makers and non-technical audiences.
  • Strong stakeholder management experience, including the ability to engage and influence across agencies and with international technical partners.

title: Senior Adversary Emulation Engineer
description:
Make your mark at Comcast -- a Fortune 30 global media and technology company. From the connectivity and platforms we provide, to the content and experiences we create, we reach hundreds of millions of customers, viewers, and guests worldwide. Become part of our award-winning technology team that turns big ideas into cutting-edge products, platforms, and solutions that our customers love. We create space to innovate, and we recognize, reward, and invest in your ideas, while ensuring you can proudly bring your authentic self to the workplace. Join us. You’ll do the best work of your career right here at Comcast. (In most cases, Comcast prefers to have employees on-site collaborating unless the team has been designated as virtual due to the nature of their work. If a position is listed with both office locations and virtual offerings, Comcast may be willing to consider candidates who live greater than 100 miles from the office for the remote option.)

Job Summary

Comcast Cybersecurity protects Comcast, our customers, our workforce, our partners, and our technology platforms from increasingly sophisticated cyber threats. We are seeking a Senior Adversary Emulation Engineer to help establish and mature adversary emulation as a repeatable capability within Threat Detection.

This role sits at the intersection of adversary emulation, threat detection engineering, threat hunting, telemetry validation, and purple team operations. The successful candidate will design and execute controlled, threat-informed emulation scenarios; validate detection coverage across enterprise telemetry sources; generate high-fidelity data for threat hunting; and translate findings into improved detections, hunt content, logging requirements, automations, and actionable reporting.

This is a hands-on senior engineering role for someone who can operate safely in complex enterprise environments, partner across cyber and engineering teams, and help Comcast continuously prove and improve its ability to detect real-world adversary behavior.

Job Description

Core Responsibilities

  • Help establish and mature Comcast’s adversary emulation capability, including operating model, rules of engagement, approval workflows, success metrics, reporting standards, and repeatable validation processes.

  • Design, plan, and execute controlled adversary emulation scenarios based on current threat intelligence, priority adversary behaviors, emerging attack techniques, and Comcast-relevant risk scenarios.

  • Emulate real-world attacker tactics, techniques, and procedures using frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK, while maintaining strict safety, deconfliction, and operational controls.

  • Build automation and AI-assisted workflows to streamline emulation planning, evidence collection, test execution, detection validation, reporting, and metrics tracking, with appropriate human review, auditability, and governance.

  • Partner with Threat Detection Engineering to validate detection coverage, alert fidelity, enrichment quality, triage workflows, and detection lifecycle effectiveness.

  • Partner with Threat Hunting to generate high-fidelity telemetry, validate hunt hypotheses, and convert emulation outcomes into reusable hunt content.

  • Identify and document logging gaps, telemetry quality issues, detection blind spots, enrichment deficiencies, and control weaknesses across endpoint, identity, cloud, network, email, SaaS, application, and data-platform sources.

  • Develop repeatable emulation playbooks, test cases, validation workflows, and reporting artifacts that can be reused across priority threats and enterprise environments.

  • Evaluate adversary emulation, breach-and-attack simulation, security validation, and emerging AI-enabled security technologies for use within Comcast’s threat operations environment.

  • Support purple team exercises, threat-informed defense initiatives, after-action reviews, and continuous improvement efforts across cyber operations.

  • Produce clear technical reports and executive-ready summaries that translate emulation results into prioritized recommendations, measurable detection improvements, and risk-informed remediation actions.

  • Collaborate across Cybersecurity, Security Operations, Security Incident Response, Threat Intelligence, Threat Hunting, Detection Engineering, Security Engineering, Cloud, Identity, Endpoint, Network, Product, and other technical teams.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in cybersecurity, computer science, information technology, engineering, or a related field.

  • 7+ years of relevant cybersecurity experience, including hands-on experience in adversary emulation, red teaming, purple teaming, detection engineering, threat hunting, incident response, or security operations.

  • Strong understanding of adversary tradecraft, attacker lifecycle, MITRE ATT&CK, threat-informed defense, detection engineering, and enterprise security telemetry.

  • Experience safely planning and executing controlled security testing in large or complex enterprise environments, including rules of engagement, approvals, deconfliction, and evidence handling.

  • Proficiency with scripting or automation using Python and at least one additional language or shell such as PowerShell or Bash.

  • Experience applying AI-assisted workflows or agentic automation to cybersecurity use cases with appropriate safety, review, and governance controls.

  • Experience working with SIEM, XDR, EDR, endpoint telemetry, identity logs, cloud logs, network data, email security telemetry, and/or application security telemetry.

  • Ability to write, review, or validate detection and hunting logic using query languages or formats such as SPL, KQL, SQL, Sigma, YARA, or similar.

  • Strong analytical, documentation, and communication skills, including the ability to explain technical findings, detection gaps, and risk implications to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Ability to work independently, exercise sound judgment, and collaborate across multiple teams in a fast-moving enterprise security environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience helping build or mature an adversary emulation, purple team, detection validation, or security validation function.

  • Experience with adversary emulation and validation tools such as Atomic Red Team, MITRE Caldera, Mandiant Security Validation, Cymulate, AttackIQ, Prelude Operator, or similar platforms.

  • Experience turning emulation results into production detections, hunt content, logging requirements, dashboards, runbooks, and measurable detection coverage improvements.

  • Experience with cloud, SaaS, identity, container, CI/CD, endpoint, network, or large-scale data-platform security testing.

  • Relevant certifications such as GCIH, GCIA, GPEN, GXPN, GREM, GCFA, OSCP, OSEP, CRTO, CISSP, or equivalent experience.

What Success Looks Like

  • Comcast has a repeatable adversary emulation operating model with clear rules of engagement, test plans, approval workflows, metrics, and reporting.

  • Priority threat scenarios are translated into safe, repeatable emulation exercises mapped to MITRE ATT&CK and Comcast-relevant risk areas.

  • Detection Engineering receives clear validation results that improve detection coverage, alert fidelity, enrichment, and response workflows.

  • Threat Hunting receives high-quality telemetry and validated hypotheses that improve hunt effectiveness.

  • Logging gaps, blind spots, and data quality issues are documented, prioritized, and converted into actionable remediation work.

  • Emulation outcomes are consistently converted into detections, hunts, dashboards, reports, and measurable improvements to Comcast’s cyber defense posture.

  • Cross-functional partners view adversary emulation as a trusted, safe, and valuable capability that improves enterprise readiness against real-world threats.

Skills

Artificial Intelligence Technologies, Cyber Defense, Cyber Threat Intelligence, Incident Response, Penetration Testing, Security Engineering, Security Testing

Compensation

This job can be performed in Virginia with a Pay Range of $134,449.01 - $210,840.49

title: Senior Business Coach, Delivery Service Partner Program
description:
Equal parts advisor and operating partner, Amazon’s team of Business Coaches assist and guide our Delivery Service Partner (DSP) business owners as they build and grow successful last mile package delivery businesses.

The Senior Business Coach (BC) helps Amazon improve the flexibility and quality of its delivery network in the Americas—to help fuel a $4B investment in rural communities bringing even faster delivery to our millions of customers in less densely populated areas. This role’s primary focus is supporting DSP operations across the broader Americas delivery network, with particular emphasis on rural market expansion and mature-state optimization. Specifically, BCs support DSPs in making business decisions that enable them to build healthy, sustainable businesses. As trusted advisors, Business Coaches work alongside DSPs, supporting business planning and strategy and helping owners address business and operational challenges.

What You’ll Do
As Senior Business Coach (BC), you will manage a portfolio of Delivery Service Partner (DSP) owners within the Amazon delivery network. With the evolution of delivery modes and rural expansion planned for 2026, and continued strategic expansion into 2027, this role is integral to our program's evolution. Sr. BCs provide strategic guidance to DSP owners throughout their business life-cycle of their relationship with Amazon—from pre-launch preparation through mature-state optimization. You will facilitate solution-oriented approaches to remove business obstacles and drive continuous improvement in financial performance, operational efficiency, and safety standards across the network. The position requires extensive collaboration with cross-functional stakeholders, including operations managers, program directors, compliance officers, legal counsel, and finance teams. The ideal candidate will demonstrate strong analytical capabilities, strategic problem-solving skills, and the ability to implement data-driven recommendations that create meaningful change both internally and externally.


Key job responsibilities
Operational Excellence & Financial Advisory
• Lead DSP owners through critical business phases including launch, operational scaling, and seasonal demand optimization
• Provide comprehensive consultation on financial management and operational optimization
• Support development of scalable business processes to ensure consistent performance metrics
• Navigate program evolution by helping owners implement and adapt to strategic changes within traditional DSP operations, including new service types and offerings such as rural delivery expansion and delivery capabilities
• Conduct data-driven business reviews, delivering performance insights and competitive benchmarking analysis

Business Development & Program Management
• Evaluate and interview potential candidates for the DSP program, ensuring alignment with program standards and objectives
• Guide strategic planning and execution of network capacity management

Stakeholder Engagement & Program Enhancement
• Foster strong DSP community engagement through coordination of local events and regional initiatives
• Build and maintain productive relationships with regional stakeholders
• Identify operational inefficiencies and champion process improvements across the network
• Design and implement solutions to enhance overall program effectiveness and DSP owner experience

The successful candidate will serve as a trusted advisor and primary account manager, combining strategic insight with practical business acumen to drive sustainable growth and operational excellence across the DSP network.


A day in the life
Strategic Leadership & Decision Making
• Drive both strategic initiatives and tactical execution to achieve business objectives
• Leverage industry expertise to establish priorities, optimize account management strategies, and develop sustainable long-term solutions
• Navigate ambiguous business environments to formulate clear strategic direction and influence cross-functional priorities
• Demonstrate sound judgment in solution design, balancing complexity with efficiency

Stakeholder Management & Communication
• Lead resolution of complex business challenges through detailed analysis and effective escalation management
• Foster collaborative relationships across multiple business units and organizational levels
• Develop and maintain strong partnerships with key stakeholders through exceptional relationship management
• Deliver compelling verbal and written communications, including executive-level presentations and strategic recommendations

Location & Travel Requirements
• Position is headquartered at our Nashville Hub
• Work arrangement includes structured mix of office presence, field travel, and remote work days. One week per month is dedicated to in-office collaboration at respective/team’s Hub. Significant field engagement is required: minimum 3 days per week of travel for 3 weeks monthly to support portfolio of Delivery Service Partners
• Must be comfortable with regular travel and maintaining a flexible schedule

The ideal candidate will demonstrate exceptional problem-solving capabilities, strong business acumen, and the ability to influence outcomes in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.


About the team
ABOUT AMAZON LOGISTICS
At Amazon Logistics (AMZL), our goal is to provide customers with an incredible package delivery experience through the last mile of the order. To achieve this goal, we partner with a network of small independent delivery businesses (Delivery Service Providers) and the independent contractor community (Amazon Flex) to deliver customer orders. Utilizing continuous improvement initiatives and creative thinking, our Delivery Station teams ensure that millions of packages reach their final destination as efficiently as possible.

title: Skadetekniker
description:
Forma framtidens mobilitet med Hedin Automotive Som en av Europas ledande aktörer inom mobilitetsbranschen brukar vi säga att vi har något för alla. Men det finns egentligen bara en sak som är viktig: vi har något för dig.

Nu får du möjligheten att bli en del av vårt team i rollen som Skadetekniker på vår anläggning i Hedin Automotive Mercedes. Med vår bredd, erfarenhet och marknadsledande position erbjuder vi dig något mer. Mer utmaningar. Mer ansvar. Mer trygghet. Mer samarbete. Mer utveckling. Mer möjligheter. Mer glädje. Mer för dig, helt enkelt.

Arbetsuppgifter Som Skadetekniker får du möjlighet att arbeta med allehanda plåtskador och reparation av kaross, riktbänk-arbeten och diverse glasarbeten. Du levererar ett fackmässigt utfört arbete och säkerställer att kunders önskemål blir åtgärdade.

Du tar ansvar för ditt arbete där du alltid vill överträffa kundens förväntningar. Du trivs med att arbeta självständigt, men har också lätt för att samarbeta och bidra till teamets gemensamma mål.

  • Erfarenhet som bilplåtslagare på skadeverkstad

Varför jobba med oss? Som arbetsgivare är vi bra på att tillvara ta på drivna och engagerade medarbetare. Hos oss finns det många karriärvägar att välja – vår inställning är att individer med rätt potential ska kunna växa med oss. När du som medarbetare växer med oss växer även vi som företag. Vi är ansvarstagande och säkerställer schyssta och rättvisa anställningsvillkor och samtliga verksamheter omfattas av kollektivavtal. Vi värnar om våra medarbetare och ser ett långsiktigt och hållbart arbetsliv som en stark konkurrenskraft.

Vi erbjuder ett brett sortiment av förmåner så som förskottsemester, extra föräldrar lön och ett generöst friskvårdsbidrag för att värna om våra medarbetares hälsa. Läs mer på vår hemsida www.hedinautomotive.se

title: ServiceNow -Configuration Management Lead
description:
We are excited to introduce an exceptional opportunity for an experienced and technically focused ServiceNow -Configuration Management Lead to join Downer’s Enterprise Service Management Platforms team.

This is a specialist leadership role suited to a passionate ServiceNow professional who thrives on improving data integrity, governance, and platform capability. You will play a critical role in ensuring Downer's ServiceNow Configuration Management Database (CMDB) remains accurate, trusted, and fit for purpose, providing the foundation for Incident, Problem, Change, Service Mapping and Service Management processes across the enterprise.

Reporting to the Head of Enterprise Service Management Platforms, you will own the governance, integrity and continuous improvement of Configuration Management within ServiceNow, including CMDB strategy, CI data quality, Discovery, Service Mapping and configuration standards.

Operating within a product-led DevOps model, this role is demand-driven and project-based, partnering with business and technology stakeholders to establish, enhance and support configuration management capability across the ServiceNow portfolio. Consistent with our "you build it, you run it" approach, you will retain accountability for the solutions and capabilities you deliver through to operational support and continuous improvement.

This position offers the opportunity to influence platform maturity, drive best practice configuration management, and contribute to the ongoing evolution of Downer's enterprise service management capabilities.

This position can be based in North Ryde(Sydney) or Milton (Brisbane).

About the Role

In this role you will:

  • Own and govern the ServiceNow CMDB, ensuring configuration item (CI) data quality, integrity and trustworthiness across the platform.
  • Establish and maintain configuration management processes, governance frameworks, standards and data models aligned with ITIL and platform architecture principles.
  • Deliver configuration management capability across projects and initiatives, including CMDB enhancements, Discovery, Service Mapping and CI lifecycle improvements.
  • Define, monitor and enforce CI data quality controls, audits and remediation activities to maintain CMDB health and reliability.
  • Partner with ServiceNow Architects, Developers, Business Analysts, Service Management teams and business stakeholders to ensure configuration data supports operational processes and decision-making.
  • Provide reporting, insights and analytics on CMDB health, data quality and configuration management maturity.
  • Drive continuous improvement opportunities, identifying innovative approaches to strengthen platform capability and user outcomes.
  • Provide technical leadership within the configuration management discipline, mentoring colleagues and acting as a trusted subject matter expert.
  • Ensure alignment with platform standards, enterprise architecture principles and ServiceNow best practices.
  • Operate within a product-led DevOps model, maintaining ownership of delivered capabilities through build, run and ongoing enhancement phases.
  • This is a highly influential individual contributor role where you will combine hands-on technical expertise with strategic leadership to improve the quality and value of enterprise configuration data.

Our Ideal Candidate

You are a highly analytical and detail-oriented ServiceNow professional who is passionate about configuration management, data governance and continuous improvement. You enjoy solving complex problems, influencing stakeholders and building trusted enterprise capabilities that enable better operational outcomes.

You are comfortable working across architecture, development and service management teams and have the ability to translate technical concepts into practical business value.

What You Will Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in information technology, Computer Science or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  • ServiceNow and/or ITIL certifications highly regarded.
  • Demonstrated experience in Configuration Management and CMDB administration, ideally within the ServiceNow platform.
  • Strong understanding of Configuration Item (CI) data modelling, governance, lifecycle management and data quality practices.
  • Experience with ServiceNow Discovery, Service Mapping and CMDB health management.
  • Sound knowledge of ITIL Configuration Management and how it supports Incident, Problem and Change Management processes.
  • Hands-on experience implementing and improving CMDB governance frameworks, standards and controls.
  • Strong analytical skills with a focus on accuracy, process improvement and data integrity.
  • Excellent stakeholder engagement, communication and collaboration skills.
  • Experience working within Agile, DevOps and product-led delivery environments.
  • Ability to make sound decisions, balance competing priorities and drive outcomes in complex enterprise technology environments.

You are recognised for your technical expertise, accountability and ability to build trusted relationships while delivering practical, sustainable solutions.

  • Grow your career with us, we are passionate about giving our people opportunities to grow through personal and professional development and continuous learning:

      • Access to professional memberships and industry networks

      • Parental leave

About the Role

Join the Bowel Health Service within the Flinders Centre for Innovation in Cancer and contribute to impactful, grant-funded research focused on gastrointestinal health and colorectal cancer prevention. Working closely with researchers, clinicians, industry partners and study participants, you will provide a mix of laboratory, administrative and clinical trial support to help deliver high-quality research outcomes that improve patient care and health outcomes.

This position makes a significant contribution to the University’s strategic plan to change 10 million lives, Every One Matters, by 2035, through directly contributing to the strategic driver of Research that Matters. By supporting innovative gastrointestinal health and colorectal cancer prevention research, this role helps generate evidence, advance clinical practice, and improve health outcomes for communities locally and globally.

About You

You are a proactive and detail-oriented research professional with a strong foundation in health or laboratory sciences and a passion for contributing to meaningful health research. Comfortable working both independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team, you bring excellent organisational skills, scientific rigour and a collaborative approach to supporting research projects from data collection through to reporting and publication.

To be successful in this position, you will bring:

  • A relevant qualification in health or laboratory sciences, or an equivalent combination of experience, education and training.

  • Strong organisational, computing and data management skills, including experience working with databases and Microsoft Office applications.

title: Design Manager
description:
Overview

Microsoft Cloud Operations and Innovation (CO&I) is the team behind the cloud. Within CO&I, the Datacenter Engineering (DCE) team is responsible for delivering core datacenter infrastructure for Microsoft’s cloud business. The MS portfolio consists of complex, multi-disciplinary, large scale, multi-year datacenter construction and lease projects. We are looking for a passionate, high-energy individual to help build the cloud datacenters that power the world’s largest online services.

In alignment with our Microsoft values, we are committed to cultivating an inclusive work environment for all employees to positively impact our culture every day.

Job Description:

The Datacenter Engineering Design Manager will manage the engineering scope, schedule, and budget for greenfield, brownfield and retrofit engineering / design projects. This specific position will support our network and regional growth in the North-East Asia region and this position will manage internal and external resources for the delivery of the Datacenter building, power, cooling, telecom, and controls infrastructure to align with Microsoft Corporation datacenter capacity roadmap for the APAC region.

The Datacenter Design Manager will be responsible for the facilitation and delivery of Microsoft’s industry-leading datacenter designs including the development of innovative technology and advanced concepts from Site Due Diligence through design development, permitting, construction, and the turnover to Operations. This role will provide design management, technical direction, decision-making and overall leadership for our datacenter designs. To be successful in this role the candidate will oversee the delivery of multiple, concurrent, complete Datacenter design solutions aligned with the scopes, schedules, and budgets of the projects. The Design Manager will engage with key MS stakeholder groups within Microsoft as well as outside vendors who specialize in datacenter architecture and engineering.



Responsibilities

Core Responsibilities:

  • Support the network growth/upgrade refresh project pipeline across the APAC Region, specifically:
    • Investigation and project scoping
    • Working with external and internal stakeholders to undertake feasibility study
    • Provide findings and internal reporting from the feasibility study, and provide proposed solution and programme
    • Implementation management and overseeing compliance to the execution process
  • Support built pipeline, including:
    • Coordinate a team of architects, engineers and designers and deliver projects aligned with the defined scope, schedule, and budget.
    • Collaborate with on-site operations teams to perform feasibility / Gap analysis for conversion of existing data center spaces to new / upgraded uses.
  • Have excellent communication, organization, and leadership skills.
  • Possess a high level of proficiency in commercial and industrial architecture and engineering with a primary focus on datacenter design.
  • Be able to work with other technical and non-technical groups in a fast-paced environment and do so with an even temperament.
  • Be a person of integrity, be methodical, detailed-oriented with a strong work ethic.


Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Architecture, Engineering, or related field (i.e. Project/Programme Management)
  • Technical understanding of mission critical environments on a multidisciplinary level
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experienced and has the ability to lead team of architects and engineers in advanced engineering and operational processes and procedures as they relate to large data center environments.
  • Experienced with design & construction procurement and contract

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Minimum of 10 years’ experience in engineering, equipment and/or construction for mission critical or hi-tech industry
  • Minimum of 5 years’ experience as project or team manager

title: Chaplain (Part-Time) - Vermilion, OH
description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!
We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

Please Note: While assigned hours are generally consistent from week to week, there are no guaranteed minimal hours and positional needs will vary depending on Chaplain availability and Client requirements.

Position Summary

Chaplains are the frontline staff fulfilling the mission and Christian ministry of MCHAP, by using their gifts and talents to serve company employees and their immediate families.

Part-Time, Vermilion, OH

Essential Functions and Responsibilities
• Serves as a messenger and conveyor of faith, mission, and purpose.
• Interacts with companies, their employees, and the community in a manner that exhibits character through personal and spiritual disciplines.

Ministry

• Makes regular visits to company worksites (usually weekly) to interact with employees and build relationships of trust and friendship motivated by Christian faith.

• Visits employees or immediate family members wherever care can be expressed and help given: hospitals, nursing homes, funeral homes, family residences, or other sites.

• May provide confidential pastoral discussions for problem issues of employees and their immediate family members including, but not limited to family matters, divorce, serious illness, care of aging parents, death and grief recovery, parenting, financial situations that may include debt discussions, budgeting, and other life issues related to financial stress, as well as any other personal issues. Provides referral service and acts as coordinator for specialized assistance to employees and/or immediate family members with specific needs.

• May assist in the planning, conduct or attend funerals for employees or immediate family members, including follow-up support and encouragement to immediate family members during the grief period.

• May make jail visits to employees and immediate family members.

• Works with companies to serve notifications of death and serious injuries to families and other employees, encouraging those impacted by various tragedies.

• May provide post-termination care for laid-off or terminated employees in order to foster a smooth transition to another work environment.

• May facilitate, but not lead, spiritual enrichment activities, as an employee-sponsored and led activity will usually be more fruitful than a chaplain led event.

• Provides, as appropriate/requested, literature and other resources to assist company employees with life issues.

• Represents companies to clients/customers where it would be appropriate to ministry services involved (i.e., serious illness, accidents, traumatic events, and funerals).

• Participates in new employee orientation to explain the Employee Care Service and the role of the Chaplain Team.

• With Executive Director of Operations (EDO) permission, responds positively and assertively to other duties and services requested by executive leadership of companies, within the scope of the Letter of Agreement between MCHAP Chaplains and the company.

Requirements
1. Has ability to work as member of interdisciplinary group and in an interfaith setting. Possesses ability to accept different lifestyles, cultures, beliefs, and values.

2. Skills to effectively listen and interact with clients, employees, and their families. Skills to deliver community presentations. Skills to deal effectively with family members and staff under stressful circumstances. High regard for the dignity and worth of clients, employees and their families. Skills to cope with stressful situations and able to document accurately according to standards.

3. Spiritual maturity and commitment to a Christian lifestyle and to MCHAPs Ministry values. Incorporates Christian values and beliefs in day-to-day activities and in the performance of job duties. Has a fundamental understanding of the Holy Bible and its proper application. Attests to a saving faith in Jesus Christ and actively participates in a biblically based church.

4. Demonstrated ability to interact professionally with diplomacy, patience, and courtesy with diverse groups; ability to establish and maintain effective and cooperative working relationships while providing exceptional customer service. Ability to make administrative and procedural decisions and judgments on sensitive, confidential issues.

5. Demonstrated excellent oral and written communication skills to communicate and interact effectively with leadership, colleagues, employees, and families. Ability to maintain emotional stability to cope with human suffering, emergencies, and other stresses.

6. Demonstrated skill in analyzing information to define and follow up on problems or objectives. Ability to identify solutions and solve problems. Demonstrated skill in interpreting policy and procedures related to the position and keeping others informed.

7. Demonstrated computer proficiency using Google Suites, Microsoft Office, or other equivalent software, internet, email messaging, and web-based software applications. Ability to understand and learn new technology programs.

8. Must have active state driver’s license and state minimum auto insurance (state(s) where servicing clients).

Conditions of Employment
Must pass a pre-employment background check.

Work Environment
This is a remote position in the field, and the work environment is dependent upon the clients’ worksite. Work environments can include manufacturing, hospitals, office buildings, and funeral homes with differing levels of temperature, noise, and light exposure.

title: Surveyor I, Senior
description:
The Senior Surveyor I is considered an intermediate to advanced level Surveyor position. The primary function is to examine and report on vessels and other marine structures during and after construction relative to compliance with the applicable requirements for maintaining the vessel in Classification with ABS and meeting associated statutory and special service requirements related to the Safety of Life at Sea, Loadline, Tonnage, Cargo Gear, and Pollution Prevention Certification. When necessary, responsible for administering office procedures and monitoring business performance at an assigned port.

What You Will Do:

  • Acts as a professional specialist for the organization in the application of related rules, regulations, requirements, concepts, principles, and processes.
  • Performs routine surveys on classed vessels, platforms, or other marine structures and at manufacturers for classification and compliance with statutory requirements.
  • Prepares technically accurate and timely reports of inspections and surveys performed.
  • Engages in contact with clients to resolve problems within areas of expertise.
  • Maintains survey files in an orderly and up-to-date manner in the area of responsibility.
  • Maintains an active awareness of new methods and developments affecting the technical scope of assigned responsibilities and recommends changes in the surveying processes and safety programs as warranted by such developments. Recommends new approaches to problems encountered and makes changes in methods, procedures, or design where necessary.
  • Plans, schedules, and coordinates various phases of surveying work and monitoring the quality of service on work performed.
  • Monitors work and projects performed by subordinate surveyors to ensure maintenance of quality, content, consistency, and continuity of work performed.
  • Provides leadership, guidance, and training to lower-level and/or less experienced surveyors.
  • Promotes the services and capabilities of ABS to present and potential customers.

What You Will Need:

Education & Experience

  • Qualifications from a tertiary institution within a relevant field of engineering or physical science (minimum two (2) years program); or
  • Qualifications from a marine or nautical institution and relevant seagoing experience as a certificated ship officer, and
  • Minimum requirements & knowledge listed for Surveyor II.
  • Minimum three (3) years of experience working as a Surveyor II.
  • Understanding of ABS strategic technical positioning in their respective sector of the marine industry or
  • Minimum eight (8) years of experience in an Engineering or Survey Capacity with an IACS member Classification Society

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Appropriate certification and/or licenses in areas of specialization may be required.
  • Ability to develop a working knowledge of ABS Rules, Guides, statutory regulations, and related instructions, as well as the ABS Employee Safety Policy.
  • Ability to read engineering plans and have a basic understanding of shipbuilding practices and vessel operations.
  • Ability to perform surveys in the prescribed format.
  • Knowledge of computer programs or software packages related to job responsibilities.
  • Knowledge of related technical interfaces required for group project work.
  • Knowledge of ships' engineering systems and machinery.
  • Ability to communicate in English, orally and in writing, pertinent information relative to assigned area of technical expertise.
  • Ability to analyze problems and propose solutions.

Physical Requirements:

  • Where allowed by local laws, a pre-employment physical examination is mandatory.
  • The role of surveyor/auditor requires sufficient physical strength, stamina, agility, and both visual and auditory acuity to perform the listed duties effectively.
  • The ability to climb vertical ladders up to nine meters and navigate steep steps is essential.
  • Shall be capable of working at heights on various staging and lifting equipment.
  • Shall be able to maneuver in tight spaces and work inside confined areas for extended periods, including kneeling and crawling.
  • The role may involve exposure to industrial environments, potential injury risks, extreme weather conditions, and demanding physical activities.
  • Shall be able to lift at least 25 lbs. / 11.34 kgs.
  • The use of small tools and the wearing of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), in accordance with ABS safety procedures, may be required.
  • Where allowed by local laws, the surveyor will be required to successfully complete an annual physical that will recertify that the individual can perform the physical actions required.

Reporting Relationships:

Will report to a Principal Surveyor or higher, under the direction of a Survey Manager or District/Country Manager as appropriate. The incumbent may supervise or provide leadership guidance to lower-level surveyors. Incumbent may be provided with support or assistance by an administrative support staff member as applicable to his/her office.

title: UI Designer (5년 이상)
description:
About

Duotone은 다양한 산업과 브랜드의 디지털 경험을 설계하고 디자인하는 Digital Design Agency입니다.
UI Designer는 웹·앱 등 다양한 디지털 서비스의 사용자 경험을 시각적으로 구체화하고,
브랜드와 서비스의 방향성을 일관된 인터페이스로 구현하는 역할을 담당합니다.

단순히 화면을 디자인하는 것을 넘어 서비스의 목적과 사용자 경험을 이해하고,
UX·기획·개발 등 다양한 직군과 협업하며 완성도 높은 디지털 프로덕트를 만들어갑니다.

About DUOTONE

[듀오톤은 집단지성의 힘을 믿습니다]
문제에 대해, 1인이 독단적으로 쉽게 결론을 짓거나 결정하지 않으며, 모든 과정을
팀 멤버들과 함께 고민하고 의논합니다. 수시로 진행되는 듀오톤만의 디자인 워크숍과
토론은 이를 보여주는 몇 가지 반증입니다. 듀오톤은 집단지성에 의거한 의사 결정 등의
팀워크를 지향하고, 능동적으로 참여하고자 하는 디자이너를 환영합니다.

[듀오톤은 이유있는 디자인을 지향합니다]
근거에 기반한 논리를 가지고 기획하고 디자인하는 것을 의미합니다.
이와 더불어, 본인이 만든 논리와 기획, 디자인에 대한 프레젠테이션은 직군과
직책을 막론하고 본인이 직접하는 것을 권장하고 있습니다. 강점을 바탕으로 일하고,
긍정적인 영항력을 끼치는 팀 플레이어를 환영합니다. 완벽한 사람은 없습니다.
듀오톤은 멀티플레이어보다 본인의 강점을 살려 프로젝트내에 좋은 에너지를 나누는 사람을 찾습니다.

[성장하는 과정 속에서 사명감을 가지고 일합니다]
듀오톤은 디자인 에이전시 특성상, 다양한 기업의 프로젝트를 동료들과 함께 만들어 나갑니다.
결과적으로 탁월한 디자인 산출물을 고객에게 선사합니다. 살몬분들은 공동의 목표를 달성하기
위해서 스트레스에 대한 강한 내성을 가지고, 기민하게 학습하고 커뮤니케이션 합니다.
이는 쉽지 않지만 함께하기에 가능합니다. 더 나아가 듀오톤의 디자인이 솔루션으로써 문제를 해결하고,
디자인 가치를 업계에 전파한다는 사명을 품고 뜨거운 마음과 냉철한 머리로
함께 나아갈 수 있으면 좋겠습니다. 듀오톤은 디자인 에이전시 특성상, 합류하시면
다양한 프로젝트에 참여할 수 있습니다. 이해관계자와 커뮤니케이션하고, 프로젝트에
다수 참여하면서 받을 수 있는 스트레스를 오히려 J커브를 그리며 성장하는 기회로 생각하고
나아가실 수 있는 분이면 좋겠습니다.

Responsibilities

• Web / Mobile App 기반의 UI 디자인 및 구축
• 서비스 및 프로젝트 목적에 맞는 UI 컨셉 및 Visual Direction 수립
• 사용자 경험과 브랜드 아이덴티티를 고려한 인터페이스 디자인

• 프로젝트 품질 향상을 위한 디자인 리뷰 및 개선안 도출

Requirements

UI / Visual / Product Design 관련 실무 경험을 보유하신 분
Figma 등 UI 디자인 툴을 능숙하게 활용하실 수 있는 분

• 본인의 역할과 기여도를 확인할 수 있는 포트폴리오 제출이 가능하신 분

Preferred

title: Analyst - Data & Insights (Thematic CoE)
description:
Position: Analyst - Data & Insights (Thematic CoE)

Location: Mumbai

Tenure: contract (Convert basis performance)



About Sattva


We Partner to deliver social impact at scale


Sattva Consulting is a global impact consulting firm from India. Since 2009 we have been engaging with communities, business and government to achieve societal impact at scale.


We believe that Civil society, Business and Government all have a critical role to play in building an equitable and sustainable world, and we actively partner with all stakeholders to enable impact through our advisory & orchestration services, knowledge and data platforms which we have built as public goods for the ecosystem and collaborative solutions and partnerships.

Our teams are based in India, Singapore, Denmark and UK, but as a global organization our work has spanned 25 countries and 5 continents. For more information, please visit: www.sattva.co.in



About Data & Insight


As a part of the Central Technology and Data team, Sattva's Data & Insight practice focuses on improving how evidence is captured, processed, interpreted, and used for decision-making in the social sector. The practice combines research, technology, AI, and systems thinking to help organisations move beyond traditional approaches to data collection, evaluation, and reporting towards more real-time, actionable, and scalable insight systems.

The practice is anchored in four core areas: better listening, rapid evaluations, benchmarking, and strengthening data systems.


Role Purpose


The Analyst, Data & Insights will support the identification, assessment, and application of AI-enabled and data technology solutions for monitoring, evaluation, learning, impact assessment, and evidence-generation engagements. The role will involve conducting structured market intelligence, developing vendor evaluation frameworks, assessing technical and functional capabilities of service providers, and translating emerging technologies into practical use cases for Sattva's advisory and impact measurement work.

The analyst will work at the intersection of market research, M&E, impact assessment, AI/NLP-enabled analytics, digital data collection, and solution design.


Role Mandate


This role is focused on building a structured, technically informed view of the AI and data technology ecosystem relevant to Sattva's Data & Insight practice. The analyst will scan Indian and global markets, evaluate technology-led service providers, and identify how emerging AI/NLP tools can be applied across monitoring, evaluation, learning, impact assessment, community listening, rapid evaluation, benchmarking, and data system strengthening projects.


Key Responsibilities


1. Market Intelligence and Landscape Mapping

- Conduct structured secondary research on AI-enabled and technology-led service providers in India and global markets.

- Map tools and platforms relevant to digital data collection, community listening, qualitative synthesis, survey analytics, dashboards, data management, and decision support.

- Track emerging models, startups, platforms, research-tech providers, AI products, and implementation partners relevant to social impact and development-sector evidence generation.

- Develop market maps, provider lists, category definitions, trend notes, and concise landscape briefs for internal use.


2. Vendor Evaluation and Technical Assessment

- Develop structured vendor evaluation frameworks and scoring models to compare service providers across functional, technical, operational, and sector-relevance parameters.

- Assess provider capabilities across AI/NLP, transcription, translation, qualitative coding, sentiment analysis, text classification, summarisation, survey analysis, dashboarding, and insight synthesis.

- Evaluate providers on scalability, interoperability, localisation, multilingual support, data security, privacy, implementation complexity, evidence quality, cost, and fit for Sattva project contexts.

- Prepare vendor profiles, comparison matrices, shortlisting notes, risk assessments, and recommendation documents.


3. M&E and Impact Assessment Use-Case Development

- Translate technology capabilities into concrete use cases for monitoring, evaluation, learning, impact assessment, rapid evaluations, benchmarking, and community listening engagements.

- Assess where AI-enabled tools can support different stages of the evaluation lifecycle, including study design, tool development, sampling support, data collection, quality checks, qualitative synthesis, survey analysis, reporting, and decision-making.

- Develop practical use-case notes that explain the problem statement, proposed tool or provider, application pathway, expected value, implementation requirements, limitations, and risks.

- Support internal teams in identifying technology-fit options for live and upcoming Sattva projects.


4. Applied Research, Synthesis, and Knowledge Products

- Synthesize market intelligence, case studies, product information, demos, public documentation, and expert inputs into clear and decision-ready knowledge products.

- Build reusable repositories of vendors, tools, evaluation criteria, use cases, pilots, references, and implementation learnings.

- Prepare technical briefs, concept notes, landscape scans, slide decks, and recommendation memos for internal leadership and project teams.

- Support pilots or proof-of-concept exercises with shortlisted technology providers, where required.



Required Qualifications and Experience


- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Development Studies, Public Policy, Economics, Management, Sociology, Statistics, Data Science, Technology, Research, or related fields.

- 1-3 years of experience in research, consulting, market intelligence, product research, M&E, impact assessment, data systems, technology scouting, or social impact advisory.

- Basic working understanding of monitoring, evaluation, learning, and impact assessment concepts, including theory of change, logframes, indicators, outputs, outcomes, baselines, endlines, mixed-methods research, and evaluation design.

- Demonstrated ability to conduct structured secondary research and convert complex information into concise, well-organised outputs.

- Prior exposure to AI-enabled tools, digital research platforms, data collection systems, analytics platforms, or technology-led service providers is preferred.



Technical Skills and Competencies


- Ability to conduct structured market research and technology landscape assessments across India and global markets.

- Ability to evaluate AI-enabled tools, NLP platforms, digital data collection systems, analytics platforms, and technology-led service providers.

- Understanding of AI and NLP applications in qualitative coding, transcription, translation, sentiment analysis, text classification, summarisation, survey analysis, and insight synthesis.

- Familiarity with digital data collection and research platforms such as KoboToolbox, ODK, SurveyCTO, CommCare, WhatsApp-based systems, IVR, chatbots, dashboards, and data management platforms.

- Strong proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets for comparison matrices, scoring models, market maps, and structured analysis.

- Strong PowerPoint and written communication skills for preparing technical briefs, vendor profiles, landscape scans, use-case notes, and recommendation documents.

- Awareness of responsible AI, data privacy, informed consent, data quality, bias, inclusion, and ethical use of technology in social impact contexts.

- Structured thinking, attention to detail, intellectual curiosity, and the ability to work independently across multiple research threads.


Why This Role Matters


This role will help Sattva's Data & Insight practice build a stronger view of how AI, NLP, and data technologies can meaningfully improve evidence generation in the social sector. The analyst's work will inform internal solution development, project design, technology partnerships, and future-facing offerings across listening, rapid evaluations, benchmarking, data systems, M&E, and impact assessment.



Why Sattva?


It's not about us really- Because IMPACT is everybody’s business.

  • Create Impact: Make an impact with the work you do and the solutions you design

  • Work Environment: Thrive in a diverse, inclusive, and collaborative environment

  • Learn & Grow: Challenge yourself to learn, grow, and deliver the best you can

  • Future Ready: Work on critical issues of today that will affect our collective tomorrow

How to Prepare?


This is your opportunity to showcase not only your qualifications but also your unique personality and passion for making a meaningful impact. Approach your application with intentionality, ensuring that each word reflects your commitment to excellence and aligns seamlessly with the values of Sattva.

FAQs on the Hiring Process

Next Steps

Together towards a sustainable world with opportunity for all!

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion are essential to our business and we foster an environment of respect and a culture that celebrates diversity and promotes equity and inclusion. description:

Microsoft is a highly innovative company that collaborates across disciplines to produce cutting edge technology that changes our world. Microsoft’s Silicon team builds custom silicon for a diverse set of systems ranging from innovative consumer products like Xbox to high-performance Azure cloud servers, clients, and augmented reality.

We are looking for design verification engineer to work in the dynamic Microsoft Artificial Intelligence Silicon Engineering (AISiE) team. The candidate should be a highly motivated self-starter who will thrive in this cutting-edge technical environment.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more.   • Own or lead verification of complex flows at the SOC, subsystem, or IP levels

Why Sandvik?

At Sandvik, we're shaping the future of enterprise technology. As a Solution Architect for Risk & Resilience, you'll play a key role in that journey—designing scalable, intelligent and sustainable solutions that support thousands of users across our global organization.

You'll influence strategic decisions, challenge conventional thinking and help define the architectural direction of a business-critical platform. By driving best practices and architectural standards, you'll ensure our solutions remain robust, adaptable and ready for the future. You’ll join a focused, expert team working at the core of our digital landscape.

About the job

As the solution architect for this domain, you’ll be the trusted technical authority for Risk & Resilience within our ServiceNow platform. The Risk & Resilience domain contains several capabilities related to Governance, Risk and Compliance. You’ll shape the technical direction of the domain while ensuring every solution aligns with architectural standards, platform strategy and long-term business objectives.

You operate within the Platform Architecture & Governance team, translating validated business needs into scalable, secure, and sustainable technical solutions while safeguarding platform integrity.

Your decisions directly influence platform stability, scalability, cost efficiency, automation levels and user experience.

Location

Your profile

You combine a passion for architecture with a strong interest in the business outcomes technology enables.

Your background includes:

  • Extensive experience designing enterprise-scale solutions within ServiceNow or similar platforms
  • Strong knowledge of Risk, Security or Resilience-related ServiceNow capabilities
  • A proven track record of driving platform transformation and reducing technical debt

description:

Since 1906, New Balance has empowered people through sport and craftsmanship to create positive change in communities around the world. In the Inline Materials team, you will lead product engineering efforts and develop new products with the Product Creation team across all categories. You will plan, drive, and validate these products to bring them from an initial idea to a commercial ready stage. You will develop valuable experience working with designers, developers, sports researchers and product managers. You will also work across the company with innovation, materials, sourcing, quality and legal teams.

You will utilize your knowledge of engineering, materials, costing, and manufacturing processes to help you deliver great results. You will learn new skills as New Balance continues to transform our product and processes to be more digital and drive great consumer experiences.

MAJOR ACCOUNTABILITIES:

  • Influences teams utilizing a deep understanding of the materials engineering viewpoint, to provide technical and commercial consultancy for NB footwear GBU’s throughout product creation cycle in a variety of roles, inclusive of: Attending product briefs and design reviews, making supplier recommendations, ensuring material data integrity, and troubleshooting material issues or failures through prototyping and product creation phases. Seeks knowledge about the consumer and the consumer's culture.

  • Identifies opportunities to partner with materials suppliers to develop and validate new sustainable materials and processes plus deliver technical solutions for material palettes and custom materials to meet NB corporate sustainability goals across footwear product creation categories.

  • Leads the validation of the final product and creation of material specifications to facilitate the commercialization process and meet consumer expectations.

  • Drives novel product and material advances through comprehensive knowledge of the machinery used for processing of knitted, woven, non-woven, leather and synthetic materials and applications as well as yarn manufacture and coloration methods.

  • Drives improvement, global alignment and rollout of category best practices.

  • Executes at accurately self-identify priorities and adjust in real time, while communicating progress and timeline adjustments. Identifies risk, builds and drives strong contingency plans.

  • Drives efficient meetings by sharing an agenda in advance, come to meetings well prepared and with a POV to guide the conversation, schedules appropriate duration and manages timeline of meetings, energizes and influences team towards a clear path forward, share meeting minutes.

  • Drives projects forward and finds creative solutions to hit challenging timelines.

  • Drives clear, concise written communication with appropriate supporting visual aids sent to appropriate audiences.

  • Drives an understanding of the global footwear business, proactively builds strong connections throughout, and can identify and leverage the optimal connections to remove barriers and improve produce and process.

REQUIREMENTS FOR SUCCESS:

  • MS or equivalent experience in Textile Engineering, Materials Engineering, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Polymer Chemistry, or Textile Chemistry.

  • 9+ years professional experience, with at least 5 years material research and/or development.

  • In depth knowledge of infrastructure and processes required to support a global manufacturer in the areas of material development and testing, technical evaluation, product development calendar and materials engineering.

  • Excellent computer skills: PowerPoint, Excel, Sharepoint, Smartsheets, Adobe Illustrator.

  • Experience in the field of material research, development, global sourcing and commercialization of knits, wovens, print, dye, wash and finish.

  • Experience turning ideas into concepts and concepts into commercial products, including developing new tools, equipment, processes and standards with machine manufacturers and material suppliers.

  • A successful candidate will be curious, open minded, always up for a challenge. They should apply their analytic skills to solve problems.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, multi-tasking, and organization skills.

  • Ability and willingness to work in a team-oriented, creative environment.

  • Ability to effectively balance work in-person and remotely to fit with New Ways of Working.

  • Some domestic and international travel may be required.

title: Bli montör eller materialhanterare på Toyota – betald utbildning!
description:
Tillsammans med Toyota Material Handling Europe erbjuder vi ett introduktionsprogram för dig som vill bygga en långsiktig karriär inom industrin. Du behöver inte ha någon tidigare erfarenhet från branschen. Programmet startar med två utbildningsveckor där du får lära dig grunderna inom montering och materialhantering, med lön under hela utbildningstiden. Därefter påbörjar du din resa i Toyota Material Handling Europes produktionsmiljö, där får du möjlighet att utvecklas steg för steg. För dig som visar driv, ansvar och vilja att växa finns på sikt goda möjligheter att ta större ansvar.

Om företaget På Toyota Material Handling Europes site i Mjölby arbetar cirka 3000 medarbetare med produkter inom materialhantering, från utvecklingskoncept till producerat fordon. Deras produktrange går från trotjänare som manuella handtruckar till autonoma självkörande fordon på 1,5 ton och innovativa energilösningar. Toyota Material Handling Europe eftersträvar att vara en hållbar arbetsgivare genom deras framstående miljöarbete och personalpolitik. De har i dagsläget bland annat en koldioxidneutral produktion och en KRAV-märkt personalrestaurang.

Toyota Material Handling Europe förordar mångfald på sin arbetsplats och med det menas de olikheter som gör oss alla unika. På företaget strävar de efter att ha en öppen, ärlig och samarbetsinriktad kultur, där de har nolltolerans mot diskriminerande beteende och trakasserier. Alla medarbetare ska känna sig trygga.

Dina framtida arbetsuppgifter Introduktionsutbildningen kombinerar teori med praktik för att du ska få en trygg start i Toyota Material Handling Europes produktion och gemenskap. Du kommer att arbeta som montör eller materialhanterare och få förståelse för hela flödet – från materialhantering till färdig produkt – samt hur samarbete, kvalitet och ständiga förbättringar bidrar till framgång.

Som montör har du en viktig roll i produktionen av truckar. Arbetet innebär varierande monteringsuppgifter, från enklare till mer avancerade moment. Med stöd av instruktioner och ritningar monterar du olika komponenter på truckarna.

Som materialhanterare är du en viktig del av fabrikens flöde. Rollen innefattar truckkörning, kittning av material till monteringslinorna, registrering av material i IT-system samt arbete vid godsmottagning och utlastning.

Arbetet är förlagt på 2-skift: • Dagvecka: måndag–torsdag 06:30–14:30 och fredag 06:30–16:00. • Kvällsvecka: måndag–torsdag 14:30–00:00.

Din profil Vi söker dig som vill ta nästa steg i arbetslivet och bygga en långsiktig karriär inom industrin. Du kanske redan arbetar inom industrin idag, eller så kommer du från en helt annan bransch och är nyfiken på att prova något nytt.

Kanske arbetar du idag inom handel, service, logistik, vård eller någon annan verksamhet där du har utvecklat ett starkt ansvarstagande, god samarbetsförmåga och ett driv att göra ett bra jobb. Vi vet att värdefulla erfarenheter kan komma från många olika yrken och tror att inställning, engagemang och vilja att lära är minst lika viktigt som tidigare branscherfarenhet.

Vi ser gärna att du:

  • har driv att utvecklas och lära dig nya saker

  • trivs med att samarbeta och skapa goda relationer

  • är engagerad och tar ansvar för dina arbetsuppgifter

  • ser möjligheter snarare än hinder och vill bidra till förbättringar

  • har vilja att växa över tid och på sikt ta större ansvar

du behöver ha goda kunskaper i både svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift

Här får du möjlighet att lära dig verksamheten från grunden, utvecklas steg för steg och bygga en långsiktig karriär på Toyota Material Handling Europe. För dig som visar driv, ansvar och förmåga att få andra med dig finns goda möjligheter att på sikt växa in i roller med större ansvar.

Vi värdesätter mångfald och arbetar aktivt för en jämnare könsfördelning inom vår verksamhet. Eftersom kvinnor idag är underrepresenterade i den här delen av verksamheten uppmuntrar vi särskilt kvinnor att söka tjänsten. Självklart välkomnar vi ansökningar från alla kvalificerade kandidater.

Låt oss guida dig genom vår rekryteringsprocess!

Skicka in din ansökan och besvara ett antal screeningfrågor.

  • Kapacitetstest & personlighetstest: Genomföra digitala tester.

  • Studiebesök: Få en inblick i din potentiellt framtida arbetsplats. Besöket äger rum 25/8.

  • Arbetsprov: Visa ditt handlag hos Skill under v.35.

  • Intervju & referenstagning: Digital intervju & referenstagning med Skill samt en fysisk intervju med chefer från Toyota Material Handling Europe.

  • Drog & alkoholtest: Undersökning hos företagshälsovården.

    • Observera att ovanstående moment är obligatoriska för att vara aktuell för programmet. Du kommer kontinuerligt att informeras via mejl om rekryteringsprocessens olika steg och din status i processen - så håll dig uppdaterad i din mejlkorg.

    Introduktionsprogrammet är ett konsultuppdrag där du kommer att bli anställd av oss på Skill med start den 9/11. Efter en tid som konsult är målsättningen att bli direktanställd av Toyota Material Handling Europe.

    Vi ser fram emot din ansökan och om du har ytterligare frågor är du välkommen att kontakta ansvarig rekryterare, Medina Denic på medina.denic@skill.se.

title: Pest Technician
description:
Benefits Start Day 1 for Full-Time Colleagues - No Waiting Period!

For more information about our benefits, see below!

We are proud to be a member of the Rentokil family of companies, the global leader in Pest Control and other services across more than 90 countries. We pride ourselves on being a trusted partner to many of the world's leading brands and serve consumer and business customers across multiple industries. We are extremely proud of our legacy of excellence and constantly work to fulfill our mission to "protect people, enhance lives, and preserve the planet."

What do our Pest Control Technicians do?

The primary purpose of this role is to perform our industry leading pest management services for residential customers. You will be responsible for identifying and eliminating pests from residential properties by conducting thorough inspections, determining the type of pest infestation, applying appropriate treatments like pesticides and traps, and providing preventative measures to prevent future infestations, all while adhering to safety regulations and communicating with clients about pest control solutions.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to the following:

  • Conduct thorough inspections of client properties to identify signs of pest infestations, damage, and entry points

  • Apply approved pest control products, including chemicals, baits, and traps, to effectively eliminate pests while adhering to safety standards

  • Educate customers on pest prevention methods and the importance of maintaining a pest-free environment. Provide advice on how to reduce the risk of future infestations.

  • Build relationships with customers, schedule and confirm their appointments, help with sales to current customers, and expand our product to new customers

  • Ensure that all pest control equipment is properly maintained, stocked, and in good working condition

  • Adhere to all local, state, and federal regulations regarding pest control products and safety protocols

  • Drive and safely operate a company provided service vehicle (we provide routine maintenance)

Essential Job Functions:

  • Working in tight, confined spaces such as basements, attics, crawl spaces, narrow aisles, or passageways

  • Working around animals, insects and termites

  • You’ll sometimes be working around mechanical parts, vehicles, electrical current, heights and scaffolding, fumes, dust, and chemicals, and we’ll train you how to handle all of these conditions safely

  • Able to work both inside and outside in your local climate in company-provided weather gear

  • Lots of moving around — regularly sitting, climbing, balancing, stooping, kneeling, crouching, and crawling, up and down stairs, ladders, scaffolding, ramps, and poles

  • You’ll need to wear personal protective equipment (PPE), like an OSHA-compliant respirator

What do you need?

  • Clean shaven face- for safety reasons (rebreathers have to be able to seal your face)

  • High school diploma or GED; related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience

  • Licenses/certificates as required by federal, state, and/or local regulations (covered by us)

  • Available to work Monday-Friday and weekends as needed

  • Open to learning and becoming knowledgeable in all areas of pest control

  • Solid reading, writing, and verbal communication skills

  • Basic math skills — You’ll need to be able to follow instructions for mixing on product labels

  • Customer-facing experience preferred

Base Pay Range

Hourly: $18.00 - $23.00

While starting pay falls within the given range, it can vary based on factors like geographic location, skills, education, and experience. Total earnings may also be affected by overtime, incentives, commissions, performance, and route assignment (where applicable).

Why Choose Us?

A career with the Rentokil family of companies can be a professional trajectory filled with opportunity. We pride ourselves on being a world-class team that rewards high performance, and we love to promote from within. We offer competitive pay and many of our roles offer performance incentives.

Below you'll find information about some of what we have to offer. All Full-Time Colleagues qualify for the following and Part-Time Colleagues qualify for most benefits after they meet certain criteria.

Work-Life Balance

title: Investco: Investment Controller
description:
Työsopimuksen tyyppi: vakituinen, kokoaikainen

Sijainti: Pohjoinen Makasiinikatu 6 A 4, 00130 Helsinki, etätyö

Hakuaika päättyy: 23.8.2026

Haluaisitko vastuullisen asiantuntijaroolin sijoittajien parissa ja syventää osaamistasi sijoitusten taloushallinnossa? Investco etsii nyt Investment Controlleria vahvistamaan kasvavaa tiimiään!

Mitä työ pitää sisällään?

Investco etsii Investment Controlleria liittymään asiantuntijatiimiinsä. Tässä roolissa vastaat itsenäisesti nimettyjen asiakkuuksien taloushallinnosta ja toimit asiakkaidesi pääyhteyshenkilönä.

Työsi kattaa sijoitus- ja holdingyhtiöiden kirjanpidon, tilinpäätökset ja veroilmoitukset sekä osaamisen karttuessa asiakaskohtaisenkonsultoinninerityisesti omistusrakenteisiin ja verosuunnitteluun liittyen. Roolissa yhdistyvät käytännön kirjanpitotyö ja asiakkuusvastuu, eli kyseessä ei ole perinteinen sisäinen controller-rooli.

Työ on monipuolinen yhdistelmä rutiinia ja analytiikkaa. Vastaat asiakkuuksistasi kokonaisvaltaisesti alusta loppuun ja työskentelet pitkäjänteisesti asiakkaiden kanssa. Työ on itsenäistä, mutta saat tueksesi kokeneen tiimin sekä kattavan perehdytyksen sijoitusmaailmaan.

Millaista osaajaa etsimme?

Etsimme sinua, jolla on vahva perusta kirjanpidosta ja kyky hoitaa asiakkuuksia itsenäisesti ja olet kiinnostunut sijoitusmaailmasta. Viihdyt roolissa, jossa yhdistyvät tarkkuus, vastuu ja asiakastyö, ja viet asioita määrätietoisesti eteenpäin.

Hakijalta odotetaan:

  • Useamman vuoden kokemusta kirjanpidon tehtävistä, mielellään tilitoimistoympäristöstä

  • Kykyä hoitaa taloushallinnon kokonaisuuksia itsenäisesti

  • Soveltuvaa korkeakoulututkintoa (esim. tradenomi)

  • Järjestelmällistä ja huolellista työotetta sekä hyviä organisointitaitoja

  • Analyyttistä ajattelutapaa ja ongelmanratkaisukykyä

  • Kiinnostusta sijoittamiseen tai rahoitusalaan

  • Hyvää suomen kielen taitoa sekä toimivaa englannin kielen osaamista

Lisäksi eduksi katsotaan:

  • Kokemus asiakastyöstä ja asiakkuuksien hoidosta

  • Kokemus sijoituskirjanpidosta tai rahastokirjanpidosta

  • Ymmärrys verotuksesta tai omistusrakenteista

  • Hyvä ruotsin kielen taito

  • Valmius työskennellä ajoittain Helsingin toimistolla

Tarjoamme sinulle:

  • Mahdollisuuden työskennellä kokeneessa ja matalahierarkisessa tiimissä, jossa vastuu ja luottamus kulkevat käsi kädessä

  • Näköalapaikan varakkaiden sijoittajien maailmaan

  • Roolin, jossa omistat omat asiakkuutesi ja pääset vaikuttamaan työsi sisältöön ja kehittymiseen

  • Kilpailukykyisen palkkamallin, jossa kiinteän palkan lisäksi ansaintasi kasvaa tekemisesi mukaan

  • Vapauden valita työskentelytapasi – voit työskennellä täysin etänä, toimistolla tai joustavasti näitä yhdistellen. Investco:n viihtyisä toimisto sijaitsee Helsingin keskustassa erinomaisella sijainnilla

  • Kokonaisvaltaiset työsuhde-edut, jotka tukevat hyvinvointiasi arjessa ja vapaa-ajalla

Käytännön asiat:

Kyseessä on vakituinen ja kokoaikainen tehtävä, jossa työllistyt suoraan Investcon palvelukseen. Työ voidaan tehdä joustavasti etänä Suomessa, mutta perehdytysvaiheessa toivomme mahdollisuutta työskennellä Helsingissä toimistolla. Tehtävä alkaa sopimuksen mukaan, toivomme aloituksen sijoittuvan syyskuun alun ja lokakuun lopun välille. Kiinteä pohjapalkka tehtävässä asettuu noin alkuun noin 3800 - 4000 €/kk välille kokemuksestasi riippuen, jonka lisäksi roolissa on laskutukseen perustuva bonusmalli. Tavoitteissaan onnistuessaan kokonaisansiot (OTE) voi nousta muutaman vuoden sisällä sisällä noin 5000 - 6000 €/kk välille ja myöhemmin myös korkeammalle.

Kiinnostuitko?

Investco

Investco on vakavarainen ja hallitusti kasvava tilitoimisto, joka palvelee varakkaita sijoittajia heidän sijoitus- ja holdingyhtiöidensä taloushallinnossa. Tarjoamme lakisääteistä kirjanpitoa laajempaa, sijoittajille räätälöityä palvelua ja autamme asiakkaitamme muun muassa pääomituksessa, voitonjaossa sekä omistusrakenteisiin liittyvissä kysymyksissä.

title: Quantitative Analytics and Model Consultant - Credit Scoring and Originations
description:
Position Overview

At PNC, our people are our greatest differentiator and competitive advantage in the markets we serve. We are all united in delivering the best experience for our customers. We work together each day to foster an inclusive workplace culture where all of our employees feel respected, valued and have an opportunity to contribute to the company’s success. As a Quantitative Analytics and Model Consultant within PNC's Model Risk Management organization, you will be based in Pittsburgh, PA or Tysons Corner, VA.

As a model validator you will perform rigorous independent reviews of PNC’s models including loss forecasting models, stress testing models, scoring models, and other models estimated in various ways including machine-learning models. You will also write reports and memos and become a lead author and owner of various model reviews.

Qualifications include but not limited to;
- Experience developing models or validating applied models within the financial services industry, government, or academic setting is preferred.
- Strong English communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to diverse stakeholders.
- Hands-on experience with model testing and estimation tools in Python, R, SQL, SAS, etc.
- Experience with credit scoring and originations a plus.PNC is an in-office company that fosters a supportive culture where employees can thrive and achieve balance. We encourage candidates to connect with their recruiter and hiring manager to understand workplace expectations and ensure the role aligns with their goals.PNC will not provide sponsorship for employment visas or participate in STEM OPT for this position.

Job Description

  • Performs complex quantitative analyses and models development to support decision-making by running quantitative strategies.
  • Develops new model frameworks by supporting the line of business. Refines, monitors, and validates existing models. Conducts on-going communication with model owners and model developers during the course of the review. Works with large data to create models.
  • Performs advanced qualitative and quantitative assessments on all aspects of models including theoretical aspects, model design and implementation as well as data quality and integrity. Reviews reports and associated quantitative analysis. Validates existing models and assesses model risks.
  • Evaluates identified model risks and reaches conclusions on strengths and limitations of the model.
