title: Principal Software Engineer
description:
Overview

Online Advertising is one of the fastest growing multi-billion-dollar business on the Internet today. Search engines, web publishers, major ad networks, and ad exchanges are now serving billions of ad impressions per day. Microsoft is innovating rapidly in this space to grow its share of this market by providing the advertising industry with the state-of-the-art online advertising platform and service.

In Microsoft Advertiser Platform team, we are building the marketing solutions for the next generation of e-commerce. As a Principal Software Engineer, you will drive complex missions and multi-team initiatives from conception through production, establish architectural direction, and influence engineering strategy across organizational boundaries. You will partner closely with product management, design, data science, and engineering teams to translate ambiguous customer and business needs into secure, reliable, and maintainable solutions which helps scale the capabilities of the marketers and help them achieve more.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Starting January 26, 2026, Microsoft AI (MAI) employees who live within a 50-mile commute of a designated Microsoft office in the U.S. or 25-mile commute of a non-U.S., country-specific location are expected to work from the office at least four days per week. This expectation is subject to local law and may vary by jurisdiction.



Responsibilities
  • Provide hands-on technical leadership for advertiser-facing products and platforms, raising the engineering bar for technical areas like architecture, quality, security, accessibility, performance, and reliability.
  • Define and drive long-term technical strategy and architecture across frontend, service, and data layers.
  • Lead complex, cross-team initiatives from requirements and design through implementation, release, measurement, and live-site operations.
  • Build and evolve modern user experiences using React, TypeScript, and related web technologies.
  • Apply customer insights, experimentation, telemetry, and business results to guide technical decisions and product improvements.
  • Identify systemic technical challenges and develop reusable platforms, frameworks, and engineering patterns that benefit multiple teams.
  • Drive technical alignment across engineering, product, design, and partner organizations while navigating ambiguity and competing priorities.
  • Establish engineering practices for testing, observability, deployment, incident response, and operational excellence.
  • Anticipate technical risks, resolve complex design and production issues, and make pragmatic trade-offs that support long-term product health.
  • Mentor engineers and technical leaders, strengthen engineering capabilities, and foster an inclusive environment where people can do their best work.
  • Contribute to broader organizational strategy and influence investment decisions through technical expertise and customer-focused judgment.


Qualifications

Required/Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 6+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python.
    • OR equivalent experience.

Other Requirements: Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

  • Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Extensive experience designing, developing, and shipping production software products or services.
  • Demonstrated expertise in full-stack development, with substantial experience building complex frontend applications using JavaScript or TypeScript and modern frameworks such as React.
  • Experience defining architecture and technical strategy for large-scale products, platforms, or distributed systems.
  • Proven ability to lead complex initiatives involving multiple engineering teams and organizational stakeholders.
  • Solid software design, coding, debugging, and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience delivering secure, reliable, maintainable, and measurable customer-facing solutions.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in ambiguous environments and make sound technical and product trade-offs.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to influence technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience with C#/.NET and the design of scalable APIs, services, and distributed systems.
  • Experience with Microsoft Azure or another major cloud-computing platform.
  • Experience with experimentation, telemetry, data-informed product development, and customer behavior analysis.
  • Experience with CI/CD, automated testing, observability, service health, and live-site operations.
  • Experience building products for advertising, commerce, enterprise, or other workflow-intensive domains.
  • Demonstrated success mentoring senior engineers and developing technical leadership across teams.

title: AVS Service Product Manager
description:
Job Description Summary

The AVS product manager plays a key leadership role in driving and accelerating service growth through service product development and commercial activation excellence for AVS products across the USCAN region, with a focus on all our Ultrasound and IGT products, customer service needs, and sales/delivery channels for Value Delivery and Value Creation. Leads New Service Introduction (NSI) coordination, including new product and enterprise digital solutions, internal and commercial readiness, and activation with USCAN Marketing that coincides with New Product Introductions. Leads and creates New Service Offerings for new Go-To-Market offerings that augment and/or replace legacy Service portfolio offerings for the AVS and related Digital Solutions. Leads discussion and strategy regarding End of Service Lifecycle for concerned modalities.

GE Healthcare is a leading global innovator in medical technology and digital solutions. Our mission is to improve lives in the moments that matter. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world.

Job Description

Essential Responsibilities

  • Provide wing-to-wing leadership for the creation, development, and commercial activation of customer-facing service products and corresponding offerings related to the Ultrasound, IGT businesses and related Digital Solutions to increase GE Healthcare service contract capture rate/market share, and enable accelerated growth in targeted region, customer segment, or commercial channel. Focused on Offering Price, Share and Mix of Imaging Portfolio.

  • Drive and prioritize new service introduction and improvement requirements from global product, digital, and engineering teams, regional customers, and commercial teams based on customer value, industry trend, competitive landscape, growth dynamics, speed to market, technical roadmap, and return on investment. Collaborate with Marketing to drive effective value proposition and Key Opinion Leader development per market and segment needs by working with marketing teams.

  • Work with global product and global service teams on understanding new NPIs suitable for the USCAN market based on customer needs and market opportunity, then develop a go-to-market strategy considering commercial considerations such as channel, commercial training, quoting, and revenue recognition.

  • Work with marketing to conduct market research to discover customers’ unmet needs and commercial opportunities. Utilizes understanding of industry trends to inform the decision-making process.

  • Manage the investment plan for AVS and related Digital Solutions Portfolio for USCAN Service. Drive investment in what will be featured in offerings vs. new standalone offerings. Determine which offerings require dedicated Sales resources vs. those that use attachment selling and the existing Sales team.

  • Drive effective roadmaps and commercial activation strategies to maximize resource utilization and growth outcomes by identifying region best practices, integrating various customer-facing service products and offerings in the region, working with region commercial/operation leaders, driving data visibility, digital platform/tool scalability, and digital ecosystem level 1-4 support sustainability and process standardization.

  • Drive effective communication and activation plans with USCAN Marketing, Commercial Excellence, and Commercial Leadership teams. Work closely with the Training teams to ensure appropriate curriculum is in place for the commercial teams selling products and solutions across various channels.

  • Communicate complex messages and negotiate with internal stakeholders across functions with others to adopt a different point of view. Influence and negotiate with peers, product teams, support functions, as well as field commercial and delivery teams.

  • Growth Mindset: the ability to see commercial opportunities for Service and franchise business partners.

  • Developing specialized knowledge of the latest commercial developments in his own area and communication skills to influence others. Contributes towards strategy and policy development, and ensures delivery within his area of responsibility.

  • Interpret internal and external business challenges and recommend best practices to improve products, processes, and services.

Qualifications/Requirements

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or related field. 8+ years’ experience in marketing, product management, or related field. Experience in a customer-facing role (Service, Sales, or Applications).

  • Leadership skills - Ability to lead teams and shape/lead growth vision and marketing strategy.

  • Team-oriented – ability to motivate and work well with diverse, cross-functional teams.

  • Excellent oral and written communication skills.

  • Strong analytical and process skills - Demonstrated ability to analyze and resolve problems, and effectively communicate the outcomes.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead and execute commercial programs and manage commercial projects go-to-market activities. Ability to document, plan, market, and monitor performance of commercial programs against measurable business goals.

  • Influencing skills – ability to motivate individuals and demonstrate organizational influence.

  • Ability to travel and willingness to work flexible hours to accommodate the needs of customers and sales teams.

Desired Characteristics

  • MBA or Master’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or related field. 10+ years’ experience in marketing, product marketing, or related field. Experience leading and developing teams. Deep marketing expertise in market & customer insights, product commercialization, and branding. Healthcare product/industry acumen. Innovation – develop new ideas through collaboration and execute on creative ideas. Established project management skills.

We expect all employees to live and breathe our behaviors: to act with humility and build trust; lead with transparency; deliver with focus, and drive ownership – always with unyielding integrity.

Our total rewards are designed to unlock your ambition by giving you the boost and flexibility you need to turn your ideas into world-changing realities. Our salary and benefits are everything you’d expect from an organization with global strength and scale, and you’ll be surrounded by career opportunities in a culture that fosters care, collaboration, and support.

title: Business Associate
description:
Roles & responsibilities

Overview Support data governance, quality, and service excellence for the Alumni Network. You will steward high‑confidentiality alumni data across Engage (a Salesforce system), KPMG Connect, PeopleSoft, and various external sources (e.g., LinkedIn) to maintain accurate records, enable smooth event operations, and strengthen business development and relationship tracking. The role demands exceptional attention to detail, sound judgment within defined standards, and the ability to deliver under tight deadlines with multiple stakeholders.

Key responsibilities

Data stewardship and validation

•Own day‑to‑day alumni data validation and administration in the primary systems (Engage, KPMG Connect, PeopleSoft)
•Run weekly data validation: extract reports, validate records, and return corrections with clear documentation.
•Maintain and govern key alumni data attributes; ensure accurate tagging to campaigns and strategic initiatives within Engage.
•Execute post‑release data integrity checks following system enhancements.
•Ensure adherence to data standards, business rules, and governance policies.

Research and profile enrichment

•Conduct structured research to resolve incomplete, inconsistent, or ambiguous records.
•Validate identity through cross‑referencing system data, LinkedIn, and other approved external sources.
•Enrich alumni profiles with verified data points; ensure all updates are validated and compliant prior to system entry.

Issue management, triage, and escalation

•Identify, classify, and resolve data issues (duplicates, conflicts, incomplete records, identity/name changes) using defined resolution rules.
•Triage and manage administration/process queries; drive closure with strong SLA focus and customer service.
•Apply judgment in ambiguous cases and escalate complex or non‑standard exceptions to onshore data stewards
•Track recurring issues and contribute to root cause analysis and preventive actions.

Roles & responsibilities

Reporting, monitoring, and controls

•Maintain data quality logs, validation trackers, and audit trails to ensure traceability
•Support reporting and dashboards in Engage/Salesforce (where applicable) based on stakeholder needs
•Monitor and report on accuracy, turnaround time, and SLA/KPI compliance

Process standardization and continuous improvement

•Help codify judgment‑based decisions into clear SOPs; reduce reliance on tacit knowledge
•Identify opportunities to streamline processes and enhance data quality and governance maturity
•Share best practices and contribute to playbooks and knowledge bases

This role is for you if you have the below

Work experience and core capabilities

•Proven track record in operational excellence and delivering exceptional customer service
•Exceptional attention to detail with strong analytical and problem‑solving skills
•Ability to work with large datasets and repeatable processes; deliver high‑quality work under pressure and tight deadlines
•Resilience and effectiveness with multiple demanding stakeholders, proactive, credible, confidential, and accountable
•Adaptability and eagerness to learn and develop expertise client‑focused with a passion for process efficiency

Data stewardship competencies

•Solid understanding of data quality principles and governance concepts
•Consistent application of data standards, definitions, and validation rules
•Experience identifying, triaging, and resolving data issues with clear documentation

Technical skills

•Hands‑on experience with CRM/data platforms and reporting tools (e.g., Salesforce)
•Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other Microsoft 365 products for tracking, reconciliation, and analysis
•Familiarity with LinkedIn and other external research tools
•

Communication and judgment

•Clear, concise written and verbal communication with cross‑functional stakeholders
•Strong judgment within defined guidelines; timely and appropriate escalation of exceptions
•Commitment to confidentiality and compliance in handling sensitive and high‑profile data

title: Data Engineer, Enterprise Data Engineering
description:
Make your mark at Comcast -- a Fortune 30 global media and technology company. From the connectivity and platforms we provide, to the content and experiences we create, we reach hundreds of millions of customers, viewers, and guests worldwide. Become part of our award-winning technology team that turns big ideas into cutting-edge products, platforms, and solutions that our customers love. We create space to innovate, and we recognize, reward, and invest in your ideas, while ensuring you can proudly bring your authentic self to the workplace. Join us. You’ll do the best work of your career right here at Comcast. (In most cases, Comcast prefers to have employees on-site collaborating unless the team has been designated as virtual due to the nature of their work. If a position is listed with both office locations and virtual offerings, Comcast may be willing to consider candidates who live greater than 100 miles from the office for the remote option.)

Job Summary

This is a new Engineer 3 position that will be responsible for developing, implementing, and maintaining data pipelines and ETL processes critical to support Comcast’s national locates program. Ensure accurate and timely ingestion of locates-related data from multiple sources. Works closely with operations & analytics teams to structure data effectively for actionable reporting and analysis. The ideal candidate must have a passion for data and a willingness to adapt to various system/operational challenges to work with disparate data sources both internally & externally.

Job Description

As part of the National Locates/Damage Prevention team, this Data Engineer is based in our Denver (Englewood), CO office, but may also sit out of our Philadelphia office. It is not approved for remote or virtual employment. We are unable to provide sponsorship for this role now or in the future.

Core Responsibilities:

  • Develop, implement and maintain robust ETL processes for ingestion, transformation and loading of locates data.
  • Design scalable solutions for large data volumes, optimizing for performance & cost.
  • Engage external teams in the creation of data pipelines from various sources, including 811 one call centers, locates vendors and ticket management systems.
  • Collaborate closely with analysts and operational stakeholders to ensure data accuracy, quality and consistency.
  • Monitor, troubleshoot and optimize data pipelines to maintain efficient and reliable data flow.
  • Document data structures and processes clearly to facilitate cross-team understanding and usage.
  • Identify and implement improvements to enhance data quality and processing efficiency.
  • Ensure compliance with data governance standards, cybersecurity and best practices.

title: SAP Project Manager
description:
The Basics

Team: Product

Experience: 5 to 10 years

Location: Mumbai / Remote

Introduction

$11 trillion of money flows every year between companies in India. It typically takes avg. 70 days for a business to get paid, and it’s increasing 5% every year, leading to a severe credit crunch in the economy

We are building India’s first AI-driven Finance & Accounting Company that transforms how businesses pay and get paid. CashFlo already processes INR 20,000+ Crores of invoices every month, across 300,000 MSMEs and 1200+ corporates.

Our leadership consists of ex-BCG and ISB / IIM / ICAI alumni with a team of industry veterans serving on the advisory board. We are backed by Elevation Capital (one of the most successful VCs in India) and General Catalyst ($30 Billion+ global fund, and early investors in Stripe, Airbnb etc.). We share our lineage with HCS, a 25 year old investment bank and a registered NBFC. We are a team of passionate problem solvers and we’re building a technology company with a strong product innovation mindset.

We are looking for someone who loves a challenge, is ambitious, super tenacious and persistent. S/he is a self-starter, thrives in a dynamic, small start-up environment, has a knack for understanding customer needs, and is result-oriented. If you check these boxes - we want to talk to you!


About the Role

We are looking for an experienced SAP Project Manager to own the end-to-end delivery of CashFlo AI Accountant’s integration with Client SAP systems. The role requires strong hands-on expertise in the SAP Material Management (MM) module, SAP FICO module, solid working knowledge of SAP S/4HANA, and a proven track record of delivering ERP projects on time, on scope, and on budget.

You will work closely with enterprise client stakeholders, SAP functional and technical consultants, internal product and engineering teams, and implementation partners to plan, execute, and govern SAP projects that directly impact procurement, finance, and supply-chain workflows for some of India’s largest corporates.

Key Responsibilities

Project Delivery & Management

• Own end-to-end delivery of SAP implementation, integration, and rollout projects, from scoping and planning through go-live and hypercare.

• Build and manage detailed project plans, timelines, resourcing, and budgets across multiple concurrent SAP engagements.

• Drive projects for large enterprise clients (Rs. 1000 Cr+ turnover), ensuring delivery is aligned to their scale, complexity, and compliance needs.

• Proactively identify project risks and issues, and drive them to closure with clear mitigation plans.

• Track and report project status, milestones, and RAID logs to leadership and client stakeholders.

Solution Ownership

• Act as the primary point of ownership requirement gathering, configuration walkthroughs, and business process alignment.

• Partner with other functional consultants to translate client workflows into solution design.

• Ensure required integrations are correctly scoped, tested, and delivered.

SAP S/4HANA & Enterprise Systems

• Bring working knowledge of SAP S/4HANA architecture, modules, and implementation methodology to guide project decisions.

• Coordinate with SAP functional consultants across modules (FICO, MM, SD, etc.) for seamless, integrated delivery.

• Support internal SAP landscape decisions — upgrades, configuration changes, and ongoing optimization.

Stakeholder & Vendor Management

• Serve as the primary point of contact for enterprise client stakeholders and their SAP/IT teams through the project lifecycle.

• Manage external SAP implementation partners, System Integrators (SIs), and vendors where required.

• Facilitate steering committee updates and executive-level status reviews.

Required Skills & Qualifications

Experience

• 5–10 years of overall experience, with a significant portion in SAP project management or SAP MM functional delivery.

• Proven track record of delivering SAP projects end-to-end for large enterprises (Rs. 1000 Cr+ turnover).

• Hands-on experience with the SAP Material Management (MM) module — Purchase Orders, GRNs, Invoice posting, Debit note posting

• Working knowledge of SAP S/4HANA — architecture, implementation approach, and functional capabilities.

• Strong project management fundamentals — planning, budgeting, risk management, and stakeholder communication.

Skills & Attributes

• Ability to bridge business requirements and technical SAP solutions with clarity.

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, comfortable engaging with senior client and internal leadership.

• Structured, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.

• Ownership mindset with the ability to work independently and drive outcomes.

Preferred / Nice to Have

• Chartered Accountant (CA) background, bringing strong financial and process acumen to SAP finance and procurement workflows.

• Exposure to fintech, SaaS, ERP, or enterprise product environments.

• Familiarity with additional SAP modules such as FICO, SD, Ariba, or Treasury.

What We’re Looking For

• Ownership mindset with strong execution capability.

• Ability to simplify complex enterprise workflows and manage them to closure.

• Strong business understanding alongside SAP domain expertise.

• Passion for building scalable, high-quality delivery processes for enterprise clients.


Joining CashFlo - Why it’s a great choice:

Uniquely Positioned for Success: CashFlo sits at the unique intersection of Payments, Lending, and SaaS - three of the fastest-growing and most lucrative spaces globally and in India. As a part of our team, you will be a key player in an industry-defining company.

An Opportunity to Create Wealth: At CashFlo, we understand that our success is deeply linked with the success of our employees. That's why we offer the potential to create exponential wealth through equity in our rapidly growing early-stage company. You will not only contribute to our growth story, but also share in the rewards.

A Collaborative and Driven Team: We pride ourselves on fostering a culture that encourages kindness, collaboration, and a shared commitment to quality. Our team members are always there to help each other, and we believe in lifting each other up. Your growth is our growth, and we succeed as a team.

Direct Impact on Company Success: At CashFlo, every role is crucial. Your work will have a real, tangible impact on our success. You'll see the results of your hard work in real-time.

Fast-Track Your Career: We invest in our employees' professional growth through comprehensive training programs, mentoring opportunities, and clear growth paths. Whether you aspire to grow as an individual contributor or on a management track, we provide the resources and support you need to accelerate your career.

Unwavering Commitment to Excellence: We are seeking individuals ready to dive into challenging work, individuals who are excited about going above and beyond to drive their own growth and the company's. If you are motivated by ambitious goals and are ready to make a significant impact, CashFlo is the place for you.

title: Applied Scientist, Delivery Networks and Tech
description:
Customer addresses, Geospatial information and Road-network play a crucial role in Amazon Logistics' Delivery Planning systems. We own exciting science problems in the areas of Address Normalization, Geocode learning, Maps learning, Time estimations including route-time, delivery-time, transit-time predictions which are key inputs in delivery planning. As part of the Science team within DNT (Last Mile), you will partner closely with other scientists and engineers in a collegial environment to develop enterprise ML solutions with a clear path to business impact. The setting also gives you an opportunity to think about a complex large-scale problem for multiple years and building increasingly sophisticated solutions year over year. In the process there will be opportunity to innovate, explore SOTA and publish the research in internal and external ML conferences.

Successful candidates will have deep knowledge of competing machine learning methods for large scale predictive modelling, natural language processing, semi-supervised & graph based learning. We also look for the experience to graduate prototype models to production and the communication skills to explain complex technical approaches to the stakeholders of varied technical expertise.

Here is a glimpse of the problem spaces and technologies that we deal with on a regular basis:

1. De-duping and organizing addresses into hierarchy while handling noisy, inconsistent, localized and multi-lingual user inputs. We do this at the scale of millions of customers for established (US, EU) as well as emerging geographies (IN, MX). We make use of technologies like LLMs, Weak supervision, Graph-based clustering & Entity matching. We also use additional modalities such as building outlines in maps, street view images and 3P datasets, gazetteers.

2. Build a generic ML framework which leverages relationship between places to improve delivery experience by learning precise delivery locations and propagating attributes, such as business hours and safe places.

3. (Work done in sister teams) Developing systems to consume inputs from areal imagery and optimize our maps to enable efficient delivery planning. Also building models to estimate travel time, turn costs, optimal route and defect propensities.

Key job responsibilities
As an Applied Scientist I, your responsibility will be to deliver on a well defined but complex business problem, explore SOTA technologies including GenAI and customize the large models as suitable for the application. Your job will be to work on a end-to-end business problem from design to experimentation and implementation. There is also an opportunity to work on open ended ML directions within the space and publish the work in prestigious ML conferences.

About the team
Last Mile Address Intelligence (LMAI) team owns WW charter for address and location learning solutions which are crucial for efficient Last Mile delivery planning. The team works out of Hyderabad and Bangalore offices in India. LMAI is a part of the DNT Science team, which also owns problems in the space of maps learning and travel time estimations. The rest of the DNT Science team and senior leadership of Last Mile org works out of Bellevue office.

title: Product Manager

title: AI Accelerated Senior Java Engineer
description:
Calling all innovators - find your future at Fiserv.

We're Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants and consumers to one another millions of times a day - quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we're involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.

Job Title

AI Accelerated Senior Java Engineer

About your role:

Join a delivery team building the CommerceHub platform, where you will design and deliver payment software while helping engineering teams apply artificial intelligence (AI) tools consistently, responsibly, and measurably. You will work across engineers, technical leads, and delivery teams to improve engineering quality, delivery speed, and predictability through scalable payment services, specification-driven development, and disciplined AI-assisted workflows.

What you'll do:

  • Design and deliver software solutions for real-time payments, payment application programming interfaces (APIs), and high-volume omnichannel commerce processing.
  • Analyze business processes and heterogeneous technology environments to define scalable, secure, and maintainable payment solutions.
  • Develop microservices using reactive design patterns for protocol translation, enrichment, orchestration, and high-throughput transaction processing.
  • Apply and reinforce consistent use of AI prompts, GitHub Copilot instructions, Codex instructions, SpecKit artifacts, and engineering guidance across delivery work.
  • Improve engineering practices by sharing reusable prompts, workflows, coding patterns, testing approaches, and lessons learned for AI-assisted development.
  • Lead use of specification-driven engineering practices, including SpecKit or similar frameworks, to improve clarity, traceability, implementation quality, and delivery predictability.
  • Validate product changes through unit, component, integration, performance, and API testing, including Postman-based API validation where applicable.
  • Conduct code reviews that evaluate AI-assisted suggestions for security, quality, maintainability, performance, and appropriate implementation.
  • Guide teams on selecting AI tools and agents for design, coding, testing, documentation, debugging, and refactoring outcomes.
  • Enhance API solutions to deliver secure, simple, and easy-to-consume interfaces for payment customers across enterprise environments.
  • Contribute to API roadmap execution, software development kit (SDK) support, client libraries, DevOps, continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), and continuous delivery strategies.
  • Responsibilities listed are not intended to be all-inclusive and may be modified as necessary.

Experience you'll need to have:

  • 8+ years of experience in software engineering using Java, Spring Boot, Spring Framework, Maven, Git, JIRA, Confluence, and enterprise software development life cycle practices.
  • 8+ years of experience designing and delivering microservices, real-time APIs, high-volume transaction processing applications, and payment platform capabilities in enterprise environments.
  • 8+ years of experience developing secure APIs and distributed services with protocol translation, orchestration, enrichment, and omnichannel consumption patterns.
  • 6+ years of experience creating automated tests using JUnit, Mockito, Postman, JMeter, integration testing, component testing, mock frameworks, virtual services, and performance testing practices.
  • 4+ years of experience using SpecKit or similar specification-driven engineering practices to define requirements, acceptance criteria, implementation plans, and validation expectations.
  • 2+ years of experience using AI-assisted engineering tools such as GitHub Copilot, Copilot Chat, Codex, AI coding agents, or similar platforms to improve code development, testing, documentation, and delivery quality.
  • 2+ years of experience creating or refining AI prompts, instruction sets, engineering playbooks, and reusable guidance for consistent AI-assisted development.
  • Experience using quality and security scanning tools such as Sonar, Fortify, WebInspect, or similar tools to identify findings and improve code quality and risk posture.
  • Experience working with Oracle, SQL Server, MySQL, or similar relational databases and enterprise data access patterns.
  • Experience applying object-oriented design patterns, domain-driven design principles, test-driven development, and enterprise architecture frameworks.
  • Experience working with cloud and platform technologies such as Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, Pivotal Cloud Foundry (PCF), Kubernetes, Jenkins, GitLab CI, or equivalent technologies.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate across engineers, technical leads, delivery teams, and stakeholders.
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education, related experience and/or military experience.

Experience that would be great to have:

  • 10+ years of experience in enterprise payments, commerce platforms, cloud-native engineering, or large-scale distributed systems.
  • Experience coaching engineers on prompt quality, AI-assisted coding workflows, agent selection, code review practices, test generation, debugging, refactoring, and documentation standards.
  • Experience defining AI usage standards, measuring adoption quality, tracking delivery outcomes, and improving engineering practices based on delivery metrics and defect trends.
  • Relevant certifications in cloud, security, architecture, agile delivery, payments, or AI-assisted software engineering, or equivalent validated experience.

Individuals with temporary visas including, but not limited to, F-1 (OPT, CPT, STEM), H-1B, H-2, or TN, or any candidate requiring sponsorship, now or in the future, will not be considered for this role.

title: Controls Engineer - Manufacturing Automation
description:
Career Area:

Manufacturing

Job Description:

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Job Title: Controls Engineer - Manufacturing Automation

Salary: £42,000–£57,000 depending on skills demonstrated

Contract: Full time & permanent

Location: Desford, Leicestershire

The Opportunity

We are seeking a Manufacturing Engineer within Controls to act as the controls and automation subject matter expert within Manufacturing Engineering. Supporting major capital and continuous improvement initiatives, you will lead controls integration, modernise legacy systems and deliver automation solutions that improve safety, quality and productivity. Your work will be instrumental in maintaining reliable manufacturing operations while shaping the future controls and operational technology landscape of the facility.

As a Controls Engineer, you are accountable for, but not limited to:

  • Identify, develop and implement automation and controls solutions that improve OEE, safety, quality and cost performance, taking projects from concept through to production deployment.

  • Design, program and support Siemens and Mitsubishi PLC, HMI and SCADA systems, while driving controls standardisation, modernisation of legacy assets and alignment with operational technology architecture.

  • Lead controls lifecycle management activities, including hardware obsolescence planning, migration strategies, cybersecurity considerations, system upgrades and long-term manufacturing supportability.

  • Provide technical leadership and escalation support for automated manufacturing production lines, acting as the subject matter expert for controls, automation and machine safety whilst ensuring reliable operation through effective troubleshooting, root cause analysis and support to maintenance and operations teams.

  • Lead manufacturing technology and continuous improvement projects, managing scope, budgets, resources, suppliers and timelines, while supporting equipment specification, FAT, SAT, commissioning and successful production handover.

  • Collaborate with manufacturing, quality, facilities, engineering and external partners to develop robust manufacturing solutions using tools such as process flow mapping, PFMEA and control plans, while promoting Design for Manufacture (DFM), lean principles, standardised workflows and mentoring others in controls and manufacturing best practices.

NB. The panel cannot make assumptions when shortlisting therefore please demonstrate your qualifications and experience on your CV relevant to the criteria outlined.

What You Can Demonstrate:

Level Working Knowledge

  • Engineering – Manufacturing (MFG): Delivers engineering solutions through the specification, integration, commissioning and support of manufacturing equipment and control systems. Applies engineering standards and technical specifications to ensure safe, reliable and sustainable manufacturing operations, including equipment specification, electrical design, commissioning activities and lifecycle upgrades that support long-term manufacturing capability.

  • Collaborative Automation: Drives the implementation and optimisation of automation technologies, including PLC-controlled equipment, robotics and automated manufacturing systems. Applies controls engineering expertise to improve safety, quality, productivity and operational performance.

  • Manufacturing Processes: Applies manufacturing process control methodologies to introduce, monitor and improve production systems. Utilises process flow mapping, PFMEA, control plans, FAT and SAT to support robust process design, equipment integration and successful production handover.

  • Problem Solving: Acts as a technical specialist in the diagnosis and resolution of complex controls and automation issues. Applies expertise in Siemens TIA Portal and Mitsubishi GX Works PLCs, HMI and SCADA systems, industrial networking technologies (Profinet, Ethernet/IP and OPC UA), motion control, drives, machine safety systems including safety PLCs, safety scanners and light guarding, machinery risk assessment and functional safety standards (ISO 13849 and IEC 62061) to deliver safe, reliable and supportable manufacturing solutions.

What You May Have:

  • Manufacturing & Automation Systems: Working knowledge of assembly, test and finish manufacturing operations, including AGV/AMR technologies, installation, commissioning, maintenance and fleet management. Familiarity with ISA-95 manufacturing architectures would be advantageous.

  • Quality & Continuous Improvement: Applies structured problem-solving and continuous improvement methodologies, including 8D, 5-Why, Fishbone and Six Sigma, to improve quality, reliability and operational performance.

  • Technical & Professional Capability: Knowledge of functional safety principles and their application to machinery, automation and manufacturing systems within a production environment.

Pending the number of applications, the criteria for the position may be enhanced to facilitate shortlisting.

Just a quick heads-up: We start reviewing applications as soon as they come in, so if you’re interested, don’t wait too long! We may close the advert early if we feel we’ve got a strong pool of potentially suitable applicants.

Don’t miss out, get your application in soon!

What You Will Get
One Company, Limitless Opportunities

Caterpillar is the world’s leading manufacturer of construction and mining equipment, off-highway diesel and natural gas engines, industrial gas turbines and diesel-electric locomotives. We do business on every continent, principally operating through three primary segments – Construction Industries, Resource Industries, and Energy & Transportation – and providing financing and related services through our Financial Products segment.

Careers at Caterpillar are limitless, we have opportunities in Engineering, Human Resources, Manufacturing, Marketing, Sales, Supply Chain and so much more. You can create the career you want. It’s your time and talent, make it count.

Our Sustainability Commitment

Caterpillar has a long-standing commitment to sustainability, one of our five Values in Action. It is part of who we are and what we do. We actively lead sustainable green initiatives to preserve the environment, help reduce poverty with the Caterpillar Foundation and stay involved in the communities we help build.

Benefits: 27 days annual leave + bank holidays, opportunity to buy additional holiday, 10% Bonus, contributory pension scheme - Caterpillar will double the employee's contribution up to 10%, contributory share scheme - Caterpillar will match 50% of the employee's contribution, Employee Support Networks – join groups that offer support, connection, and a sense of community, optional flexible benefits including access to private health and dental care plans, EV car lease etc

Travel: Up to 5% UK travel may be required, including visits to other facilities as needed.

August 6, 2026 - August 31, 2026

title: Ticket Office Event Staff - Homestead-Miami Speedway
description:
HOMESTEAD-MIAMI SPEEDAY

Homestead-Miami Speedway has been open since 1995 following an initiative to spur economic recovery in the aftermath of Hurricane Andrew. The Speedway, which was founded by Miami businessman, racing enthusiast and philanthropist Ralph Sanchez, is a 650-acre facility that features a 1.5-mile oval and 2.21-mile road course. The Speedway hosts on-track events nearly 300 days per year and generates more than $301 million annually for the region. NASCAR crowned champions in all three of its national series at Homestead-Miami Speedway for 18 straight years (2002-19) and will once again host NASCAR Championship weekend in 2026.

Homestead-Miami Speedway is hiring for Ticket Office Event Staff. This position will provide customer service, product upsell, and order processing via telephone, mail, and walk-ups. This is a part-time seasonal position.

Duties & Responsibilities:
• Selling parking passes to all walk-up customers.
• Process cash and credit card payments.
• Serve as a staff member working in a ticket booth.
• Develop a working knowledge of track pricing, policies, procedures, and general event information. As the first line for guest questions, Event Ticketing Staff must be able to answer questions or direct guests in the proper direction.
• Direct vehicle traffic flow to proper areas.
• Assist guests with questions regarding directions, information about the facility, and parking assistance.
• Handle will-call requests at the ticket office.

• Other duties as assigned.

Education & Experience:
• High school diploma or general education degree (GED); or one to three months related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
• 1-2 years’ event staffing or ticket sales experience preferred.

Other Qualifications:
• Minimum 18 years of age.
• Ability to work outdoors in changing weather conditions for extended periods.
• Attention to detail and ability to provide a high level of customer service is required.
• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-energy environment.
• Flexible schedule during the event.
• Previous cash handling experience preferred.
• Reliable transportation to and from the track location.
• Pass background screening.

title: Logistiikkatyöntekijä ABB Distribution Solutions
description:
Etsimme yhteistyökumppanillemme ABB Oy:lle Distribution Solutions -yksikköön motivoitunutta henkilöä logistiikan tehtävään.

ABB:n Distribution Solutions kehittää, valmistaa, myy ja markkinoi sähkönjakeluverkon suojareleitä sekä ohjaus-, automaatio- ja valvontalaitteita. Sähköverkon vikatilanteissa suojarele havaitsee vian, viestii siitä eteenpäin ja suojaa näin ihmishenkiä ja laitteita edistäen samalla sähkönsaannin luotettavuutta. Suojareleiden lisäksi Vaasassa sijaitsevan tehtaan ydinosaamista ovat kaukokäytön ohjaus- ja valvontalaitteet, jotka ovat laajasti käytössä energiayhtiöissä ja teollisuudessa myös Suomessa.

Tulet työskentelemään yksikön pakkaamossa ja logistiikassa, jossa työhön kuuluu mm. suojareleiden ja oheistuotteiden pakkaaminen. Lisäksi työtehtäväsi voivat rakentua myös keräilystä, tavaran vastaanotosta ja hyllytyksestä sekä muista lähettämön tehtävistä.

Työ vaatii oma-aloitteisuutta sekä halua kehittyä työssä. Työssä menestyäksesi sinun tulee olla tarkka työssäsi ja elektroniikan ymmärtäminen on hyödyksesi tässä tehtävässä. Kielitaitovaatimuksina on suomi ja toivomme sinulta kykyä kommunikoida myös englanniksi. Työssä käytetään mm. SAP-, Office 365-ohjelmistoja, joten hyvät IT-taidot ovat eduksi. Lisäksi sähkötyöturvallisuus- ja työturvallisuuskortti katsotaan eduksi. Aikaisempi kokemus logistiikasta tai kokoonpanotyöstä on tehtävässä hyödyksi.

Työsuhde on määräaikainen ja solmitaan työntekijän ja Adeccon välille. Työt alkavat sopimuksen mukaan elokuun aikana. Työtä tehdään pääsääntöisesti kahdessa vuorossa, mutta sinulla tulee olla valmius tehdä 3-vuorotyötä. Tehtävään valitulle tullaan tekemään työhöntulotarkastus huumausainetesteineen.

Toivomme sinulta itsenäistä ja palvelualtista työotetta, kykyä toimia joustavasti tiimissä ja halua sitoutua tehtävään pidemmäksikin ajaksi. Työ vaatii myös tarkkuutta, huolellisuutta ja hyviä kommunikointitaitoja. Tarjoamme mahdollisuuden oppia ja kehittyä työssä ammattitaitoisten kollegoiden tukemana. Saat työhösi perusteellisen perehdytyksen.

Haethan tehtävään pian, mutta viimeistään 31.8.2026 mennessä. Olethan nopea, sillä paikka täytetään sopivan henkilön löydyttyä. Jos sinulla on kysyttävää työtehtävästä tai hakuprosessista, otathan yhteyttä haun yhteyshenkilöön: Janne Henriksson 040 154 5851.

title: Lead Software Engineer- Data Engineer
description:
Career Area:

Technology, Digital and Data

Job Description:

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Software Engineering Lead – Data Platform

About the Role

We are seeking a highly skilled Software Engineering Lead – Data Platform to lead the development of Caterpillar’s next-generation Digital Manufacturing Data Platform. This platform enables large-scale data ingestion, transformation, and analytics across manufacturing, supply chain, and engineering ecosystems.

The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in data engineering, large-scale data ingestion, AWS-based architectures, and Snowflake, along with strong leadership and software engineering discipline.

Key Responsibilities

  • Leadership & Delivery
  • Lead and mentor a team of data engineers and platform developers
  • Drive Agile execution and ensure predictable, high-quality delivery
  • Establish engineering best practices, code quality, and CI/CD standards
  • Data Platform & Architecture
  • Architect scalable and secure data platforms on AWS
  • Design robust data ingestion frameworks for batch and near real-time pipelines
  • Define best practices in data modeling, governance, and metadata management
  • Data Engineering & Ingestion
  • Lead design and development of scalable ingestion pipelines (structured and unstructured data)
  • Build and optimize Snowflake-based data platforms for performance and cost
  • Enable ingestion of diverse sources (databases, APIs, files, streaming data)
  • Cloud & Platform Engineering
  • Leverage AWS services (S3, Glue, Lambda, EMR, Redshift, etc.) for end-to-end pipelines
  • Implement CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps / Jenkins
  • Ensure system scalability, resiliency, and operational readiness
  • Software Engineering Excellence
  • Enforce software engineering principles (modular design, code quality, testing, version control)
  • Drive automation and continuous improvement
  • Promote reusable frameworks for ingestion and transformation
  • Stakeholder Collaboration
  • Partner with product managers, SMEs, and business stakeholders
  • Translate business needs into scalable data solutions

Must-Have Skills

  • 10+ years of experience in Data Engineering / Data Platform roles
  • Strong experience in AWS data ecosystem (S3, Glue, Lambda, EMR, Redshift)
  • Deep expertise in Snowflake (architecture, optimization, data modeling)
  • Strong programming skills in Python and SQL
  • Extensive experience with data ingestion pipelines and ETL/ELT frameworks
  • Exposure to real-time streaming (Kafka, Spark Streaming)
  • Experience with CI/CD tools (GitHub, Jenkins, AWS CloudFormation etc.)
  • Solid understanding of distributed systems and scalable architectures
  • Strong foundation in software engineering principles (Git, testing, design patterns)
  • Experienced in working with Agile teams
  • Collaborate with Data Science and AI teams to operationalize ML models and analytics workflows.
  • Promote integration of AI capabilities into data engineering pipelines (e.g., GenAI, MCP, ATA).
  • Support real-time analytics and edge AI use cases in manufacturing environments.
  • Use AI extensively in building and testing Data Ingestion and Data pipeline

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with Graph Databases (Neo4j, Neptune)
  • Experience with Vector Databases (Milvus, OpenSearch)
  • Knowledge of NVIDIA ecosystem and RAPIDS (cuDF, cuML, cuGraph)
  • Experience integrating AI/ML pipelines or GenAI workflows

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science / Engineering
  • Proven track record in leading engineering teams and delivering at scale
  • Strong leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills

This position requires working onsite five days a week.

title: Communications Specialist III- Academic Affairs
description:

Our Values

Respect | Belonging | Accountability | Transparency

Department

Public Affairs - Marketing

Job Summary

The Specialist III, Communications role requires the skill of a seasoned professional who needs minimal review of work. The role is responsible for developing and executing advanced communication strategies within Academic Affairs that support Denver Health's academic mission, brand and strategic objectives. This role manages complex projects, creates high-impact content for both internal and external audiences and ensures consistent messaging across various channels. The Communications Specialist works closely with key stakeholders in the Office of Research, the Office of Education, and across the organization to support initiatives related to highlighting academic programs and activities, promoting academic achievements of Denver Health faculty and staff, facilitating academic partnerships, and decreasing barriers for researchers and learners. This includes internal and external communications, executive communications, patient communications, research communications, marketing, media relations, crisis communications, and employee engagement.


Essential Functions:

  • Strategic Content Development:

    Develops and executes comprehensive academic communication plans that align with Denver Health’s strategic priorities.

    Ensures that internal and external resources and presentations are up-to-date, aligned, impactful, and user-friendly.

​

  • Editorial Oversight & Copyediting:

    Leads editorial planning and content calendar development, ensuring a cohesive approach to storytelling across all channels, including the external academic affairs website.

    Produces a monthly newsletter and manages the distribution list. Also monitors data on open rates, click rates and general growth of this external product. (30%)

  • Serves as the final set of eyes on all internal and external collateral, ensuring accuracy, clarity, consistency and adherence to brand and AP style guidelines.​ Provides copyediting, proofreading and quality control for marketing and communication materials. (10%)

    Supports the health system’s Public Information Officer (PIO) by assisting with media inquiries, drafting press materials and supporting proactive media pitches to enhance Denver Health’s academic profile through earned media; this role partners with the PIO and is not expected to serve as the primary media contact initially.

    Provides media support during academic events or announcements, including drafting or copyediting key messages and talking points. (5%)

​

  • Contributes to social media, including content creation and posting to promote research and education at Denver Health. (10%)

  • Executive Communications:
    Helps with executive communications when needed, including ppt presentations. (10%)

  • Attends events and represents Denver Health externally (5%)


Education:

  • Bachelor's Degree Communications, Journalism or related field required.


Work Experience:

  • 4-6 years related work experience with extensive writing required.


Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • strong written word and design skills, with the ability to clearly convey information to multiple different stakeholders.

  • Mastery of AP style.

  • Skilled in video shooting and editing.

  • Self-starter and independent thinker who works with limited supervision and guidance.

  • Excellent communication skill.

  • Excellent customer service.

  • Service-oriented working style, excellent organizational abilities, and strong interpersonal skills are required.

  • Good judgment/ ability to work cooperatively and in a mentoring role in an integrated team environment.

Days (United States of America)

At Denver Health, we take care of the people who take care of our community. Our benefits are built to support your life, your family, and your future — with generous paid time off, fully paid parental leave, exceptional retirement contributions, comprehensive health coverage, and nationally recognized well-being programs. We invest in your growth through tuition assistance, career advancement pathways, and professional development — while also offering meaningful financial advantages through loan forgiveness eligibility and employer contributions. Denver Health is an integrated, high-quality academic healthcare system considered a model for the nation that includes a Level I Trauma Center, a 555-bed acute care medical center, Denver’s 911 emergency medical response system, 10 family health centers, 19 school-based health centers, Rocky Mountain Poison & Drug Safety, the Public Health Institute at Denver Health, Denver Health Medical Plan and Denver Health Foundation.

description:

Job Description:

About the Role & Team

As a Sound Designer, you will be responsible for the end-to-end audio postproduction process for Disney's Kids Hub across Europe and Africa. Working across multiple languages and territories, you will create, edit, mix, manage, and deliver high-quality audio assets that bring campaigns and programming to life while maintaining the highest creative and technical standards.

Based within the Spain Creative Services team and reporting to the Manager Creative, Kids Hub, you will partner closely with Editorial, Creative, Production, and external audio suppliers.

You’ll join a team grounded in our Disney values — acting with Integrity, welcoming everyone through Inclusion, embracing boundless Creativity, working together through Collaboration and caring deeply for our Community. These values shape how we work and how we support one another every day.

This role will be based in our Madrid office. This is a part-time position, working 30 hours per week.

What You Will Do

  • You will independently manage end-to-end audio postproduction for assigned projects, from initial sound concept through final delivery, while solving a range of technical and creative problems

  • Create, edit, and mix audio for campaigns and shows across multiple media platforms and in multiple languages, including dialogue, sound effects, ambience, and music, ensuring coherence and quality throughout the postproduction process

  • Adapt and version existing audio structures for new languages, markets, campaigns, and programme formats while maintaining creative and technical standards

  • Lead and support audio recording sessions with voiceover talent (in-house and external vendors), ensuring clean recordings and directing performance to meet creative objectives

  • Prototype sound concepts to illustrate creative goals for campaigns and promotions, collaborating closely with producers, editors, and other creative partners

  • Perform detailed sound editing and mixing, including noise reduction, level balancing, application of sound effects, and precise synchronization to picture

  • Oversee the quality and progress of audio editing, supervising all required elements before delivery to broadcast or final publishing platforms

  • Manage audio assets and suppliers, ensuring all materials meet technical specifications, official sound standards, and creative briefs

  • Troubleshoot software and hardware issues and propose creative solutions to achieve specific sound results or address feedback from the creative team

Required Qualifications & Skills

  • Degree in Audio, Sound Recording, Music, Media Production, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience

  • A link to a portfolio or showreel showcasing audio postproduction, sound design, editing, and mixing work is required. Please include this with your application for consideration

  • Significant professional experience in audio postproduction, sound design, or audio production, preferably within television, broadcast, media, or entertainment environments

  • Experience working with or maintaining a professional audio studio setup, including monitoring systems and recording hardware

  • Professional proficiency in English and Spanish

  • Strong sound design, audio editing, and mixing skills, with proficiency in industry-standard tools such as Pro Tools, EUCON, DADman, and Dante Controller

  • Knowledge of television and media production workflows, including creating and conforming audio to picture, managing sound assets, applying broadcast audio standards and best practices, and navigating local audio production markets and supplier networks

title: Systemutvecklare till framtidens transportsystem!
description:
Hur utvecklar vi smarta och hållbara IT-lösningar som förbättrar järnvägen och gör resandet smidigare? Vi söker erfarna systemutvecklare som vill vara del av vårt team och bidra till svaren på den frågan.

Arbetsuppgifter

Som systemutvecklare hos oss blir du en viktig del av ett team där vi utvecklar smarta IT-lösningar för järnvägen och därigenom bidrar till ett mer tillgängligt och effektivt transportsystem! Vi ökar innovationstakten och förstärker nu vår IT-organisation med skickliga .NET-utvecklare.

En vanlig dag hos oss innebär att du:

  • implementerar tekniska beslut och testar nya idéer för att skapa innovativa lösningar.
  • bidrar till både nyutveckling och vidareutveckling av system som är avgörande för järnväg, samhälle och resenärer.
  • förvaltar befintliga system i nära samarbete med verksamheten för att optimera nytta och värde.
  • arbetar med IT-utvecklingsprojekt, exempelvis inom kapacitetstilldelning.
  • dokumenterar och skapar spårbarhet för det arbete som utförs..
  • deltar i prioriteringsmöten för att hantera arbetsfördelning och identifiera vad som är mest kritiskt att arbeta med.

Det betyder att du:

  • arbetar både enskilt och i team.
  • har förmåga att samarbeta och kommunicera tekniska frågor på ett begripligt sätt.
  • kan ta egna initiativ och arbeta självgående.
  • förstår vikten av dokumentation och struktur för att skapa spårbarhet.
  • vill vara med och utveckla hållbara och framtidssäkrade lösningar.

Vi arbetar agilt och värdesätter samarbete, innovation och kunskapsdelning. Hos oss får även erfarna medarbetare möjlighet att växa i en miljö där du kan testa nya idéer och känna dig trygg med stöd från dina kollegor. Vi lyssnar på våra användares behov och utvecklar lösningar därefter - vilket innebär en balans mellan självständigt arbete och samarbete med både verksamheten och övriga team.

Kvalifikationer

Vem är du?

Vi tror att du är en problemlösare med ett analytiskt sinne som gillar att testa nya vägar och arbeta tillsammans med andra för att hitta de bästa lösningarna. Du är nyfiken, öppen för att lära dig mer och trivs i en miljö där vi hjälper varandra att utvecklas. Du drivs av att få grotta ner dig i tekniken och lära dig om verksamheten som IT-systemen ska stödja och i samspel med verksamheten utveckla lösningar som i sin tur gör användarna nöjda. För att samverkan ska bli så bra som möjligt behöver du ha en god kommunikativ förmåga och kunna bygga smidiga samarbeten.

Vi söker dig som

  • har minst fem års aktuell och relevant arbetserfarenhet av systemutvecklingsarbete efter avslutade studier
  • har minst tre års aktuell och relevant arbetserfarenhet av programmering med C#, .NET och MSSQL
  • har en högskoleexamen om minst 180 hp (120p) med inriktning IT, alternativt annan utbildning i kombination med erfarenhet som Trafikverket bedömer likvärdigt
  • har goda kunskaper i svenska i tal och skrift
  • har goda kunskaper i engelska i tal och skrift

Det är meriterande om du

  • har aktuell och relevant arbetserfarenhet av programmering med Angular och JavaScript
  • har aktuell och relevant erfarenhet av att arbeta enligt Agilt arbetssätt
  • har aktuell och relevant erfarenhet av att arbeta med driftsättnings- och/eller testautomation
  • har aktuell och relevant erfarenhet av att arbeta i en komplex IT-miljö
Övrig information

Varför jobba hos oss?

Här får du en arbetsplats där du kan utvecklas både professionellt och personligt. Vi erbjuder:

  • Goda karriär- och utvecklingsmöjligheter - vi tror på att investera i våra medarbetares framtid
  • Flexibilitet och balans - möjlighet att arbeta delvis på distans och generöst antal semesterdagar
  • En inkluderande arbetskultur - vi värdesätter mångfald och ser olikheter som en styrka
  • Ett jobb som gör skillnad - bidra till hållbara och effektiva transporter för hela samhället

I den här rekryteringen behöver du bifoga ditt CV men vi behöver inget personligt brev.

För att undvika att du missar viktig information om din ansökan behöver du se till att hålla dig uppdaterad via Min karriärsida! Vi använder främst mail (från mejladress: noreply@heroma.se) för att göra utskick och kallelser. Kolla din inkorg och även skräppost/SPAM regelbundet under denna tid för att vara säker på att du får all information från oss! Du kan med fördel även lägga till den mejladressen i dina mejlkontakter.

Önskar du att arbeta delvis på distans? I den här tjänsten kan det finnas möjlighet att arbeta hemifrån upp till 40 procent av din arbetstid.

#LI-Hybrid #LI-LG1

Ansökan

De frågor som du får besvara när du skickar in din ansökan kommer att ligga till grund för det första urvalet vi gör. Om det inte står något annat i annonsen vill vi att du bifogar ditt CV. Vi har slutat begära in personligt brev eftersom vi inte har med det som del av urvalsunderlaget. Om du har skyddade personuppgifter ska du kontakta ansvarig chef för rekryteringen så att din ansökan blir hanterad enligt särskilda rutiner. Du hittar namn och kontaktuppgifter till chefen i annonsen.

Inom vår IT-organisation är du med och utvecklar Sverige med hjälp av moderna och innovativa lösningar. Vi är mitt i en spännande förändring där vi försöker ta vara på digitaliseringens möjligheter till fullo. Digitaliseringen ställer allt större krav och vi vill därför anpassa oss vad gäller kompetens, arbetssätt och organisation i takt med utvecklingen. Vi har ett helhetsansvar för IT och telekom, en verksamhet som pågår dygnet runt, året om - precis som Sveriges transportsystem.

På Trafikverket jobbar vi med att göra Sverige närmare. Vi tror på att en förening av olika erfarenheter, bakgrunder och perspektiv är den bästa grunden för att bygga en arbetsplats fri från diskriminering och en miljö där alla trivs och gör sitt bästa. Vi tror på mångfald där den gemensamma nämnaren är pålitlighet, engagemang och mod. För det är så vi bäst representerar vårt samhälle.

This is a hands-on role: you'll architect and operate cloud infrastructure, drive automation and observability excellence, build robust CI/CD pipelines, and help shape the engineering culture around reliability and operational best practices.

Responsibilities:

  • Operate and optimize Apache Kafka ecosystems, including Strimzi, Kafka Connect, and MirrorMaker, to support real-time data pipelines.

Requirements:

  • 6+ years of hands-on experience in a DevOps or SRE role.

  • Strong knowledge of AWS services, including: VPC, EC2, EKS, S3, ECR, EBS, RDS, ElastiCache, IAM, KMS, Secrets Manager, SSM Parameter Store, CloudWatch, MSK, SNS, SQS, Route 53, Direct Connect, Transit Gateway, and ELB/ALB/NLB.

  • Strong background in monitoring and observability: VictoriaMetrics or Prometheus, Grafana, and the ELK stack; solid understanding of log collection and processing with Fluentbit, Fluentd, and Logstash.

  • Experience operating and managing Apache Kafka ecosystems, including Strimzi, Kafka Connect, and MirrorMaker.

  • Experience with Ansible for configuration management; experience with AWX is a plus.

  • Proficiency in scripting and automation with Bash, Python, and Go.

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate cross-functionally in a fast-paced, regulated environment.

  • English language proficiency.

title: QA Test Consultant
description:
We are seeking a highly motivated Quality Engineering (QE) Consultant with 4–6 years of experience in software testing, automation, and emerging AI technologies. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience testing AI/GenAI applications, APIs, and web applications, along with strong expertise in Playwright automation and AI evaluation frameworks.

This role will focus on ensuring the quality, reliability, safety, and performance of AI-powered solutions by designing comprehensive test strategies, implementing automation frameworks, validating AI model behavior, and establishing evaluation mechanisms for large language model (LLM)-based applications.

The candidate will collaborate closely with Product Owners, Developers, Data Scientists, and AI Engineers to drive quality throughout the software development lifecycle.

AI & GenAI Testing

  • Design and execute test strategies for AI/GenAI applications, including LLM-powered solutions, AI agents, copilots, and conversational systems.
  • Validate AI outputs for:
    • Accuracy
    • Relevance
    • Groundedness
    • Consistency
    • Hallucination detection
    • Toxicity and safety compliance
  • Create and maintain prompt test suites and benchmark datasets.
  • Perform functional, regression, performance, and reliability testing for AI-enabled applications.
  • Define and execute AI evaluation metrics and quality gates.

Automation & Quality Engineering

  • Develop and maintain test automation frameworks using Playwright.
  • Automate UI, API, and end-to-end business workflows.
  • Create reusable automation assets and testing accelerators.
  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Support shift-left testing and quality engineering practices.

API Testing

  • Design and execute API test cases using tools such as:
    • Postman
    • REST Assured
    • Playwright API Testing
  • Validate API contracts, authentication, authorization, error handling, and performance.
  • Conduct integration testing across distributed systems and third-party services.

AI Evaluation & Quality Metrics

  • Establish AI evaluation frameworks and quality scorecards.
  • Measure model quality using evaluation techniques such as:
    • Precision/Recall
    • Relevancy scoring
    • Semantic similarity
    • Groundedness validation
    • Human-in-the-loop evaluation
  • Analyze AI quality trends and recommend improvements.
  • Support Responsible AI and model governance requirements.

Collaboration & Stakeholder Management

  • Work closely with engineering, product, and AI teams to identify quality risks early.
  • Participate in requirement reviews and design discussions.
  • Communicate testing progress, risks, and quality metrics to stakeholders.
  • Contribute to QE best practices, standards, and reusable playbooks.

Experience

  • 4–6 years of experience in Quality Engineering, Software Testing, or Test Automation.
  • Hands-on experience testing AI/Generative AI applications.
  • Experience with modern web application testing and API testing.

Technical Skills

  • Strong expertise in Playwright automation.
  • Hands-on experience with API testing and automation.
  • Experience validating AI/LLM-based applications and AI agents.
  • Good understanding of AI evaluation methodologies and testing techniques.
  • Familiarity with:
    • M365 Copilot
    • OpenAI/Azure OpenAI
    • Claude
    • Gemini
    • Agentic AI frameworks
  • Knowledge of test management tools such as Azure DevOps (ADO), Jira, or similar platforms.
  • Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.

Preferred Skills

  • Exposure to Python or TypeScript for automation and AI testing.
  • Experience with AI evaluation frameworks such as:
    • RAG evaluation
    • Prompt evaluation
    • LLM benchmarking
    • Human feedback-based evaluation
  • Knowledge of Responsible AI principles, AI governance, and model risk management.
  • Experience testing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems and AI agents.

Education

Key Competencies

  • Strong communication and stakeholder management
  • Quality-first mindset
  • Continuous learning and innovation

  • Attention to detail
  • Adaptability to emerging AI technologies

The Canon Alliance Vice President plays a critical role in shaping and advancing HP's strategic partnership with Canon, evolving our business model, improving efficiency, optimizing costs, and ensuring operational excellence. title: Kokki, Rosso Porvoo / Kock, Rosso Borgå
description:
Primary location:
PORVOO

KOKKI PORVOON ROSSOON, 30 H/ VK, VAKITUINEN TYÖSUHDE

Etsimme kokkia Porvoon Rossoon vakituiseen työsuhteeseen. Rosson monipuoliselta ruokalistalta löytyy herkullisia á la carte -annoksia, pastaruokia sekä suosittuja pizzoja, joten toivomme sinulla olevan jo kokemusta näiden valmistuksesta. Lisäksi työpäivään kuuluu esivalmisteluja, astiahuoltoa sekä varastojen hallintaa. Tehtävä sopii henkilölle, joka viihtyy vauhdikkaassa ympäristössä ja on halukas työskentelemään silloin kuin meillä parhaiten viihdytään, eli iltaisin ja viikonloppuisin.

Työskentelet pääasiassa Porvoon Rossossa, mutta pääset tarvittaessa tekemään vuoroja myös Porvoon Amarillossa. Amarillon monipuoliselta ruokalistalta löytyy herkullisia meksikolaisia annoksia, kuten tacoja ja burritoja sekä meheviä hampurilaisia.

Tervetuloa ihan tavallisiin töihin - harvinaisen maukkaiden tehtävien pariin.Tavallisuus ei toki tarkoita, että meillä olisi täällä jotenkin tylsää tai tylsää porukkaa töissä-päinvastoin!

Mitä toivomme sinulta?
- Kohtaat sekä asiakkaat että työkaverit sydän kohdallaan <3
- Kokemusta kokin työstä sekä à la carte -annosten ja pizzojen valmistuksesta.
- Reipasta ja oma-aloitteista työotetta: osaat tarttua tehtäviin ja pidät huolta työpisteestäsi.
- Työssä kävellään ja kannetaan paljon, joten hyvä fyysinen kunto on eduksi.
- Halua oppia uutta ja kehittyä osana tiimiä.
- Suomen kielen taitoa, sillä työskentelemme suomeksi.

Mitä ihan tavallinen työ meillä tarkoittaa?
- Työpaikan, johon kiva tulla ja myös kiva lähteä kotiin.
- Tiimiä, jossakaveria ei jätetäja jossa esihenkilöt ovat mukana arjen tekemisessä.
- Alennuksia S-ryhmän tuotteista ja palveluista eli esimerkiksi ruoasta, elektroniikasta, ravintoloista, hotelleista ja monesta muusta mukavasta asiasta.
- MaRa:ntyöehtosopimuksen mukaista palkkausta, joka on kokemusvuosista riippuen 13,32 €/h - 14,62 €/h + työaikalisät
- 5 % kielilisä, jos asiakaspalvelu onnistuu vähintään suomeksi ja ruotsiksi.
- Koko henkilökunnan yhteistä tulospalkkiota, jopa 1,70 € / tehty työtunti yrityksentuloksen ja toimialakohtaisten mittarienperusteella.
- Kulttuuri-, hyvinvointi- ja liikuntaetuja.

Jätä siis hakemuksesi, jos tykkäät ihan tavallisesta arjesta, vauhdikkaasta tekemisestä, hyvästä ruoasta ja poikkeuksellisen hyvistä työkavereista.

Etenemme rekrytoinnissa jo hakuaikana, joten jätä hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian, mutta viimeistään tiistaina 18.8.2026. Lisätietoja tehtävästä saat sähköpostitse osoitteesta vbo.rekry@sok.fi. Työsuhde alkaa sopimuksen mukaan.

***

KOCK TILL ROSSO I BORGÅ, 30 H/VECKA, FAST ANSTÄLLNING

Vi söker en kock till Rosso i Borgå för en fast anställning. På Rossos mångsidiga meny hittar du läckra á la carte-rätter, pastarätter och populära pizzor, så vi önskar att du redan har erfarenhet av att tillreda dessa. Dessutom hör förberedelser, diskunderhåll och lagerhantering till din arbetsdag. Jobbet passar dig som trivs i en fartfylld miljö och vill arbeta när vi har som mest liv och rörelse, alltså kvällar och helger.

Du arbetar huvudsakligen på Rosso i Borgå, men vid behov kan du också ta arbetspass på Amarillo i Borgå. På Amarillos mångsidiga meny finns läckra mexikanska rätter såsom tacos och burritos samt saftiga hamburgare.

Välkommen till ett helt vanligt jobb - med ovanligt välsmakande uppgifter.Vanlighet betyder förstås inte att vi skulle ha det tråkigt eller att vi skulle vara ett tråkigt gäng - tvärtom!

Vad önskar vi av dig?
- Du möter både kunder och kollegor med hjärtat på rätt ställe. <3
- Erfarenhet av arbete som kock och tillredning av á la carte-rätter och pizza
- Du har ett raskt och självgående arbetssätt: du tar tag i uppgifter och håller ordning på din arbetsstation.
Arbetet innebär mycket gående och bärande, så god fysisk kondition är en fördel.
- Du har vilja att lära dig nytt och utvecklas som en del av teamet.
- Kunskaper i finska, eftersom finska är vårt arbetsspråk.

Vad innebär ett helt vanligt jobb hos oss?
- Ett jobb som får dig på gott humör både före och efter arbetsdagen.
- Ett team där man inte lämnar kollegorna i sticket och där cheferna jobbar sida vid sida med teamet.
