title: Designer, koneisto- ja putkistojärjestelmät
description:
Oletko sinä tiimimme seuraava huippuosaaja?

Haemme nyt koneisto-/putkistosuunnittelijaa konevarustelun osastolle!

Tule mukaan suunnittelemaan ja toteuttamaan maailman edistyksellisimpiä risteilyaluksia ja jätä kädenjälkesi laivanrakennuksen historiaan! Meyer Turku tarjoaa sinulle kannustavan työpaikan, jossa voit kehittyä ja tavoitella omannakoistasi tyouraa.

Mitä koneisto-/putkistosuunnittelijan tehtäviin kuuluu?

Koneisto-/putkistosuunnittelijana työskentelet osana valmistussuunnittelutiimiä, jossa vastaat laivan koneisto- ja putkistojärjestelmien valmistussuunnittelusta. Tehtävässäsi laadit tuotannon tarvitsemia suunnitelmia ja dokumentteja sekä varmistat omalta osaltasi suunnitteluaineiston laadun ja oikea-aikaisen valmistumisen.

Työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä perussuunnittelun, tuotannon sekä muiden sidosryhmien kanssa. Tehtävä tarjoaa mahdollisuuden päästä mukaan vaativiin laivanrakennusprojekteihin ja näkemään suunnittelutyön tulokset osana valmiita aluksia.

Tehtäviisi kuuluu muun muassa:

- koneisto- ja putkistoalueiden 3D-mallinnus ja suunnittelu CADMATIC-ohjelmistolla
- valmistussuunnitteluaineiston laatiminen tuotannon käyttöön
- esivalmistukseen ja asennukseen liittyvien dokumenttien tuottaminen
- suunnitelmien tarkentaminen ja päivittäminen projektin edetessä
- yhteistyö perussuunnittelun, tuotannon ja muiden suunnittelualojen kanssa
- oman vastuualueesi suunnittelutehtävien aikataulun ja laadun varmistaminen

Työssäsi edistät myös yhtiömme HSE-tavoitteita ja olet mukana rakentamassa turvallisempaa, terveellisempää ja ympäristöystävällisempää työympäristöä.

Mitä odotamme sinulta:

Tehtävään soveltuva tekninen koulutus (insinööri tai diplomi-insinööri) antaa hyvät valmiudet tehtävässä menestymiseen. Voit olla jo kokeneempi suunnittelija tai urasi alkuvaiheessa oleva tuleva ammattilainen.

Toivomme sinulta:

- soveltuvaa teknistä koulutusta (insinööri tai diplomi-insinööri) tai opintojen loppuvaiheessa olemista
- kiinnostusta tekniseen suunnittelutyöhön ja halua kehittää osaamistasi
- kokemusta suunnittelutehtävistä ja 3D-suunnittelujärjestelmistä (esim. CADMATIC tai CATIA)
- AutoCADin ja Microsoft 365 -ohjelmistojen tuntemusta
- hyviä yhteistyö- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja
- sujuvaa suomen kielen sekä riittävää englannin kielen taitoa

Arvostamme lisäksi oma-aloitteista työotetta, oppimishalukkuutta sekä kiinnostusta kehittää toimintatapoja yhdessä muun tiimin kanssa.

Kokemus laivanrakennuksesta katsotaan eduksi, mutta meillä kasvat laivanrakentajaksi kokeneiden osaajien opastuksessa.

Huomioithan, että edellytämme valitulta henkilöltä hyväksyttyä huumausainetestiä sekä terveystarkastuksessa todettua sopivuutta työsuhteen tehtäviin.

Miksi tulla meille töihin?

Pääset työskentelemään laivanrakennuksen huipulla. Maailman edistyksellisimmät risteilyalukset suunnitellaan ja rakennetaan Meyer Turun telakalla. Meidät tunnetaan huipputeknologisesta osaamisestamme, monialaisesta tuotannostamme sekä innovatiivisista ratkaisuistamme, jotka vievät koko laivanrakennusalaa eteenpäin. Tilauskantamme ulottuu pitkälle tulevaisuuteen. Vuonna 2025 liikevaihtomme oli 2,1 miljardia euroa ja työntekijöitä oli noin 2 300.

Olet osa huipputekijöiden porukkaa. Meillä on osaamista, jota ei löydy mistään muualta. Telakallamme on yli 450 ammattia, ja olemme kaikki laivanrakentajia – jokaisen työpanosta tarvitaan yhteisen päämäärän saavuttamiseen.

Saat myötätuulta urallesi. Kannustamme työntekijöitämme kehittymään, oppimaan uutta ja tarttumaan tilaisuuksiin. Mahdollistamme pitkät työurat: uusia, mielenkiintoisia työtehtäviä löytyy usein oman organisaatiomme sisältä.

Työsuhde-edut ovat kohdallaan. Telakan oma työterveysasema tarjoaa monipuolisia palveluja, apua ja tukea koko työurasi ajan. Vapaa-ajalla voit käydä Meyer Turun kuntosalilla, osallistua monipuolisten harrastusryhmiemme toimintaan tai käyttää liikunta- ja kulttuurietuja muihin harrastuksiisi.

Kysyttävää:

Pasi Salminen

Head of Department

+358 50 559 8389, arkipäivisin klo 12-16, ajalla 10.8.-14.8.2026.

Meyer Turku

Meyer Turku Oy rakentaa maailman uudenaikaisimpia ja energiatehokkaimpia risteilyaluksia, autolauttoja ja erikoisaluksia. Osuutemme maailman risteilyalustenrakennusmarkkinoista on yli 10 prosenttia. Suurimpia asiakkaitamme ovat Royal Caribbean ja Rajavartiolaitos.

Meyer Turku Oy työllistää yli 2 000 huippuammattilaista Turun telakalla, jossa on rakennettu laivoja vuodesta 1737 alkaen. Meyer Turku Oy:n tytäryhtiöitä ovat Piikkiössä sijaitseva hyttitehdas Piikkio Works Oy, kokonaistoimituksia laivojen yleisiin tiloihin tarjoava Shipbuilding Completion Oy sekä Raumalla sijaitseva laivanrakennus- ja offshore-alan suunnitteluyritys ENGnD Oy.

Pyrimme jatkuvasti kestävämpään laivanrakentamiseen. Olemme tunnistaneet viisi YK:n Agenda 2030 -tavoitetta, joihin pystymme toiminnassamme ja yhteistyössämme kumppaneiden ja asiakkaiden kanssa erityisesti vaikuttamaan.

title: Junior Developer
description:

Here at BNZ, it's about more than just banking. We work together in an agile, energising environment to create innovative solutions through our promise "If you can imagine a better future, let's find a way."

We support wellbeing, flexible working and have a generous leave offering. There is the opportunity for growth, learning and career development. No two days are the same.

Ko mātou tēnei | This is Us

We have an exciting opportunity for a Junior Developer in our Digital Channels domain. As a Junior Developer, you’ll help drive change in digital banking across Aotearoa New Zealand, with great benefits and a supportive environment where your contribution is valued.

Digital Channels builds and supports BNZ’s Internet Banking customer channels. We’re modernising our technology stack by modularising our front-end banking applications and moving toward a micro front-end architecture.

Ninja Turtles is the platform team for our Internet Banking development community. The team evolves and maintains the Internet Banking Shell that brings our micro front ends together, helping our talented teams deliver high-quality features for customers.

This is a great opportunity for a junior front-end developer to join a highly influential team in our Internet Banking community and learn from some of our most experienced and respected Senior Developers.

Mō te Tūranga | About the tūranga

We sat down with the Engineering Lead (Who you’ll report to), and they told us the following about the role:

This is a permanent, full-time opportunity based in Wellington. This is a hybrid position with three days in the office and two days where you can work flexibly.

What are 5 day to day tasks the person in this role will complete?

  • Design, build and support robust, scalable solutions across the Internet Banking platform and related services.
  • Support platform stability through BAU support, production issue analysis, incident resolution and root cause remediation.
  • Contribute to technical design and the long-term maintainability of platform components.
  • Improve reliability, performance, deployment quality, monitoring and supportability through continuous improvement practices.
  • Collaborate through code reviews, pair programming, feedback and knowledge sharing.
  • Keep system, support and architecture documentation accurate, current and accessible.

What is the team culture and environment like?

The team is collaborative, supportive and delivery focused. We value practical problem solving, ownership, knowledge sharing and strong partnerships with other development teams to deliver great features and outcomes for customers.

What skills and experience are required for this role?

  • 2 Years practical experience in development and maintenance of technology applications.
  • Front-end development experience / exposure to delivering enterprise applications.
  • Practical experience with REACT, Node.js, JavaScript, TypeScript
  • Exposure to unit testing frameworks such as Jest and Cypress.
  • Exposure to building and deploying code via Ci/CD pipeline such as Jenkins.
  • Ability to communicate ideas and designs clearly and concisely.
  • Exposure to Cloud platforms such as AWS and Azure.

What attributes will this person display to be successful in this role?

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across technology teams and business stakeholders.
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment, adapting to changing priorities and business needs.
  • Takes ownership of complex technical issues, driving them through to resolution.
  • Demonstrates strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with a focus on delivering practical outcomes.
  • Proactive in providing operational support and identifying opportunities for continuous improvement.
  • Committed to quality, system resilience, and operational excellence.
  • Passionate about delivering reliable solutions that support both colleagues and customers.

Please Note: Applications for this vacancy close on Friday 21 August 2026. We review applications as they are received and may close advertising early.

This is an exciting opportunity to join us! We're bold thinkers who are taking brave steps to create a company that people want to work for, and customers want to bank with. At PNC, our people are our greatest differentiator and competitive advantage in the markets we serve. We are all united in delivering the best experience for our customers. title: Senior Data Architect – Agentic AI Solutions
description:
Senior Data Architect – Agentic AI Solutions

Description -

We're looking for a Data Architect who has spent their career deep in data and analytics, and is now hands-on with the latest AI technology stacks — someone who can architect AI-ready data for agentic workflows, not just talk about it. This is an individual contributor role on the technical career path, but at this level, that means leading from the front: owning technical direction across workstreams, driving deliverables with cross-functional teams, and bringing clarity to ambiguous, high-stakes architectural problems. You'll interact regularly with technical teams, business partners, and executives across HP's business units, working on the next phase of agentic AI for the enterprise alongside our frontier technology partners. This isn't an advisory or PowerPoint role — you'll be building, not just designing.

What You'll Do

  • Architect AI-ready data foundations, including the semantic and context layers that make enterprise data usable by LLMs and agentic workflows.

  • Lead technical workstreams end-to-end — setting direction, aligning teams, and owning clearly defined deliverables.

  • Partner directly with frontier AI vendors and internal stakeholders to prototype, validate, and scale new architectural patterns.

  • Shape enterprise data strategy and platform architecture, spanning data warehousing, modeling, and governance.

  • Build hands-on solutions using LLMs — not just evaluate or recommend them.

  • Engage confidently with business and executive stakeholders across HP's business units, translating complex architecture into business context and vice versa.


What You'll Bring

  • 10+ years designing and delivering enterprise data warehousing solutions, with deep expertise in data modeling, data engineering and enterprise data architecture — Data & Analytics should be the throughline of your career, not a chapter in it.

  • Four-year or Graduate Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or any other related discipline or commensurate work experience or demonstrated competence.

  • Proven track record defining data strategy and platform architecture within a large, complex enterprise.

  • Broad enterprise knowledge spanning multiple business domains (Supply Chain, Finance, Sales, Customer, etc.) and data subjects — you understand data beyond the technical layer and can connect architecture to business outcomes.

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with modern AI architecture, including building real, production-grade solutions using LLMs and applied AI solution design — pilots and proof-of-concepts alone don't meet this bar.

  • Hands-on experience with Databricks and Microsoft Fabric is strongly preferred; familiarity with the broader Azure and AWS data ecosystem is expected.

  • Comfort working across multiple technologies and platforms, with a clear, demonstrable habit of continuously learning as the landscape shifts.

  • Strong communication and influencing skills — equally effective shaping strategy with senior leadership and rolling up your sleeves on the architecture itself.


About the Team


The Enterprise Data & Analytics (EDA) organization is HP's central team for corporate data — covering Data Architecture, Data Strategy, Data Engineering, Data Platforms and Analytics for initiatives that span the entire company. As a Principal Architect on this team, you'll work directly with technical and business teams across HP's business units, and have a real seat at the table in shaping HP's data and AI strategy.

Why This Role

You'll be working on problems that don't have established playbooks yet, alongside some of the top technology companies in the world who HP has partnered with at the frontier of AI. If you've spent your career in data and you're ready to apply that depth to where enterprise AI is actually heading, this is the role.

Additional commission opportunities for someone with an industry recognized and HealthFitness approved Personal Trainer certification. The final wage offer will be determined based on factors such as location, qualifications, experience, skill set, and other relevant factors. We understand that compensation is an important factor when considering a new opportunity, and we strive to provide a competitive wage within the market.

description:
Under general supervision, the 1404 Clerk performs general clerical work. This is the journey-level position in the Clerk series.

Examples of Important and Essential Duties:

According to Civil Service Commission Rule 109, the duties specified below are representative of the range of duties assigned to this job code/class and are not intended to be an inclusive list.

1. Files, maintains and retrieves documents, records and correspondence in accordance with established procedures.

2. Codes and indexes documents, records and correspondence. Methods may include color code, terminal digit, numerical, alphabetical and/or chronological order to ensure proper filing and ready access of data.

3. Checks and reviews a variety of documents for completeness and accuracy.

4. Compiles information and data necessary for the preparation of various departmental reports in which judgment may be exercised in the selection of data and materials.

5. Prepares and maintains a variety of reports in which judgment may be exercised in the selection of data and materials.

6. Makes mathematical computations using addition, subtraction, multiplication and division of whole numbers, decimals and fractions.

7. Receives and accounts for moderate amounts of money from the collection of fees and similar sources.

8. Disseminates information and answers inquiries by communicating with the public, departmental personnel and other departments.

9. Operates office equipment, including calculators, photocopying equipment, adding machines, computer terminals, document imaging, fax machines and postage meters.

10. Processes mail: opens, time stamps, sorts and distributes the incoming mail; stuffs and seals envelopes; makes daily pickup and delivery to ensure timely mailing and receipt of mail.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

Applicants must meet the minimum qualifications requirement by the final filing date unless otherwise noted.

  1. Current Category 16, 17, or 18 Exempt Employee in Class 1404 who has worked at least 2,080 hours in class 1404; AND
  2. Experience:
    One (1) year of clerical experience including preparing and maintaining a variety of records and/or documents, filing, use of office equipment, public contact and processing of incoming and outgoing mail.

    Substitution:
    Any one of the following may substitute for six (6) months of the required experience:
  • Completion of a clerical training program (240 hours); OR
  • 15 semester units (or equivalent quarter units) of coursework from an accredited college or university; OR
  • Completion of an approved City and County of San Francisco Clerical Administrative training program (as designated on the job announcement).

Note: Employee must have served continuously (with no break in service) in Class 1404 in Category 16, 17, or 18 exempt status the equivalent of at least one (1) year (2,080 hours).

title: Customs Compliance Specialist
description:
Who We Are:

Since 1906, New Balance has empowered people through sport and craftsmanship to create positive change in communities around the world. We innovate fearlessly, guided by our core values and driven by the belief that conventions were meant to be challenged. We foster a culture in which every associate feels welcomed and respected, where leaders and creatives are inspired to shape the world of tomorrow by taking bold action today.

JOB MISSION:

The Customs Compliance Specialist supports U.S. and global import and export activities by ensuring compliance with U.S. and international trade laws, Customs regulations, and internal company policies. This role partners with brokers, logistics providers, and internal business teams to facilitate timely and compliant cross-border shipments, while mitigating risks and supporting operational efficiency.

MAJOR ACCOUNTABILITIES:

  • Ensure adherence to U.S. and international Customs regulations, including HTS classification, valuation, and country of origin requirements.

  • Monitor and audit import/export transactions, including HTS classification, to confirm accuracy and compliance with Customs laws and company standards.

  • Collaborate with Customs brokers, freight forwarders, internal stakeholders and logistics teams to ensure timely and compliant clearance of goods.

  • Respond to inquiries from Customs authorities, brokers, and internal stakeholders regarding trade compliance issues.

  • Maintain and organize all documentation required for Customs entry and recordkeeping in compliance with statutory retention requirements.

  • Support corrective actions for compliance risks, post-entry amendments, and government inquiries or audits. Notify manager of repetitive issues or non-compliances to prevent future instances and determine best practices.

  • Assist in the development, maintenance, and communication of Customs compliance procedures and training.

  • Partner with internal teams to implement process improvements that enhance compliance and efficiency. Determine areas of improvement needed and provide manager with ways to improve process flows.

  • Call out system issues or inconsistencies, copy manager.

  • Other duties as assigned and needed due to regulatory trade changes and team coverage. Duties may shift as Trade Team priorities shift, need for flexibility and team mentality.

REQUIREMENTS FOR SUCCESS

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in International Business, Supply Chain, Logistics, or related field; or equivalent experience.

  • Experience: 5+ years of experience in Customs compliance, trade compliance, or import/export operations preferred.

  • Licensed Customs Broker and/or Certified Customs Specialist strongly preferred.

  • Strong understanding of U.S. and international Customs regulations, HTS classification, valuation, and free trade agreements.

  • Footwear/apparel classification experience beneficial.

  • Demonstrated ability to work with Customs brokers, freight forwarders, and regulatory agencies including partner government agencies such as CPSC, USDA. Ability to review AD/CVD scope language and determine applicability.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word and Excel), email, and familiarity with trade compliance (e.g. ACE) and business systems (e.g Order Management, ERP, PLM- Flex).

  • Demonstrated ability to read, write and speak English fluently; ability to match numbers/letters.

  • Strong verbal and written skills utilizing appropriate demeanor, proper grammar/spelling, and respectful tone to communicate clearly and effectively; professional phone/Microsoft Teams on-camera demeanor.

  • Intermediate computer skills in Microsoft Office (Word and Excel), WMS and email.

  • Strong organizational, communication and interpersonal skills; detail oriented.

  • Attention to detail, learning mind-set and collaborative mindset/working style. Ability to learn and retain processes and procedures in a changing environment.

title: Senior Fellow & Co-Coordinator
description:
[What the role is]

The Climate Change in Southeast Asia Programme (CCSEAP) at the ISEAS-Yusof Ishak Institute was established in 2020 to examine the phenomenon of climate change, its impact, and policy responses across the region. Building on ISEAS’ thought leadership, the programme seeks to advance climate discourse and knowledge in Southeast Asia through research, policy papers, publications, seminars and workshops. Applications are invited for:

Senior Fellow (Energy/Climate) & Co-Coordinator, CCSEAP (2-year contract)

[What you will be working on]

The Senior Fellow’s primary focus of research is on Southeast Asia’s energy transitions in the context of a green recovery and the nexus between energy and climate. The Senior Fellow will examine the political, economic, social, technological and/or policy implications of these interactions in the context of planned energy transitions in the region. Country expertise and focus on selected Southeast Asian countries will be an advantage.

As Co-Coordinator, the candidate is also expected to bring a broader view across the programme’s wider climate agenda — including climate diplomacy, ASEAN climate governance, and adaptation — sufficient to help set direction for the programme, and not solely their own individual research project. Secondary research focus may be on, but is not limited to, carbon pricing, carbon markets, labour transition issues, green technology or sustainable finance.

Job Responsibilities

  • Conduct research and provide analysis, and co-lead the programme’s overall research agenda and strategic priorities together with the Coordinator, including the allocation of work among researchers and Research Officers

  • Contribute regularly to ISEAS’ research products such as Fulcrum commentary, ISEAS Perspective, and Trends in Southeast Asia;

  • Take primary responsibility for specific external grants, including donor reporting, budget tracking, and management of stakeholder expectations;

  • Co-lead the conceptualisation, execution and analysis of the Southeast Asia Climate Outlook Survey;

  • Build and maintain the programme's external network — including with the ASEAN Secretariat, regional think-tank networks, multilateral bodies, government counterparts and donors — representing the programme externally and deputising for the Coordinator when required

  • Plan, organise and take lead responsibility for seminars, workshops and outreach activities in accordance with the Institute’s mission;

  • Supervise and mentor junior researchers, Research Officers and interns within the programme;

  • Identify and help cultivate new funding opportunities and donor relationships for the programme;

  • Contribute to the programme’s multi-year strategic planning in alignment with ISEAS’ institutional priorities;

  • Serve as an internal reviewer/editor for Programme publications to help maintain quality and consistency

[What we are looking for]

Job Requirements

  • A PhD degree in Climate Science, Climate Policy, Environmental Policy, Energy, Public Policy, International Relations, or a related discipline;

  • At least 8–15 years of relevant research and/or policy experience, including demonstrated experience in programme or project management, team leadership, or grant/fund management;

  • A strong, established track record of publications and thought leadership in the climate–energy nexus (peer-reviewed and policy outputs, media presence, invited talks);

  • Demonstrated experience managing budgets, donor relationships, or research teams;

  • An existing network within the regional and/or international climate-energy policy community (e.g. ASEAN bodies, multilateral institutions, donor agencies) will be an advantage;

  • Strong interdisciplinary orientation and interest in the nexus between climate change and energy;

  • Excellent communication and writing skills in English; working knowledge of other Southeast Asian languages will be an advantage;

  • Awareness of regional and global developments, and ability to contribute to the strategic and policy-oriented direction of research projects aligned with ISEAS's mandate.

  • Ability to lead and manage research projects, including planning, resource management and securing research funding.

  • Team player with strong leadership, mentoring, interpersonal and networking skills, and diplomatic skill in managing stakeholders and donors;

  • Willingness to be based full-time in Singapore for the duration of the appointment.

Applications should include a cover letter, a full CV, three referee contacts (including at least one who can speak to the candidate’s managerial or leadership experience), a strong research proposal on energy transitions in Southeast Asia of not more than five pages (double spaced), a one-page statement of vision for the programme’s strategic priorities and stakeholder/donor management over the appointment period, and a writing sample of a commentary nature.

The research proposal should discuss the topic to be examined, plans for any fieldwork and duration, projected timeline of research, and output.

Opportunities for renewal will be considered, subject to performance and funding.

Remuneration and benefits will depend on the candidate’s qualifications and experience.

title: Trust Real Estate Department Lead
description:
Position Overview

At PNC, our people are our greatest differentiator and competitive advantage in the markets we serve. We are all united in delivering the best experience for our customers. We work together each day to foster an inclusive workplace culture where all of our employees feel respected, valued and have an opportunity to contribute to the company’s success. As a Trust Real Estate Department Lead within PNC's Asset Management Group organization, you will be based Pittsburgh, PA or Cleveland, OH.

As a Trust Real Estate Department Lead, you will have the following responsibilities:

• Oversee workflow and assist team with executing transactions and processes.
• Monitor and coordinate the operations workflow and assist team members with escalated issues. May process and/or reconcile transactions of varying risk and financial value in accordance with established policies and procedures. Identify and address exceptions and serve as a point of escalation. Partner internally to resolve escalations and provide guidance. May interact with external customers and third parties in completing transactions or resolving escalated issues.
• Coach team members and provide applicable training. May lead team huddles/meetings and/or continuous improvement sessions. May provide input on team member performance and development.
• Provide consultation and advice to internal and external customers. Review existing processes, recommend improvements and may assist with implementation. Provide input and may update standard operating procedures. Participate in and may serve as a subject matter resource for projects.
• Review transactions and related documents and verify work processes to ensure completeness, accuracy, and conformance to established service levels and applicable procedures. May review reports to identify exceptions, monitor quality and ensure compliance. May participate in risk mitigation activities. Verifies the completeness and accuracy of procedures.

Preferred experience/skills include:

• Management/leadership experience
• Knowledge of fiduciary practices including trust real estate
• CPM, CCIM, CTFA, Trust SchoolPNC is an in-office company that fosters a supportive culture where employees can thrive and achieve balance. We encourage candidates to connect with their recruiter and hiring manager to understand workplace expectations and ensure the role aligns with their goals.PNC will not provide sponsorship for employment visas or participate in STEM OPT for this position.

Job Description

  • Acts as subject matter expert to oversee all assigned trust owned real estate assets which may include highly complex residential, rental, commercial, farmland and timber properties as well as oil, gas and mineral interests. Accountable for identifying, mitigating and escalating risk while acquiring, preserving and managing these properties.
  • Complies with the banks policies and procedures for consistent management of real estate activities in alignment with the banks fiduciary policies and procedures, to include such activities as: real estate purchases, sales, leases, negotiations, general property management, safekeeping, disposition/productivity analysis, bill payments, tax and insurance enforcement and the hiring of contractors and agents.
  • Collaborates as the subject matter expert with AMG Fiduciary Counsel and Market Fiduciary Advisors and Managers as necessary to ensure risks are appropriately analyzed, managed, escalated and resolved.
  • Accountable for assessing risk and making recommendations to accept, retain or sell assets. Oversees annual reviews. Presents recommendations to Real Estate Trust Investment Committee and/or Special Assets Committee, according to committee guidelines.
  • Preserves and manages assigned physical properties. Makes recommendations for property improvements based on need. Coordinates the hiring of professionals as needed for maintenance and upkeep of the property. Ensures all properties are adequately inspected, valued and insured; ensures all taxes, insurance premiums and property related expenses are timely paid and kept current.
  • Guides all activities necessary to purchase or sell a property. Determines if capital improvements are necessary. Assesses risk of transaction. Presents recommendations to Real Estate Trust Investment Committee or and/or Special Assets Committee. Engages with internal partners and external service providers to ensure a smooth and accurate transfer of ownership.

PNC Employees take pride in our reputation and to continue building upon that we expect our employees to be:

  • Customer Focused - Knowledgeable of the values and practices that align customer needs and satisfaction as primary considerations in all business decisions and able to leverage that information in creating customized customer solutions.
  • Managing Risk - Assessing and effectively managing all of the risks associated with their business objectives and activities to ensure they adhere to and support PNC's Enterprise Risk Management Framework.

Qualifications

Successful candidates must demonstrate appropriate knowledge, skills, and abilities for a role. Listed below are skills, competencies, work experience, education, and required certifications/licensures needed to be successful in this position.

Competencies

Contracts Review, Decision Making and Critical Thinking, Effective Communications, Fiduciary Responsibilities, Lease and Property Management - Real Estate, Real Estate Development, Real Estate Law & Policy Compliance, Real Estate Property Data Analysis, Real Estate Sales Closings and Agreements

title: Associate Chemist - PFAS Prep - 2nd Shift, Tues-Sat
description:

The Associate Chemist prepares and analyzes environmental samples using standard analytical techniques according to approved scientific methodology in compliance with Eurofins Environment Testing Quality Assurance programs and standard operating procedures (SOPs).     • Preparation of samples using standard techniques

    • Performing routine instrument maintenance

  • HRMS sample preparation
  • Gas Chromatography
  • Liquid Chromatography
  • Mass Spectrometry

This position is 2nd shift, Tues-Sat, 3pm -1130pm. Training will be M-F 7am-3:30pm.

Ideal Candidates will have:

  • Previous experience with PFAS and/or LC/MS and/or sample preparation

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to convey information clearly and professionally.
  • Able to interpret written materials and communicate findings effectively.
  • Demonstrated ability to identify issues, analyze root causes, and propose practical solutions.
  • Applies critical thinking to evaluate options and make decisions.
  • Effective collaboration skills to contribute to team goals and support department productivity goals
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage priorities and meet deadlines.
  • Effectively balances multiple tasks while maintaining accuracy.
  • Comfortable using mathematical formulas and tools to perform calculations and analyze data.
  • Consistently delivers high-quality work within established timelines and specifications.
  • Able to work independently, following written or verbal instructions with minimal oversight.
  • Strong interpersonal skills; able to coordinate tasks and communicate effectively both verbally and in writing.

title: Mobile Service Technician - Lead
description:
FleetPride is the largest after-market distributor of heavy-duty truck and trailer parts in the U.S. with some of the best and brightest people in the business! Partner with the best in the heavy-duty industry and apply today!

GENERAL JOB DESCRIPTION

The Mobile Technician III is expected to have mastered all aspects of Preventative Maintenance on all vehicle systems with the ability to train and develop other Technicians. Will perform all major and advanced adjustments, repairs, and component replacements. Perform advanced diagnostic operations in order to successfully diagnose vehicle system failures and suggest accurate system repairs. This technician will also work in the shop between service calls. They may also be asked to participate in the after-hour on-call rotation for the location, if needed.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Examine vehicles to determine the extent of damage or malfunction(s).
  • Provide customers with preventative maintenance solutions, whenever appropriate.
  • Maintain 80% productivity
  • Examine vehicles to determine extent of damage or malfunction(s)
  • Train new service shop employees on company procedures regarding vehicle repairs.
  • Inspect orders for completion and quality before presentation or delivery to customers.
  • Perform inspections and preventative maintenance of vehicles and equipment.
  • Perform routine and scheduled maintenance services such as oil changes, lubrications and filter replacements.
  • Repair, reline, replace, and adjust brakes (air, hydraulic, electric and brake accessories).
  • Test drive vehicles and test components using proper equipment.
  • Troubleshoot and repair suspension systems including leaf and coil spring systems, and Hendrickson walking beam type suspension systems.
  • Troubleshoot and repair electrical systems, exhaust systems, steering systems, air conditioning, PTO”S and custom exhaust systems.
  • Adjust, remove and replace clutches and drivelines.
  • Overhaul, troubleshoot and repair diesel and gasoline engines.
  • Troubleshoot and repair fuel tanks, fifth wheels, trailer hitches, pintle hooks, auxiliary axles and frames.
  • Perform tandem alignment, front axle king pin and bushing repairs.
  • Perform basic aluminum and steel wire welding.
  • Review service story provided by service writers and determine tasks that need to be accomplished in order for the order to be completed in a timely manner.
  • File, grind, sand and smooth filled or repaired surfaces, using power tools and hand tools.

description:
Overview

The GitHub Copilot Science team under CoreAI at Microsoft India Development Center (IDC) is looking for a data-driven product manager to help define, measure, and ship AI-powered coding experiences for developers. Our division's mission is to empower builders and their teams to achieve more.

Qualifications

  • 6+ years of product management experience shipping enterprise or consumer products in the software industry. Experience building large-scale AI/ML products/services is preferred.

description:
Position Overview

At PNC, our people are our greatest differentiator and competitive advantage in the markets we serve. We are all united in delivering the best experience for our customers. We work together each day to foster an inclusive workplace culture where all of our employees feel respected, valued and have an opportunity to contribute to the company’s success. As a Production Quality Analyst, within PNC’s Dealer Floorplan Operations organization, you will be based in Pittsburgh, PA

In this role, you will be expected to work Monday - Friday, 8:00 am EST - 4:30 pm EST.

As a Production Quality Analyst, you will be conducting Quality Control for two areas of the Dealer Floorplan team. Part of this will be conducting due diligence for the loan servicing side or maintenance request side in DFP. For loan servicing requests, these typically deal with monetary transactions, whereas maintenance requests can consist of a variety of transactions such as adding a checking account onto record for WI. WI is the third-party loan tracking system that also tracks disbursement of funds for DFP.

The different portfolios of dealers you will be expected to deal with consist of Commercial and Auto. Commercial is typically heavy equipment, and Auto is typically the inventory that is at auto dealerships. Funding requests are often subject to same-day SLAs, consisting of anything received before 1:30 pm EST for Commercial and 2:30 pm EST for Auto. The system cutoff for WI is 5:30 pm EST, and work can be submitted in WI up until this time.

In this role, if any errors are found, you will send the request back to the appropriate entity that submitted the request for correction. For requests indicating that payment be made via wire, another system, PSUI, is used to complete the monetary transaction. If no errors are found for wire requests that are submitted, you will submit funds for release so that funds can be disbursed to customers within the Commercial or Auto portfolio.

In addition to your quality control and production responsibilities, you will serve as a key resource for the Dealer Floorplan team by supporting new dealer onboarding activities, assisting with escalations, and helping answer questions from team members, particularly in the absence of a Team Lead or Manager. You will be relied upon to support special projects and complete work outside of standard production activities.

You will work closely with leadership to provide insight into ongoing issues, trends, and escalations, helping to identify root causes and support process improvements.
Your expertise and knowledge of the business will be leveraged to assist leadership in evaluating challenges and developing solutions while ensuring day-to-day production objectives continue to be met.

You can expect to have a touch base with your supervisor in the morning to get a general idea of what will be assigned for the day and to discuss anything from the day prior. title: Lead Security Architect-Cloud Migration
description:
What success looks like in this role:

Lead Security Architect – Federal Government Cloud Migration Programme

Location: Australia (Customer Site) – Canberra, onsite

Security Clearance: NV1 Security Clearance (Mandatory)

Role Purpose

The Lead Security Architect owns the security architecture for a wave-based application migration and modernisation programme delivered into a highly secure federal government environment, working alongside the Project Delivery Lead, who holds ultimate ownership of the programme overall, and the Lead Cloud Migration Architect, who owns the technical outcome across application, infrastructure and cloud, data, and business architecture.

This role ensures the migration approach, target architecture, and tooling/AI usage align with the customer's security policies and procedures and with the Australian Government's security and AI governance frameworks, including the Information Security Manual (ISM), the Protective Security Policy Framework (PSPF), the Essential Eight, and IRAP assurance practices. The Lead Security Architect engages closely with the customer's cybersecurity leadership and architecture teams, represents Unisys in the customer's security governance forums, and acts as the programme's security subject matter expert, providing expertise into the assessment, strategy, migration planning, and architecture functions.

Essential Skills, Knowledge and Experience

Professional Experience

  • Extensive years of experience in security architecture, cybersecurity consulting, or security engineering, with demonstrated depth and breadth across cloud, infrastructure, identity, network, and endpoint security.

  • Proven experience delivering security architecture for complex, large-scale application migration programmes to Azure and AWS target clouds.

  • Experience working within government or other highly regulated environments, including experience supporting Australian Government

  • Experience conducting security assessments, architecture reviews, and remediation planning, and supporting projects through design, implementation, and operational transition.

  • Track record of owning the security architecture outcome of a customer-facing programme alongside a delivery lead and a technical/enterprise architecture lead, with a clear division of accountability between the three.

Technical Knowledge

  • Strong understanding of the Information Security Manual (ISM), the Protective Security Policy Framework (PSPF), the Essential Eight, and security assurance practices, including IRAP.

  • Practical knowledge of cloud platforms (Azure and AWS), infrastructure, networking, endpoint security, and identity technologies, including modern authentication and privileged access management.

  • Working knowledge of Australian Government AI governance, including the Policy for the Responsible Use of AI in Government, its AI Impact Assessment Tool, the National AI Centre's Guidance for AI Adoption, and the National AI Plan for the Australian Public Service, sufficient to assess proposed AI tooling for a federal government customer.

  • Familiarity with the Commonwealth Procurement Rules (CPRs), the Privacy Act 1988, and the Public Governance, Performance and Accountability Act 2013 (PGPA) as they bear on security and data-handling obligations.

Leadership and Stakeholder Skills

  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills across business, technical, and executive audiences, including CISOs and governance boards.

  • Ability to lead and develop a team of security architects while remaining hands-on with technical detail.

  • Strong judgement in balancing security risk, delivery pace, and innovation, particularly when assessing new tooling or AI capability for a security-conscious customer.

You will be successful in this role if you have:

  • Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

  • NV1 Security Clearance (Mandatory).

title: Knock, 글로벌 이커머스 채널 MD
description:
About

2018년 설립된 비나우는 스킨케어 브랜드 넘버즈인(numbuzin), 메이크업 브랜드 퓌(fwee), 바디케어 브랜드 노크(Knock,)를 운영하는 글로벌 뷰티 기업입니다.

비나우는 ‘Global No.1 Beauty Company’라는 비전 아래 다양한 카테고리의 신규 브랜드를 지속적으로 선보이며 성장하고 있습니다. 현재 전 세계 약 14개국에 제품을 수출하고 있으며 차별화된 제품력과 브랜드 경쟁력을 바탕으로 글로벌 시장에서 빠르게 입지를 확대하고 있습니다.

특히 브랜드 런칭 6년 만에 외부 투자 없이 2025년 연매출 3,250억 원을 달성하며 업계의 주목을 받고 있습니다. 또한 2027~2028년 IPO를 준비하고 있으며 장기적으로는 연매출 1조 원 규모의 종합 뷰티 기업으로 도약하는 것을 목표로 하고 있습니다.

비나우는 회사의 성장이 곧 구성원의 성장에서 시작된다고 믿습니다.
업계 최고 수준의 보상과 성장 기회를 제공하며 구성원들이 자신의 잠재력을 마음껏 발휘할 수 있는 환경을 만들어가고 있습니다. 글로벌 No.1 뷰티 컴퍼니를 향한 도전적인 여정에 함께하며 새로운 역사를 만들어갈 인재를 기다립니다.

About Knock, 채널 파트 ​ ​
BENOW, 그리고 ​우리가 하는 일

K-뷰티의 ​대세감 속에서도, ​글로벌 ​바디 카테고리의 ​성공은 ​
그동안 ​그 누구도 완벽히 ​증명해 ​내지 못했던 도전적인 ​영역입니다.

우리는 ​타인이 ​정해둔 카테고리의 한계를 ​넘어,
글로벌 ​전역의 ​바디 루틴을 ​새롭게 정의하기 ​위해 ​
북미 시장을 시작으로 ​원대한 여정을 ​문을 열고자 합니다.

이제는 단순한 상품 입점을 넘어, 브랜드의 성장을 견인할 최전선의 접점으로서
'북미 이커머스 채널(아마존, 자사몰)의 초기 세팅과 고도화된 채널 전략'이 필요한 시점입니다.

글로벌 시장의 최전선에서 브랜드의 무대를 넓히고,
독보적인 가시적 성과를 직접 만들어갈 실무 전문가를 기다립니다.

Responsibilities

• 북미 온라인 채널 세팅: 브랜드 노크의 북미 온라인 판매 채널(아마존, 자사몰) 초기 구축 및 채널별 성장 전략 수립
• 채널별 운영 전략 실행: 가격, 프로모션, 광고, 제품 등 채널 특성에 맞춘 최적화된 전략 수립 및 실행
• 데이터 기반 지표 관리: 매출, 광고 효율, 재고, 고객 지표 등의 데이터 분석 및 성과 개선
• 글로벌 시장 리서치: 타겟 국가 관점의 시장·경쟁사·채널 트렌드 분석 및 가시적 성장 기회 발굴

Requirements

• 글로벌 이커머스 채널 MD로 실무 2년 이상의 경력을 보유하신 분
• 비즈니스 영어 커뮤니케이션에 능통하신 분 (Fluent 이상)
• 타겟군에 맞는 프로모션, 제품 전략을 수립하고 실행하며 실제 운영 성과를 만들어본 경험이 있으신 분
• 트렌드에 민감하며, 경쟁 브랜드의 프로모션을 빠르게 분석하고 벤치마킹할 수 있으신 분

Preferred

• 북미 국가 유학 또는 거주 경험
• 특정 채널 운영을 END TO END로 리딩해 본 경험
• 화장품 및 글로벌 트렌드에 대한 높은 관심도

Benefits

• 연 2회 성과급 지급 (월 급여 기준 600%~800%)
• 식비 지원
• 제품 할인 및 신제품 증정 (자사 제품 50% 할인)
• 연계 휴양 시설 지원
• 경조사 지원
• 생일 오후 반차
• 건강 지원
• 교육비 지원
• 팀별 운영비 지급
• 기념일 선물 지급
• 주택 자금 지원

title: Kaitaupua | Mauri Ora Coordinator
description:
• Have you got a strong commitment to patient service, confidentiality, and accuracy?

  • Are you confident supporting clinicians with the practical workflow of a busy practice?

  • Do you want to develop your medical reception skills in a supportive, professional, and student-centred environment?

Kōrero mō te tūranga - About the role

Te Herenga Waka - Victoria University of Wellington is currently recruiting for a Kaitaupua - Mauri Ora Coordinator to join the Support Team on a permanent, full-time basis.

This is a busy medical receptionist role within the University’s Student Health and Student Counselling services. The role is often the first point of contact for students and is central to creating a calm, welcoming, professional, and efficient experience for patients accessing healthcare and counselling support.

Key responsibilities:

  • Provide front-line medical reception, welcoming and assisting students in a friendly, professional, and confidential manner, both in person and over the phone.
  • Schedule appointments, manage patient enquiries, support the appointment system, and help maintain smooth day-to-day reception flow.
  • Gather, process, and update student information accurately, maintaining medical records, registrations, correspondence, scanning, filing, and other documentation to a high standard.
  • Undertake financial administration associated with student appointments, including payments, invoicing, receipts, remittances, account transactions, and other practice billing processes.
  • Support clinicians and the wider team with day-to-day administrative workflow, maintain an organised reception environment.

Ō pūmanawa - About you

You will:

  • Bring a strong customer service mindset, sound administrative skills, and ideally substantial experience in medical reception or a similar health, counselling, or front-line service environment.
  • Be confident greeting patients, managing phones and appointment enquiries, updating records, handling payments, and supporting clinicians with the practical workflow of a busy practice.
  • Have excellent communication skills, a calm and empathetic manner, and the ability to work effectively with a diverse student population while maintaining accuracy, privacy, and confidentiality. This role is busy and challenging at times, but also extremely rewarding and interesting for someone who genuinely enjoys medical reception work.
  • Care about patients, but also about doing things efficiently and to a high standard.

  • Be able to defuse tension with empathy, remain calm under pressure, and find satisfaction in getting the details right while helping make someone’s day a little easier. A good sense of humour will go a long way.

Key requirements:

  • Medical reception experience, or proven front-line reception experience in a medical, counselling, or similar health-focused environment.
  • Proven experience in administration work, work processes, records and information management.
  • Experience scheduling appointments, managing patient enquiries, handling phone calls and emails, and supporting a busy appointment system.
  • Experience with patient payments, invoicing, receipts, account transactions, or other basic financial administration tasks.
  • A strong commitment to patient service, confidentiality, accuracy, and maintaining a professional reception environment.
  • Proven experience with windows-based computer packages including Microsoft Office.
  • Proven experience with general office procedures and equipment (e.g., photocopier, phones, filing systems).
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience in working effectively in a multicultural environment.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who wants to use and further develop their medical reception skills in a supportive, professional, and student-centred health and counselling environment. It will suit someone who takes pride in reception work, values strong relationships with patients and clinical colleagues, and wants to be part of a team that is professionalising and elevating the importance of front-line healthcare administration.

Preference is given to candidates available for an immediate start. Please also note that this role requires safety checking through a pre-employment check.

title: Field Service Representative
description:
Career Area:

Job Description:

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Installs, maintains and troubleshoots equipment at the customer's location using a set of tools, parts and technical diagrams. Customer service assignment include on-site preventive maintenance and inspection service work, call-out services and commissioning activities on turbomachinery and package systems.

What we offer:
1. Competitive Compensation Packages (65k-85k not including OT)
2. Travel, Company Truck, Gas Card, Meals/Lodging ALL included
3. Medical, dental and vision coverage starting day 1
4. Paid time off plan (Vacation, Holiday, Volunteer, Etc.)
5. 401(k) Savings Plan including company match
6. Health savings account (HSA)
7. Flexible spending accounts (FSAs)
8. Short and long-term disability coverage
9. Parental leave
10. Employee Assistance Programs
11. Voluntary Benefits and Employee Discounts
12. Career Development

What you will do:

  • Use a variety of test equipment to diagnose and identify malfunctions and may refer to schematics and manufacturers' specifications that provide instructions on how to locate problems with guidance of experienced field service personnel and/or supervisor.

  • Under supervision use hand tools, gauges and instruments to analyze, repair or replace faulty parts. Utilize digital tools and systems.

  • Observe and check for common causes of trouble, such as dirty or defective components, cleaning and lubricating equipment with guidance of experienced field service personnel and/or supervisor.

  • Under supervision perform routine installations and making adjustments to equipment as appropriate within normal procedures.

What you will have:

Degree Requirement
Degree or equivalent experience desired

Skill Descriptors
Service Excellence: Knowledge of customer service concepts and techniques; ability to meet or exceed customer needs and expectations and provide excellent service in a direct or indirect manner.

Initiative: Being proactive and committing to action on self-identified job responsibilities and challenges; ability to seek out work and the drive to accomplish goals.

Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations.

Mechanical Maintenance - Power Supply: Knowledge of machines used in power plant; ability to conduct preventive maintenance and repairs or replacements on faulty mechanical parts used in power plants.

Mechanical Maintenance (Oil and Gas): Knowledge of mechanical equipment and the preventive maintenance; ability to repair or replace faulty mechanical parts used in the exploration, production or refining of hydrocarbons.

Safety (Oil and Gas): Knowledge of procedures, practices, considerations and regulatory requirements for the safety and protection of workers, community, environment and company assets; ability to identify and respond accordingly to work-related hazards.

Programmable Logic Controller (PLC): Knowledge of Programmable Logic Controller (PLC); ability to design, implement, and operate automated process controls.

Troubleshooting Technical Problems: Knowledge of troubleshooting approaches, tools and techniques; ability to anticipate, detect and resolve technical problems in a manufacturing environment.

Candidates must:

  • Pass a Department of Transportation (DOT) drug screen and a physical fitness evaluation.

  • Clean Driving Record (this includes no moving violations within the last 12 months, no "2 point" violations within the last 3 years, and no DUIs within the last 7 years)

  • Candidate must successfully complete physical exam and obtain OGUK (offshore) certification by Solar-approved physician.

  • Be able to obtain a legal Transportation Worker's Identification Credential.

  • The selected applicant must live or relocate to the greater Houston area for this position

This Job Description is intended as a general guide to the job duties for this position and is intended for the purpose of establishing the specific salary grade. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as an exhaustive summary of all responsibilities, duties and effort required of employees assigned to this job. At the discretion of management, this description may be changed at any time to address the evolving needs of the organization. It is expressly not intended to be a comprehensive list of “essential job functions” as that term is defined by the Americans with Disabilities Act.

Visa Sponsorship is not available for this position.

August 6, 2026 - August 19, 2026

Any offer of employment is conditioned upon the successful completion of a drug screen.

Caterpillar is an Equal Opportunity Employer, Including Veterans and Individuals with Disabilities. Qualified applicants of any age are encouraged to apply.

description:

Regular

Please review the following job description:

The branch leader has responsibility for managing all aspects of assigned branch. The responsibilities include but are not limited to: driving branch performance through leading, coaching and managing; and business development. Small business expertise and development critical to Truist’s Purpose of inspiring and building better lives and communities. Ensuring compliance with internal controls, operational procedures and risk management policies. Management of human capital including interviewing, selection, hiring, conducting performance reviews, disciplinary actions, workforce management scheduling. May be cross trained to assist with teller transactions as needed.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Following is a summary of the essential functions for this job. Other duties may be performed, both major and minor, which are not mentioned below. Specific activities may change from time to time.

1. Promote positive public image in the community and instill the Purpose, Mission and Values in the team and in support of the Truist culture.
2. Drive the business development of the branch to deliver both strong team performance as well as strong individual performance through personal productivity, in the areas of Truist strategy including but not limited to Small Business, Mass Affluent, Community Heroes, and Integrated Relationship Management (IRM) partnership.
3. Drive branch revenue through Small Business development and new client strategies. Drive the growth of Small Business expertise through branch routines of face-to-face appointments with clients, outbound calling, and prospecting as well as the growth of Mass Affluent through face-to-face appointments and outbound calling.
4. Participation, as reviewed and approved in the market, in civic, government, professional, business, community affairs, associations and groups to prospect and develop new business through community involvement and building the Truist Brand.
5. Responsible for successfully executing on the branch engagement routines by leading, growing, coaching and motivating teammates, to fulfill the Purpose Mission and Values for client’s financial success and team empowerment.
6. Partnership with Integrated Relationship Management (IRM) and Operations partners. Partner with the area operations officer to ensure compliance with bank procedures, internal controls, risk management and the Truist Code of Ethics and ensuring that all required training is successfully completed by the entire team. Proactively collaborate with all IRM and key line of business partners to lead and promote One Team culture within branch through One Team/Business Partnerships.
7. Responsible for human capital decisions including interviewing, selection, hiring, workforce scheduling, development planning, annual performance reviews, ratings, and performance counseling including disciplinary actions for all members of branch team.

QUALIFICATIONS


Required Qualifications:
The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
1. Bachelor’s degree or equivalent education and related training or experience.
2. Two years of financial services and consumer/small business expertise or equivalent experience and/or performance
3. One year of previous branch leadership or management experience
4. Strong interpersonal, sales relationship and prioritization skills.
5. Strong written and verbal skills.
6. Must be SAFE Mortgage Licensing Act compliant within 30 days of employment in this role, including new or transfer of registration, and applicable NMLS background check.
7. Ability to inspire, lead and coach others.


Preferred Qualifications:
1. Bachelor’s degree with a concentration in Business, Accounting, Finance or Banking
2. Graduate of Internal Leadership Development Programs

title: Personlig assistent sökes hos kille i Bollnäs  50% dagtid.
description:
På Kura Omsorg arbetar vi tillsammans för alla människors rätt till att leva livet fullt ut. Nu söker vi ytterligare en kollega till vårt team, är det du?

OM TJÄNSTEN

Vi på Kura Omsorg söker dig som vill arbeta som personlig assistent hos vår kund i Bollnäs. Tjänsten avser cirka 50 % och innebär arbete som stöd i en matvarubutik. Arbetet sker enligt ett rullande schema där arbetstiderna är 08.30–12.30 eller 07.30–13.00

Introduktion önskas så snart som möjligt. Tjänsten är vikariat tom 1/4-27 med möjlighet till förlängning.

OM KUNDEN

Vår kund är en positiv kille i 25-årsåldern som lever ett aktivt och innehållsrikt liv. Han har Downs syndrom, vilket gör att han behöver en trygg och motiverande hand i sin vardag. Kommunikation är viktig för honom där han kan behöva extra stöd i nya sociala sammanhang genom att du finns där som en länk till omvärlden.

Som hans assistent blir du en viktig följeslagare till jobbet där han stortrivs. När det kommer till fritiden ägnar vår kund sig gärna åt skidåkning och träning, och deltar även i gymnastik, fotboll, innebandy och bowling. Vi ser positivt på om du delar dessa intressen.

ÄR DU DEN VI SÖKER?

Vi söker dig som har ett genuint engagemang för att arbeta med människor och förmågan att läsa av andras behov. Som person är du trygg, stabil och har ett naturligt tålamod. Eftersom kunden mår bäst i en lugn miljö och kan bli stressad av för mycket prat, är det viktigt att du är lyhörd och kan anpassa din kommunikation efter situationen.

Tidigare erfarenhet av butiksarbete är meriterande, men stor vikt läggs vid personlig lämplighet. Vi söker en trygg och strukturerad person som har god förmåga att kommunicera tydligt och kan ge stöd i arbetet i butiksmiljö.

KRAV

  • Rökfri

  • Körkort och tillgång till bil

Sysselsättningsgrad: Ca 50%.

Antal tjänster: 1

Lön: Vi tillämpar individuell lönesättning. Övriga ersättningar i enlighet med kollektivavtal.

Din ansökan kommer att läsas av medarbetare på Kura Omsorg, kund och anhörig. Urvalet sker löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdagen. Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

För anställning hos oss på Kura Omsorg behöver du ha ett BankID och godkänner att använda ditt BankID i tjänsten. En förutsättning för att påbörja en anställning hos oss är att du som söker kan uppvisa giltig ID-handling och lämna in personbevis samt eventuella dokument som styrker rätten till arbete i Sverige. Personbevis kan du enkelt ladda ned på Skatteverkets hemsida. På grund av att tjänsten kan omfatta ensamarbete, nattarbete och arbetsuppgifter som enligt Arbetsmiljöverkets föreskrifter (AFS 2012:3) inte får utföras av minderåriga, måste du ha fyllt 18 år för att jobba som personlig assistent.

Om du ska arbeta med barn och unga under 18 år krävs att du uppvisar utdrag ur belastningsregistret. Från och med den 1 mars 2026 gäller nya bestämmelser som innebär att registerkontrollen omfattar både utdrag ur belastningsregistret och utdrag ur misstankeregistret. Utdraget beställs av via Polismyndighetens e-tjänst. Observera att handläggningstiden kan variera, varför beställning bör göras i god tid.

Utdragen kan beställas med BankID via följande länk: https://polisen.se/tjanster-tillstand/belastningsregistret/barn-med-funktionsnedsattning/

Vi rekommenderar att du säkerställer att du har aktuella utdrag i enlighet med gällande lagstiftning och de nya regler som trädde i kraft den 1 mars 2026.

ATT ARBETA PÅ KURA OMSORG

Som anställd personlig assistent hos oss omfattas du av kollektivavtal samt avtalspension. Du är försäkrad på och till/från arbetet om något oförutsett skulle inträffa. Vi erbjuder friskvårdsbidrag till alla våra anställda. Dessutom anordnar vi aktiviteter som riktar sig både till dig som anställd och till kunden du arbetar med. Vi är måna om att du som medarbetare ska trivas hos oss!

DELA KANDIDATER MELLAN BOLAGEN

Din ansökan kan komma att delas med våra systerbolag om din profil matchar en annan tjänst inom Team Olivia. Du ger ditt medgivande i ansökan.

FÖR DIG MED ANSTÄLLNINGSSTÖD

Om du som söker har rätt till någon form av anställningsstöd tar vi som arbetsgivare på Kura Omsorg även detta i beaktning vid en eventuell anställning. Det är frivilligt att ange denna information i din ansökan, alternativt kan du även meddela detta vid en eventuell intervju.

title: Lähihoitaja tai sairaanhoitaja keikkatyöhön Pihlajalinna Jyväskylä ja Seppä
description:
Haluaisitko työskennellä keikkaluonteisesti lääkärikeskuksissamme Jyväskylässä? Tarjoamme sinulle paikan, johon on mukava tulla. Meillä työ perustuu luottamukseen ja aitoon välittämiseen, jokaisen ääni otetaan huomioon ja toimintaa kehitetään yhdessä. Olemme sitoutuneet edistämään työyhteisöissämme monimuotoisuutta, osallisuutta sekä yhdenvertaisuutta. Meillä luodaan iloista, mutkatonta ja turvallista työarkea.


Tässä tehtävässä työpäiväsi ovat aina hieman erilaisia ja pääset kehittymään monenlaisissa tehtävissä. Sinulla on mahdollisuus monipuolisiin lääkärikeskuksen tehtäviin kuten mm. asiakaspalveluun ja monipuolisiin terveydenhuollon taustatöihin, asiakkaiden ohjaukseen ja neuvontaan palvelupisteellä, pientoimenpiteissä avustamiseen sekä osaamisen mukaan tarvittaessa myös laboratorionäytteiden ottoon. Meillä työskentelee lämminhenkinen moniammatillinen tiimi- sinä olisit yksi heistä!

Arvostamme joustavuutta ja vastuunkantoa omasta työstä sekä innostusta luoda myönteisiä ja mieleenpainuvia kohtaamisia. Keikkatyö tarjoaa mahdollisuuden työskennellä joustavasti juuri omaan elämäntilanteeseesi sopien. Lääkärikeskuksissamme palvellaan asiakkaita arkisin sekä viikonloppuisin, arkisin työvuorot sijoittuvat klo 7-20:30 välille ja viikonloppuisin klo 9:30-15:30 välille.


Sinä olet meille tärkeä


* Saat hyvän perehdytyksen ja kannustavan tiimin tuen monipuolisiin tehtäviin lääkärikeskuksessamme

* Huolehdimme osaamisestasi tarjoamalla kouluttautumismahdollisuuksia, jatkuvasti käytössäsi olevan oppimisympäristö Pihlajalinna Akatemian ja saat esiperehdytyksen jo ennen työsuhteen alkua työyhteisöön tutustumisen tueksi

* Työnantajana ja kollegoina lupaamme kuunnella ja auttaa sinua kehittymään työssäsi. Palkkauksessa ja työehdoissa noudatamme terveyspalvelualan työehtosopimusta sekä huomioimme työkokemuksesi ja osaamisesi yksilöllisesti


Kuulostaisiko keikkatyö sinulle houkuttelevalta?

Toivomme, että olet terveydenhuollon ammattilainen: sairaanhoitaja tai lähihoitaja! Eduksesi on aiempi kokemus asiakaspalvelutehtävistä, DH-potilastietojärjestelmän käytöstä sekä kokemus näytteenotosta, itsenäisestä vastaanottotyöstä ja lääkäreiden avustamisesta pientoimenpiteissä. Suomen kielen taitosi tulee olla hyvä ja asiointi kanssasi sujua englanniksikin. Edellytämme tehtävään valitulta sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon asiakas- ja potilastyössä vaadittavaa tartuntatautilain mukaista soveltuvuutta.



Kiinnostuitko? Jätä hakemuksesi rekrytointijärjestelmämme kautta 23.8.26 mennessä.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa palveluvastaavamme Piia Olkinuora 040 4578515 tai piia.olkinuora@pihlajalinna.fi, soittoaika arkisin klo 8-16

Rekrytointiprosessista voit kysyä lisätietoja hoitajarekrytointi@pihlajalinna.fi

description:

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Installs, maintains and troubleshoots equipment at the customer's location using a set of tools, parts and technical diagrams. Customer service assignments include on-site preventive maintenance and inspection service work, call-out services and commissioning activities on turbomachinery and package systems.

This is a remote position but qualified applicants will reside in the state of Ohio or Virginia to be able to support the local Customer base.

What you will do:

  • Observe and check for common causes of trouble, such as dirty or defective components, cleaning and lubricating equipment with guidance of experienced field service personnel and/or supervisor.

  • Under supervision perform routine installations and making adjustments to equipment as appropriate within normal procedures.

Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations.

Safety (Oil and Gas): Knowledge of procedures, practices, considerations and regulatory requirements for the safety and protection of workers, community, environment and company assets; ability to identify and respond accordingly to work-related hazards.
Programmable Logic Controller (PLC): Knowledge of Programmable Logic Controller (PLC); ability to design, implement, and operate automated process controls.

title: IV-Asentaja, Jyväskylä
description:
Etsimme IV-asentajaa/huoltajaa Jyväskylään

Etsitkö vakaata ja hyvää työpaikkaa, jossa pääset kehittämään osaamistasi ja tekemään mielenkiintoisia IV-alan töitä?

Tehtävän kuvaus

Työmaat ovat pääasiallisesti saneerauskohteita mm. ruokakauppoja sekä toimistosaneerauksia. Työt ovat iv-kanavien nuohousta, vaihtoja, eristämistä ja tarvittaessa säätöjen kohistamista. Työpäivät alkavat asiakkaan toimipisteeltä, josta kuljetaan työmaille firman autoilla. Eli oman auton käyttö ei ole pakollista tässä työssä.

Jos seuraavat asiat ovat hallussa, saatat olla etsimämme henkilö

Hakeaksesi tätä työpaikkaa, sinulla tulee olla:

  • Talotekniikka-alan koulutus - työ on vastuullista ja peruskoulutuksen pitää olla kunnossa.
  • Vähintään muutaman vuoden kokemus IV-alalta - etsimme ammattilaista, jolta asiat sujuvat eikä tarvitse olla vahtimassa
  • Valmiutta tehdä myös reissutöitä - osa asiakkaan kohteista sijaitsee Keksi-Suomen ulkopuolella.
  • Voimassa oleva työturvallisuuskortti - jos ei ole, niin asia on hoidettava kuntoon ennen töiden aloitusta.
  • Hyvä suomen kielen taito - työnjohtokieli on suomi.
  • Korkea työmoraali – työ on itsenäistä ja vastaat itse työnjäljestäsi.
  • Sosiaaliset taidot kunnossa – tulet toimeen ihmisten kanssa tiukoissakin paikoissa.

Vision työntekijälupaus

Oli visiosi työelämästä kirkas tai vasta hahmottumassa, me autamme molemmissa tapauksissa. Varmistamme, että työsopimukset ja varusteet ovat kunnossa, ja että ammattilaisena saat osaamistasi vastaavan palkan. Olemme tukena ja turvana, jos sellaista tarvitset. Meille on tärkeää, että viihdyt työssäsi.

Visiolaisena saat tässä tehtävässä:

  • Osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi mukaan määräytyvän palkan.
  • Määräaikaisen työsuhteen 37,5h/vko
  • Palkanmaksun kaksi kertaa kuukaudessa.
  • Perehdytyksen työhön.
  • Jokaiseen työtehtävään soveltuvat työvarusteet.
  • Päivittäisen tuen työasioissa.
  • Mahdollisuuden kehittää ammattitaitoasi ja edetä vaativampiin tehtäviin.
  • Hyville tyypeille on aina kysyntää ja autamme sinua löytämään uusia töitä määräaikaisen työsuhteen päättyessä.

Onko meillä yhteinen visio? — Näin teet työpaikkahakemuksen

Haastattelemme jo hakuaikana potentiaalisia hakijoita, joten mikäli koet olevasi etsimämme työntekijä, niin nyt on aika jättää hakemus. Tee se ohessa olevan linkin kautta!

Hakemuksia tulee paljon, ja jotta hakuprosessi on kaikille reilu, voimme ottaa huomioon vain järjestelmässä tehdyt hakemukset.

Voit parantaa omia mahdollisuuksiasi tulla valituksi, kun:

  • liität hakemukseesi ansioluettelon (CV) tai kirjaat aikaisemmat työpaikkasi kuluneelta viideltä vuodelta,
  • kerrot, miten aiemmissa työpaikoissa opitut asiat tukevat sinua pärjäämään hakemassasi uudessa tehtävässä.

Näin saat lisätietoa tehtävästä

Jos haluat lisätietoja tehtävästä, voit lähettää rekrytoinnista vastaaville henkilöille sähköpostia otsikolla "Haettu työ" osoitteeseen ari.ahonen(at)visiohr.fi. Olemme tavoitettavissa ma-pe klo 09.00-16.00.

Arvostamme, että sähköpostissa kysyt vain työtehtävään liittyviä asioita. Jätä esimerkiksi itsesi esittely ja myyntipuheet varsinaiseen hakemukseen.

Tsemppiä hakemuksen tekoon!

Visio — Aidosti läsnä alueellasi

Visio Henkilöstöratkaisut on valtakunnallisesti paikallinen. Tunnemme paikalliset työmarkkinat ja olemme aidosti läsnä alueellasi. Jos haet Keski-Suomessa työpaikkaa, siinä auttavat sinua Jyväskylästä käsin Ari ja Mikko-Matti.

Visio Henkilöstöratkaisut

Visio Keski-Suomi on osa Visio Henkilöstöratkaisut -konsernia, joka on vuonna 2020 perustettu kotimainen henkilöstöpalvelualan yritys. Pelaamme reilua peliä ja tarjoamme töitä niin raudanlujille ammattilaisille, kuin sellaiseksi kehittyville. Yhdistämme työntekijät ja työnantajat niin, että molemmat löytävät juuri tarpeisiinsa sopivan ratkaisun. Yhteistyö perustuu kaikkien kolmen tahon keskinäiseen luottamukseen.

Jos haluat reilun työnantajan, joka arvostaa osaamistasi ja huomaa työpanoksesi, se on Visio.

title: Gruppchef för Projektkvalitet till Siemens Energy i Finspång
description:
Vi på Adecco söker nu en Group Manager – Project Quality Management till vår världsledande teknikkund Siemens Energy i Finspång. Detta är en spännande möjlighet för dig som vill kombinera ledarskap, kvalitetsarbete och tekniskt komplexa projekt i en internationell miljö. Du får en nyckelroll i att leda och utveckla ett team som säkerställer att kvalitetskraven uppfylls genom hela projektlivscykeln inom industriella gasturbiner och värmepumpslösningar.

Om du drivs av att utveckla människor, förbättra processer och skapa förutsättningar för framgångsrika projektleveranser kan detta vara nästa steg i din karriär.

Om rollen

Som Group Manager för Project Quality Management har du personalansvar för ett team som arbetar med kvalitetssäkring och kvalitetskontroll i Siemens Energys kundprojekt. Teamet ansvarar för att säkerställa att kvalitetskrav uppfylls på ett effektivt sätt och i enlighet med kundernas förväntningar, interna processer och gällande standarder.

I rollen ansvarar du för att stötta, utveckla och coacha teamet samtidigt som du arbetar med resursplanering, kompetensutveckling och kontinuerliga förbättringar. Du samarbetar nära flera delar av verksamheten, bland annat projektledning, konstruktion, inköp och anbudsorganisation, för att skapa effektiva arbetssätt och framgångsrika projektleveranser.

Du blir en viktig länk mellan verksamheten, projekten och kvalitetsorganisationen och får möjlighet att påverka både teamets och organisationens fortsatta utveckling.

Exempel på ansvarsområden

  • Leda, coacha och utveckla medarbetare inom Project Quality Management
  • Säkerställa effektiv resursplanering och rätt kompetens för pågående och kommande projekt
  • Driva förbättringsinitiativ och utveckla arbetsprocesser inom kvalitetsområdet
  • Stödja projektorganisationen i kvalitetsrelaterade frågor genom hela projektets livscykel
  • Samarbeta tvärfunktionellt med projektledning, engineering och andra verksamhetsområden
  • Bidra i anbuds- och offertarbete genom budgetestimeringar, kvalitetsbedömningar och granskning av kundkrav
  • Säkerställa att QA/QC-krav uppfylls enligt kundernas förväntningar och verksamhetens kvalitetsstandarder

Tjänsten är en heltidstjänst och ett konsultuppdrag via Adecco med start 2026-09-01 till och med 2027-08-31.

Om dig

The Pima County Recorders Office has an opening for a Recording Technician who will provide direct support to the public, commercial real estate organizations, development and construction entities, government agencies, and law offices by accepting legal instruments for recordation and verifying document compliance with Arizona Revised Statutes and regulations. This position is differentiated from other clerical and administrative support classifications by the technical and legal knowledge required related to the application of relevant statutory obligations and Arizona State requirements regarding the handling of sensitive and/or confidential information.

As defined under the Americans with Disabilities Act, this classification may include any of the following tasks, knowledge, skills, and other characteristics. This list is ILLUSTRATIVE ONLY and is not a comprehensive listing of all functions and tasks performed by incumbents of this class. Work assignments may vary depending on the department’s need and will be communicated to the applicant or incumbent by the supervisor.

  • Processes e-recorded and paper documents for compliance with Arizona Revised Statute, verifying completeness and resolving informational errors;

  • Identifies and distinguishes among multiple legal document types and associated legal descriptors to ensure proper classification and recordation;

  • Performs accurate primary data entry into the specialized recording database;

  • Maintains security and confidentiality of records, including statutory redaction of personal identifying information and secure handling of sensitive documents;

Two years of progressively responsible clerical, administrative, technical, or paraprofessional support experience INCLUDING one year providing department, program, or small business coordination OR one year of specialized experience processing subdivision plats, development plans, rezoning applications, real estate or planning documents, or serving in a public-sector permitting, addressing, or code enforcement support role.

One year of experience with Pima County in an Administrative Assistant II or closely related position as determined by the department head at the time of recruitment.
