title: Input Device Architect, Personal Systems
description:
Input Device Architect, Personal Systems

Description -

Job Summary
This role owns the technology architecture and roadmap for input device components — touch panel, touch IC, and pen — across HP's Personal Systems portfolio. It evaluates emerging technologies and partner capabilities, translates POC data into solution proposals, and defines design specifications by balancing market, ID, human factor, and platform requirements. The role acts as the component-level technical authority, bridging procurement, cross-functional engineering, and execution teams to deliver technically sound, cost-competitive input device solutions.

Responsibilities

  • Own the technology roadmap for input device commodities (touch panel, touch IC, pen), tracking the broader input device ecosystem and evaluating new technologies, innovations, and partner/supplier capabilities for alignment with roadmap and business value.

  • Evaluate products from a component-level perspective to shape viable design solutions and define input device design specifications by balancing market requirements, ID (industrial design) requirements, human factor requirements, and platform requirements, and hand over specifications to execution teams for implementation.

  • Leverage POC (proof-of-concept) data to develop and recommend input device solutions and technology packages.

  • Collaborate and communicate internally with PM planners, ID, human factor, platform architect, procurement, and other cross-functional engineering teams (e.g., mechanical, BIOS…etc.) regarding design specifications, technical alignment, cost evaluation, and issue resolution.

  • Collaborate and communicate with external supplier and outsourced development partners regarding design architecture, technical proposals, and project progress.

  • Support a scope extending beyond notebook to include AIO (All-in-One), POS (Point of Sale), and other form factors, spanning Consumer, Commercial, Gaming, and Mobile Workstation business units.

  • Provide guidance and technical mentoring on input device technology and design excellence to less experienced staff members.


Education & Experience Recommended

  • Four-year or Graduate Degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or any other related discipline or commensurate work experience or demonstrated competence.

  • Typically has 10+ years of work experience, preferably in engineering design and solutions, implementation across hardware development lifecycle, or a related field.

  • Demonstrated component-level expertise in display and touch IC commodities, with the ability to provide comprehensive and timely technical insight as well as commodity market insight.

  • Experience with input device/touch and pen technologies applied across PC, tablet, or mobile phone products is preferred.

  • Strong teamwork and cross-functional collaboration skills, with proven ability to work effectively with marketing, architecture, and procurement teams, along with strong communication and the ability to respond effectively in real time.

title: SVP- Security Architect
description:

It’s more than a career at NAB. It’s about more meaningful work, more global opportunities and more innovation beyond boundaries .

At NAB India, we’re ramping-up and growing at a very fast pace. Our passionate leaders recruit and develop high performing people, empowering them to deliver exceptional outcomes to make a positive difference in the lives of our customers and our communities.

NAB's Domain Delivery Cycle requires architecture to be embedded early in the delivery chain — shaping and assessing the pipeline of Business Outcomes and Epics, preventing ill-formed work from entering the backlog, and ensuring solutions align with technology strategy and patterns.

Essential capabilities:

  • Deep technical knowledge and experience within the aligned security capability domain, enabling credible engagement with delivery teams, technology platforms, and vendor solutions — and the ability to function as the recognised subject matter expert on projects within the domain.
  • Ability to produce and maintain Domain Roadmaps that articulate the transition states, investment sequencing, and funded delivery plan required to realise the target state defined by the Enterprise Security Architect.
  • Ability to inform and shape the domain delivery slate — working with domain stakeholders, Product Owners, and GS leadership to prioritise delivery based on risk, cost, feasibility, capability effectiveness, and strategic alignment.
  • Ability to translate a defined target state into a prioritised, sequenced roadmap of investments and transition states — and to clearly articulate the trade-offs of alternative sequencing to influence decision-making.
  • Ability to support the Enterprise Security Architect — providing delivery-informed input into target state development, surfacing domain challenges, and translating strategic direction into executable architecture within the delivery cycle.
  • Strong influencing skills across project and domain stakeholders — able to shape architectural outcomes with Product Owners, delivery leads, engineers, RTEs, GS leadership, and business representatives without direct authority.
  • Clear written and verbal communication — able to produce governance submissions, investment proposals, BOAs, ESAs, options assessments, and domain roadmaps that are actionable and fit for purpose.
Experience

  • 16+ years experience in technology or security roles, with a significant portion in solution architecture, technical delivery, or hands-on security engineering within the relevant domain.
  • Demonstrated experience producing domain or capability roadmaps that informed investment prioritisation and delivery sequencing within a large, complex enterprise.
  • Demonstrated experience functioning as an architectural SME on projects — providing technical authority, shaping solution direction, and influencing project stakeholders to adopt sound architectural approaches.
  • Demonstrated experience working with domain leadership and product owners to prioritise and sequence the delivery slate, balancing competing demands across risk, cost, and strategic alignment.
  • Experience providing architectural oversight across concurrent projects, including solution endorsement, options assessment, and tech debt governance.
  • Experience working within structured delivery cycles — embedded alongside product owners, delivery teams, and engineering in an agile environment.
  • Experience in Australian financial services or similarly regulated industries preferred.

A diverse and inclusive workplace works better for everyone:

Our goal is to foster a culture that fills us with pride, rooted in trust and respect. NAB is committed to creating a positive and supportive environment where everyone is encouraged to embrace their true, authentic selves. A diverse and inclusive workplace where our differences are celebrated, and our contributions are valued. It’s a huge part of what makes NAB such a special place to be.

We’re committed to delivering a positive experience for our colleagues and a workplace you can be proud of. We support our colleagues to balance their careers and personal life through flexible working arrangements such as hybrid working and job sharing and competitive financial and lifestyle benefits. We invest in our colleagues through world class development programs (Distinctive Leadership and Career Qualified in Banking), and empower you to learn, grow and pursue exciting career opportunities

title: Senior Project Manager
description:
Do you believe no challenge is too complex to solve? You’ll fit right in at U.S. Engineering Innovations. We deliver award-winning mechanical contracting, construction, service, and maintenance solutions with a focus on performance and innovation. Our team of skilled and collaborative professionals drives every project from preconstruction through final testing, always aligned with our clients’ goals.

U.S. Engineering Innovations has been an industry leader through constant innovation and a willingness to evolve. The construction industry changes rapidly, and we cultivate a dynamic workplace where even our newest team members can influence change and make an impact. We know that our most valuable asset is our people. Join us!

SENIOR PROJECT MANAGER
Senior Project Manager is a vital part of the US Engineering Innovations team and holds responsibility for overseeing the profitability and success of the project. The Senior Project Manager gets engaged from the preparation and review of estimates, through the construction phase, and takes charge of all activities from the start to on-time and on-budget completion. Additionally, business development expectations include strengthening existing relationships and fostering new ones.

Principal Duties and Accountabilities:

  • Proficient at plan/spec estimating as well as conceptual estimating in a design/build/assist scenario.
  • Understands the total life cycle of a building and is able to guide customers to the best solution that aligns with their mission.
  • Partners with field leadership to ensure projects are installed on schedule while maintaining the required design criteria.
  • Work with customer base to ensure conceptual designs and budgets meet the customers’ needs and expectations.
  • Proficient at preconstruction activities such as formulating a project execution plan, detailed estimate reviews, commodity and equipment procurement, subcontractor selection, issuing subcontracts, submittals, and developing the project schedule.
  • Establish project objectives, procedures, and performance standards within scope of company policies and standard operating procedures.
  • Forecasts project profitability monthly, identifies trends, and makes adjustments to the project execution plan as necessary.
  • Manages subcontractor proposal requests, scope reviews and the issuing of subcontracts.
  • Responsible for establishing and monitoring schedule of field and subcontractor progress.
  • Assists in the coordination of safety programs and oversees job site safety reviews.
  • Coordinates all job correspondence.
  • Identifies opportunities for future projects and networks internally and externally to pursue such opportunities, in collaboration with the Vice President of Operations – Service and Special Projects, and others.
  • Responsible for understanding the offerings of US Engineering’s sister companies and promoting their services when appropriate.
  • Responsible for supporting the professional development of other team members through education, mentoring, and continuous feedback.
  • Conducts quarterly performance assessments of support staff and assists with field leadership feedback.
  • Thoroughly understands the strategic direction of US Engineering and aligns all project execution plans with the overall strategy.
  • WBS and work pack management (Facilitate VC/MX)
  • Build, maintain and track project Schedule (CPM Schedules)
  • Host weekly internal coordination meetings.
  • Responsible for creating and tracking closeout process including all equipment startups QA/QC, Commissioning, and warranty.

Job Scope:
The Senior Project Manager – should possess the ability to simultaneously manage multiple projects, ranging from $500.00 up to approximately $20,000,000 in value.

Management Responsibility
Acts as a project manager – management of a project team, on which the individuals comprising the team may vary by project.

Education & Experience:
  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management or related field.
  • Equivalent combination of field and relevant project leadership experience will be considered.
  • Minimum of 7-10 years of relevant experience is required.
Knowledge, skills, and abilities:
  • Thorough knowledge of mechanical construction industry practices, processes, and standards – including systems design, installation, and servicing.
  • Must possess a strong technical knowledge of HVAC systems, as well as a basic knowledge of plumbing systems and industrial processes.
  • Ability to maximize performance of project team through innovative and effective management techniques.
  • Superior communication and interpersonal skills, such as diplomacy, persuasion, etc. are essential to develop and foster effective professional relationships.
  • Time management and organizational skills.
  • Basic level of financial acumen necessary to manage project budget / performance.
  • Knowledge of the following computer programs: MS Word, Excel.
  • Strong problem-solving, negotiation, and conflict-management skills.
  • Ability to successfully drive project through completion.

Physical and/or travel demands:
  • Routine daily driving to project sites required.
  • Infrequent overnight travel may be required, based on project assignments.
  • Physical demands include walking on uneven surfaces, climbing ladders, bending, kneeling, and lifting. Position includes sitting and standing, use of telephone, keyboard, and computer monitor.
Benefits and Compensation:
  • The range for this position has been established at $115,360 to $163,624 and is US Engineering Innovations’ good faith and reasonable estimate at the time of the posting. The compensation offered to the finalist selected for this role will be set based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to, internal equity, experience, education, specialty, and training.
  • Your total compensation will go beyond the number on your paycheck. Team members are eligible for a year-end bonus based on company and/or individual performance as well as paid time off. An industry-leading benefits package including health, dental, and vision plans, matching retirement contributions, and matching 529 contributions all add to your bottom line.
This position will be posted until August 25, 2026. To apply, please visit .

Four Seasons Resort The Nam Hai, awarded Two Michelin Keys and recognized as a Forbes Five-Star resort for eight consecutive years, is an idyllic beachfront retreat on Vietnam's culturally rich central coast. Set across 35 hectares of lush tropical gardens with more than 4,500 coconut palms and a pristine one-kilometre stretch of Ha My Beach, the resort offers effortless access to three UNESCO World Heritage Sites: Hoi An Ancient Town, My Son Sanctuary, and the Imperial City of Hue. Conveniently located just 30 minutes from Da Nang International Airport and 15 minutes from Hoi An, the resort seamlessly blends cultural discovery, world-class luxury, and beachfront serenity.

ABOUT THE ROLE

The F&B Service Ambassador will provide exceptional and personalized butler services to guests, ensuring their comfort and satisfaction throughout their stay, in accordance to established SOPs on Butler Service This role involves anticipating guest needs, offering tailored services, and maintaining high standards of service delivery. The F&B Service Ambassador will work closely with other departments to ensure seamless guest experiences, providing support for special requests, events, and daily needs

WHAT YOU WILL DO

+ Guest Service Excellence:

  • Anticipate and respond to guest needs, providing knowledgeable recommendations & personalized service based on preferences and requirements.

  • Ensure guests feel welcomed and valued by maintaining a friendly, professional demeanor at all times. Offer guests an enjoyable, dining experience conforming to service standards.

  • Handle guest requests promptly and efficiently, ensuring satisfaction with attention to detail.

  • Ensure tables/rooms set-up are properly set and maintain cleanliness throughout service.

+ Operational Support:

  • Maintain knowledge of guest preferences, room assignments, and any special requests or events.

  • Coordinate with housekeeping, concierge, and other departments to fulfill guest needs.

  • Ensure rooms and guest areas are well-maintained, tidy, and prepared for guest use.

  • Assist with reservations, transportation arrangements, and itinerary planning for guests.

+ Event and Special Request Management:

  • Assist in organizing and overseeing special events or celebrations for guests, including birthdays, anniversaries, and corporate gatherings.

  • Provide tailored services for special requests, such as making arrangements for dining, leisure activities, or in-room services.

  • Coordinate with the kitchen and F&B teams to ensure guest requests for meals or special dietary needs are fulfilled.

+ Team Collaboration and Support:

  • Supervise and support junior team members, promoting consistent and professional service delivery.

  • Work closely with other departments, housekeeping, and front desk staff to ensure coordinated, efficient service delivery.

  • Provide support during busy periods or special events, stepping in where necessary to maintain high service standards.

+ Administrative and Miscellaneous Duties:

  • Maintain accurate records of guest preferences, special requests, and services provided to ensure consistency and personalized service.

  • Assist with the preparation of reports or updates on guest activities, ensuring accurate tracking of services and requests.

  • Ensure all guest areas and service equipment are maintained to the highest standards of cleanliness and functionality.

  • Respond appropriately to emergency situations, ensuring guest safety and comfort at all times.

+ Technical and System Proficiency:

  • Familiarity with handling money transactions and operating the the hotel’s systems, including room assignment, guest request management tools, and POS systems accurately.

  • Stay up to date with new technologies and systems implemented to improve guest experience.

+ Emergency and Miscellaneous Duties:

  • Respond to emergencies or safety situations within the hotel, ensuring guests are supported and safe.

  • Undertake additional tasks as required to ensure guest satisfaction and operational efficiency.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • College diploma, preferably in hotel and restaurant management.

  • 2-3 years as a team leader or supervisor, with an all-day dining background


WHAT WE OFFER

  • Competitive Salary, wages, and a comprehensive benefits package

  • Excellent Training and Development opportunities

  • Employee Discovery Nights at any Four Seasons worldwide

  • Complimentary Cleaning for Employee Uniforms

  • Complimentary Employee Meals

  • Complimentary Employee bus from/to Danang center

title: Portfolio Analytics & Strategy Analyst
description:
Position Overview

At PNC, our people are our greatest differentiator and competitive advantage in the markets we serve. We are all united in delivering the best experience for our customers. We work together each day to foster an inclusive workplace culture where all of our employees feel respected, valued and have an opportunity to contribute to the company’s success. As a Portfolio Analytics & Strategy Analyst within PNC's Business and Strategy organization, you will be based in Pittsburgh, PA.PNC is an in-office company that fosters a supportive culture where employees can thrive and achieve balance. We encourage candidates to connect with their recruiter and hiring manager to understand workplace expectations and ensure the role aligns with their goals.PNC will not provide sponsorship for employment visas or participate in STEM OPT for this position.

Job Description

  • Provides financial and regulatory reporting and analyses to maintain adequate controls over the financial and regulatory reporting processes. Responsible for running complex business performance, risk and operational analytics. May include the development of analytical methods/models to assess market, credit and/or operational risk of new and existing financial products.
  • Leverages business / product expertise to rigorously analyze large datasets, improve risk adjusted returns, deliver profitable growth, and communicate conclusions. Synthesizes analytical results and develops, recommends, and implements business strategies that improve lending decisions, assist in managing risk, increase revenues, reduce exposure to losses, meet business goals, and improve performance. Establishes baselines for strategies and tracks actual performance to expectations.
  • Applies predictive models, third party data, and other tools to develop and execute appropriate segmentation and targeting for acquisition and portfolio strategies to provide insight into portfolio risk. Manages engagements with internal and external information suppliers ensuring solution is fit for purpose while maintaining appropriate governance and oversight.
  • Works with business, credit, data, and model development partners to design, develop, and monitor test designs and analytical reporting to track and enhance strategies. Designs / enhances standard reporting suites for regular product / portfolio reviews.
  • Collaborates with the line of business, Finance, and Risk partners to assess and establish credit risk appetite and to understand its implications, as well as to establish policies and procedures governing the identification, monitoring, and management of risk appetite.

PNC Employees take pride in our reputation and to continue building upon that we expect our employees to be:

  • Customer Focused - Knowledgeable of the values and practices that align customer needs and satisfaction as primary considerations in all business decisions and able to leverage that information in creating customized customer solutions.
  • Managing Risk - Assessing and effectively managing all of the risks associated with their business objectives and activities to ensure they adhere to and support PNC's Enterprise Risk Management Framework.

Qualifications

Successful candidates must demonstrate appropriate knowledge, skills, and abilities for a role. Listed below are skills, competencies, work experience, education, and required certifications/licensures needed to be successful in this position.

Preferred Skills

Analytical Thinking, Credit Risks, Data Analytics, Financial Analysis, Model Development, Operational Risks, Quantitative Models, Risk Appetite

Competencies

Analytical Approach, Banking Products, Big Data Management and Analytics, Business Analytics, Credit Risk, Mathematics of Financial Instruments, Operational Risk, Performance Measurement, Predictive Analytics, Pricing Models and Analytics, Regulatory Environment - Financial Services, Risk Management Banking

Work Experience

Roles at this level typically require a university / college degree, with 2+ years of relevant professional experience. In lieu of a degree, a comparable combination of education, job specific certification(s), and experience (including military service) may be considered.

Education

Bachelors

Certifications

No Required Certification(s)

Licenses

No Required License(s)

Pay Transparency

Base Salary: $75,000.00 – $125,000.00Salaries may vary based on geographic location, market data and on individual skills, experience, and education. This role is incentive eligible with the payment based upon company, business and/or individual performance.

Application Window

Generally, this opening is expected to be posted for two business days from 06/17/2026, although it may be longer with business discretion.

Benefits

PNC offers a comprehensive range of benefits to help meet your needs now and in the future. Depending on your eligibility, options for full-time employees include: medical/prescription drug coverage (with a Health Savings Account feature), dental and vision options; employee and spouse/child life insurance; short and long-term disability protection; 401(k) with PNC match, pension and stock purchase plans; dependent care reimbursement account; back-up child/elder care; adoption, surrogacy, and doula reimbursement; educational assistance, including select programs fully paid; a robust wellness program with financial incentives.In addition, PNC generally provides the following paid time off, depending on your eligibility: maternity and/or parental leave; up to 11 paid holidays each year; 9 occasional absence days each year, unless otherwise required by law; between 15 to 25 vacation days each year, depending on career level; and years of service.

To learn more about these and other programs, including benefits for full time and part-time employees, visit .

Disability Accommodations Statement

If an accommodation is required to participate in the application process, please contact us via email at AccommodationRequest@pnc.com. Please include “accommodation request” in the subject line title and be sure to include your name, the job ID, and your preferred method of contact in the body of the email. Emails not related to accommodation requests will not receive responses. Applicants may also call 877-968-7762 and say "Workday" for accommodation assistance. All information provided will be kept confidential and will be used only to the extent required to provide needed reasonable accommodations.


At PNC we foster an inclusive and accessible workplace. We provide reasonable accommodations to employment applicants and qualified individuals with a disability who need an accommodation to perform the essential functions of their positions.

Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO)


PNC provides equal employment opportunity to qualified persons regardless of race, color, sex, religion, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, veteran status, or other categories protected by law.

This position is subject to the requirements of Section 19 of the Federal Deposit Insurance Act (FDIA) and, for any registered role, the Secure and Fair Enforcement for Mortgage Licensing Act of 2008 (SAFE Act) and/or the Financial Industry Regulatory Authority (FINRA), which prohibit the hiring of individuals with certain criminal history.

California Residents

Refer to the California Consumer Privacy Act Privacy Notice to gain understanding of how PNC may use or disclose your personal information in our hiring practices.

title: [인턴] 프론트엔드 개발자
description:
About

넥스트그라운드는 월 ​200만명이 ​사용하는 ​부동산 정보 ​플랫폼 ‘집품’ 을 운영하고 ​있습니다.
2024년 ​하반기부터 흑자 ​전환 상태이며, 2025년 ​Top-tier 투자사로부터 ​30억원의 ​투자를 유치하였습니다. ​
성장성과 ​수익성을 ​모두 갖추며, 부동산 ​시장에서 ​혁신을 만들어가고 있습니다.

---------------
안녕하세요! 넥스트그라운드에서 프론트엔드팀 리드를 맡고 있는 유하영입니다.

제가 넥스트그라운드에 합류한 지난 시간 동안 집품의 트래픽은 월 평균 30% 이상 성장했습니다.
이 과정에서 프론트엔드 개발팀은 매월 200만명이 넘는 웹/앱의 모든 사용자에게 동일한 기능과 좋은 사용자 경험을 제공하기 위해 노력하고 있습니다. 그만큼 앞으로 마주할 새로운 챌린지들을 기대하고 있습니다.

집품 개발팀은 비즈니스 임팩트를 위해 다양한 직군과 긴밀히 협업을 하고 있습니다.
목표를 위해 주어진 시간에 기능을 완성할 뿐 아니라, 확장 가능한 구조를 고민하고 있습니다.

새로운 것에 대한 두려움 없으신 분, 문제를 파악하고 개선할 의지가 있으신 분과 함께 성장하고 싶습니다.
넥스트그라운드는 회사와 함께 성장해나가실 프론트엔드 개발자를 찾고 있습니다.

많은 관심 부탁드립니다.

Responsibilities

• 집품 플랫폼의 유저들을 위한 프론트엔드 개발을 담당합니다.
• 신규 서비스의 설계부터 출시까지 함께 참여합니다.
• AI를 활용하여 팀의 속도와 품질을 높이기 위한 규칙을 만들기 위해 고민합니다.
• 집품 서비스 전반의 성능을 최적화하고 안정성을 높이기 위해 고민합니다.
웹 성능 지표, 렌더링 등 이슈를 분석하고 개선합니다.
• 높은 생산성 유지 및 비효율적인 구조 개선을 위한 리팩터링을 진행합니다.

Requirements

• Next.js, TypeScript 기반의 웹 개발 경험이 있으신 분
• 주도적으로 문제를 분석하여 해결할 수 있으신 분
• AI를 적극적으로 활용하여 생산성을 높인 경험이 있으신 분
• 유저의 경험을 함께 고민하며, 타 직군과의 적극적인 커뮤니케이션이 가능하신 분
• 빠르게 개발하고 배포하는 문화를 경험하고 싶으신 분
• 대학 졸업자 이상 (2027년 02월 졸업 예정자 포함)


기술스택
• Typescript, Next.js, React, Flutter
• React Query, Recoil, SWR
• TailwindCSS, eslint, prettier, biome
• GitHub Actions, Sentry
• Github, Slack, Notion, Figma

Preferred

• 서버 사이드 렌더링 (SSR, Next.js) 개발 경험이 있으신 분
• 요구사항을 파악하여 더 좋은 방향을 제안할 수 있으신 분
• UI/UX에 관심이 많으신 분
• Sentry 등 모니터링 도구를 활용해 장애나 안정성을 높인 경험이 있으신 분
• 모바일 앱 내에서 작동하는 WebView(In-App) 경험 또는 앱 개발 경험이 있으신 분
• 브라우저, 기기에 따라 나타나는 다양한 이슈 해결 경험이 있으신 분
• 프론트엔드 아키텍처, 디자인 시스템, 공통 라이브러리 개발에 대한 경험 또는 관심이 있으신 분

Benefits

• 서로 존중하는 문화를 만들어요
자유로운 연차 사용
'님' 호칭과 '존댓말'을 통한 커뮤니케이션

• 구성원의 성장을 적극적으로 지원해요
업무 도서비 지원
강의 등 수강료 지원
국내외 출장비 지원

• 쾌적한 업무 환경을 제공해요
최신형 노트북 + 모니터
무제한 스낵 및 음료 제공
넓고 쾌적한 오피스 (스파크플러스, 강남역 7분 이내 위치)

title: Senior Communications Specialist
description:
Career Area:

Communications

Job Description:

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc.

When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

Caterpillar has an exciting opportunity for a Sr. Communications Specialist to join the Cat Digital division. In this role, you will serve as the primary communications partner for the AI & Analytics, Digital Applications, and Digital Platforms teams, helping translate complex technology initiatives into compelling narratives that resonate across the enterprise and beyond.

You will play a key role supporting senior leaders and bringing to life the stories behind Caterpillar's digital transformation efforts, helping employees, customers, and stakeholders understand the critical role these teams play in developing the digital solutions that solve customer challenges and shape the future of our business.

This position requires someone who can quickly understand technical concepts, connect business strategy to technology outcomes, and create impactful communications that elevate the work of software engineering teams and executive leaders.

What You Will Do

Strategic Storytelling & Content Development

  • Develop compelling narratives that connect digital initiatives to business outcomes and enterprise strategy.

  • Modernize communication formats, styles, and delivery methods to increase engagement and effectiveness.

  • Translate complex technical concepts into clear, compelling, and accessible stories for a broad range of audiences.

  • Create executive presentations, talking points, speeches, leadership messaging, and strategic communication materials.

  • Develop content that highlights innovation, engineering achievements, and digital transformation initiatives across Cat Digital.

Internal Communications

  • Create, manage, and deploy internal communications across a variety of channels, including employee newsletters, Viva Engage, SharePoint, leadership messages, presentations, and organizational updates.

  • Partner with stakeholders across Cat Digital and the enterprise to identify and amplify stories that support organizational priorities.

  • Support communications planning and change management activities associated with new technologies, digital initiatives, and organizational priorities.

  • Ensure communications align with business objectives and reinforce Caterpillar's digital strategy.

External Communications

  • Develop external communications in partnership with Caterpillar's media and communications teams, including:

  • Press releases

  • Executive talking points

  • Media statements

  • Conference and panel materials

  • Thought leadership content

  • Support executive visibility initiatives and help position Cat Digital leaders as industry voices on topics related to technology, AI, and digital transformation.

  • Manage communications review and approval processes with Legal, Brand, and cross-functional stakeholders.

Executive Partnership & Communications Advisory

  • Serve as the communications advisor for three senior leaders responsible for leading the AI & Analytics, Digital Applications, and Digital Platforms teams in Caterpillar’s Cat Digital division.

  • Develop communication strategies that support executive priorities and organizational objectives.

  • Provide counsel on messaging, communication risks, stakeholder considerations, and organizational impact.

  • Manage communication priorities, workflows, timelines, and deliverables across multiple stakeholders.

What You Will Have

Presentation Development & Communication

  • Strong writing skills and the ability to distill complex information and create a clear, compelling narrative.

  • Experience using tools such as PowerPoint, Canva, Adobe Express, or similar platforms to support storytelling and executive communications.

  • Strong understanding of visual storytelling principles and how to effectively communicate ideas through presentations and digital content.

  • Technology Curiosity & Business Acumen

  • Ability to quickly learn and understand technical concepts related to software engineering, analytics, artificial intelligence, applications, digital platforms, and emerging technologies.

  • Strong curiosity and willingness to ask thoughtful questions to fully understand business and technical objectives.

  • Ability to connect technical work to broader business outcomes and strategic goals.

Executive Partnership

  • Executive presence and the ability to confidently support senior leaders.

  • Strong judgment and discretion when handling sensitive or confidential information.

  • Experience developing executive messaging, presentations, and leadership communications.

Communication & Influence

  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.

  • Ability to collaborate effectively across multiple functions and organizational levels.

  • Strong influencing skills and the ability to gain alignment without direct authority.

  • Ability to simplify complex information and tailor messaging for diverse audiences.

Initiative & Innovation

  • Proactive mindset with the ability to identify needs, anticipate challenges, and work independently.

  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and thrive in a fast-paced environment.

  • Experience leveraging AI tools and emerging technologies to improve productivity, efficiency, content creation, and research.

What Will Set You Apart

  • Bachelor's degree in Communications, Marketing, Journalism, Public Relations, Business, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

  • Five or more years of experience in Communications, Public Relations, Executive Communications, or a related field.

  • Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple stakeholders, priorities, and deadlines.

  • Proven ability to translate highly technical concepts into meaningful business narratives for non-technical audiences. Experience supporting technology, software engineering, analytics, AI, digital products, or digital transformation is preferred.

  • Experience supporting both internal and external communications (executive communications, thought leadership initiatives, speaking engagements, media opportunities).

  • Familiarity with generative AI tools and prompting techniques used for research, content creation, and communications planning.

  • Experience working with global teams and stakeholders across multiple regions is preferred.

  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and navigate sensitive business information.

Why Join Us

  • Help shape how Caterpillar communicates its digital acceleration story.

  • Be part of a team helping redefine what the future of heavy industry looks like through technology, data, automation, and AI.

  • Partner directly with senior leaders driving advanced technology at Caterpillar.

  • Influence executive messaging, enterprise storytelling, and strategic communications initiatives.

  • Gain exposure to emerging technologies and industry-leading digital innovation efforts.

Additional Information

  • Preferred Location: Dallas, TX

  • Additional Consideration: Peoria, IL or Chicago, IL

  • Relocation assistance is available for those who qualify.

  • Sponsorship is not available for this position.

  • This position will support leaders and teams across the AI & Analytics, Digital Applications, and Digital Platforms organizations within the Cat Digital division at Caterpillar.

  • Travel up to 25%

Summary Pay Range:

$112,710.00 - $169,060.00

Compensation and benefits offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, job level, market location, job-related knowledge, skills, individual performance and experience. Please note that salary is only one component of total compensation at Caterpillar.

title: Program Manager, Hub Delivery - Quality
description:
Job Overview
As an L4 Program Manager for Hub Delivery, you will support delivery operations, monitor hub performance metrics, and ensure quality standards are met across delivery networks. You will work closely with hub teams and delivery partners to identify and resolve operational issues while maintaining clear communication channels with stakeholders to ensure successful package delivery.

*This role is not virtual and does require you to be local to Austin, Texas
**This role will be either Front Half or Back Half based


Key job responsibilities
Execute components of Hub Delivery to support successful package delivery operations

Implement established hub delivery playbooks and standard operating procedures

Monitor hub performance metrics and identify opportunities to improve delivery efficiency

Review delivery associate interactions to ensure quality standards and correct tagging in hub systems

Track and report on key delivery performance indicators including hub resolution times, save rates, and quality scores

Identify and escalate systemic hub delivery issues to appropriate Senior Program Managers

Provide Day 1 onboarding support to new hub team members to ensure quality standards are maintained

Identify early delivery disruptions to mitigate failures before they impact customer promise dates

Coordinate partner disruption communications between hubs and delivery partners to maintain transparency and set expectations

Create and maintain WBR/DBR bridges for hub delivery reporting purposes

Troubleshoot hub delivery issues in real-time to minimize customer impact and maintain delivery SLAs

Collaborate with internal hub teams and delivery partners to optimize resource allocation for successful deliveries

Support risk identification and mitigation efforts across the hub delivery network

Communicate regularly with hub managers and stakeholders to provide updates on delivery program status

A day in the life
Support hub teams in maintaining Hub Delivery's operating model

Follow established hub delivery practices and playbooks to ensure consistent execution across delivery networks

Identify and report redundant delivery efforts that could be streamlined within the hub system

Monitor for scale blockers and parity gaps across Hub Delivery

Execute assigned hub delivery tasks and projects with guidance from senior team members

Support special hub delivery projects from documentation to deployment

Review quality of hub team interactions and provide coaching to delivery team members

Generate and distribute hub performance reports to track delivery program health

Respond to and troubleshoot delivery issues at hubs as they arise

Coordinate with last-mile delivery teams to ensure smooth handoffs from hubs

title: Sähköasentaja teollisuuteen Kajaaniin
description:
Sähköasentaja teollisuuteen
Etsimme asiakkaallemme Kajaaniin osaavia ja motivoituneita sähköasentajia työskentelemään vaativissa teollisuuden sähköasennuskohteissa. Työkohteet painottuvat moderneihin teollisuusympäristöihin, kuten datakeskuksiin, tuotantolaitoksiin ja muihin teknisesti vaativiin projekteihin. Jos haluat työskennellä kasvavalla toimialalla, kehittää osaamistasi suurissa teollisuushankkeissa ja olla mukana rakentamassa tulevaisuuden infrastruktuuria, tämä tehtävä voi olla juuri sinulle. Työt alkavat sopimuksen mukaan lähiaikoina ja osaaville tekijöille on tarjolla mahdollisuus pitkäaikaiseen työsuhteeseen.

Työtehtävät:
Työskentelet monipuolisissa teollisuuden sähköasennuskohteissa Kajaanin alueella. Päivittäisiin työtehtäviisi kuuluvat kaapelihyllyjen ja kaapelireittien asennukset, erilaisten sähkökaapelointien toteuttaminen sekä sähkökeskusten, kojeiden ja sähkölaitteiden asennus ja kytkennät. Osallistut myös sähköjärjestelmien mittauksiin, käyttöönottoihin ja toimintakokeisiin sekä vikojen paikantamiseen ja tarvittaviin huolto- ja kunnossapitotöihin. Työskentelet osana ammattitaitoista projektitiimiä varmistaen, että kaikki asennukset toteutetaan turvallisesti, laadukkaasti ja voimassa olevien määräysten mukaisesti. Monipuoliset projektit tarjoavat mahdollisuuden kartuttaa kokemusta nykyaikaisista teollisuusympäristöistä ja vaativista sähköasennuksista.

Odotamme:
Toivomme sinulta sähköalan koulutusta sekä aiempaa kokemusta sähköasennuksista. Kokemus teollisuuden sähköasennuksista, datakeskuksista, automaatioasennuksista tai vastaavista vaativista kohteista katsotaan eduksi, mutta ennen kaikkea arvostamme halua oppia uutta ja kehittää omaa osaamistasi. Työskentelet sujuvasti sekä itsenäisesti että osana työryhmää ja pystyt toimimaan joustavasti muuttuvissa työtilanteissa. Edellytämme huolellista työotetta, vastuullisuutta sekä sitoutumista turvallisiin työtapoihin. Voimassa oleva työturvallisuus- ja sähköturvallisuuskortti katsotaan tehtävässä eduksi.

Tarjoamme:
Tarjoamme sinulle mahdollisuuden työskennellä mielenkiintoisissa ja pitkäkestoisissa teollisuuden sähköasennusprojekteissa vakaassa työympäristössä. Pääset mukaan nykyaikaisiin datakeskus- ja teollisuushankkeisiin, joissa voit kehittää ammattitaitoasi ja kartuttaa arvokasta kokemusta tulevaisuuden teknologioiden parissa. Saat käyttöösi asianmukaiset työvälineet, ammattitaitoisen työyhteisön tuen sekä kilpailukykyisen palkkauksen osaamisesi mukaisesti. Hyvälle tekijälle tarjoamme mahdollisuuden pitkäaikaiseen työsuhteeseen ja jatkuvaan ammatilliseen kehittymiseen monipuolisten työtehtävien parissa.

Palkkaus:
Palkka määräytyy sähköistys- ja sähköasennusalan TES:n mukaan. Lopullinen palkka sovitaan osaamisen, kokemuksen ja tehtävän vaativuuden perusteella. Palkkataso sijoittuu noin 15,50-21,35 €/h välille.

title: Engineer 3, Network Engineering - SDWAN
description:
Comcast Business offers a suite of Connectivity, Communications, Networking, Cybersecurity, Wireless, and Managed Solutions to help global organizations of all sizes prepare for what’s next. Powered by the nation’s largest Gig-speed broadband network and backed by 24/7 customer support, Comcast Business is the nation’s largest technology provider to small businesses and one of the leading service providers to the Enterprise market. Comcast Business has been consistently recognized by industry analysts and associations as a leader and innovator, and one of the fastest growing providers of Ethernet services.

Job Summary

The Engineer 3, Network Engineering - Software Defined Networking (SD-WAN) is responsible for supporting and troubleshooting SD-WAN services for Comcast Business mid-market customers. This role serves as a technical escalation point for service assurance, change requests, and incident resolution, ensuring customer networks remain stable and operational. The engineer will work closely with internal operations teams, equipment vendors, and field resources to diagnose issues, resolve underlay circuit concerns, and coordinate hardware replacement activities when necessary.

The ideal candidate will possess strong SD-WAN expertise, hands-on troubleshooting experience, and a solid understanding of WAN and LAN technologies.

Job Description

BEFORE YOU APPLY

  • Location: CO - Denver, 8000 E Iliff Ave ; IL - Naperville, 1415 W Diehl Rd Ste 5 ; TX - Plano, 7900 Windrose Avenue 8th Floor

  • Onsite Requirement: 4 days per week

  • Must live within 50 miles of the office or self-relocate

  • No relocation assistance available

  • Candidates must be authorized to work in the U.S. without current or future employer sponsorship

  • Comcast will not provide employment visa sponsorship or immigration-related support for this position

Responsibilities:

  • Provide advanced support and troubleshooting for SD-WAN environments serving mid-market business customers.
  • Diagnose and resolve service-impacting incidents related to SD-WAN overlays, underlay circuits, routing, and connectivity.
  • Perform service assurance activities, including customer change requests and network modifications.
  • Troubleshoot WAN and LAN network issues across customer environments.
  • Serve as a technical escalation resource for complex networking issues.
  • Work closely with cross-functional teams to coordinate hardware replacements and network restoration efforts.
  • Monitor network performance and proactively identify service degradation or potential outages.
  • Document troubleshooting activities, resolutions, and network configurations.
  • Collaborate with vendors and internal support teams to resolve equipment and circuit-related issues.
  • Participate in after-hours, weekend, holiday, and on-call support as required.
  • Consistent exercise of independent judgment and discretion in matters of significance.
  • Regular, consistent and punctual attendance. Must be able to work nights and weekends, variable schedule(s) as necessary.
  • Other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree and/or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Strong experience supporting and troubleshooting SD-WAN solutions.
  • Hands-on experience with Versa SD-WAN platforms and associated technologies.
  • Strong knowledge of WAN, LAN, routing, switching, and IP networking fundamentals.
  • Experience troubleshooting underlay circuit connectivity issues.
  • Ability to analyze network incidents and drive timely resolution.
  • Strong communication and customer-facing troubleshooting skills.
  • Experience supporting business customer network environments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting service provider, managed network, or enterprise networking environments.
  • Knowledge of Ethernet, MPLS, DIA, broadband, and other WAN transport technologies.
  • Familiarity with network monitoring and performance management tools.
  • Industry certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, Versa, or equivalent networking certifications.

Employees at all levels are expected to:

  • Own the customer experience think and act in ways that put our customers first, give them seamless digital options at every touchpoint, and make them promoters of our products and services.
  • Know your stuff be enthusiastic learners, users and advocates of our game-changing technology, products and services, especially our digital tools and experiences.
  • Win as a team make big things happen by working together and being open to new ideas.
  • Be an active part of the Net Promoter System a way of working that brings more employee and customer feedback into the company by joining huddles, making call backs and helping us elevate opportunities to do better for our customers.
  • Drive results and growth.
  • Support a culture of inclusion in how you work and lead.
  • Do what's right for each other, our customers, investors and our communities.

title: Corporate & Institutional Banking Undergraduate Intern – Commercial & Corporate Banking (East)

At PNC, our people are our greatest differentiator and competitive advantage in the markets we serve. We are all united in delivering the best experience for our customers. We work together each day to foster an inclusive workplace culture where all of our employees feel respected, valued and have an opportunity to contribute to the company’s success. As an Intern within PNC's Commercial and Corporate Banking organization, you will be based within the PNC footprint.PNC is an in-office company that fosters a supportive culture where employees can thrive and achieve balance. We encourage candidates to connect with their recruiter and hiring manager to understand workplace expectations and ensure the role aligns with their goals.PNC will not provide sponsorship for employment visas or participate in STEM OPT for this position.

Job Description

As a PNC Intern, you will participate in a "best-in-class" internship program. During this 10-week program, you will have the opportunity to gain exposure to a specific line of business, expand the tools you need to launch your career and complement your education with real-world job experience.

Corporate & Institutional Banking (C&IB) offers strategic insight and financial solutions for businesses, municipalities and nonprofits throughout the U.S. Working in C&IB provides you the opportunity to be exposed to multiple disciplines of banking, enabling you to hone your financial and client-facing skills across many industries and develop deep understanding of PNC’s product suite.

As a Commercial & Corporate Banking intern, your primary role will be to support experienced bankers in their engagement with PNC’s client base. The program enables you to observe and explore advising, managing, and servicing customer relationships in a variety of business segments, including:

  • Commercial Banking – Serves and advises companies with annual revenues between $20 million and $100 million.

  • Corporate Banking – Serves and advises companies with annual revenue in excess of $100 million.

  • Healthcare– Serves and advises for-profit and not-for-profit healthcare and healthcare related companies.

  • Specialty Industries - Serves and advises businesses and organizations in specific industries such as Food and Beverage, Technology, Chemicals and Plastics, HealthSI, and more.

  • Public Finance – Serves and advises local or major government entities, higher education institutions and not-for-profits.

  • Credit Products Group – Structures loans, underwrites transactions, and manages a loan portfolio for various segments including Corporate Banking, Diversified Industries Group, Public Finance and Financial Institutions Group, etc.

Interns will not only support a variety of businesses at PNC, but also a growing national franchise. While an intern, you will cover and support a specific region and will sit in one of PNC’s hub locations, which may include but are not limited to:

  • Atlanta, GA, Chicago, IL, Cincinnati, OH, Cleveland, OH, Philadelphia, PA, Pittsburgh, PA, Troy, MI, and Washington DC

title: Tuntiopettaja (pt), äidinkieli ja kirjallisuus ja S2
description:
Gradia-lukioissa olet osa Suomen suurimpiin kuuluvaa lukioyhteisöä. Tuntiopettajan tehtäviin kuuluu oman oppiaineen opetussuunnitelman mukaisen luokka- ja verkko-opetuksen lisäksi opiskelijoiden ohjaustehtäviä. Tuntiopettaja suunnittelee ja kehittää opetustaan itsenäisesti ja osana aineryhmän opettajatiimiä. Tuntiopettaja osallistuu ylioppilaskirjoituksiin liittyviin tehtäviin sekä koulun suunnittelu-, arviointi- ja kehittämistyöhön sekä sidosryhmäyhteistyöhön ja kodin ja koulun väliseen yhteistyöhön.

Toimimme kahdella kampuksella Jyväskylän keskustan kupeessa. Tehtävän ensisijainen sijoituskoulu palvelussuhteen alkaessa on Jyväskylän aikuislukio. Tehtävä painottuu aikuislukiossa järjestettävän aikuisten perusopetuksen suomi toisena kielenä -ryhmien opetukseen, mutta siihen voi sisältyä myös äidinkielen ja kirjallisuuden opetusta.

Tehtävässä edellytetään pedagogisten menetelmien ja välineiden hallintaa, valmiutta eri-ikäisten ja -taustaisten opiskelijoiden kohtaamiseen, hyviä vuorovaikutus- ja työyhteisötaitoja sekä kehittävää työotetta ja valmiutta työn kehittämiseen. Eduksi voidaan katsoa opetusteknologian ja verkkopedagogiikan osaaminen.

Etsimme yhteisöömme Sinua, joka työskentelet arvojemme mukaisesti:
-arvostaen,
-rohkeasti,
-vastuullisesti,
-yhdessä.

Tarjoamme sinulle
- mukavan työyhteisön ja tukea työssä onnistumiseen
- mahdollisuuksia oman osaamisen kehittämiseen
- kattavat työterveyspalvelut Terveystalossa
- vuotuisen liikunta-, kulttuuri- ja hyvinvointiedun, ryhmäliikuntatunteja ja oman kuntosalin käyttömahdollisuuden
- kuntovalmentajan palvelut
- edullisen henkilökuntalounaan opiskelijaravintoloissamme
- alennuksen Jyväskylän liikenteen Linkki-kuukausilipusta

Kelpoisuusvaatimuksena tehtävään on asetuksen 986/1998 10 § mukainen aineenopettajan kelpoisuus. Palkka ja palvelussuhteen ehdot määräytyvät kunta-alan opetushenkilöstön virka- ja työehtosopimuksen OVTES Osio B liite 3 mukaan. Tehtävään kelpoisen, kokoaikaisen tuntiopettajan tehtäväkohtainen palkka on 3531,75 euroa/kk, jonka lisäksi maksetaan olennaisen työkokemuksen pituuteen perustuvaa vuosisidonnaista lisää enintään 1086,28 euroa/kk. Lisäksi maksetaan rekrytointilisää 111,32 euroa/kk. Lisäksi kaikissa tehtävissämme on mahdollisuus enintään 10 % henkilökohtaiseen lisään. Tehtävän työaika on arviolta 14-18 vuosiviikkotuntia (opetusvelvollisuuteen ja kokoaikaiseen, tehtäväkohtaiseen palkkaan vaadittavat tunnit ovat 18).

Tehtävässä noudatetaan opetusvelvollisuustyöaikaa. Tehtävässä on neljän (4) kuukauden koeaika. Valitun on ennen tehtävän vastaanottamista esitettävä lain 504/2002 mukainen lasten kanssa työskentelevän rikostaustan selvittämiseksi tarpeellinen rikosrekisteriote, joka ei saa olla 6 kk vanhempi.

Odotamme hakemustasi sähköisesti Kuntarekry.fi-järjestelmän kautta viimeistään 20.8.2026 klo 15.00 mennessä.

Haastattelut järjestetään tiistaina 25.8.2026. Tähän tehtävään hakeneiden joukosta voidaan täyttää myös lukuvuonna 2026-2027 mahdollisesti tarvittavia määräaikaisia sijaisuuksia. Hakijoita pyydetään hakemuksessaan ilmoittamaan myös, ovatko tehtävän lisäksi kiinnostuneita mahdollisista määräaikaisista tehtävistä.

Tule tekemään astetta parempaa tulevaisuutta!

title: Head of Contracting
description:
Why loveholidays?
At loveholidays - we trailblaze together. We’re on a mission to open the world to everyone, giving our customers’ unlimited choice, unmatched ease and unmissable value for their next getaway. Our team is the driving force behind our role as our customers’ personal holiday expert - the smart way to get away.

We’re using progressive tech to drive cutting-edge innovation and open the world to everyone. Within our Commercial and Support teams, you'll find a place to accelerate your growth by actively seeking learning opportunities and carving your own path. You'll create impact for our future by owning projects and shaping the business strategy to reach shared goals, all within our enhanced international community of collaborative and passionate teams.


About the team:

The Land Supply team is a central driver of loveholidays’ success. We are responsible for sourcing all of the bookable land products in our marketplace. Our mission is to secure the broadest range of inventory at the most competitive rates, availability & customer experience quality. We bridge the gap between data-driven yield management and long-term relationship building. As we grow towards our vision of becoming the global leader in package holidays, we are scaling directly contracted inventory and this team is leading that evolution.

The impact you’ll have:

In this role, you will primarily lead our direct contracting activity across key assigned destinations, with the opportunity to expand into other geographies over time. You will play a critical role not just in direct contracting with hoteliers on behalf of loveholidays, but will contribute strongly to the design of a best-in-class sourcing strategy for our future growth.

Ideally, you will be based within your designated region with strong local market connections. You will be our primary regional presence, leveraging your industry relationships to ensure loveholidays is a preferred partner for major hotel chains and DMCs. You will turn market insights into a sustainable commercial advantage, ensuring our diverse, international customer base always has access to the best rates and exclusive offers.

Your day-to-day:

  • Strategic Portfolio Growth: Define and implement the sourcing strategy, establishing loveholidays as a leader through a direct-contracting model.

  • Relationship Management: Serve as the lead contact for major hotel chains and DMCs, fostering long-term, mutually beneficial partnerships.

  • Commercial Negotiation: Secure market-leading rates, availability and exclusive value-adds that distinguish our brand in all markets - with a particular focus on UK + DE customers.

  • Market Agility: Proactively secure inventory and special offers during peak seasons to ensure we remain the first choice for customers throughout the year.

  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Partner with Inventory, Yield, and Marketing teams to ensure our supply aligns with demand and our top deals receive high visibility on our platform.

  • Operational Excellence: Manage the end-to-end contracting process, ensuring all agreements are finalized and loaded efficiently.

  • Market Analysis: Maintain a constant pulse on the industry to ensure our pricing and product offering remain highly competitive.

Your skillset:

  • Commercial Expert: You have a strong track record in purchasing within the travel sector and a deep understanding of commercial performance.

  • Strong Industry Network: You possess an extensive list of established contacts across hotel chains and DMCs.

  • Linguistic Fluency: You are professionally fluent in English, capable of leading complex discussions in both languages.

  • Technical Proficiency: You have hands-on experience with the Channel Managers commonly used across Spain and Portugal

  • Adaptable & Driven: You work well in fast-paced environments and are motivated by achieving ambitious growth targets.

Desirable:

  • Experience in a high-growth travel or OTA environment.

The interview journey:

  1. Intro to loveholidays with the Talent Acquisition Team – 30 mins

  2. 1st stage with the Contracting Team – 45 mins

  3. 2nd stage Meet with Commercial Supply Director - 60 mins

  4. Final stage with CMO or VP Land – 45 mins

Perks of joining us:

  • Company pension contributions at 5%.

  • Individualised training budget for you to learn on the job and level yourself up.

  • Discounted holidays for you, your family and friends.

  • 25 days of holidays per annum (plus 8 public holidays) increases by 1 day for every second year of service, up to a maximum 30 days per annum.

  • Ability to buy and sell annual leave.

  • Cycle to work scheme, season ticket loan and eye care vouchers.

At loveholidays, we focus on developing an inclusive culture and environment that encourages personal growth and collective success. Each individual offers unique perspectives and ideas that increase the diversity and effectiveness of our teams. And we value the insight and potential you could bring on our continued journey.

Team members operate at the forefront of AI, collaborating directly with model builders with unprecedented speed. Join us to work on cutting-edge projects and shape the future of AI in a fast-paced, collaborative, and impactful environment.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

Canada: $182000 - $186000 (CAD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits

Learn more about benefits at Google.
  • Design and scale secure infrastructure on Google Cloud Platform (GCP) that powers the entire generative AI agent lifecycle, empowering developers to seamlessly build, evaluate, deploy, monitor, and optimize agents.

title: Part-time Chaplain - Cushing OK
description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!
We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

Please Note: While assigned hours are generally consistent from week to week, there are no guaranteed minimal hours and positional needs will vary depending on Chaplain availability and Client requirements.

Cushing, Drumright, and Chandler area - likely 4 hours a week

Position Summary

Chaplains are the frontline staff fulfilling the mission and Christian ministry of MCHAP, by using their gifts and talents to serve company employees and their immediate families.

Essential Functions and Responsibilities
• Serves as a messenger and conveyor of faith, mission, and purpose.
• Interacts with companies, their employees, and the community in a manner that exhibits character through personal and spiritual disciplines.

Ministry

• Makes regular visits to company worksites (usually weekly) to interact with employees and build relationships of trust and friendship motivated by Christian faith.

• Visits employees or immediate family members wherever care can be expressed and help given: hospitals, nursing homes, funeral homes, family residences, or other sites.

• May provide confidential pastoral discussions for problem issues of employees and their immediate family members including, but not limited to family matters, divorce, serious illness, care of aging parents, death and grief recovery, parenting, financial situations that may include debt discussions, budgeting, and other life issues related to financial stress, as well as any other personal issues. Provides referral service and acts as coordinator for specialized assistance to employees and/or immediate family members with specific needs.

• May assist in the planning, conduct or attend funerals for employees or immediate family members, including follow-up support and encouragement to immediate family members during the grief period.

• May make jail visits to employees and immediate family members.

• Works with companies to serve notifications of death and serious injuries to families and other employees, encouraging those impacted by various tragedies.

• May provide post-termination care for laid-off or terminated employees in order to foster a smooth transition to another work environment.

• May facilitate, but not lead, spiritual enrichment activities, as an employee-sponsored and led activity will usually be more fruitful than a chaplain led event.

• Provides, as appropriate/requested, literature and other resources to assist company employees with life issues.

• Represents companies to clients/customers where it would be appropriate to ministry services involved (i.e., serious illness, accidents, traumatic events, and funerals).

• Participates in new employee orientation to explain the Employee Care Service and the role of the Chaplain Team.

• With Executive Director of Operations (EDO) permission, responds positively and assertively to other duties and services requested by executive leadership of companies, within the scope of the Letter of Agreement between MCHAP Chaplains and the company.

Requirements
1. Has ability to work as member of interdisciplinary group and in an interfaith setting. Possesses ability to accept different lifestyles, cultures, beliefs, and values.

2. Skills to effectively listen and interact with clients, employees, and their families. Skills to deliver community presentations. Skills to deal effectively with family members and staff under stressful circumstances. High regard for the dignity and worth of clients, employees and their families. Skills to cope with stressful situations and able to document accurately according to standards.

3. Spiritual maturity and commitment to a Christian lifestyle and to MCHAPs Ministry values. Incorporates Christian values and beliefs in day-to-day activities and in the performance of job duties. Has a fundamental understanding of the Holy Bible and its proper application. Attests to a saving faith in Jesus Christ and actively participates in a biblically based church.

4. Demonstrated ability to interact professionally with diplomacy, patience, and courtesy with diverse groups; ability to establish and maintain effective and cooperative working relationships while providing exceptional customer service. Ability to make administrative and procedural decisions and judgments on sensitive, confidential issues.

5. Demonstrated excellent oral and written communication skills to communicate and interact effectively with leadership, colleagues, employees, and families. Ability to maintain emotional stability to cope with human suffering, emergencies, and other stresses.

6. Demonstrated skill in analyzing information to define and follow up on problems or objectives. Ability to identify solutions and solve problems. Demonstrated skill in interpreting policy and procedures related to the position and keeping others informed.

7. Demonstrated computer proficiency using Google Suites, Microsoft Office, or other equivalent software, internet, email messaging, and web-based software applications. Ability to understand and learn new technology programs.

8. Must have active state driver’s license and state minimum auto insurance (state(s) where servicing clients).

Conditions of Employment
Must pass a pre-employment background check.

Work Environment
This is a remote position in the field, and the work environment is dependent upon the clients’ worksite. Work environments can include manufacturing, hospitals, office buildings, and funeral homes with differing levels of temperature, noise, and light exposure.

title: Senior AI Engineer (m/f/d)
description:

Commercial Pricing Landscape is a service facade that unifies the complex process of insurance policies calculations under one common API. This is the central system for calculations, which will be used by other customer applications that collect information for insurance policies.

Here we convert a large amount of data, develop the convenient API, orchestrate the distributed tasks, proceed with versioning of parameters and implement the calculators that need to perform on large amounts of data at lightning speed.

Stack of the Project: Java 25, Kotlin 2.3, Spring Boot 4, Spring Security, PostgreSQL, Spring Data JDBC, Flyway, Kafka, RESTful API, Maven, MS Azure, Docker, Kubernetes on the Backend. And, Angular 17, NGRx, NodeJS, Fastify on the Frontend.

Candidates are not expected to have worked with every technology listed; solid hands-on experience with several, and the aptitude to pick up the rest, is what matters.

What you do

  • Implementing large, complex software applications based on RESTful and Kafka-based event-driven microservices with Java, Kotlin, Spring, and Junit.

  • Taking part in making technical discussions within the team for continuous product improvement.

  • Experience in implementing best architecture principles and design patterns to ensure reliability, scalability, and seamless integration across both new and existing systems, with a deep understanding of typical integration patterns and challenges.
  • Experience in working with relational databases, ability to optimize queries. Knowledge of monitoring the quality of the product, testing approaches and code validation.
  • Experience with Agile methodology for project management (SAFe is a plus). Experience as scrum master is nice to have.
  • Strong engineering fundamentals come first, but AI is not optional for us. Hands-on experience with AI coding tools such as Claude Code is required, and building with AI as a core part of the workflow is strongly preferred.

Työ tapahtuu pääsääntöisesti avustettavan kotona, harrastuksissa tai vapaa-ajalla.

Työtehtävät sisältävät hoitotoimenpiteitä (mm. letkuruokintaa), pukeutumisessa ja ruokailussa avustamista, ostoksilla, elokuvissa ja ulkoilemassa avustamista. Työ sisältää nostoja ja siirtoja, joten hyvä fyysinen kunto on työssä eduksi.

Palkkaus: Heta TES C + mahdolliset lisät.

Työ alkaa 1.9.2026.

Kyseisessä työssä työkokemus/ sopiva koulutus on eduksi , samoin eri kuntoutusalojen koulutus/ työkokemus sekä viittomien tuntemus. Työ sopii hyvin myös alasta kiinnostuneelle opiskelijalle tai osa-aikatyötä tekevälle. Työhön perehdytetään.

Tehtävä edellyttää hyvää suomen kielen taitoa ja täysi-ikäisyyttä. Avustajan toivotaan olevan avoin, positiivinen, oma-aloitteinen ja huumorintajuinen.

Työnantajalla on velvollisuus pyytää työhön valitun työntekijän rikosrekisteriote nähtäväksi, kun avustajan työtehtävään kuuluu alle 18-vuotiaiden lasten kanssa työskentely tilanteissa, joissa lapsen huoltaja ei ole läsnä (Laki lasten kanssa työskentelevien rikostaustan selvittämisestä 504/2002).

Työnantajalla on oikeus pyytää iäkkäiden ja vammaisten henkilöiden kanssa työhön valitulta työntekijältä rikosrekisteriote nähtäväksi kerran työsuhteen alkaessa (Laki sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon valvonnasta 741/2023, 28 §).

Rikosrekisteriote on salassa pidettävää tietoa ja sitä ei tule lähettää hakemuksen yhteydessä.

At BWH® Hotels, we don't just offer employment opportunities, we create opportunities to be part of something extraordinary. Job Purpose

The Network Engineer II supports, improves, and helps modernize enterprise network services across a hybrid cloud environment. This role is responsible for planning and implementing network changes, supporting secure connectivity for users and applications, and helping ensure reliable performance across data center, cloud, branch, and remote access environments.

This position requires strong hands-on enterprise networking experience, including routing, switching, firewall administration, VPN/ZTNA technologies, and cloud networking. The ideal candidate is comfortable owning work from planning through implementation, working with infrastructure and application teams, and using automation and infrastructure-as-code practices to improve consistency, reliability, and speed of delivery.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and support enterprise network solutions across hybrid cloud, data center, branch, and remote access environments.
  • Plan, test, and execute network changes with a focus on availability, security, performance, and minimal user impact.
  • Configure and troubleshoot routing, switching, firewall, VPN, and ZTNA technologies.
  • Support cloud networking services, including AWS networking components such as VPCs, security groups, load balancers, and Direct Connect.
  • Manage next-generation firewall policies, configuration standards, and rule changes in alignment with security and compliance requirements.
  • Partner with application, cloud, security, and infrastructure teams to support reliable application connectivity and integration.
  • Use infrastructure-as-code and automation tools such as Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible, Chef, or similar technologies to deploy and manage network services.
  • Monitor network performance, investigate issues, and participate in incident response and root cause analysis.
  • Create and maintain network diagrams, standards, configuration documentation, and operational procedures.
  • Support environments subject to PCI or similar compliance requirements.
  • Identify opportunities to improve resiliency, automation, monitoring, security, and operational efficiency.
  • Participate in project delivery and operational support activities as needed.

Preferred Experience and Education

  • Minimum of 4 years of hands-on experience in enterprise networking.
  • Strong working knowledge of routing, switching, firewalls, VPN, and secure access technologies.
  • Experience troubleshooting and supporting routing protocols such as BGP, OSPF, or EIGRP.
  • Experience supporting or managing next-generation firewall platforms such as Fortinet, Palo Alto, AWS Managed Firewall, or similar solutions.
  • Working knowledge of cloud networking concepts and services.
  • Experience with network monitoring, logging, or observability tools such as DataDog, Splunk, or similar platforms.
  • Ability to plan and execute network changes with appropriate testing, documentation, communication, and rollback planning.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to work across technical teams to resolve complex issues.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

Required Knowledge and Skills

  • Experience with AWS networking services, including VPCs, application load balancing, network load balancing, security groups, and Direct Connect.
  • Experience with Cloudflare networking or security services.
  • Experience with Fortinet firewall administration.
  • Experience using Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible, Chef, or similar automation tools.
  • Experience designing or supporting networks that meet or exceed PCI compliance requirements.
  • Fortinet, AWS, Cloudflare, Cisco, or related networking certifications.

Technical Skills

  • Enterprise routing and switching
  • BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, VPN, and ZTNA technologies
  • Firewall administration and network security controls
  • AWS networking services
  • Cloudflare networking or security services
  • Infrastructure as code and network automation
  • Network monitoring, logging, and troubleshooting
  • Secure application connectivity
  • PCI or regulated network environments
  • Network documentation and operational standards

This hybrid model fosters intentional collaboration, teamwork, connection, and productivity, while still providing flexibility and work life balance.
